import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

universe u

/--
OET anchor: h-b4babd684de7c112
**定义（扩展规范空间）**
设 `X` 为带有指定吸收元 `bot` 的集合，并要求存在非吸收点。
`X` 上的一个规范结构是一族扩展伪度量 `d_i: X × X → ENNReal` (i ∈ I)。
每个分量包含四个伪度量公理：自距零、对称、三角不等式、吸收元隔离。
-/
class ExtendedPseudoMetric (X : Type u) (bot : X) (d : X → X → ENNReal) where
  nonabsorbing : ∃ x : X, x ≠ bot
  dist_self : ∀ x : X, d x x = 0
  symm : ∀ x y : X, d x y = d y x
  triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d x z ≤ d x y + d y z
  isolate_bot : ∀ x ≠ bot, d x bot = ⊤

/-- 开球的定义：B_i(x_0, r) -/
def ball {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal) (x0 : X) (r : ENNReal) : Set X :=
  { x | d x x0 < r }

/-- 规范族的全分量零距关系。 -/
def GaugeZeroRelated {X I : Type} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (x y : X) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : I, d i x y = 0

/-- 规范族分离，当且仅当其全分量零距关系蕴含点相等。 -/
def IsSeparating {X I : Type} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y : X, GaugeZeroRelated d x y → x = y

/-- 规范族非分离，当且仅当它不分离。 -/
def IsNonSeparating {X I : Type} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) : Prop :=
  ¬ IsSeparating d

/--
OET anchor: h-ecdfb943b4fb8922
**引理（族零距关系的等价性）**
任意伪度量族的全分量零距关系都是等价关系。
-/
theorem gauge_zero_related_equivalence {X I : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (dist_self : ∀ i x, d i x x = 0)
    (symm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ i x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    Equivalence (GaugeZeroRelated d) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x i
    exact dist_self i x
  · intro x y hxy i
    rw [symm i]
    exact hxy i
  · intro x y z hxy hyz i
    apply le_antisymm
    · calc
        d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z := triangle i x y z
        _ = 0 := by rw [hxy i, hyz i, zero_add]
    · exact zero_le _

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.gauge_space
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Base
import Mathlib.Data.EReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

set_option linter.style.longLine false

open Set

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
**定义（有限内覆盖）**
A finite set of centers contained in `U` whose open `ε`-balls cover `U`.
-/
def InternalEpsilonNet {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) (centers : Finset X) : Prop :=
  (↑centers : Set X) ⊆ U ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ c ∈ centers, d x c < ε

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
**定义（覆盖数）**
`U` 在 `d` 下的 `ε`-内覆盖数。不存在有限内覆盖时，第二个下确界
对空证明类型取值为 `⊤`；空集由空中心集给出覆盖数 `0`。
-/
noncomputable def covering_number {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨅ (centers : Finset X) (_ : InternalEpsilonNet d ε U centers),
    (centers.card : ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
存在有限内覆盖时，覆盖数由某个有限内覆盖的中心数取得，且该中心数最小。
这将下确界实现与正文的最小值定义对应起来。
-/
theorem covering_number_attained {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (hfinite : ∃ centers : Finset X, InternalEpsilonNet d ε U centers) :
    ∃ centers : Finset X, InternalEpsilonNet d ε U centers ∧
      covering_number d ε U = (centers.card : ENNReal) ∧
      ∀ other : Finset X, InternalEpsilonNet d ε U other →
        centers.card ≤ other.card := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ centers : Finset X,
      InternalEpsilonNet d ε U centers ∧ centers.card = n := by
    obtain ⟨centers, hcenters⟩ := hfinite
    exact ⟨centers.card, centers, hcenters, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨centers, hcenters, hcard⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hmin : ∀ other : Finset X, InternalEpsilonNet d ε U other →
      centers.card ≤ other.card := by
    intro other hother
    rw [hcard]
    exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨other, hother, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨centers, hcenters, ?_, hmin⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iInf_le_of_le centers (iInf_le_of_le hcenters le_rfl)
  · apply le_iInf
    intro other
    apply le_iInf
    intro hother
    exact_mod_cast hmin other hother

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
覆盖数为无穷，当且仅当不存在有限内覆盖。
-/
theorem covering_number_eq_top_iff {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) :
    covering_number d ε U = ⊤ ↔
      ¬ ∃ centers : Finset X, InternalEpsilonNet d ε U centers := by
  constructor
  · intro htop hfinite
    obtain ⟨centers, _, hcard, _⟩ := covering_number_attained d ε U hfinite
    have hne : (centers.card : ENNReal) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _
    exact hne (hcard.symm.trans htop)
  · intro hnone
    apply top_unique
    apply le_iInf
    intro centers
    apply le_iInf
    intro hcenters
    exact False.elim (hnone ⟨centers, hcenters⟩)

/-- 非空集合的内覆盖数至少为一。 -/
theorem one_le_covering_number_of_nonempty {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) (hU : U.Nonempty) :
    (1 : ENNReal) ≤ covering_number d ε U := by
  apply le_iInf
  intro centers
  apply le_iInf
  intro hcenters
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hU
  obtain ⟨c, hc, _⟩ := hcenters.2 x hx
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨c, hc⟩))

/-- The empty set has internal covering number zero. -/
@[simp] theorem covering_number_empty {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) :
    covering_number d ε (∅ : Set X) = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hnet : InternalEpsilonNet d ε (∅ : Set X) ∅ := by
      simp [InternalEpsilonNet]
    exact iInf_le_of_le ∅ (iInf_le_of_le hnet (by simp))
  · exact bot_le

/-- Finite internal covers of two sets combine to an internal cover of their
union. -/
private theorem internal_epsilon_net_union {X : Type} [DecidableEq X]
    {d : X → X → ENNReal}
    {ε : ENNReal} {A B : Set X} {centers_a centers_b : Finset X}
    (h_a : InternalEpsilonNet d ε A centers_a)
    (h_b : InternalEpsilonNet d ε B centers_b) :
    InternalEpsilonNet d ε (A ∪ B) (centers_a ∪ centers_b) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro c hc
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hc with hc_a | hc_b
    · exact Set.mem_union_left B (h_a.1 hc_a)
    · exact Set.mem_union_right A (h_b.1 hc_b)
  · intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx_a | hx_b
    · rcases h_a.2 x hx_a with ⟨c, hc, hdist⟩
      exact ⟨c, Finset.mem_union_left centers_b hc, hdist⟩
    · rcases h_b.2 x hx_b with ⟨c, hc, hdist⟩
      exact ⟨c, Finset.mem_union_right centers_a hc, hdist⟩

/-- Internal covering number is subadditive under binary unions. -/
theorem covering_number_union_le {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) (A B : Set X) :
    covering_number d ε (A ∪ B) ≤
      covering_number d ε A + covering_number d ε B := by
  classical
  unfold covering_number
  apply ENNReal.le_iInf₂_add_iInf₂
  intro centers_a h_a centers_b h_b
  calc
    (⨅ (centers : Finset X)
        (_ : InternalEpsilonNet d ε (A ∪ B) centers),
        (centers.card : ENNReal)) ≤
        (((centers_a ∪ centers_b).card : Nat) : ENNReal) := by
      exact iInf_le_of_le (centers_a ∪ centers_b)
        (iInf_le_of_le (internal_epsilon_net_union h_a h_b) le_rfl)
    _ ≤ (centers_a.card : ENNReal) + (centers_b.card : ENNReal) := by
      exact_mod_cast Finset.card_union_le centers_a centers_b

/-- Internal covering number is subadditive under a union indexed by a finite
set. -/
theorem covering_number_bi_union_finset_le {X A : Type}
    (d : X → X → ENNReal) (ε : ENNReal) (pieces : A → Set X)
    (s : Finset A) :
    covering_number d ε (⋃ a ∈ s, pieces a) ≤
      ∑ a ∈ s, covering_number d ε (pieces a) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      have hunion :
          (⋃ b ∈ (insert a s : Finset A), pieces b) =
            pieces a ∪ ⋃ b ∈ s, pieces b := by
        ext x
        simp
      rw [hunion]
      exact (covering_number_union_le d ε (pieces a) (⋃ b ∈ s, pieces b)).trans
        (add_le_add_right ih _)

/-- Internal covering number is subadditive under a finite indexed union. -/
theorem covering_number_i_union_finite_le {X A : Type} [Fintype A]
    (d : X → X → ENNReal) (ε : ENNReal) (pieces : A → Set X) :
    covering_number d ε (⋃ a : A, pieces a) ≤
      ∑ a : A, covering_number d ε (pieces a) := by
  classical
  simpa using
    covering_number_bi_union_finset_le d ε pieces (Finset.univ : Finset A)

/-- 对 ENNReal 声明对数函数（约定 log2(⊤) = ⊤, log2(0) = ⊥ 即 -∞） -/
noncomputable def log2_ereal (x : ENNReal) : EReal :=
  if x = 0 then ⊥
  else if x = ⊤ then ⊤
  else ↑(Real.logb 2 x.toReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
**定义（度量熵）**
基于覆盖数定义度量熵。
-/
noncomputable def metric_entropy {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) : EReal :=
  log2_ereal (covering_number d ε U)

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
非空集合的度量熵非负，允许取正无穷。
-/
theorem metric_entropy_nonneg {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) (hU : U.Nonempty) :
    (0 : EReal) ≤ metric_entropy d ε U := by
  have hcover := one_le_covering_number_of_nonempty d ε U hU
  have hzero : covering_number d ε U ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hcover)
  by_cases htop : covering_number d ε U = ⊤
  · simp [metric_entropy, log2_ereal, htop]
  · simp only [metric_entropy, log2_ereal, if_neg hzero, if_neg htop]
    apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
    apply Real.logb_nonneg one_lt_two
    simpa using ENNReal.toReal_mono htop hcover

/-- 空集熵遵循正文约定，等于负无穷。 -/
@[simp] theorem metric_entropy_empty {X : Type} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ε : ENNReal) : metric_entropy d ε (∅ : Set X) = ⊥ := by
  simp [metric_entropy, log2_ereal]

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
**定义（子族复合伪度量）**
The composite pseudometric associated to a gauge subfamily.
-/
noncomputable def subfamily_pseudometric
    {X I : Type} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (J : Set I) : X → X → ENNReal :=
  fun x y => ⨆ j : {j // j ∈ J}, d j.1 x y

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
**定义（子族复合伪度量）**
A nonempty subfamily of component extended pseudometrics again defines an
extended pseudometric by pointwise supremum.
-/
theorem subfamily_pseudometric_is_extended
    {X I : Type} {bot : X} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (J : Set I) (hJ : J.Nonempty)
    (hd : ∀ i : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i)) :
    ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (subfamily_pseudometric d J) := by
  rcases hJ with ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩
  refine
    { nonabsorbing := (hd j₀).nonabsorbing
      dist_self := ?_
      symm := ?_
      triangle := ?_
      isolate_bot := ?_ }
  · intro x
    apply le_antisymm
    · dsimp [subfamily_pseudometric]
      apply iSup_le
      intro j
      rw [(hd j.1).dist_self]
    · exact zero_le _
  · intro x y
    dsimp [subfamily_pseudometric]
    congr with j
    exact (hd j.1).symm x y
  · intro x y z
    dsimp [subfamily_pseudometric]
    apply iSup_le
    intro j
    exact ((hd j.1).triangle x y z).trans <|
      add_le_add
        (le_iSup (fun k : {k // k ∈ J} => d k.1 x y) j)
        (le_iSup (fun k : {k // k ∈ J} => d k.1 y z) j)
  · intro x hx
    apply top_unique
    have hj : d j₀ x bot ≤ subfamily_pseudometric d J x bot :=
      le_iSup (fun k : {k // k ∈ J} => d k.1 x bot) ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩
    simpa [(hd j₀).isolate_bot x hx] using hj

/-- A singleton subfamily recovers its unique component pseudometric. -/
theorem subfamily_pseudometric_singleton
    {X I : Type} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (i : I) :
    subfamily_pseudometric d ({i} : Set I) = d i := by
  funext x y
  apply le_antisymm
  · dsimp [subfamily_pseudometric]
    apply iSup_le
    intro j
    rw [show j.1 = i from j.2]
  · exact le_iSup_of_le ⟨i, Set.mem_singleton i⟩ le_rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-65d0745eb743dfe2
**定义（子族度量熵）**
Metric entropy associated to a gauge subfamily.
-/
noncomputable def subfamily_metric_entropy
    {X I : Type} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (J : Set I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) :
    EReal :=
  log2_ereal (covering_number (subfamily_pseudometric d J) ε U)

/-- 子族度量熵直接沿用对应复合伪度量的度量熵。 -/
theorem subfamily_metric_entropy_eq_metric_entropy
    {X I : Type} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (J : Set I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) :
    subfamily_metric_entropy d J ε U = metric_entropy (subfamily_pseudometric d J) ε U := rfl

/-- 单元素子族的度量熵等于对应的单分量度量熵。 -/
theorem subfamily_metric_entropy_singleton
    {X I : Type} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) :
    subfamily_metric_entropy d ({i} : Set I) ε U = metric_entropy (d i) ε U := by
  rw [subfamily_metric_entropy_eq_metric_entropy, subfamily_pseudometric_singleton]

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.gauge_space

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

set_option linter.style.longLine false
set_option linter.style.emptyLine false

/--
OET anchor: h-57a1dc05727a3772
**定义（算子空间）**：指定吸收元 `bot`。
`Ω` 上的算子为满足 `ϕ(bot) = bot` 的函数。
-/
@[ext]
structure Operator (X : Type) (bot : X) where
  func : X → X
  preserves_bot : func bot = bot

/-- 指定 Ω 的吸收元 ⊥_Ω 为全未定义算子 -/
def bot_operator {X : Type} {bot : X} : Operator X bot :=
  ⟨fun _ => bot, rfl⟩

/-- 恒等函数保持吸收元，因而给出恒等算子。 -/
def operator_identity {X : Type} {bot : X} : Operator X bot := ⟨id, rfl⟩

/-- 算子复合保持吸收元；左侧算子在右侧算子之后作用。 -/
def operator_compose {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) : Operator X bot :=
  ⟨ϕ.func ∘ ψ.func, by simp [ψ.preserves_bot, ϕ.preserves_bot]⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-57a1dc05727a3772
算子在函数复合下构成幺半群，单位元为恒等算子。
-/
instance operator_monoid {X : Type} {bot : X} : Monoid (Operator X bot) where
  one := operator_identity
  mul := operator_compose
  mul_assoc _ _ _ := rfl
  one_mul _ := rfl
  mul_one _ := rfl

/-- 全未定义算子在复合的左侧吸收任意算子。 -/
@[simp] theorem bot_operator_mul {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕ : Operator X bot) :
    bot_operator * ϕ = bot_operator := rfl

/-- 全未定义算子在复合的右侧吸收任意算子。 -/
@[simp] theorem mul_bot_operator {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕ : Operator X bot) :
    ϕ * bot_operator = bot_operator := by
  ext x
  exact ϕ.preserves_bot

/-- 算子的定义域：不映射到吸收元 `bot` 的集合 -/
def dom {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕ : Operator X bot) : Set X :=
  { x | ϕ.func x ≠ bot }

/-- 吸收元不属于算子的定义域。 -/
@[simp] theorem bot_not_mem_dom {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕ : Operator X bot) :
    bot ∉ dom ϕ := by
  simp [dom, ϕ.preserves_bot]

/--
**像集（Image Set）**
定义算子 `ϕ` 在子集 `U ⊆ dom(ϕ)` 上的像集为 `Im(ϕ)|_U`。
当 `U = dom(ϕ)` 时简记为 `Im(ϕ)`。
-/
def operator_image {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Set X :=
  ϕ.func '' U

/-- 算子在自身定义域上的像集不含吸收元。 -/
@[simp] theorem bot_not_mem_operator_image_dom {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕ : Operator X bot) :
    bot ∉ operator_image ϕ (dom ϕ) := by
  rintro ⟨x, hx, hbot⟩
  exact hx hbot

/-- 诱导算子度量 (取上确界 ⨆) -/
noncomputable def op_dist {X : Type} {bot : X} (d : X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x : X, d (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x)

/--
OET anchor: h-91e0e3c458eb7786
**命题 #h-91e0e3c458eb7786（算子规范空间）**
若底层空间存在非吸收点，则算子空间存在非吸收算子。
-/
theorem operator_space_nonabsorbing {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (hX : ∃ x : X, x ≠ bot) :
    ∃ ϕ : Operator X bot, ϕ ≠ bot_operator := by
  rcases hX with ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨⟨id, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro h_eq
  have h_eval := congrArg (fun ϕ : Operator X bot => ϕ.func x) h_eq
  exact hx h_eval

/--
OET anchor: h-91e0e3c458eb7786
**命题 #h-91e0e3c458eb7786（算子规范空间）**
$d_{\mathrm{op},i}$ 是 $\mathcal{X}_{\mathrm{op}}$ 上的扩展伪度量。
-/
theorem op_dist_is_pseudo_metric {X : Type} {bot : X} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (dist_self : ∀ x : X, d x x = 0)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d x y = d y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d x z ≤ d x y + d y z)
    (dist_bot : ∀ x ≠ bot, d x bot = ⊤) :
    (∀ ϕ : Operator X bot, op_dist d ϕ ϕ = 0) ∧
    (∀ ϕ ψ : Operator X bot, op_dist d ϕ ψ = op_dist d ψ ϕ) ∧
    (∀ ϕ ψ χ : Operator X bot, op_dist d ϕ χ ≤ op_dist d ϕ ψ + op_dist d ψ χ) ∧
    (∀ ϕ : Operator X bot, ϕ ≠ bot_operator → op_dist d ϕ bot_operator = ⊤) := by
  constructor
  · -- 扩展规范空间公理 (i)
    intro ϕ
    dsimp [op_dist]
    have h : (fun x => d (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func x)) = fun x => 0 := by
      ext x
      exact dist_self (ϕ.func x)
    rw [h]
    haveI : Nonempty X := ⟨bot⟩
    exact iSup_const
  constructor
  · -- 扩展规范空间公理 (ii)
    intro ϕ ψ
    dsimp [op_dist]
    have h : (fun x => d (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x)) = (fun x => d (ψ.func x) (ϕ.func x)) := by
      ext x
      exact symm (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x)
    rw [h]
  constructor
  · -- 扩展规范空间公理 (iii)
    intro ϕ ψ χ
    dsimp [op_dist]
    -- ⨆ x, d (ϕ x) (χ x) ≤ (⨆ x, d (ϕ x) (ψ x)) + (⨆ x, d (ψ x) (χ x))
    apply iSup_le
    intro x
    have h_tri := triangle (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x) (χ.func x)
    -- ENNReal sum of sups is ≥ sup of sums
    have h1 : d (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x) ≤ ⨆ y, d (ϕ.func y) (ψ.func y) := le_iSup (fun y => d (ϕ.func y) (ψ.func y)) x
    have h2 : d (ψ.func x) (χ.func x) ≤ ⨆ y, d (ψ.func y) (χ.func y) := le_iSup (fun y => d (ψ.func y) (χ.func y)) x
    exact le_trans h_tri (add_le_add h1 h2)
  · -- 扩展规范空间公理 (iv)
    intro ϕ h_ne
    have h_exists : ∃ x, ϕ.func x ≠ bot := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      apply h_ne
      ext x
      exact h x
    rcases h_exists with ⟨x0, hx0⟩
    have h_top : d (ϕ.func x0) bot = ⊤ := dist_bot (ϕ.func x0) hx0
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    have h_le : d (ϕ.func x0) ((@bot_operator X bot).func x0) ≤ op_dist d ϕ (@bot_operator X bot) := by
      exact le_iSup (fun x => d (ϕ.func x) ((@bot_operator X bot).func x)) x0
    dsimp [bot_operator] at h_le
    rw [h_top] at h_le
    exact h_le

set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-91e0e3c458eb7786
**命题（算子规范空间，正文同形封装）**
保留正文中有限非空指标族的完整语境，并将诱导算子伪度量封装为
`ExtendedPseudoMetric` 实例所要求的全部性质。
-/
theorem operator_gauge_space_textbook
    {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ i : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i)) :
    ∀ i : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric (Operator X bot) bot_operator (op_dist (d i)) := by
  intro i
  rcases op_dist_is_pseudo_metric (d i)
      (hd i).dist_self (hd i).symm (hd i).triangle (hd i).isolate_bot with
    ⟨hself, hsymm, htriangle, hisolate⟩
  exact
    { nonabsorbing := operator_space_nonabsorbing (hd i).nonabsorbing
      dist_self := hself
      symm := hsymm
      triangle := htriangle
      isolate_bot := hisolate }

/--
OET anchor: h-038952f7c6c1d6e5
**注（定义域隔离）**
$\mathrm{dom}(\phi) \neq \mathrm{dom}(\psi) \Rightarrow d_{\mathrm{op},i}(\phi, \psi) = +\infty$。
-/
theorem op_dist_eq_top_of_dom_ne {X : Type} {bot : X} (d : X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot)
    (dist_bot : ∀ x : X, x ≠ bot → d x bot = ⊤)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d x y = d y x)
    (h_dom : dom ϕ ≠ dom ψ) :
    op_dist d ϕ ψ = ⊤ := by
  have h_exists : ∃ x, (ϕ.func x ≠ bot ∧ ψ.func x = bot) ∨ (ϕ.func x = bot ∧ ψ.func x ≠ bot) := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply h_dom
    ext x
    have hx := h x
    tauto

  rcases h_exists with ⟨x0, h1 | h2⟩
  · have h_phi_ne : ϕ.func x0 ≠ bot := h1.1
    have h_psi_eq : ψ.func x0 = bot := h1.2
    have h_d_top : d (ϕ.func x0) (ψ.func x0) = ⊤ := by
      rw [h_psi_eq]
      exact dist_bot (ϕ.func x0) h_phi_ne
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    rw [← h_d_top]
    exact le_iSup (fun x => d (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x)) x0
  · have h_phi_eq : ϕ.func x0 = bot := h2.1
    have h_psi_ne : ψ.func x0 ≠ bot := h2.2
    have h_d_top : d (ϕ.func x0) (ψ.func x0) = ⊤ := by
      rw [h_phi_eq]
      rw [symm bot (ψ.func x0)]
      exact dist_bot (ψ.func x0) h_psi_ne
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    rw [← h_d_top]
    exact le_iSup (fun x => d (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x)) x0

open scoped Classical in
/--
算子规范族分离当且仅当点空间规范族分离。
这是附录 D 中分离特化命题的通用代数核心。
-/
theorem op_dist_separating_iff {X I : Type} {bot : X} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (dist_self : ∀ i x, d i x x = 0) :
    IsSeparating d ↔ IsSeparating (fun i (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) => op_dist (d i) ϕ ψ) := by
  constructor
  · intro h_sep ϕ ψ h_eq
    have h_func_eq : ϕ.func = ψ.func := by
      ext x
      apply h_sep
      intro i
      have h_sup : op_dist (d i) ϕ ψ = 0 := h_eq i
      have h_le := le_iSup (fun x => d i (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x)) x
      rw [← op_dist, h_sup] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
    cases ϕ
    cases ψ
    congr
  · intro h_op_sep a b h_eq
    let phi_a : Operator X bot := ⟨fun x => if x = bot then bot else a, if_pos rfl⟩
    let phi_b : Operator X bot := ⟨fun x => if x = bot then bot else b, if_pos rfl⟩
    have h_phi_eq : phi_a = phi_b := by
      apply h_op_sep
      intro i
      dsimp [op_dist]
      apply le_antisymm _ (zero_le _)
      apply iSup_le
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x = bot
      · dsimp [phi_a, phi_b]
        rw [if_pos hx, if_pos hx]
        rw [dist_self i bot]
      · dsimp [phi_a, phi_b]
        rw [if_neg hx, if_neg hx]
        have hd : d i a b = 0 := h_eq i
        rw [hd]
    have h_eval : phi_a.func b = phi_b.func b := by rw [h_phi_eq]
    by_cases hb : b = bot
    · by_cases ha : a = bot
      · rw [ha, hb]
      · have h_eval_a : phi_a.func a = phi_b.func a := by rw [h_phi_eq]
        dsimp [phi_a, phi_b] at h_eval_a
        rw [if_neg ha, if_neg ha] at h_eval_a
        exact h_eval_a
    · dsimp [phi_a, phi_b] at h_eval
      rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb] at h_eval
      exact h_eval

/--
**定义（受限评估）**
$$d_{\mathrm{op},i}(\phi, \psi)\big|_U := \sup_{x \in U} d_i(\phi(x), \psi(x))$$
-/
noncomputable def restricted_eval {X : Type} {bot : X} (d : X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x ∈ U, d (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x)

/--
OET anchor: h-1c441b84eff949c6
**注（受限评估的伪度量性质与局限）**
固定同一个 `U` 时，受限评估满足前三条伪度量公理，并被全域算子距离控制；
空限制域上它不保吸收元隔离。
-/
theorem restricted_eval_basic_properties {X : Type} {bot : X} (d : X → X → ENNReal)
    (dist_self : ∀ x : X, d x x = 0)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d x y = d y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d x z ≤ d x y + d y z) :
    (∀ ϕ : Operator X bot, ∀ U : Set X, restricted_eval d ϕ ϕ U = 0) ∧
    (∀ ϕ ψ : Operator X bot, ∀ U : Set X, restricted_eval d ϕ ψ U = restricted_eval d ψ ϕ U) ∧
    (∀ ϕ ψ χ : Operator X bot, ∀ U : Set X,
      restricted_eval d ϕ χ U ≤ restricted_eval d ϕ ψ U + restricted_eval d ψ χ U) ∧
    (∀ ϕ ψ : Operator X bot, ∀ U : Set X, restricted_eval d ϕ ψ U ≤ op_dist d ϕ ψ) ∧
    (∀ ϕ : Operator X bot, restricted_eval d ϕ bot_operator ∅ = 0) := by
  constructor
  · intro ϕ U
    dsimp [restricted_eval]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply iSup_le
      intro x
      apply iSup_le
      intro _
      rw [dist_self]
    · exact zero_le _
  constructor
  · intro ϕ ψ U
    dsimp [restricted_eval]
    congr with x
    congr with _
    exact symm (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x)
  constructor
  · intro ϕ ψ χ U
    dsimp [restricted_eval]
    apply iSup_le
    intro x
    apply iSup_le
    intro hx
    have h_tri := triangle (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x) (χ.func x)
    have h1 : d (ϕ.func x) (ψ.func x) ≤ ⨆ y, ⨆ _ : y ∈ U, d (ϕ.func y) (ψ.func y) := by
      apply le_iSup_of_le x
      exact le_iSup_of_le hx le_rfl
    have h2 : d (ψ.func x) (χ.func x) ≤ ⨆ y, ⨆ _ : y ∈ U, d (ψ.func y) (χ.func y) := by
      apply le_iSup_of_le x
      exact le_iSup_of_le hx le_rfl
    exact le_trans h_tri (add_le_add h1 h2)
  constructor
  · intro ϕ ψ U
    dsimp [restricted_eval, op_dist]
    apply iSup_le
    intro x
    apply iSup_le
    intro _
    exact le_iSup (fun y => d (ϕ.func y) (ψ.func y)) x
  · intro ϕ
    dsimp [restricted_eval]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply iSup_le
      intro x
      apply iSup_le
      intro hx
      exact False.elim hx
    · exact zero_le _

/--
Internal helper for finite composition of operators.
The textbook definition is anchored in the operator-chain calculus chapter.
-/
def OperatorChain {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) : Operator X bot :=
  match ϕs with
  | [] => ⟨id, rfl⟩
  | ϕ :: tail => ⟨ϕ.func ∘ (OperatorChain tail).func, by
      -- (ϕ ∘ chain) bot = ϕ (chain bot) = ϕ bot = bot
      have h_tail : (OperatorChain tail).func bot = bot := (OperatorChain tail).preserves_bot
      simp [h_tail, ϕ.preserves_bot]⟩

/-- 既有有限复合实现等于算子幺半群中按同一顺序取的乘积。 -/
theorem operator_chain_eq_prod {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) :
    OperatorChain ϕs = ϕs.prod := by
  induction ϕs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons ϕ tail ih =>
      change operator_compose ϕ (OperatorChain tail) = ϕ * tail.prod
      rw [ih]
      rfl

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.gauge_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic


namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open Finset

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-af85899693cc8750
**定义（子集受限 Lip 矩阵）**：
`IsLipMatrix ϕ U L` 表示矩阵 L = (L_{i, j}) 是算子 ϕ 在子集 U 上的合法 Lipschitz 矩阵。
$$d_j(\phi(x), \phi(y)) \leq \sum_{i \in I} L_{i \to j} \cdot d_i(x, y)$$
这里 L i j 表示 $L_{i \to j}$。
-/
def IsLipMatrix (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
  ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ i : I, L i j * d i x y

/--
OET anchor: h-4ff5c58d71e1651f
**引理（受限 Lip 矩阵族的单调性）**
限制域缩小时，合法 Lip 矩阵族按包含关系扩大。
-/
theorem restricted_lip_matrix_family_antitone (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (hUV : U ⊆ V) :
    {L | IsLipMatrix d ϕ V L} ⊆ {L | IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L} := by
  intro L hL
  refine ⟨hUV.trans hL.1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact hL.2 x (hUV hx) y (hUV hy) j

/--
OET anchor: h-4ff5c58d71e1651f
全定义域上的合法 Lip 矩阵在任意子集上仍然合法。
-/
theorem global_lip_matrix_family_subset (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    {L | IsLipMatrix d ϕ (dom ϕ) L} ⊆ {L | IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L} :=
  restricted_lip_matrix_family_antitone d ϕ U (dom ϕ) hU

/--
OET anchor: h-af85899693cc8750
**定义（子集受限 co-Lipschitz 矩阵）**：
`IsCoLipMatrix ϕ U K` 表示矩阵 K = (K_{i, j}) 是算子 ϕ 在子集 U 上的合法 co-Lipschitz 矩阵。
$$d_j(\phi(x), \phi(y)) \geq \sum_{i \in I} K_{i \to j} \cdot d_i(x, y)$$
-/
def IsCoLipMatrix (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (K : I → I → ENNReal) : Prop :=
  U.Nonempty ∧
  U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
  ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≥ ∑ i : I, K i j * d i x y

/--
OET anchor: h-893b1d33535f7245
**引理（受限 co-Lip 矩阵族的单调性）**
限制到非空子集时，合法 co-Lip 矩阵族按包含关系扩大。
-/
theorem restricted_colip_matrix_family_antitone (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (hU_ne : U.Nonempty) (hUV : U ⊆ V) :
    {K | IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ V K} ⊆ {K | IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K} := by
  intro K hK
  refine ⟨hU_ne, hUV.trans hK.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact hK.2.2 x (hUV hx) y (hUV hy) j

/--
OET anchor: h-893b1d33535f7245
全定义域上的合法 co-Lip 矩阵在任意非空子集上仍然合法。
-/
theorem global_colip_matrix_family_subset (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hU_ne : U.Nonempty) (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    {K | IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ (dom ϕ) K} ⊆ {K | IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K} :=
  restricted_colip_matrix_family_antitone d ϕ U (dom ϕ) hU_ne hU

/--
OET anchor: h-c4369c63c86cbacf
**注（单分量情形下的标量 Lip 界）**
当指标集只有一个分量时，Lip 矩阵不等式退化为单个标量不等式。
-/
theorem single_component_lip_matrix_ineq [Subsingleton I] (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal) (i : I) (hL : IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
      d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L i i * d i x y := by
  intro x hx y hy
  rcases hL with ⟨_, hineq⟩
  have h := hineq x hx y hy i
  have hsum_eq : (∑ k : I, L k i * d k x y) = L i i * d i x y := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
    · intro k _ hk
      have hki : k = i := Subsingleton.elim k i
      exact (hk hki).elim
    · intro hi
      exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim
  simpa [hsum_eq] using h

/--
OET anchor: h-88784dcbfff0ea66
**注（co-Lip 通道退化的点对判据）**
若某个点对在输出分量上归零而在源分量上有正距离，则该 co-Lip 通道系数必须为零。
-/
theorem colip_entry_eq_zero_of_output_zero_input_pos (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal) (i j : I) (x y : X)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hout : d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0) (hin : 0 < d i x y) :
    K i j = 0 := by
  rcases hK with ⟨_, _, hineq⟩
  have hsum_le_zero : (∑ k : I, K k j * d k x y) ≤ 0 := by
    simpa [hout] using hineq x hx y hy j
  have hterm_le_sum : K i j * d i x y ≤ ∑ k : I, K k j * d k x y := by
    simpa using
      (Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (a := i)
        (f := fun k : I => K k j * d k x y)
        (by
          intro _ _
          exact zero_le _)
        (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hterm_zero : K i j * d i x y = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (le_trans hterm_le_sum hsum_le_zero) (zero_le _)
  by_contra hne
  have hpos : 0 < K i j := lt_of_le_of_ne (zero_le _) (Ne.symm hne)
  have hmul_pos : 0 < K i j * d i x y := ENNReal.mul_pos hne (ne_of_gt hin)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (by rw [hterm_zero]) hmul_pos)

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-b959b42f25710105
**命题 #h-b959b42f25710105（两个算子的点对像距扰动界，点对像距双向扰动）**
If two operators are pointwise close on `U`, then pairwise image distances for
the second are bounded by those for the first plus the two endpoint errors.
-/
theorem operator_pair_image_distance_perturbation
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (δ : I → ENNReal)
    (hdom1 : U ⊆ dom ϕ1) (hdom2 : U ⊆ dom ϕ2)
    (hclose : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ1.func z) (ϕ2.func z) ≤ δ j) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ2.func y) ≤
        d j (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) + (δ j + δ j) := by
  have _ := hdom1
  have _ := hdom2
  intro x hx y hy j
  have htri₁ :=
    (hd j).triangle (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ2.func y)
  have htri₂ :=
    (hd j).triangle (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) (ϕ2.func y)
  have hleft : d j (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ1.func x) ≤ δ j := by
    rw [(hd j).symm (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ1.func x)]
    exact hclose x hx j
  have hright : d j (ϕ1.func y) (ϕ2.func y) ≤ δ j :=
    hclose y hy j
  have hmid :
      d j (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ2.func y) ≤
        d j (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) + δ j := by
    exact le_trans htri₂ (add_le_add (le_refl _) hright)
  calc
    d j (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ2.func y)
        ≤ d j (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ1.func x) +
          d j (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ2.func y) := htri₁
    _ ≤ δ j + (d j (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) + δ j) :=
        add_le_add hleft hmid
    _ = d j (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) + (δ j + δ j) := by
        simp [add_comm, add_assoc]

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-b959b42f25710105
**命题 #h-b959b42f25710105（两个算子的点对像距扰动界，反向点对扰动）**
The symmetric pointwise closeness condition gives the reverse pairwise
perturbation bound.
-/
theorem operator_pair_image_distance_perturbation_rev
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (δ : I → ENNReal)
    (hdom1 : U ⊆ dom ϕ1) (hdom2 : U ⊆ dom ϕ2)
    (hclose : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ1.func z) (ϕ2.func z) ≤ δ j) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) ≤
        d j (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ2.func y) + (δ j + δ j) := by
  apply operator_pair_image_distance_perturbation d hd ϕ2 ϕ1 U δ hdom2 hdom1
  intro z hz j
  rw [(hd j).symm (ϕ2.func z) (ϕ1.func z)]
  exact hclose z hz j

/--
OET anchor: h-b959b42f25710105
**命题 #h-b959b42f25710105（两个算子的点对像距扰动界，Lip 上界桥接）**
A Lip certificate for the first operator gives an additive upper bound for the
second operator under pointwise perturbation.
-/
theorem operator_pair_lip_bound_of_pointwise_perturbation
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (δ : I → ENNReal)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hdom1 : U ⊆ dom ϕ1) (hdom2 : U ⊆ dom ϕ2)
    (hclose : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ1.func z) (ϕ2.func z) ≤ δ j)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d ϕ1 U L) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ2.func y) ≤
        (∑ i : I, L i j * d i x y) + (δ j + δ j) := by
  have _ := hdom1
  intro x hx y hy j
  have hpair :=
    operator_pair_image_distance_perturbation d hd ϕ1 ϕ2 U δ hdom1 hdom2 hclose
      x hx y hy j
  have hlip := hL.2 x hx y hy j
  exact le_trans hpair (add_le_add hlip (le_refl _))

/--
OET anchor: h-b959b42f25710105
**命题 #h-b959b42f25710105（两个算子的点对像距扰动界，co-Lip 下界桥接）**
A co-Lip certificate for the first operator survives as an additive-side lower
bound for the second operator under pointwise perturbation.
-/
theorem operator_pair_colip_bound_of_pointwise_perturbation
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (δ : I → ENNReal)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hdom1 : U ⊆ dom ϕ1) (hdom2 : U ⊆ dom ϕ2)
    (hclose : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ1.func z) (ϕ2.func z) ≤ δ j)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ1 U K) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      (∑ i : I, K i j * d i x y) ≤
        d j (ϕ2.func x) (ϕ2.func y) + (δ j + δ j) := by
  have _ := hdom1
  intro x hx y hy j
  have hpair :=
    operator_pair_image_distance_perturbation_rev d hd ϕ1 ϕ2 U δ hdom1 hdom2 hclose
      x hx y hy j
  have hcolip := hK.2.2 x hx y hy j
  exact le_trans hcolip hpair

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.lip_matrix

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

noncomputable section

set_option linter.style.longLine false

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open Finset

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
local instance instDecidableEqIMatrixComposition : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/-- 矩阵乘法 L2 * L1 -/
noncomputable def matrix_mul (L2 L1 : I → I → ENNReal) : I → I → ENNReal :=
  fun i j => ∑ k : I, L2 k j * L1 i k

/-- 恒等矩阵 -/
def matrix_id : I → I → ENNReal :=
  fun i j => if i = j then 1 else 0

/--
OET anchor: h-c80171fa685dc795
**推论 #h-c80171fa685dc795（有限复合的局部矩阵界）**
归纳定义的有限复合有界性：任意 n 步复合的局部矩阵界可以写成前向连乘形式。
-/
inductive RightChainLipBounded : List (Operator X bot) → Set X → (I → I → ENNReal) → Prop
  | nil (U : Set X) (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ bot) : RightChainLipBounded [] U matrix_id
  | cons (ϕ : Operator X bot) (tail_ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X)
         (L_phi L_tail : I → I → ENNReal)
         (h_tail : RightChainLipBounded tail_ϕs U L_tail)
         (h_phi : IsLipMatrix d ϕ ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func '' U) L_phi) :
         RightChainLipBounded (ϕ :: tail_ϕs) U (matrix_mul L_phi L_tail)

/--
全复合 Lip 矩阵复合（任意 n 步）。
-/
theorem right_chain_lip_matrix (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (h_bound : RightChainLipBounded d ϕs U L) :
    IsLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ϕs) U L := by
  induction h_bound with
  | nil U hU =>
    dsimp [OperatorChain, IsLipMatrix]
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      exact hU x hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      dsimp [matrix_id]
      have h_sum : (∑ i : I, (if i = j then (1 : ENNReal) else 0) * d i x y) = d j x y := by
        rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]
        have h_zero : (∑ i ∈ Finset.erase Finset.univ j, (if i = j then (1 : ENNReal) else 0) * d i x y) = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro i hi
          have h_ne : i ≠ j := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi
          rw [if_neg h_ne, zero_mul]
        rw [h_zero, add_zero, if_pos rfl, one_mul]
      rw [h_sum]
  | cons ϕ tail_ϕs U L_phi L_tail h_tail h_phi ih =>
    dsimp [OperatorChain]
    dsimp [IsLipMatrix] at h_phi ih ⊢
    rcases h_phi with ⟨h_phi_dom, h_phi_ineq⟩
    rcases ih with ⟨h_tail_dom, h_tail_ineq⟩
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      have h_tail_eval : (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x ∈ (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
      exact h_phi_dom h_tail_eval
    · intro x hx y hy j
      have h_tail_x : (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x ∈ (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
      have h_tail_y : (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y ∈ (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hy
      have step1 := h_phi_ineq ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x) h_tail_x ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y) h_tail_y j
      have step2 : ∑ k : I, L_phi k j * d k ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x) ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y) ≤ ∑ k : I, L_phi k j * (∑ i : I, L_tail i k * d i x y) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro k _
        gcongr
        exact h_tail_ineq x hx y hy k
      have step3 : ∑ k : I, L_phi k j * (∑ i : I, L_tail i k * d i x y) = ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, L_phi k j * (L_tail i k * d i x y) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      have step4 : ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, L_phi k j * (L_tail i k * d i x y) = ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (L_phi k j * L_tail i k) * d i x y := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        rw [mul_assoc]
      have step5 : ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (L_phi k j * L_tail i k) * d i x y = ∑ i : I, (∑ k : I, L_phi k j * L_tail i k) * d i x y := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      calc
        d j (ϕ.func ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x)) (ϕ.func ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y)) ≤ ∑ k : I, L_phi k j * d k ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x) ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y) := step1
        _ ≤ ∑ k : I, L_phi k j * (∑ i : I, L_tail i k * d i x y) := step2
        _ = ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, L_phi k j * (L_tail i k * d i x y) := step3
        _ = ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (L_phi k j * L_tail i k) * d i x y := step4
        _ = ∑ i : I, (∑ k : I, L_phi k j * L_tail i k) * d i x y := step5
        _ = ∑ i : I, matrix_mul L_phi L_tail i j * d i x y := rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-c80171fa685dc795
**推论 #h-c80171fa685dc795（有限复合的局部矩阵界, co-Lip 保距下限）**
-/
inductive RightChainCoLipBounded : List (Operator X bot) → Set X → (I → I → ENNReal) → Prop
  | nil (U : Set X) (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ bot) (hU_ne : U.Nonempty) : RightChainCoLipBounded [] U matrix_id
  | cons (ϕ : Operator X bot) (tail_ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X)
         (K_phi K_tail : I → I → ENNReal)
         (h_tail : RightChainCoLipBounded tail_ϕs U K_tail)
         (h_phi : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func '' U) K_phi) :
         RightChainCoLipBounded (ϕ :: tail_ϕs) U (matrix_mul K_phi K_tail)

/--
全复合 co-Lip 矩阵复合（任意 n 步）。
-/
theorem right_chain_colip_matrix (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X) (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (h_bound : RightChainCoLipBounded d ϕs U K) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ϕs) U K := by
  induction h_bound with
  | nil U hU hU_ne =>
    dsimp [OperatorChain, IsCoLipMatrix]
    constructor
    · exact hU_ne
    · constructor
      · intro x hx
        dsimp [dom]
        exact hU x hx
      · intro x hx y hy j
        dsimp [matrix_id]
        have h_sum : (∑ i : I, (if i = j then (1 : ENNReal) else 0) * d i x y) = d j x y := by
          rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)]
          have h_zero : (∑ i ∈ Finset.erase Finset.univ j, (if i = j then (1 : ENNReal) else 0) * d i x y) = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro i hi
            have h_ne : i ≠ j := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi
            rw [if_neg h_ne, zero_mul]
          rw [h_zero, add_zero, if_pos rfl, one_mul]
        rw [h_sum]
  | cons ϕ tail_ϕs U K_phi K_tail h_tail h_phi ih =>
    dsimp [OperatorChain]
    dsimp [IsCoLipMatrix] at h_phi ih ⊢
    rcases h_phi with ⟨h_phi_ne, h_phi_dom, h_phi_ineq⟩
    rcases ih with ⟨h_tail_ne, h_tail_dom, h_tail_ineq⟩
    constructor
    · exact h_tail_ne
    · constructor
      · intro x hx
        dsimp [dom]
        have h_tail_eval : (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x ∈ (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
        exact h_phi_dom h_tail_eval
      · intro x hx y hy j
        have h_tail_x : (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x ∈ (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
        have h_tail_y : (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y ∈ (OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hy
        have step1 := h_phi_ineq ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x) h_tail_x ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y) h_tail_y j
        have step2 : ∑ k : I, K_phi k j * d k ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x) ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y) ≥ ∑ k : I, K_phi k j * (∑ i : I, K_tail i k * d i x y) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro k _
          gcongr
          exact h_tail_ineq x hx y hy k
        have step3 : ∑ k : I, K_phi k j * (∑ i : I, K_tail i k * d i x y) = ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, K_phi k j * (K_tail i k * d i x y) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        have step4 : ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, K_phi k j * (K_tail i k * d i x y) = ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (K_phi k j * K_tail i k) * d i x y := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _
          rw [mul_assoc]
        have step5 : ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (K_phi k j * K_tail i k) * d i x y = ∑ i : I, (∑ k : I, K_phi k j * K_tail i k) * d i x y := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        calc
          d j (ϕ.func ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x)) (ϕ.func ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y)) ≥ ∑ k : I, K_phi k j * d k ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func x) ((OperatorChain tail_ϕs).func y) := step1
          _ ≥ ∑ k : I, K_phi k j * (∑ i : I, K_tail i k * d i x y) := step2
          _ = ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, K_phi k j * (K_tail i k * d i x y) := step3
          _ = ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (K_phi k j * K_tail i k) * d i x y := step4
          _ = ∑ i : I, (∑ k : I, K_phi k j * K_tail i k) * d i x y := step5
          _ = ∑ i : I, matrix_mul K_phi K_tail i j * d i x y := rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-c80171fa685dc795
**推论 #h-c80171fa685dc795（有限复合的局部矩阵界）**

这是正文命题的最终包装。`RightChainLipBounded` 与
`RightChainCoLipBounded` 分别逐步记录每个算子在其实际输入像集上的证书；两个分支彼此独立，
并保留正文中的非空有限复合与起始定义域前提。
-/
theorem finite_composition_local_matrix_bounds_textbook
    (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (hϕs : ϕs ≠ []) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain ϕs)) (L K : I → I → ENNReal) :
    (RightChainLipBounded d ϕs U L →
      IsLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ϕs) U L) ∧
    (RightChainCoLipBounded d ϕs U K →
      IsCoLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ϕs) U K) := by
  have _ := hϕs
  have _ := hU
  exact ⟨right_chain_lip_matrix d ϕs U L,
    right_chain_colip_matrix d ϕs U K⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-193cebcc1a7f9259
**命题 #h-193cebcc1a7f9259（Lip 矩阵复合律）**
-/
theorem lip_matrix_comp (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U1 U2 : Set X)
    (L1 L2 : I → I → ENNReal)
    (h_im : ∀ x ∈ U1, ϕ1.func x ∈ U2)
    (hL1 : IsLipMatrix d ϕ1 U1 L1)
    (hL2 : IsLipMatrix d ϕ2 U2 L2) :
    IsLipMatrix d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) U1 (matrix_mul L2 L1) := by
  dsimp [IsLipMatrix] at hL1 hL2 ⊢
  rcases hL1 with ⟨hU1_dom, hL1_ineq⟩
  rcases hL2 with ⟨hU2_dom, hL2_ineq⟩
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [OperatorChain, dom]
    have h_phi1_x_in_U2 := h_im x hx
    exact hU2_dom h_phi1_x_in_U2
  · intro x hx y hy j
    have h_phi1_x_in_U2 := h_im x hx
    have h_phi1_y_in_U2 := h_im y hy
    dsimp [OperatorChain]
    have step1 := hL2_ineq (ϕ1.func x) h_phi1_x_in_U2 (ϕ1.func y) h_phi1_y_in_U2 j
    have step2 : ∑ k : I, L2 k j * d k (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) ≤ ∑ k : I, L2 k j * (∑ i : I, L1 i k * d i x y) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro k _
      gcongr
      exact hL1_ineq x hx y hy k
    have step3 : ∑ k : I, L2 k j * (∑ i : I, L1 i k * d i x y) = ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, L2 k j * (L1 i k * d i x y) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    have step4 : ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, L2 k j * (L1 i k * d i x y) = ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (L2 k j * L1 i k) * d i x y := by
      rw [sum_comm]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [mul_assoc]
    have step5 : ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (L2 k j * L1 i k) * d i x y = ∑ i : I, (∑ k : I, L2 k j * L1 i k) * d i x y := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [sum_mul]
    calc
      d j (ϕ2.func (ϕ1.func x)) (ϕ2.func (ϕ1.func y)) ≤ ∑ k : I, L2 k j * d k (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) := step1
      _ ≤ ∑ k : I, L2 k j * (∑ i : I, L1 i k * d i x y) := step2
      _ = ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, L2 k j * (L1 i k * d i x y) := step3
      _ = ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (L2 k j * L1 i k) * d i x y := step4
      _ = ∑ i : I, (∑ k : I, L2 k j * L1 i k) * d i x y := step5
      _ = ∑ i : I, matrix_mul L2 L1 i j * d i x y := rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-0f256e6f1d38a612
**命题 #h-0f256e6f1d38a612（co-Lip 矩阵复合律）**
-/
theorem colip_matrix_comp (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U1 U2 : Set X)
    (K1 K2 : I → I → ENNReal)
    (h_im : ∀ x ∈ U1, ϕ1.func x ∈ U2)
    (hK1 : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ1 U1 K1)
    (hK2 : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ2 U2 K2) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) U1 (matrix_mul K2 K1) := by
  dsimp [IsCoLipMatrix] at hK1 hK2 ⊢
  rcases hK1 with ⟨hU1_ne, hU1_dom, hK1_ineq⟩
  rcases hK2 with ⟨hU2_ne, hU2_dom, hK2_ineq⟩
  constructor
  · exact hU1_ne
  · constructor
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [OperatorChain, dom]
      have h_phi1_x_in_U2 := h_im x hx
      exact hU2_dom h_phi1_x_in_U2
    · intro x hx y hy j
      have h_phi1_x_in_U2 := h_im x hx
      have h_phi1_y_in_U2 := h_im y hy
      dsimp [OperatorChain]
      have step1 := hK2_ineq (ϕ1.func x) h_phi1_x_in_U2 (ϕ1.func y) h_phi1_y_in_U2 j
      have step2 : ∑ k : I, K2 k j * d k (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) ≥ ∑ k : I, K2 k j * (∑ i : I, K1 i k * d i x y) := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro k _
        gcongr
        exact hK1_ineq x hx y hy k
      have step3 : ∑ k : I, K2 k j * (∑ i : I, K1 i k * d i x y) = ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, K2 k j * (K1 i k * d i x y) := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      have step4 : ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, K2 k j * (K1 i k * d i x y) = ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (K2 k j * K1 i k) * d i x y := by
        rw [sum_comm]
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        rw [mul_assoc]
      have step5 : ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (K2 k j * K1 i k) * d i x y = ∑ i : I, (∑ k : I, K2 k j * K1 i k) * d i x y := by
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [sum_mul]
      calc
        d j (ϕ2.func (ϕ1.func x)) (ϕ2.func (ϕ1.func y)) ≥ ∑ k : I, K2 k j * d k (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) := step1
        _ ≥ ∑ k : I, K2 k j * (∑ i : I, K1 i k * d i x y) := step2
        _ = ∑ k : I, ∑ i : I, K2 k j * (K1 i k * d i x y) := step3
        _ = ∑ i : I, ∑ k : I, (K2 k j * K1 i k) * d i x y := step4
        _ = ∑ i : I, (∑ k : I, K2 k j * K1 i k) * d i x y := step5
        _ = ∑ i : I, matrix_mul K2 K1 i j * d i x y := rfl




/--
OET anchor: h-193cebcc1a7f9259
**命题 #h-193cebcc1a7f9259（Lip 矩阵复合律）- 像集受限版本**
使用精确的上游像集作为下游定义域。
-/
theorem lip_matrix_comp_exact (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U1 : Set X)
    (L_phi1 L_phi2 : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hL1 : IsLipMatrix d ϕ1 U1 L_phi1)
    (hL2 : IsLipMatrix d ϕ2 (operator_image ϕ1 U1) L_phi2) :
    IsLipMatrix d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) U1 (matrix_mul L_phi2 L_phi1) := by
  apply lip_matrix_comp d ϕ1 ϕ2 U1 (operator_image ϕ1 U1) L_phi1 L_phi2
  · intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ1.func hx
  · exact hL1
  · exact hL2

/--
OET anchor: h-0f256e6f1d38a612
**命题 #h-0f256e6f1d38a612（co-Lip 矩阵复合律）- 像集受限版本**
使用精确的上游像集作为下游定义域。
-/
theorem colip_matrix_comp_exact (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U1 : Set X)
    (K_phi1 K_phi2 : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hK1 : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ1 U1 K_phi1)
    (hK2 : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ2 (operator_image ϕ1 U1) K_phi2) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) U1 (matrix_mul K_phi2 K_phi1) := by
  apply colip_matrix_comp d ϕ1 ϕ2 U1 (operator_image ϕ1 U1) K_phi1 K_phi2
  · intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ1.func hx
  · exact hK1
  · exact hK2

/--
OET anchor: h-11006ddd8c43bfec
**注（零步复合的单位矩阵证书）**
零步链的单位矩阵同时是恒等映射的 Lip 与 co-Lip 矩阵。
-/
theorem zero_step_identity_matrix_lip_colip (U : Set X)
    (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ bot) (hU_ne : U.Nonempty) :
    IsLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ([] : List (Operator X bot))) U matrix_id ∧
      IsCoLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ([] : List (Operator X bot))) U matrix_id := by
  constructor
  · exact right_chain_lip_matrix d [] U matrix_id (RightChainLipBounded.nil U hU)
  · exact right_chain_colip_matrix d [] U matrix_id (RightChainCoLipBounded.nil U hU hU_ne)

end

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.matrix_composition

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

noncomputable section

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

variable {I : Type} [Fintype I]
local instance instDecidableEqIPathAlgebra : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I

/--
OET anchor: h-e4154c34e95d3c23
**命题 #h-e4154c34e95d3c23（有限矩阵乘积条目的零值与正值判据）- 代数基础**
判定单步矩阵连乘等于零等价于全连乘不存在正路径。
-/
theorem matrix_mul_eq_zero_iff (L1 L2 : I → I → ENNReal) (i j : I) :
    matrix_mul L2 L1 i j = 0 ↔ ∀ k : I, L2 k j = 0 ∨ L1 i k = 0 := by
  dsimp [matrix_mul]
  rw [sum_eq_zero_iff]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro k
  rw [mul_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h (mem_univ k)
  · intro h _
    exact h

/--
OET anchor: h-e4154c34e95d3c23
**命题 #h-e4154c34e95d3c23（有限矩阵乘积条目的零值与正值判据）- 代数基础**
判定单步矩阵连乘大于零等价于存在严格正路径。
-/
theorem matrix_mul_pos_iff (K1 K2 : I → I → ENNReal) (i j : I) :
    matrix_mul K2 K1 i j > 0 ↔ ∃ k : I, K2 k j > 0 ∧ K1 i k > 0 := by
  dsimp [matrix_mul]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra h_not
    push Not at h_not
    have h_zero : ∑ k : I, K2 k j * K1 i k = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k _
      have hk := h_not k
      by_cases h2 : K2 k j > 0
      · have h1 : K1 i k ≤ 0 := hk h2
        have hz1 : K1 i k = 0 := le_antisymm h1 (zero_le _)
        rw [hz1, mul_zero]
      · push Not at h2
        have hz2 : K2 k j = 0 := le_antisymm h2 (zero_le _)
        rw [hz2, zero_mul]
    rw [h_zero] at h
    exact lt_irrefl 0 h
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩
    have h_ne1 := pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hk1
    have h_ne2 := pos_iff_ne_zero.mp hk2
    have h_mul_ne := mul_ne_zero h_ne1 h_ne2
    have h_mul_pos := pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr h_mul_ne
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le h_mul_pos
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k_1 => K2 k_1 j * K1 i k_1)
    · intro _ _
      exact zero_le _
    · exact Finset.mem_univ k

/--
OET anchor: h-e4154c34e95d3c23
**命题 #h-e4154c34e95d3c23（有限矩阵乘积条目的零值与正值判据）- 连乘定义**
-/
noncomputable def matrix_list_mul : List (I → I → ENNReal) → I → I → ENNReal
  | [] => matrix_id
  | K :: Ks => matrix_mul K (matrix_list_mul Ks)

/-- A list-valued encoding of the successive Lip certificates on the actual image domains. -/
inductive RightChainLipCertificateList {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) :
    List (Operator X bot) → Set X → List (I → I → ENNReal) → Prop
  | nil (U : Set X) (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ bot) :
      RightChainLipCertificateList d [] U []
  | cons (ϕ : Operator X bot) (tail : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X)
      (Lϕ : I → I → ENNReal) (Ls : List (I → I → ENNReal))
      (h_tail : RightChainLipCertificateList d tail U Ls)
      (hϕ : IsLipMatrix d ϕ ((OperatorChain tail).func '' U) Lϕ) :
      RightChainLipCertificateList d (ϕ :: tail) U (Lϕ :: Ls)

/-- A list-valued encoding of the successive co-Lip certificates on the actual image domains. -/
inductive RightChainCoLipCertificateList {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) :
    List (Operator X bot) → Set X → List (I → I → ENNReal) → Prop
  | nil (U : Set X) (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ bot) (hU_ne : U.Nonempty) :
      RightChainCoLipCertificateList d [] U []
  | cons (ϕ : Operator X bot) (tail : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X)
      (Kϕ : I → I → ENNReal) (Ks : List (I → I → ENNReal))
      (h_tail : RightChainCoLipCertificateList d tail U Ks)
      (hϕ : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ ((OperatorChain tail).func '' U) Kϕ) :
      RightChainCoLipCertificateList d (ϕ :: tail) U (Kϕ :: Ks)

theorem RightChainLipCertificateList.length_eq {X : Type} {bot : X}
    {d : I → X → X → ENNReal} {ϕs : List (Operator X bot)} {U : Set X}
    {Ls : List (I → I → ENNReal)}
    (h : RightChainLipCertificateList d ϕs U Ls) : ϕs.length = Ls.length := by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ih => simp [ih]

theorem RightChainCoLipCertificateList.length_eq {X : Type} {bot : X}
    {d : I → X → X → ENNReal} {ϕs : List (Operator X bot)} {U : Set X}
    {Ks : List (I → I → ENNReal)}
    (h : RightChainCoLipCertificateList d ϕs U Ks) : ϕs.length = Ks.length := by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ih => simp [ih]

/--
OET anchor: h-e4154c34e95d3c23
**命题 #h-e4154c34e95d3c23（有限矩阵乘积条目的零值与正值判据）- 存在正路径定义**
-/
inductive ExistsPositivePath : List (I → I → ENNReal) → I → I → Prop
  | nil_path (i : I) : ExistsPositivePath [] i i
  | cons_path (K : I → I → ENNReal) (Ks : List (I → I → ENNReal)) (i k j : I)
      (h_head : K k j > 0)
      (h_tail : ExistsPositivePath Ks i k) : ExistsPositivePath (K :: Ks) i j

/--
OET anchor: h-e4154c34e95d3c23
**命题 #h-e4154c34e95d3c23（有限矩阵乘积条目的零值与正值判据）- co-Lip 乘积条目的正值判据**
对于矩阵链列乘法，某元素严格大于零当且仅当存在一条全正路径。
-/
theorem list_matrix_mul_pos_iff (Ks : List (I → I → ENNReal)) (i j : I) :
    matrix_list_mul Ks i j > 0 ↔ ExistsPositivePath Ks i j := by
  induction Ks generalizing j with
  | nil =>
    unfold matrix_list_mul
    unfold matrix_id
    constructor
    · intro h
      split_ifs at h with heq
      · rw [heq]
        exact ExistsPositivePath.nil_path j
      · exact False.elim (lt_irrefl 0 h)
    · intro h
      cases h
      split_ifs with heq
      · exact zero_lt_one
      · exact False.elim (heq rfl)
  | cons K Ks ih =>
    unfold matrix_list_mul
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h_mul := matrix_mul_pos_iff (matrix_list_mul Ks) K i j
      rw [h_mul] at h
      rcases h with ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩
      have h_tail := (ih k).mp hk2
      exact ExistsPositivePath.cons_path K Ks i k j hk1 h_tail
    · intro h
      cases h with
      | cons_path _ _ _ k _ hk_head hk_tail =>
        rw [matrix_mul_pos_iff]
        use k
        constructor
        · exact hk_head
        · exact (ih k).mpr hk_tail

/--
OET anchor: h-e4154c34e95d3c23
**命题 #h-e4154c34e95d3c23（有限矩阵乘积条目的零值与正值判据）- Lip 乘积条目的零值判据**
对于矩阵链列乘法，某元素为零当且仅当不存在任何全正路径（完全隔离）。
-/
theorem list_matrix_mul_eq_zero_iff (Ks : List (I → I → ENNReal)) (i j : I) :
    matrix_list_mul Ks i j = 0 ↔ ¬ ExistsPositivePath Ks i j := by
  have h_pos := list_matrix_mul_pos_iff Ks i j
  constructor
  · intro h h_path
    have h_pos_val := h_pos.mpr h_path
    rw [h] at h_pos_val
    exact lt_irrefl 0 h_pos_val
  · intro h
    by_contra h_ne
    have h_pos_val : matrix_list_mul Ks i j > 0 := pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr h_ne
    have h_path := h_pos.mp h_pos_val
    exact h h_path

/--
OET anchor: h-e4154c34e95d3c23
**命题 #h-e4154c34e95d3c23（有限矩阵乘积条目的零值与正值判据）**

正文命题的最终包装。两个证书列表与同一非空算子链逐步对齐，且每个证书都作用在该步的
实际输入像集上；结论分别给出上界乘积的全路径阻断判据与下界乘积的正路径判据。
-/
theorem finite_matrix_product_entry_zero_positive_textbook
    {X : Type} {bot : X} (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (hϕs : ϕs ≠ []) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain ϕs))
    (Ls Ks : List (I → I → ENNReal))
    (hLs : RightChainLipCertificateList d ϕs U Ls)
    (hKs : RightChainCoLipCertificateList d ϕs U Ks) (i j : I) :
    (matrix_list_mul Ls i j = 0 ↔ ¬ ExistsPositivePath Ls i j) ∧
      (matrix_list_mul Ks i j > 0 ↔ ExistsPositivePath Ks i j) := by
  have hLs_ne : Ls ≠ [] := by
    intro hLs_nil
    have hlen := hLs.length_eq
    rw [hLs_nil] at hlen
    have hϕs_len : ϕs.length = 0 := by simpa using hlen
    exact hϕs (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hϕs_len)
  have hKs_ne : Ks ≠ [] := by
    intro hKs_nil
    have hlen := hKs.length_eq
    rw [hKs_nil] at hlen
    have hϕs_len : ϕs.length = 0 := by simpa using hlen
    exact hϕs (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hϕs_len)
  have _ := hU
  have _ := hLs_ne
  have _ := hKs_ne
  exact ⟨list_matrix_mul_eq_zero_iff Ls i j,
    list_matrix_mul_pos_iff Ks i j⟩

end

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.lip_matrix

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}

/--
Source: vol-01-gauge-spaces-and-operators/02-operator-bounds.md,
分量通道（正文中的单输入分量上界说明）.
A scalar Lip bound on the restricted domain, from input component `i` to output component `j`.
-/
def HasScalarLipBound (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (i j : I) (c : ENNReal) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ c * d i x y

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.single_channel
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.computational_fiber
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Operations
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Lattice.Fold

set_option linter.style.longLine false
set_option linter.style.emptyLine false

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

noncomputable section

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open Finset

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
local instance instDecidableEqIAnnihilationMatrix : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/-- 度量开球 $B_i(y, r)$ -/
def OpenBall (i : I) (y : X) (r : ENNReal) : Set X :=
  { x | d i x y < r }

/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
**定义（非平凡有限半径）**
$r \in (0, +\infty)$
-/
def FinitePositiveRadius (r : ENNReal) : Prop := 0 < r ∧ r ≠ ⊤

/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
任意输入、输出扩展伪度量上的零化内切半径。
正文在非空评估域 `U ⊆ dom ϕ` 和基点 `y ∈ U` 上使用此公式。
-/
noncomputable def metric_annihilation_radius (d_in d_out : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (y : X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ (r : ENNReal) (_ : FinitePositiveRadius r)
    (_ : {x | d_in x y < r} ∩ U ⊆ {x ∈ U | d_out (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0}), r

/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
一般伪度量版本的极小零化极径：评估域为 `U`，取下确界的基点集合为 `A`。
-/
noncomputable def metric_min_annihilation_radius_on (d_in d_out : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U A : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨅ y ∈ A, metric_annihilation_radius d_in d_out ϕ U y

/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
一般伪度量版本的同域简记，即取 `A = U`。
-/
noncomputable def metric_min_annihilation_radius (d_in d_out : X → X → ENNReal)
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  metric_min_annihilation_radius_on d_in d_out ϕ U U

/-- 严格小于一般零化内切半径的点，在指定输出伪度量下零距。 -/
theorem output_zero_of_lt_metric_annihilation_radius
    (d_in d_out : X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (x y : X)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (h : d_in x y < metric_annihilation_radius d_in d_out ϕ U y) :
    d_out (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp h
  obtain ⟨_, hr⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp hr
  obtain ⟨hsub, hxr⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp hr
  exact (hsub ⟨hxr, hx⟩).2

/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
**定义（零化内切半径）**
$\nu_{\phi, d_i, J}(y \mid U) = \sup \{r > 0 \mid r \neq \infty \wedge B_i(y, r) \cap U \subseteq \operatorname{Fib}_{\phi, J}(\phi(y) \mid U)\}$
-/
noncomputable def annihilation_radius (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ (r : ENNReal) (_ : FinitePositiveRadius r) (_ : OpenBall d i y r ∩ U ⊆ ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U (ϕ.func y)), r

/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
**定义（极小零化极径）**
$\underline{\nu}_{\phi, d_i, J}(A\mid U) = \inf_{y \in A} \nu_{\phi, d_i, J}(y \mid U)$。
正文取 $\emptyset\neq A\subseteq U\subseteq\operatorname{dom}(\phi)$；$U$ 为评估域，$A$ 为基点集合。
-/
noncomputable def min_annihilation_radius_on (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I)
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U A : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨅ y ∈ A, annihilation_radius d ϕ i J U y

/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
**定义（极小零化极径的同域简记）**
$\underline{\nu}_{\phi, d_i, J}\big|_U = \underline{\nu}_{\phi, d_i, J}(U\mid U)$
-/
noncomputable def min_annihilation_radius (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  min_annihilation_radius_on d ϕ i J U U

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
输入分量与输出子族版本，是一般零化内切半径的特化。
-/
theorem annihilation_radius_eq_metric (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I)
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) :
    annihilation_radius d ϕ i J U y =
      metric_annihilation_radius (d i) (comp_pseudo_metric d J) ϕ U y := rfl

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
单输出分量版本恰好使用 `d_i,d_j` 作为输入、输出伪度量。
-/
theorem annihilation_radius_singleton_eq_metric (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i j : I)
    (U : Set X) (y : X) :
    annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y =
      metric_annihilation_radius (d i) (d j) ϕ U y := by
  rw [annihilation_radius_eq_metric, comp_pseudo_metric_singleton]

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
在任意基点集合 `A` 上，分量版本的下确界与一般定义一致。
-/
theorem min_annihilation_radius_on_eq_metric (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I)
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U A : Set X) :
    min_annihilation_radius_on d ϕ i J U A =
      metric_min_annihilation_radius_on (d i) (comp_pseudo_metric d J) ϕ U A := rfl

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-bb1487a09d8bf151
同域简记的分量版本与一般定义一致。
-/
theorem min_annihilation_radius_eq_metric (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I)
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) :
    min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i J U =
      metric_min_annihilation_radius (d i) (comp_pseudo_metric d J) ϕ U := rfl

lemma ennreal_le_of_forall_pos_lt {a b : ENNReal} (h : ∀ c, 0 < c → c < a → c ≤ b) : a ≤ b := by
  by_contra h_not
  have h_lt : b < a := not_le.mp h_not
  rcases exists_between h_lt with ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩
  have hc_pos : 0 < c := lt_of_le_of_lt (zero_le _) hc1
  have h_le := h c hc_pos hc2
  have h_false := not_le.mpr hc1
  exact h_false h_le

omit [Fintype I] in
lemma ann_radius_downward (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) (r1 r2 : ENNReal)
    (h_le : r1 ≤ r2) (h_sub : OpenBall d i y r2 ∩ U ⊆ ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U (ϕ.func y)) :
    OpenBall d i y r1 ∩ U ⊆ ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U (ϕ.func y) := by
  intro x hx
  have h_in_r1 : d i x y < r1 := hx.1
  have h_in_r2 : d i x y < r2 := lt_of_lt_of_le h_in_r1 h_le
  exact h_sub ⟨h_in_r2, hx.2⟩

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
单个纤维上的零化半径满足交集律：
$\nu_{\phi, i, J}(y \mid U) = \min_{j \in J} \nu_{\phi, i, j}(y \mid U)$
-/
theorem annihilation_radius_eq_min (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) :
    annihilation_radius d ϕ i J U y = J.val.inf' J.prop (fun j => annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro j hj
    dsimp [annihilation_radius]
    apply iSup_le
    intro r
    apply iSup_le
    intro hr
    apply iSup_le
    intro h_sub
    apply le_iSup_of_le r
    apply le_iSup_of_le hr
    have h_sub_j : OpenBall d i y r ∩ U ⊆ ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func y) := by
      intro x hx_U_ball
      have hx_fib := h_sub hx_U_ball
      dsimp [ComputationalFiber] at *
      constructor
      · exact hx_fib.1
      · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j) (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)).mpr
        intro k hk
        have hk_eq : k = j := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk
        rw [hk_eq]
        have h_all_zero := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)).mp hx_fib.2
        exact h_all_zero j hj
    exact le_iSup_of_le h_sub_j le_rfl
  · dsimp [annihilation_radius]
    apply ennreal_le_of_forall_pos_lt
    intro r' hr'_pos hr'
    have h_r'_ne_top : r' ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_lt hr'
    have h_fin_pos : FinitePositiveRadius r' := ⟨hr'_pos, h_r'_ne_top⟩
    apply le_iSup_of_le r'
    apply le_iSup_of_le h_fin_pos
    have h_sub_r' : OpenBall d i y r' ∩ U ⊆ ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U (ϕ.func y) := by
      intro x hx_ball
      dsimp [ComputationalFiber]
      constructor
      · exact hx_ball.2
      · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)).mpr
        intro k hk
        have hk_lt : r' < annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset k) U y := by
          have h_le_k := Finset.inf'_le (fun j => annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y) hk
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hr' h_le_k
        have h_sup := lt_iSup_iff.mp hk_lt
        rcases h_sup with ⟨rk, hrk⟩
        have h_sup2 := lt_iSup_iff.mp hrk
        rcases h_sup2 with ⟨hrk_fin_pos, hrk2⟩
        have h_sup3 := lt_iSup_iff.mp hrk2
        rcases h_sup3 with ⟨hk_sub, hk_final⟩
        have h_r'_le_rk : r' ≤ rk := le_of_lt hk_final
        have hk_sub_r' := ann_radius_downward d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset k) U y r' rk h_r'_le_rk hk_sub
        have hx_in_fib_k := hk_sub_r' hx_ball
        have hk_zero := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset k) (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)).mp hx_in_fib_k.2
        exact hk_zero k (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
    apply le_iSup_of_le h_sub_r'
    exact le_rfl

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-2b53c51151014456
**命题（零化极径的分量最小值公式）**
$\underline{\nu}_{\phi, i, J}\big|_U = \min_{j \in J} \underline{\nu}_{\phi, i, j}\big|_U$。
-/
theorem min_annihilation_radius_eq_min (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I)
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (_hU : U.Nonempty)
    (_hU_dom : U ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i J U = J.val.inf' J.prop (fun j => min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.le_inf'
    intro j hj
    dsimp [min_annihilation_radius]
    apply iInf₂_mono
    intro y hy
    rw [annihilation_radius_eq_min]
    exact Finset.inf'_le _ hj
  · dsimp [min_annihilation_radius]
    apply le_iInf
    intro y

/-- A valid Lip step preserves zero distance in every component. -/
theorem all_component_zero_preserved_by_lip_step (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal) (x y : X)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L)
    (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hzero : ∀ i : I, d i x y = 0) :
    ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
  rcases hL with ⟨_, hineq⟩
  intro j
  have h_bound := hineq x hx y hy j
  have h_sum_zero : (∑ i : I, L i j * d i x y) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    rw [hzero i, mul_zero]
  rw [h_sum_zero] at h_bound
  exact le_antisymm h_bound (zero_le _)

/-- Iterating valid Lip steps preserves zero distance in every component. -/
theorem all_component_zero_preserved_along_lip_steps
    (x x' : Nat → X) (s q : Nat)
    (hsq : s ≤ q)
    (hstep :
      ∀ p, s ≤ p → p < q →
        ∃ (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal),
          IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L ∧
            x p ∈ U ∧ x' p ∈ U ∧
            x (p + 1) = ϕ.func (x p) ∧ x' (p + 1) = ϕ.func (x' p))
    (hzero : ∀ l : I, d l (x s) (x' s) = 0) :
    ∀ l : I, d l (x q) (x' q) = 0 := by
  let P : Nat → Prop := fun t =>
    (∀ p, s ≤ p → p < t →
      ∃ (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal),
        IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L ∧
          x p ∈ U ∧ x' p ∈ U ∧
          x (p + 1) = ϕ.func (x p) ∧ x' (p + 1) = ϕ.func (x' p)) →
    ∀ l : I, d l (x t) (x' t) = 0
  have hprop : P q := by
    refine Nat.le_induction ?base ?step q hsq
    · intro _
      exact hzero
    · intro n hsn ih hsteps l
      have hprev : ∀ l : I, d l (x n) (x' n) = 0 := by
        apply ih
        intro p hp_s hp_n
        exact hsteps p hp_s (Nat.lt_trans hp_n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
      rcases hsteps n hsn (Nat.lt_succ_self n) with ⟨ϕ, U, L, hL, hx, hx', hx_next, hx'_next⟩
      rw [hx_next, hx'_next]
      exact all_component_zero_preserved_by_lip_step d ϕ U L (x n) (x' n) hL hx hx' hprev l
  exact hprop hstep

theorem ann_radius_ge (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) (M : ENNReal)

  apply le_iSup_of_le r
  apply le_iSup_of_le h_fin_pos
  apply le_iSup_of_le (h_subset r h_fin_pos hr_lt)

theorem composite_zero_radius_bound_1 (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U1 : Set X) (i j : I)
    (L2 : I → I → ENNReal) (hL2 : IsLipMatrix d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' U1) L2) :
    min_annihilation_radius d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U1 ≥
    ⨅ l : I, min_annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 := by

  apply le_iInf
  intro y
  apply le_iInf
  intro hy
  apply ann_radius_ge
  intro r _ hr_lt x hx
  have hx_ball :
      d i x y <
        ⨅ l : I, (⨅ y ∈ U1, annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 y) :=
    lt_trans hx.1 hr_lt
  have hx_U : x ∈ U1 := hx.2

  have h_eq_all_l : ∀ l : I, d l (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) = 0 := by
    intro l
    have h_le_ann : (⨅ l : I, (⨅ y ∈ U1, annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 y)) ≤ annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 y := by
      have h1 : (⨅ l : I, (⨅ y ∈ U1, annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 y)) ≤ ⨅ y ∈ U1, annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 y := iInf_le _ l
      have h2 : (⨅ y ∈ U1, annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 y) ≤ annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 y := iInf₂_le y hy
      exact le_trans h1 h2
    have h_lt_ann : d i x y < annihilation_radius d ϕ1 i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U1 y := lt_of_lt_of_le hx_ball h_le_ann
    have h_sup := lt_iSup_iff.mp h_lt_ann
    rcases h_sup with ⟨r, hr⟩
    have h_sup2 := lt_iSup_iff.mp hr
    rcases h_sup2 with ⟨hr_fin_pos, hr2⟩
    have h_sup3 := lt_iSup_iff.mp hr2

    have h_in_fiber := h_sub hx_in_ball
    have h_fib := h_in_fiber.2
    have h_iff := comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset l) (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y)

  constructor
  · exact hx_U
  · have h_iff := Finset.sup_eq_bot_iff (fun k => d k ((OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]).func x) ((OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]).func y)) {j}
    apply h_iff.mpr
    intro k hk
    have hk_eq : k = j := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hk

    dsimp [OperatorChain]
    rcases hL2 with ⟨_, hL_ineq⟩
    have h_im_x : ϕ1.func x ∈ ϕ1.func '' U1 := Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ1.func hx_U
    have h_im_y : ϕ1.func y ∈ ϕ1.func '' U1 := Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ1.func hy
    have h_bound := hL_ineq (ϕ1.func x) h_im_x (ϕ1.func y) h_im_y j
    have h_sum_zero : ∑ k : I, L2 k j * d k (ϕ1.func x) (ϕ1.func y) = 0 := by
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro l _
      rw [h_eq_all_l l, mul_zero]
    rw [h_sum_zero] at h_bound
    exact le_antisymm h_bound (zero_le _)

/-- 辅助定义：链上的 Lip 矩阵存在性 (剔除第一层) -/
def HasTailLipMatrices (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) : List (Operator X bot) → Prop
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | ϕ :: tail => HasTailLipMatrices d U tail ∧ ∃ L, IsLipMatrix d ϕ ((OperatorChain tail).func '' U) L

/-- 辅助函数：提取算子链的第一步（列表末尾） -/
def first_operator : List (Operator X bot) → Operator X bot
  | [] => ⟨id, rfl⟩
  | [ϕ] => ϕ
  | _ :: tail => first_operator tail

/-- Internal chain form of the lower bound for composite annihilation radii. -/
theorem composite_zero_radius_bound_1_chain_helper (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X) (i j : I) :
    HasTailLipMatrices d U ϕs →
    min_annihilation_radius d (OperatorChain ϕs) i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U ≥
    ⨅ l : I, min_annihilation_radius d (first_operator ϕs) i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U := by
  intro h_chain
  induction ϕs generalizing j
  case nil =>
    dsimp [OperatorChain, first_operator]
    exact iInf_le (fun l => min_annihilation_radius d ⟨id, rfl⟩ i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U) j
  case cons ϕ tail ih =>
    cases tail
    case nil =>
      dsimp [OperatorChain, first_operator]
      exact iInf_le (fun l => min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U) j
    case cons ϕ_tail tail_tail =>
      dsimp [HasTailLipMatrices] at h_chain
      have h_tail_chain := h_chain.1
      have h_phi_lip := h_chain.2
      rcases h_phi_lip with ⟨L, hL⟩

      have h_first : first_operator (ϕ :: ϕ_tail :: tail_tail) = first_operator (ϕ_tail :: tail_tail) := rfl
      rw [h_first]

      have h_ann_comp : min_annihilation_radius d (OperatorChain (ϕ :: ϕ_tail :: tail_tail)) i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U =
          min_annihilation_radius d (OperatorChain [ϕ, OperatorChain (ϕ_tail :: tail_tail)]) i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U := by
        congr 1

      rw [h_ann_comp]

      have h_step := composite_zero_radius_bound_1 d (OperatorChain (ϕ_tail :: tail_tail)) ϕ U i j L hL

      have h_ih_all : ∀ l : I, min_annihilation_radius d (OperatorChain (ϕ_tail :: tail_tail)) i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U ≥
          ⨅ k : I, min_annihilation_radius d (first_operator (ϕ_tail :: tail_tail)) i (singleton_nonempty_finset k) U := by
        intro l
        exact ih l h_tail_chain

      have h_inf_step : (⨅ l : I, min_annihilation_radius d (OperatorChain (ϕ_tail :: tail_tail)) i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U) ≥
          ⨅ k : I, min_annihilation_radius d (first_operator (ϕ_tail :: tail_tail)) i (singleton_nonempty_finset k) U := by
        apply le_iInf_iff.mpr
        intro l
        exact h_ih_all l

      exact le_trans h_inf_step h_step

    (h_len : 2 ≤ ϕs.length)
    (h_dom : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain ϕs))
    (h_U_nempty : U.Nonempty)

    ⨅ l : I, min_annihilation_radius d (first_operator ϕs) i (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U := by
  -- Retained for text alignment
  have _ := h_len
  have _ := h_dom
  have _ := h_U_nempty
  exact composite_zero_radius_bound_1_chain_helper d ϕs U i j h_lip

theorem finite_radius_le_annihilation_radius_of_fiber_ball (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i : I)
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) (r : ENNReal)
    (hr : FinitePositiveRadius r)
    (h_sub : OpenBall d i y r ∩ U ⊆ ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U (ϕ.func y)) :
    r ≤ annihilation_radius d ϕ i J U y := by
  apply le_iSup_of_le r
  apply le_iSup_of_le hr
  exact le_iSup_of_le h_sub le_rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-ff54b8d36fa86c90
**命题（恒等分量的纤维与零化半径）(ii)**
在恒等分量上，若有限正半径球在受限域内落入基点的输入零距类，
则零化内切半径不小于该半径，因而严格为正。
-/
theorem id_component_annihilation_radius_ge_of_zero_class_ball
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (y : X)
    (hy : y ∈ U) (h_id : i ∈ IdComponent d ϕ U)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z)
    (r₀ : ENNReal) (hr : FinitePositiveRadius r₀)
    (h_ball : OpenBall d i y r₀ ∩ U ⊆ {x | x ∈ U ∧ d i x y = 0}) :
    r₀ ≤ annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y ∧
      0 < annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y := by
  have h_fiber := id_component_singleton_fiber_eq_zero_class d ϕ U i y hy h_id
    symm triangle
  have h_le : r₀ ≤ annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y := by
    apply finite_radius_le_annihilation_radius_of_fiber_ball d ϕ i
      (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y r₀ hr
    rw [h_fiber]
    exact h_ball
  exact ⟨h_le, lt_of_lt_of_le hr.1 h_le⟩

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-fd32966bed4ea8d0
**命题（常值分量与零化极径）(ii)**
若所有非纤维点与基点的源距离为 `⊤`，则任意有限半径球仍包含于该纤维。
-/
theorem finite_balls_avoid_infinite_nonfiber_points (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i j : I)
    (U : Set X) (y : X)
    (h_nonfiber_top :
      ∀ x ∈ U,
        x ∉ ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func y) →
          d i x y = ⊤) :
    ∀ r : ENNReal, FinitePositiveRadius r →
      OpenBall d i y r ∩ U ⊆
        ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func y) := by
  intro r _ x hx
  by_contra hx_not
  have htop := h_nonfiber_top x hx.2 hx_not
  have hlt : d i x y < r := hx.1
  rw [htop] at hlt
  exact False.elim (not_top_lt hlt)

set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-fd32966bed4ea8d0
**命题（常值分量与零化极径）(ii)**
若所有非纤维点与基点的源距离为 `⊤`，则该基点的零化半径为 `⊤`。
-/
theorem annihilation_radius_eq_top_of_infinite_nonfiber_points (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i j : I)
    (U : Set X) (y : X)
    (h_nonfiber_top :
      ∀ x ∈ U,
        x ∉ ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func y) →
          d i x y = ⊤) :
    annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y = ⊤ := by
  apply top_unique
  rw [← ENNReal.iSup_natCast]
  apply iSup_le
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ n =>
      have hr : FinitePositiveRadius ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ENNReal) := by
        constructor
        · exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
        · exact ENNReal.natCast_ne_top (Nat.succ n)
      apply le_iSup_of_le (((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ENNReal))
      apply le_iSup_of_le hr
      exact le_iSup_of_le
        (finite_balls_avoid_infinite_nonfiber_points d ϕ i j U y h_nonfiber_top
          ((Nat.succ n : ℕ) : ENNReal) hr)
        le_rfl

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-fd32966bed4ea8d0
**命题（常值分量与零化极径）(ii)**
一个反例模式：若每个基点的非纤维点都在源分量上距离 `⊤`，
但输出端仍存在正距离点对，则零化矩阵条目为 `⊤`，目标分量却不是常值分量。
-/
theorem annihilation_matrix_top_does_not_force_const_component_pattern (ϕ : Operator X bot) (i j : I)
    (U : Set X)
    (h_nonfiber_top :
      ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ x ∈ U,
        x ∉ ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func y) →
          d i x y = ⊤)
    (h_output_pos : ∃ x ∈ U, ∃ y ∈ U, 0 < d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)) :
    AnnihilationMatrix d ϕ U j i = ⊤ ∧ j ∉ ConstComponent d ϕ U := by
  constructor
  · dsimp [AnnihilationMatrix, min_annihilation_radius]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_top
    · apply le_iInf
      intro y
      apply le_iInf
      intro hy
      rw [annihilation_radius_eq_top_of_infinite_nonfiber_points d ϕ i j U y
        (h_nonfiber_top y hy)]
  · intro h_const
    rcases h_output_pos with ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hpos⟩
    have hzero := h_const x hx y hy
    exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hzero

end

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy
