import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.lip_matrix

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/-- OET anchor: h-273361882c9d8ace
常值分量：受限域上的输出两两零距。
-/
def ConstComponent (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Set I :=
  {i | ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0}

/-- OET anchor: h-273361882c9d8ace
恒等分量：排除常值分量后，输出与输入逐点零距。
-/
def IdComponent (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Set I :=
  {i | i ∉ ConstComponent d ϕ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) x = 0}

/-- OET anchor: h-273361882c9d8ace
有效分量：既非常值分量，也非恒等分量。
-/
def ActComponent (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Set I :=
  {i | i ∉ IdComponent d ϕ U ∧ i ∉ ConstComponent d ϕ U}

/-- 分划的有效部分同时排除逐点零距与输出两两零距。 -/
theorem act_component_iff (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) :
    i ∈ ActComponent d ϕ U ↔
      ¬ (∀ x ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) x = 0) ∧ i ∉ ConstComponent d ϕ U := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun hp => h.1 ⟨h.2, hp⟩, h.2⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun hid => h.1 hid.2, h.2⟩

/-- 逐点零距蕴含点对距离保持。 -/
theorem component_distance_of_pointwise_zero (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I)
    (h_id : ∀ x ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) x = 0)
    (symm : ∀ x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = d i x y := by
  intro x hx y hy
  have hx_zero : d i (ϕ.func x) x = 0 := h_id x hx
  have hy_zero : d i (ϕ.func y) y = 0 := h_id y hy
  have hx_zero_symm : d i x (ϕ.func x) = 0 := by
    rw [symm, hx_zero]
  have hy_zero_symm : d i y (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
    rw [symm, hy_zero]
  have h_le₁ : d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ d i x y := by
    have h1 := triangle (ϕ.func x) x (ϕ.func y)
    have h2 := triangle x y (ϕ.func y)
    calc
      d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ d i (ϕ.func x) x + d i x (ϕ.func y) := h1
      _ ≤ d i (ϕ.func x) x + (d i x y + d i y (ϕ.func y)) := by gcongr
      _ = d i x y := by rw [hx_zero, hy_zero_symm, zero_add, add_zero]
  have h_le₂ : d i x y ≤ d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) := by
    have h1 := triangle x (ϕ.func x) y
    have h2 := triangle (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) y
    calc
      d i x y ≤ d i x (ϕ.func x) + d i (ϕ.func x) y := h1
      _ ≤ d i x (ϕ.func x) + (d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) + d i (ϕ.func y) y) := by gcongr
      _ = d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) := by rw [hx_zero_symm, hy_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
  exact le_antisymm h_le₁ h_le₂

/-- OET anchor: h-176471fbe0cf6b8c
恒等分量保持对应的点对距离。
-/
theorem id_component_preserves_component_distance (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I)
    (h_id : i ∈ IdComponent d ϕ U)
    (symm : ∀ x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = d i x y :=
  component_distance_of_pointwise_zero d ϕ U i h_id.2 symm triangle

/-- 两个逐点零距条件在复合下保持。 -/
theorem pointwise_zero_comp (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I)
    (hϕ : ∀ x ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) x = 0)
    (hψ : ∀ x ∈ ϕ.func '' U, d i (ψ.func x) x = 0)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, d i ((OperatorChain [ψ, ϕ]).func x) x = 0 := by
  intro x hx
  apply le_antisymm ?_ (zero_le _)
  change d i (ψ.func (ϕ.func x)) x ≤ 0
  calc
    _ ≤ d i (ψ.func (ϕ.func x)) (ϕ.func x) + d i (ϕ.func x) x := triangle _ _ _
    _ = 0 := by rw [hψ _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx), hϕ x hx, add_zero]

/-- OET anchor: h-e1615fa20ede09bc
恒等分量在复合下保持；保距性质保证复合仍非常值。
-/
theorem id_comp_preservation_exact (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (h_U_dom : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]))
    (symm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ i x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    IdComponent d ϕ1 U ∩ IdComponent d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' U) ⊆
    IdComponent d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) U := by
  have _ := h_U_dom
  intro i hi
  refine ⟨?_, pointwise_zero_comp d ϕ1 ϕ2 U i hi.1.2 hi.2.2 (triangle i)⟩
  intro hc
  apply hi.1.1
  intro x hx y hy
  have heq := component_distance_of_pointwise_zero d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' U) i hi.2.2
    (symm i) (triangle i) _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx) _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hy)
  exact heq.symm.trans (hc x hx y hy)

/-- OET anchor: h-2c5dc85febaac657
外侧常值分量直接传递到复合，无须源端正直径。
-/
theorem const_comp_outer_const_exact (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I)
    (h_const : i ∈ ConstComponent d ψ (ϕ.func '' U)) :
    i ∈ ConstComponent d (OperatorChain [ψ, ϕ]) U := by
  intro x hx y hy
  exact h_const _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx) _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hy)

/-- 有效分量的两步包含律。 -/
theorem act_comp_inclusion_helper (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (symm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ i x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    ActComponent d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) U ⊆
    ActComponent d ϕ1 U ∪ ActComponent d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' U) := by
  intro i hi
  rw [act_component_iff] at hi
  by_contra hnot
  simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hnot
  have h1 : (∀ x ∈ U, d i (ϕ1.func x) x = 0) ∨ i ∈ ConstComponent d ϕ1 U := by
    by_contra hn
    rw [not_or] at hn
    exact hnot.1 ((act_component_iff d ϕ1 U i).mpr hn)
  have h2 : (∀ x ∈ ϕ1.func '' U, d i (ϕ2.func x) x = 0) ∨
      i ∈ ConstComponent d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' U) := by
    by_contra hn
    rw [not_or] at hn
    exact hnot.2 ((act_component_iff d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' U) i).mpr hn)
  rcases h2 with hid2 | hc2
  · rcases h1 with hid1 | hc1
    · exact hi.1 (pointwise_zero_comp d ϕ1 ϕ2 U i hid1 hid2 (triangle i))
    · apply hi.2
      intro x hx y hy
      exact (component_distance_of_pointwise_zero d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' U) i hid2
        (symm i) (triangle i) _ (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx) _
        (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hy)).trans (hc1 x hx y hy)
  · exact hi.2 (const_comp_outer_const_exact d ϕ1 ϕ2 U i hc2)

/-- OET anchor: h-e1615fa20ede09bc
复合算子的有效分量包含于两步各自有效分量的并。
-/
theorem act_comp_inclusion_exact (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (h_U_dom : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]))
    (symm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ i x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    ActComponent d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) U ⊆
    ActComponent d ϕ1 U ∪ ActComponent d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' U) := by
  have _ := h_U_dom
  exact act_comp_inclusion_helper d ϕ1 ϕ2 U symm triangle

/-- 链上各步在实际像域的有效分量之并。 -/
def chain_act_components (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (U : Set X) : List (Operator X bot) → Set I
  | [] => ∅
  | ϕ :: tail => chain_act_components d U tail ∪ ActComponent d ϕ ((OperatorChain tail).func '' U)

/-- OET anchor: h-e1615fa20ede09bc
有限复合的有效分量包含律，包括零步情形。
-/
theorem act_comp_inclusion_chain (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X)
    (dist_self : ∀ i x, d i x x = 0)
    (symm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ i x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z) :
    U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain ϕs) →
    ActComponent d (OperatorChain ϕs) U ⊆ chain_act_components d U ϕs := by
  induction ϕs with
  | nil =>
    intro _ i hi
    exact False.elim (((act_component_iff d _ U i).mp hi).1 (fun x _ => dist_self i x))
  | cons ϕ tail ih =>
    intro hdom i hi
    have htail : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain tail) := by
      intro x hx hb
      have h := hdom hx
      change ϕ.func ((OperatorChain tail).func x) ≠ bot at h
      exact h (by rw [hb, ϕ.preserves_bot])
    have hcases := act_comp_inclusion_helper d (OperatorChain tail) ϕ U symm triangle hi
    rcases hcases with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (ih htail h)
    · exact Or.inr h

/--
OET anchor: h-8f36f69dab71e689
**注 #h-8f36f69dab71e689（复合分量保持的逆向蕴含一般不成立）**
两点换位算子给出有效分量包含律与恒等分量保持律不可反向的共同反例。
-/
theorem swap_pair_factors_active_but_composite_identity (ϕ1 ϕ2 : Operator X bot) (i : I) (a b : X)
    (hϕ1a : ϕ1.func a = b)
    (hϕ1b : ϕ1.func b = a)
    (hϕ2a : ϕ2.func a = b)
    (hϕ2b : ϕ2.func b = a)
    (h_image : ϕ1.func '' ({a, b} : Set X) = ({a, b} : Set X))
    (h_ba_pos : 0 < d i b a)
    (h_self_a : d i a a = 0)
    (h_self_b : d i b b = 0) :
    i ∈ ActComponent d ϕ1 ({a, b} : Set X) ∧
      i ∈ ActComponent d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' ({a, b} : Set X)) ∧
      i ∈ IdComponent d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) ({a, b} : Set X) ∧
      i ∉ ActComponent d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) ({a, b} : Set X) := by
  have mem_a : a ∈ ({a, b} : Set X) := Set.mem_insert_iff.mpr (Or.inl rfl)
  have mem_b : b ∈ ({a, b} : Set X) := Set.mem_insert_iff.mpr (Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton b))
  have hϕ1_act : i ∈ ActComponent d ϕ1 ({a, b} : Set X) := by
    constructor
    · intro h_id
      have h_zero := h_id.2 a mem_a
      rw [hϕ1a] at h_zero
      exact (ne_of_gt h_ba_pos) h_zero
    · intro h_const
      have h_zero := h_const a mem_a b mem_b
      rw [hϕ1a, hϕ1b] at h_zero
      exact (ne_of_gt h_ba_pos) h_zero
  have hϕ2_act_on_U : i ∈ ActComponent d ϕ2 ({a, b} : Set X) := by
    constructor
    · intro h_id
      have h_zero := h_id.2 a mem_a
      rw [hϕ2a] at h_zero
      exact (ne_of_gt h_ba_pos) h_zero
    · intro h_const
      have h_zero := h_const a mem_a b mem_b
      rw [hϕ2a, hϕ2b] at h_zero
      exact (ne_of_gt h_ba_pos) h_zero
  have hϕ2_act : i ∈ ActComponent d ϕ2 (ϕ1.func '' ({a, b} : Set X)) := by
    rw [h_image]
    exact hϕ2_act_on_U
  have h_comp_id : i ∈ IdComponent d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) ({a, b} : Set X) := by
    constructor
    · intro hc
      have hz := hc b mem_b a mem_a
      simp [OperatorChain, hϕ1a, hϕ1b, hϕ2a, hϕ2b] at hz
      exact (ne_of_gt h_ba_pos) hz
    · intro z hz
      rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hz with hza | hzb_mem
      · simp [hza, OperatorChain, hϕ1a, hϕ2b, h_self_a]
      · have hzb : z = b := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hzb_mem
        simp [hzb, OperatorChain, hϕ1b, hϕ2a, h_self_b]
  have h_not_act : i ∉ ActComponent d (OperatorChain [ϕ2, ϕ1]) ({a, b} : Set X) := by
    intro h_act
    exact h_act.1 h_comp_id
  exact ⟨hϕ1_act, hϕ2_act, h_comp_id, h_not_act⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-176471fbe0cf6b8c
**命题 #h-176471fbe0cf6b8c（分量类型的矩阵约束）- 常值分量的 co-Lip 零条目**
常值输出分量使所有在源域上有正距离的 co-Lip 通道条目为零。
-/
theorem const_component_colip_entry_eq_zero (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    [Fintype I]
    (K : I → I → ENNReal) (i k : I)
    (h_const : i ∈ ConstComponent d ϕ U)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K)
    (hpos : ∃ x ∈ U, ∃ y ∈ U, 0 < d k x y) :
    K k i = 0 := by
  rcases hpos with ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy_pos⟩
  have hout : d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 := h_const x hx y hy
  exact
    _root_.formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.colip_entry_eq_zero_of_output_zero_input_pos
      d ϕ U K k i x y hK hx hy hout hxy_pos

/--
OET anchor: h-176471fbe0cf6b8c
**命题 #h-176471fbe0cf6b8c（分量类型的矩阵约束）- 常值分量的零 Lip 行**
常值输出分量的单行 Lip 上界可取零。
-/
theorem const_component_zero_lip_row_bound (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I)
    [Fintype I]
    (h_const : i ∈ ConstComponent d ϕ U) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
      d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ k : I, (0 : ENNReal) * d k x y := by
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [h_const x hx y hy]
  exact zero_le _

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.metric_entropy
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.component_partition
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Set.Image
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic

set_option linter.style.longLine false

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

noncomputable section

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}
local instance instDecidableEqIComputationalFiber : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/-- 非空有限子族 -/
abbrev NonemptyFinset (I : Type) := { J : Finset I // J.Nonempty }


/-- 单元素非空子族 -/
def singleton_nonempty_finset (j : I) : NonemptyFinset I := ⟨{j}, Finset.singleton_nonempty j⟩

/-- 全指标非空子族。 -/
def full_nonempty_finset [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] : NonemptyFinset I :=
  ⟨Finset.univ, Finset.univ_nonempty⟩

**定义（子族复合伪度量）**
$d_J(x, y) := \max_{j \in J} d_j(x, y)$
-/
def comp_pseudo_metric (J : NonemptyFinset I) (x y : X) : ENNReal :=
  J.val.sup (fun j => d j x y)

/-- 有限子族上的最大复合伪度量等于基础章定义的子族复合伪度量。 -/
theorem comp_pseudo_metric_eq_subfamily (J : NonemptyFinset I) :
    comp_pseudo_metric d J =
      subfamily_pseudometric d (↑J.val : Set I) := by
  funext x y
  apply le_antisymm
  · dsimp [comp_pseudo_metric, subfamily_pseudometric]
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro j hj
    exact le_iSup_of_le ⟨j, hj⟩ le_rfl
  · dsimp [comp_pseudo_metric, subfamily_pseudometric]
    apply iSup_le
    intro j
    exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun k => d k x y) j.2

/-- A singleton finite subfamily recovers the selected component. -/
@[simp]
theorem comp_pseudo_metric_singleton (i : I) :
    comp_pseudo_metric d (singleton_nonempty_finset i) = d i := by
  funext x y
  dsimp [comp_pseudo_metric, singleton_nonempty_finset]
  simp

/--
复合伪度量 $d_J$ 等于 0 当且仅当子族中的每个测度均为 0。
-/
theorem comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff (J : NonemptyFinset I) (x y : X) :
    comp_pseudo_metric d J x y = 0 ↔ ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j x y = 0 := by
  dsimp [comp_pseudo_metric]
  exact Finset.sup_eq_bot_iff (fun j => d j x y) J.val

**定义（计算纤维）**
$\operatorname{Fib}_{\phi, J}(y \mid U) := \{x \in U \mid d_J(\phi(x), y) = 0\}$
-/
def ComputationalFiber (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y : X) : Set X :=
  { x ∈ U | comp_pseudo_metric d J (ϕ.func x) y = 0 }

  · intro h

    have h_j0 := h j0 hj0
    have hx_U := h_j0.1
    constructor
    · exact hx_U
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y).mpr

theorem fiber_eq_of_comp_dist_zero (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X) (y y' : X)
    (triangle : ∀ j x y z, d j x z ≤ d j x y + d j y z)
    (symm : ∀ j x y, d j x y = d j y x)
    (h_dist : comp_pseudo_metric d J y y' = 0) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y = ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y' := by
  ext x
  dsimp [ComputationalFiber]
  have h_zero : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j y y' = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J y y').mp h_dist
  have h_y_y'_symm : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j y' y = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [symm]
    exact h_zero j hj
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx_U, h_comp⟩
    have h_x_y : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (ϕ.func x) y = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y).mp h_comp
    constructor
    · exact hx_U
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y').mpr
      intro j hj
      have h_le := triangle j (ϕ.func x) y y'
      rw [h_x_y j hj, h_zero j hj, add_zero] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
  · rintro ⟨hx_U, h_comp⟩
    have h_x_y' : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (ϕ.func x) y' = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y').mp h_comp
    constructor
    · exact hx_U
    · apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y).mpr
      intro j hj
      have h_le := triangle j (ϕ.func x) y' y
      rw [h_x_y' j hj, h_y_y'_symm j hj, add_zero] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)

theorem fiber_partition (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X)
    (self_dist_zero : ∀ j x, d j x x = 0) :
    ⋃ y ∈ ϕ.func '' U, ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y = U := by

    exact h_fib.1
  · intro hx

    use Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func hx
    dsimp [ComputationalFiber]
    constructor
    · exact hx

计算纤维的互斥属性：对于任意两个像点，其纤维要么相等，要么不交。

theorem fiber_disjoint (ϕ : Operator X bot) (J : NonemptyFinset I) (U : Set X)
    (triangle : ∀ i x y z, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z)
    (symm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x) :
    ∀ y1 ∈ ϕ.func '' U, ∀ y2 ∈ ϕ.func '' U,
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y1 = ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y2 ∨
    Disjoint (ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y1) (ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y2) := by
  intro y1 _ y2 _
  by_cases h_comp : comp_pseudo_metric d J y1 y2 = 0
  · left
    exact fiber_eq_of_comp_dist_zero d ϕ J U y1 y2 triangle symm h_comp
  · right
    rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hx.1.2
    have h2 := hx.2.2
    have h_x_y1 : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (ϕ.func x) y1 = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y1).mp h1
    have h_x_y2 : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (ϕ.func x) y2 = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (ϕ.func x) y2).mp h2
    have h_y1_y2 : ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j y1 y2 = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      have h_le := triangle j y1 (ϕ.func x) y2
      rw [symm j y1 (ϕ.func x), h_x_y1 j hj, h_x_y2 j hj, zero_add] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
    have h_comp_zero : comp_pseudo_metric d J y1 y2 = 0 := (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J y1 y2).mpr h_y1_y2
    exact False.elim (h_comp h_comp_zero)

    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ)
    (J K : NonemptyFinset I)
    (hmetric : ∀ i, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i)) :
    (∀ y y', comp_pseudo_metric d J y y' = 0 →
      ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y = ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y') ∧
    ((⋃ y ∈ ϕ.func '' U, ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y) = U ∧
      ∀ y₁ ∈ ϕ.func '' U, ∀ y₂ ∈ ϕ.func '' U,
        ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y₁ = ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y₂ ∨
          Disjoint (ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U y₁)

      have h_le := triangle (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func u0) y
      rw [h_const_zero, hy_equiv, zero_add] at h_le
      exact le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)

/--
OET anchor: h-8d9c504286a147a3
**命题（计算纤维的基本性质，(vi)）- 常值分量的空纤维**
常值分量在与常值像正距分离的目标上给出空纤维。
-/
theorem const_component_singleton_fiber_eq_empty_for_separated_target
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (u0 y : X)
    (hu0 : u0 ∈ U)
    (h_const : i ∈ ConstComponent d ϕ U)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d i x y = d i y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d i x z ≤ d i x y + d i y z)
    (hy_pos : 0 < d i y (ϕ.func u0)) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset i) U y = ∅ := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have h_fib_zero : d i (ϕ.func x) y = 0 := by
      have h_all :=
        (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset i)
          (ϕ.func x) y).mp hx.2
      exact h_all i (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
    have h_const_zero : d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func u0) = 0 :=
      h_const x hx.1 u0 hu0
    have h_y_φx : d i y (ϕ.func x) = 0 := by
      rw [symm y (ϕ.func x), h_fib_zero]
    have h_le := triangle y (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func u0)
    rw [h_y_φx, h_const_zero, zero_add] at h_le
    have h_zero : d i y (ϕ.func u0) = 0 := le_antisymm h_le (zero_le _)
    exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hy_pos) h_zero)
  · intro hx
    exact False.elim hx

end

theorem log2_ereal_mono {x y : ENNReal} (h : x ≤ y) : log2_ereal x ≤ log2_ereal y := by
  dsimp [log2_ereal]
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [if_pos hx]
    exact bot_le
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · rw [hy] at h
      have h_x0 : x = 0 := bot_unique h
      contradiction
    · rw [if_neg hy]
      by_cases hy_top : y = ⊤
      · rw [if_pos hy_top]
        exact le_top
      · rw [if_neg hy_top]
        by_cases hx_top : x = ⊤
        · rw [hx_top] at h
          have h_y_top : y = ⊤ := top_unique h
          contradiction
        · rw [if_neg hx_top]
          apply EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr
          dsimp [Real.logb]
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          · apply Real.log_le_log
            · exact ENNReal.toReal_pos hx hx_top
            · exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hy_top h
          · apply le_of_lt
            exact Real.log_pos one_lt_two
theorem ereal_sub_le_sub_left {a b c : EReal} (h : a ≤ b) : c - b ≤ c - a := by
  exact EReal.sub_le_sub le_rfl h

@[simp]
theorem log2_ereal_one : log2_ereal (1 : ENNReal) = 0 := by
  norm_num [log2_ereal, Real.logb]

/--

**注（映射熵差的望远镜恒等式）**
有限实数熵列的相邻差满足望远镜恒等式。

theorem real_entropy_difference_telescopes (E : Nat → ℝ) (k : Nat) :
    (∑ m ∈ range k, (E m - E (m + 1))) = E 0 - E k := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [sum_range_succ, ih]
      ring

/-- 基础内覆盖在单分量伪度量上的特化。 -/
abbrev IsEpsilonNet (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (centers : Finset X) : Prop :=
  InternalEpsilonNet (d i) ε U centers

/-- 复合度量 $d_J$ 的 $\varepsilon$-覆盖网 -/
abbrev IsEpsilonNetComp (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (U : Set X) (centers : Finset X) : Prop :=
  InternalEpsilonNet (comp_pseudo_metric d J) ε U centers

/-- 子族覆盖数 $\mathcal N_J(\varepsilon,U)$。 -/
noncomputable def cov_num_comp (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  covering_number (comp_pseudo_metric d J) ε U

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- 有限子族记号给出的覆盖数等于对应子族复合伪度量的覆盖数。 -/
theorem cov_num_comp_eq_subfamily_covering_number
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) :
    cov_num_comp d J ε U =
      covering_number
        (subfamily_pseudometric d (↑J.val : Set I)) ε U := by
  rw [cov_num_comp, comp_pseudo_metric_eq_subfamily]

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- The singleton subfamily covering number is the single-component one. -/
theorem cov_num_comp_singleton_eq_cov_num
    (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) :
    cov_num_comp d (singleton_nonempty_finset i) ε U =
      covering_number (d i) ε U := by
  rw [cov_num_comp, comp_pseudo_metric_singleton]

omit [Fintype I] in
theorem cov_num_comp_le_of_epsilon_net (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (centers : Finset X) (hnet : IsEpsilonNetComp d J ε U centers) :
    cov_num_comp d J ε U ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) := by
  dsimp [cov_num_comp]
  exact le_trans
    (iInf_le
      (fun centers : Finset X =>
        ⨅ (_ : IsEpsilonNetComp d J ε U centers), (centers.card : ENNReal))
      centers)
    (iInf_le
      (fun _ : IsEpsilonNetComp d J ε U centers => (centers.card : ENNReal))
      hnet)

/-- 覆盖数 $\mathcal{N}_i(\varepsilon, U)$，即基础覆盖数在单分量伪度量上的特化。 -/
noncomputable def cov_num (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  covering_number (d i) ε U

omit [Fintype I] in
/-- A real-valued metric entropy has finite covering number. -/
theorem cov_num_lt_top_of_metric_entropy_eq_real
    (j : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X) (e : ℝ)
    (hentropy : metric_entropy (d j) ε U = (e : EReal)) :
    cov_num d j ε U < ⊤ := by
  apply lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr
  intro htop
  have hcover_top : covering_number (d j) ε U = ⊤ := by
    simpa [cov_num] using htop
  have hentropy_top : metric_entropy (d j) ε U = ⊤ := by
    simp [metric_entropy, log2_ereal, hcover_top]
  rw [hentropy_top] at hentropy
  exact EReal.coe_ne_top e hentropy.symm

/-- Coercion from real numbers to `EReal` preserves finite sums. -/
theorem mapping_ereal_coe_finset_sum {A : Type} (s : Finset A) (f : A → ℝ) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, ((f a : ℝ) : EReal)) = (((∑ a ∈ s, f a) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih => simp [ha, ih]

omit [Fintype I] in
theorem cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (centers : Finset X) (hnet : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers) :
    cov_num d i ε U ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) := by
  dsimp [cov_num]
  exact le_trans
    (iInf_le (fun centers : Finset X => ⨅ (_ : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers), (centers.card : ENNReal)) centers)
    (iInf_le (fun _ : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers => (centers.card : ENNReal)) hnet)

omit [Fintype I] in
theorem one_le_cov_num_of_nonempty (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U.Nonempty) :
    (1 : ENNReal) ≤ cov_num d i ε U := by
  dsimp [cov_num]
  apply le_iInf
  intro centers
  apply le_iInf
  intro hnet
  rcases hU with ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases hnet.2 x hx with ⟨c, hc, _⟩
  exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨c, hc⟩))

/--
OET anchor: h-56e96ed2cda64242
**命题（分量分划与映射熵差）- 零直径非空集合的覆盖数**
若非空集合中任意两点在分量 `i` 下零距，则其任意正精度覆盖数为 `1`。
-/
theorem cov_num_eq_one_of_nonempty_zero_diameter (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (V : Set X)
    (hV : V.Nonempty)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, d i x y = 0) :
    cov_num d i ε V = 1 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rcases hV with ⟨v0, hv0⟩
    let centers : Finset X := {v0}
    have hnet : IsEpsilonNet d i ε V centers := by
      dsimp [IsEpsilonNet, centers]
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        have hx_eq : x = v0 := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
        simpa [hx_eq] using hv0
      · intro x hx
        use v0
        constructor
        · exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
        · rw [hzero x hx v0 hv0]
          exact hε
    have hle : cov_num d i ε V ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) :=
      cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net d i ε V centers hnet
    simpa [centers] using hle
  · exact one_le_cov_num_of_nonempty d i ε V hV

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-56e96ed2cda64242
**命题（分量分划与映射熵差）- 受限等距保持覆盖数**
若 `ϕ` 在 `U` 上保持分量 `i` 的点对距离，则像集与原集合的覆盖数相等。
-/
theorem cov_num_image_eq_of_component_distance_preserving
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i : I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (hdist : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = d i x y) :
    cov_num d i ε (ϕ.func '' U) = cov_num d i ε U := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · dsimp [cov_num]
    apply le_iInf
    intro centers_U
    apply le_iInf
    intro hnet_U
    let centers_V := centers_U.image ϕ.func
    have hnet_V : IsEpsilonNet d i ε (ϕ.func '' U) centers_V := by
      dsimp [IsEpsilonNet, centers_V] at hnet_U ⊢
      constructor
      · intro z hz
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image] at hz
        rcases hz with ⟨u, hu, hzu⟩
        have huU : u ∈ U := hnet_U.1 hu
        rw [← hzu]
        exact Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func huU
      · intro z hz
        rcases hz with ⟨x, hxU, hz_eq⟩
        rcases hnet_U.2 x hxU with ⟨c, hc, hc_lt⟩
        have hcU : c ∈ U := hnet_U.1 hc
        use ϕ.func c
        constructor
        · exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func hc
        · rw [← hz_eq, hdist x hxU c hcU]
          exact hc_lt
    have hle : cov_num d i ε (ϕ.func '' U) ≤ (centers_V.card : ENNReal) :=
      cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net d i ε (ϕ.func '' U) centers_V hnet_V
    exact le_trans hle (Nat.cast_le.mpr Finset.card_image_le)
  · dsimp [cov_num]
    apply le_iInf
    intro centers_V
    apply le_iInf
    intro hnet_V
    have h_ex : ∀ v ∈ centers_V, ∃ u ∈ U, ϕ.func u = v := by
      intro v hv
      have hv_image : v ∈ ϕ.func '' U := hnet_V.1 hv
      exact (Set.mem_image ϕ.func U v).mp hv_image
    let pre (v : X) (hv : v ∈ centers_V) : X := Classical.choose (h_ex v hv)
    have hpre : ∀ v (hv : v ∈ centers_V), pre v hv ∈ U ∧ ϕ.func (pre v hv) = v := by
      intro v hv
      exact Classical.choose_spec (h_ex v hv)
    let centers_U := centers_V.attach.image (fun v : {x // x ∈ centers_V} => pre v.val v.prop)
    have hnet_U : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers_U := by
      dsimp [IsEpsilonNet, centers_U]
      constructor
      · intro u hu
        rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image] at hu
        rcases hu with ⟨v, _, huv⟩
        rw [← huv]
        exact (hpre v.val v.prop).1
      · intro x hxU
        have hφx : ϕ.func x ∈ ϕ.func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func hxU
        rcases hnet_V.2 (ϕ.func x) hφx with ⟨v, hv, hv_lt⟩
        use pre v hv
        constructor
        · rw [Finset.mem_image]
          exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, Finset.mem_attach centers_V ⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩
        · have hp := hpre v hv
          rw [← hdist x hxU (pre v hv) hp.1, hp.2]
          exact hv_lt
    have hle : cov_num d i ε U ≤ (centers_U.card : ENNReal) :=
      cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net d i ε U centers_U hnet_U
    have h_card : (centers_U.card : ENNReal) ≤ (centers_V.card : ENNReal) := by
      apply Nat.cast_le.mpr
      have h_attach : centers_V.attach.card = centers_V.card := Finset.card_attach
      rw [← h_attach]
      exact Finset.card_image_le
    exact le_trans hle h_card

set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-56e96ed2cda64242
**命题（分量分划与映射熵差）- 常值分量输出覆盖数**
常值分量在非空受限域上的像集覆盖数为 `1`。
-/
theorem const_component_image_cov_num_eq_one
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (hU : U.Nonempty)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_const : j ∈ ConstComponent d ϕ U) :
    cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) = 1 := by
  have h_image_nonempty : (ϕ.func '' U).Nonempty := hU.image ϕ.func
  apply cov_num_eq_one_of_nonempty_zero_diameter d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) h_image_nonempty hε
  intro y hy z hz
  rcases hy with ⟨x, hxU, hy_eq⟩
  rcases hz with ⟨w, hwU, hz_eq⟩
  rw [← hy_eq, ← hz_eq]
  exact h_const x hxU w hwU

/--

恒等分量在对应分量下保持像集覆盖数。

theorem id_component_image_cov_num_eq
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (h_id : j ∈ IdComponent d ϕ U)
    (symm : ∀ x y : X, d j x y = d j y x)
    (triangle : ∀ x y z : X, d j x z ≤ d j x y + d j y z) :
    cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) = cov_num d j ε U := by
  have hdist : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = d j x y :=
    id_component_preserves_component_distance d ϕ U j h_id symm triangle
  exact cov_num_image_eq_of_component_distance_preserving d ϕ U j ε hdist

/--
OET anchor: h-f4a4cb93f576325e
**注（有限集上映射熵差的良定性）- 有限集覆盖数有限**
有限集在正精度下具有有限覆盖数。
-/
theorem cov_num_lt_top_of_finite (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (hU_fin : U.Finite)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (self_dist_zero : ∀ z, d i z z = 0) :
    cov_num d i ε U < ⊤ := by
  let centers := hU_fin.toFinset
  have hnet : IsEpsilonNet d i ε U centers := by
    dsimp [IsEpsilonNet, centers]
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      exact (hU_fin.mem_toFinset.mp hx)
    · intro x hx
      use x
      constructor
      · exact hU_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr hx
      · rw [self_dist_zero x]
        exact hε
  have hle : cov_num d i ε U ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) :=
    cov_num_le_of_epsilon_net d i ε U centers hnet
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top centers.card))

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-f4a4cb93f576325e
**注（有限集上映射熵差的良定性）- 子族覆盖数有限**
有限集在任意非空有限子族的复合伪度量下具有有限覆盖数。
-/
theorem cov_num_comp_lt_top_of_finite (J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (hU_fin : U.Finite)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (self_dist_zero : ∀ j z, d j z z = 0) :
    cov_num_comp d J ε U < ⊤ := by
  let centers := hU_fin.toFinset
  have hnet : IsEpsilonNetComp d J ε U centers := by
    dsimp [IsEpsilonNetComp, centers]
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      exact hU_fin.mem_toFinset.mp hx
    · intro x hx
      use x
      constructor
      · exact hU_fin.mem_toFinset.mpr hx
      · apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ hε
        exact le_of_eq ((comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J x x).mpr
          (fun j _ => self_dist_zero j x))
  have hle : cov_num_comp d J ε U ≤ (centers.card : ENNReal) :=
    cov_num_comp_le_of_epsilon_net d J ε U centers hnet
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top centers.card))


/-- 全有界假设 -/
def IsTotallyBounded (i : I) (U : Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε > 0, ε ≠ ⊤ → cov_num d i ε U < ⊤

/-- 映射熵差良定性（非空且至少有一端有限，从而排除 -∞ - (-∞) 和 ⊤ - ⊤） -/
def EntropyDiffWellDefined (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (ε : ENNReal) : Prop :=
  U.Nonempty ∧ (cov_num d i ε U < ⊤ ∨ cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) < ⊤)

/-- 子族映射熵差良定性。 -/
def SubfamilyEntropyDiffWellDefined (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal) : Prop :=
  U.Nonempty ∧
    (cov_num_comp d K ε U < ⊤ ∨
      cov_num_comp d J ε (ϕ.func '' U) < ⊤)

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-f4a4cb93f576325e
**注（有限集上映射熵差的良定性）**
非空有限集及其像集的覆盖数均有限，因此映射熵差良定。
-/
theorem finite_set_mapping_entropy_diff_well_defined
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (hU_fin : U.Finite)
    (hε : 0 < ε)
    (_hε_ne_top : ε ≠ ⊤)
    (self_dist_zero : ∀ k z, d k z z = 0) :
    cov_num d i ε U < ⊤ ∧
      cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) < ⊤ ∧
      EntropyDiffWellDefined d ϕ U i j ε := by
  have hU_cov : cov_num d i ε U < ⊤ :=
    cov_num_lt_top_of_finite d i ε U hU_fin hε (self_dist_zero i)
  have h_image_fin : (ϕ.func '' U).Finite := hU_fin.image ϕ.func
  have h_image_cov : cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) < ⊤ :=
    cov_num_lt_top_of_finite d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) h_image_fin hε (self_dist_zero j)
  exact ⟨hU_cov, h_image_cov, ⟨hU_nonempty, Or.inl hU_cov⟩⟩

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-f4a4cb93f576325e
**注（有限集上映射熵差的良定性）**
非空有限集在任意非空子族 `K,J` 上的输入熵与像集熵均有限，
因此子族映射熵差良定。
-/
theorem finite_set_subfamily_mapping_entropy_diff_well_defined
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (K J : NonemptyFinset I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (hUdom : U ⊆ dom ϕ)
    (hU_fin : U.Finite)

    · intro z hz

      rcases h_net_U.2 x hx_U with ⟨c, hc_in, hc_lt⟩
      use ϕ.func c

    rcases hK with ⟨_, _, hK_ineq⟩
    have h_colip_sum := hK_ineq x hx y hy j
    have h_sum_lower : K i j * d i x y ≤ ∑ k : I, K k j * d k x y := by
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun (k : I) _ => zero_le (K k j * d k x y))
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact le_trans h_sum_lower h_colip_sum
  have h_cov :=
    colip_cov_num_bound_aux d ϕ U i j (K i j) (ε / K i j)
      h_colip h_K_pos h_K_ne_top
  have h_mul_div : K i j * (ε / K i j) = ε :=
    ENNReal.mul_div_cancel'
      (fun h => False.elim ((ne_of_gt h_K_pos) h))
      (fun h => False.elim (h_K_ne_top h))
  rw [h_mul_div] at h_cov
  have h_cov_log := log2_ereal_mono h_cov
  exact ereal_sub_le_sub_left h_cov_log

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
**代数辅助引理（零化半径给出的输出熵上界）**
-/
theorem resolution_limit_annihilation_bound_aux (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (ν ε : ENNReal)
    (h_nu : min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U = ν)
    (h_eps_pos : 0 < ε) :
    cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) ≤ cov_num d i ν U := by
  dsimp [cov_num]
  apply le_iInf
  intro centers_U
  apply le_iInf
  intro h_net_U

  -- The image of centers_U under ϕ
  let centers_V := centers_U.image ϕ.func

  have h_net_V : IsEpsilonNet d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) centers_V := by
    dsimp [IsEpsilonNet]
    constructor
    · intro v hv
      have hv_in := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
      rcases hv_in with ⟨u, hu, hv_eq⟩
      have hu_in : u ∈ U := h_net_U.1 hu
      rw [← hv_eq]
      exact Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ.func hu_in
    · intro v hv
      rcases (Set.mem_image ϕ.func U v).mp hv with ⟨u, hu, hv_eq⟩
      have h_u_ex := h_net_U.2 u hu
      rcases h_u_ex with ⟨c, hc, hc_dist⟩

      have h_nu_le_ann : ν ≤ annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U c := by
        rw [← h_nu]
        dsimp [min_annihilation_radius]
        have hc_in_U : c ∈ U := h_net_U.1 hc
        exact iInf₂_le c hc_in_U

      have hc_dist_lt : d i u c < annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U c := lt_of_lt_of_le hc_dist h_nu_le_ann

      have h_sup := lt_iSup_iff.mp hc_dist_lt
      rcases h_sup with ⟨r, hr⟩
      have h_sup2 := lt_iSup_iff.mp hr
      rcases h_sup2 with ⟨hr_pos, hr2⟩
      have h_sup3 := lt_iSup_iff.mp hr2
      rcases h_sup3 with ⟨h_sub, h_final⟩

      have hu_in_ball : u ∈ OpenBall d i c r ∩ U := ⟨h_final, hu⟩
      have hu_in_fiber := h_sub hu_in_ball

      dsimp [ComputationalFiber] at hu_in_fiber
      have hu_fib := hu_in_fiber.2
      have h_iff := comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j) (ϕ.func u) (ϕ.func c)
      have hd_j_zero : d j (ϕ.func u) (ϕ.func c) = 0 := (h_iff.mp hu_fib) j (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)

      use ϕ.func c
      constructor
      · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      · rw [← hv_eq]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_of_eq hd_j_zero) h_eps_pos

  have h_le := iInf_le (fun (c : Finset X) => ⨅ (_ : IsEpsilonNet d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) c), (c.card : ENNReal)) centers_V
  have h_le2 := iInf_le (fun (_ : IsEpsilonNet d j ε (ϕ.func '' U) centers_V) => (centers_V.card : ENNReal)) h_net_V

  have h_card_le : (centers_V.card : ENNReal) ≤ (centers_U.card : ENNReal) := by
    exact Nat.cast_le.mpr Finset.card_image_le

  exact le_trans (le_trans h_le h_le2) h_card_le

/--
OET anchor: h-e9598cebcf324e28
**命题 #h-e9598cebcf324e28（零化半径给出的输出熵上界）**
-/
theorem resolution_limit_annihilation_bound_exact (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (ν ε : ENNReal)
    (_h_dom : U ⊆ dom ϕ)
    (_h_nempty : U.Nonempty)
    (h_nu_val : min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U = ν)
    (h_nu_pos : 0 < ν)
    (h_nu_ne_top : ν ≠ ⊤)
    (h_eps_pos : 0 < ε)
    (_h_eps_ne_top : ε ≠ ⊤)
    (h_tb : IsTotallyBounded d i U) :
    cov_num d i ν U < ⊤ ∧
    log2_ereal (cov_num d j ε (ϕ.func '' U)) ≤ log2_ereal (cov_num d i ν U) := by
  constructor
  · exact h_tb ν h_nu_pos h_nu_ne_top
  · have h_cov := resolution_limit_annihilation_bound_aux d ϕ U i j ν ε h_nu_val h_eps_pos
    exact log2_ereal_mono h_cov

end

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.matrix_composition
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.path_algebra
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.annihilation_matrix

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

noncomputable section

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy
open Set


open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}

/--
OET anchor: h-92938f295a2b0333
**定义（恒等算子）**
-/
def id_operator : Operator X bot := ⟨id, rfl⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-92938f295a2b0333
**定义（代数因式分解）**
排除两个平凡恒等因子。
-/
def AlgebraicFactorization (ϕ : Operator X bot) : Prop :=
  ∃ ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot,
    ϕ₁ ≠ id_operator ∧ ϕ₂ ≠ id_operator ∧ OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁] = ϕ

/-- 给定非平凡因子即给出代数因式分解。 -/
theorem algebraic_factorization_of_witness (ϕ ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot)
    (h₁ : ϕ₁ ≠ id_operator) (h₂ : ϕ₂ ≠ id_operator)
    (hcomp : OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁] = ϕ) :
    AlgebraicFactorization ϕ := by
  exact ⟨ϕ₁, ϕ₂, h₁, h₂, hcomp⟩

/--
域限制算子：在 `U` 内等于原算子，在 `U` 外映到 `bot`。
-/
noncomputable def restrict_operator (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Operator X bot := by
  classical
  exact
    ⟨fun x => if x ∈ U then ϕ.func x else bot, by
      by_cases hbot : bot ∈ U
      · simp [hbot, ϕ.preserves_bot]
      · simp [hbot]⟩

theorem restrict_operator_apply_of_mem (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (restrict_operator ϕ U).func x = ϕ.func x := by
  classical
  simp [restrict_operator, hx]

theorem restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∉ U) :
    (restrict_operator ϕ U).func x = bot := by
  classical
  simp [restrict_operator, hx]

/-- 若 `U ⊆ dom ϕ`，则限制算子的定义域正好是 `U`。 -/
theorem dom_restrict_operator_eq (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    dom (restrict_operator ϕ U) = U := by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · constructor
    · intro _; exact hx
    · intro _hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem ϕ U hx]
      exact hU hx
  · constructor
    · intro hdom
      dsimp [dom] at hdom
      rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem ϕ U hx] at hdom
      exact False.elim (hdom rfl)
    · intro h
      exact False.elim (hx h)

/--
OET anchor: h-a63623c9504af642
**命题 #h-a63623c9504af642（域限制与复合的相容性）**
域限制与二步复合在给定像域限制下相容。
-/
theorem restrict_comp_eq (ϕ₁ ϕ₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) :
    restrict_operator (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]) U =
      OperatorChain [restrict_operator ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U), restrict_operator ϕ₁ U] := by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ U
  · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]) U hx]
    dsimp [OperatorChain]
    rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem ϕ₁ U hx]
    have him : ϕ₁.func x ∈ ϕ₁.func '' U := Set.mem_image_of_mem ϕ₁.func hx
    rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U) him]
  · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem (OperatorChain [ϕ₂, ϕ₁]) U hx]
    dsimp [OperatorChain]
    rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem ϕ₁ U hx]
    by_cases hbot : bot ∈ ϕ₁.func '' U
    · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U) hbot, ϕ₂.preserves_bot]
    · rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_not_mem ϕ₂ (ϕ₁.func '' U) hbot]

/-- 局部等价：两个算子在 `U` 上逐点相等。 -/
def LocalEquivalent (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ U, ϕ.func x = ψ.func x

/-- 局部等价等价于域限制算子相等。 -/
theorem local_equivalent_iff_restrict_eq (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) :
    LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U ↔ restrict_operator ϕ U = restrict_operator ψ U := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · simp [restrict_operator, hx, h x hx]
    · simp [restrict_operator, hx]
  · intro h x hx
    have happ := congrArg Operator.func h
    have hpoint := congrFun happ x
    simpa [restrict_operator, hx] using hpoint

variable [Fintype I]
local instance instDecidableEqIDecompositionCore : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5f909fa9f5d7da
**命题 #h-3d5f909fa9f5d7da(i)**
Lip 矩阵可从大域限制到小域。
-/
theorem lip_localization (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUV : U ⊆ V)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d ϕ V L) :
    IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L := by
  exact restricted_lip_matrix_family_antitone d ϕ U V hUV hL

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5f909fa9f5d7da
**命题 #h-3d5f909fa9f5d7da(ii)**
co-Lip 矩阵可从大域限制到非空小域。
-/
theorem colip_localization (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hU_ne : U.Nonempty)
    (hUV : U ⊆ V)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ V K) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K := by
  exact restricted_colip_matrix_family_antitone d ϕ U V hU_ne hUV hK

/--
OET anchor: h-5846008cae9ea67d
**命题 #h-5846008cae9ea67d（分段合成的全域证书比较界，Lip 分块限制核心）**
分段算子的全域 Lip 矩阵限制到任一分块后，仍是该分块局域算子的 Lip 矩阵。
-/
theorem piecewise_lip_restricts_to_piece (ψ ϕm : Operator X bot) (U Um : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUmU : Um ⊆ U)
    (h_agree : LocalEquivalent ψ ϕm Um)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d ψ U L) :
    IsLipMatrix d ϕm Um L := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [dom]
    rw [← h_agree x hx]
    exact hL.1 (hUmU hx)
  · intro x hx y hy j
    rw [← h_agree x hx, ← h_agree y hy]
    exact hL.2 x (hUmU hx) y (hUmU hy) j

/--
OET anchor: h-5846008cae9ea67d
**命题 #h-5846008cae9ea67d（分段合成的全域证书比较界，co-Lip 分块限制核心）**
分段算子的全域 co-Lip 矩阵限制到任一非空分块后，仍是该分块局域算子的 co-Lip 矩阵。
-/
theorem piecewise_colip_restricts_to_piece (ψ ϕm : Operator X bot) (U Um : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUm_ne : Um.Nonempty)
    (hUmU : Um ⊆ U)
    (h_agree : LocalEquivalent ψ ϕm Um)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d ψ U K) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d ϕm Um K := by
  refine ⟨hUm_ne, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [dom]
    rw [← h_agree x hx]
    exact hK.2.1 (hUmU hx)
  · intro x hx y hy j
    rw [← h_agree x hx, ← h_agree y hy]
    exact hK.2.2 x (hUmU hx) y (hUmU hy) j

/--
OET anchor: h-5bedef30d593a0bc
**引理 #h-5bedef30d593a0bc(i)**
局部等价保持受限 Lip 矩阵族。
-/
theorem local_equiv_lip_matrix_iff (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (h_eq : LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U) :
    IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L ↔ IsLipMatrix d ψ U L := by
  constructor
  · intro hL
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [← h_eq x hx]
      exact hL.1 hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      rw [← h_eq x hx, ← h_eq y hy]
      exact hL.2 x hx y hy j
  · intro hL
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [h_eq x hx]
      exact hL.1 hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      rw [h_eq x hx, h_eq y hy]
      exact hL.2 x hx y hy j

/--
OET anchor: h-5bedef30d593a0bc
**引理 #h-5bedef30d593a0bc(ii)**
局部等价保持受限 co-Lip 矩阵族。
-/
theorem local_equiv_colip_matrix_iff (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (h_eq : LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K ↔ IsCoLipMatrix d ψ U K := by
  constructor
  · intro hK
    refine ⟨hK.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [← h_eq x hx]
      exact hK.2.1 hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      rw [← h_eq x hx, ← h_eq y hy]
      exact hK.2.2 x hx y hy j
  · intro hK
    refine ⟨hK.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [dom]
      rw [h_eq x hx]
      exact hK.2.1 hx
    · intro x hx y hy j
      rw [h_eq x hx, h_eq y hy]
      exact hK.2.2 x hx y hy j

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-5bedef30d593a0bc
**引理 #h-5bedef30d593a0bc(iii) 的纤维核心**
局部等价使同一中心点诱导的计算纤维一致。
-/
theorem local_equiv_computational_fiber_eq (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) (y : X)
    (h_eq : LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    ComputationalFiber d ϕ J U (ϕ.func y) =
      ComputationalFiber d ψ J U (ψ.func y) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hdist⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    rwa [← h_eq x hx, ← h_eq y hy]
  · rintro ⟨hx, hdist⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    rwa [h_eq x hx, h_eq y hy]

/-- A point with different outputs witnesses distinct operators. -/
theorem operator_ne_of_exists_point_ne (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (x₀ : X)
    (hneq : ϕ.func x₀ ≠ ψ.func x₀) :
    ϕ ≠ ψ := by
  intro h
  exact hneq (by rw [h])

/-- Replace one input value by `a` and leave every other point unchanged. -/
noncomputable def replace_at_operator (a b : X) (hb : b ≠ bot) : Operator X bot := by
  classical
  exact
    ⟨fun x => if x = b then a else x, by
      have hbotb : bot ≠ b := Ne.symm hb
      simp [hbotb]⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-11fd78baa402e538
**命题 #h-11fd78baa402e538（局部等价不蕴含全域等价）**
存在两个不同的非吸收点时，可构造定义域相同的两个算子，
使其在共同定义域的非空子集上局部等价，但并非同一算子。
-/
theorem local_equivalent_not_global_counterexample (a b : X)
    (ha : a ≠ bot) (hb : b ≠ bot) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ∃ (ϕ ψ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X),
      dom ϕ = dom ψ ∧ U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
        LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ U ∧ ϕ ≠ ψ := by
  classical
  refine ⟨id_operator, replace_at_operator a b hb, {a}, ?_,
    Set.singleton_nonempty a, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext x
    by_cases hxb : x = b
    · subst x
      simp [dom, id_operator, replace_at_operator, ha, hb]
    · simp [dom, id_operator, replace_at_operator, hxb]
  · intro x hx
    have hxa : x = a := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
    subst x
    simpa [dom, id_operator] using ha
  · intro x hx
    have hxa : x = a := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
    subst x
    simp [id_operator, replace_at_operator, hab]
  · apply operator_ne_of_exists_point_ne (x₀ := b)
    simpa [id_operator, replace_at_operator] using Ne.symm hab

/--
OET anchor: h-a1caa879309ff2e3
**逐步局部等价的列表表示**
逐步局部等价数据。
列表顺序与 `OperatorChain` 一致：尾部先作用，表头后作用。
-/
inductive StepwiseLocalEquivalent :
    List (Operator X bot) → List (Operator X bot) → Set X → Prop
  | nil (U : Set X) : StepwiseLocalEquivalent [] [] U
  | cons {ϕ ψ : Operator X bot} {ϕs ψs : List (Operator X bot)} {U : Set X}
      (h_tail : StepwiseLocalEquivalent ϕs ψs U)
      (h_head : LocalEquivalent ϕ ψ ((OperatorChain ϕs).func '' U)) :
      StepwiseLocalEquivalent (ϕ :: ϕs) (ψ :: ψs) U

/--
OET anchor: h-95e7f90e21e41cae
**命题 #h-95e7f90e21e41cae(ii)**
逐步局部等价推出复合算子在初始域上局部等价。
-/
theorem stepwise_local_equiv_operator_chain :
    ∀ {ϕs ψs : List (Operator X bot)} {U : Set X},
      StepwiseLocalEquivalent ϕs ψs U →
        LocalEquivalent (OperatorChain ϕs) (OperatorChain ψs) U
  | [], [], U, StepwiseLocalEquivalent.nil _ => by
      intro x hx
      rfl
  | ϕ :: ϕs, ψ :: ψs, U, StepwiseLocalEquivalent.cons h_tail h_head => by
      intro x hx
      have h_tail_eq := stepwise_local_equiv_operator_chain h_tail x hx
      have h_head_eq :=
        h_head ((OperatorChain ϕs).func x) (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)
      dsimp [OperatorChain]
      rw [← h_tail_eq]
      exact h_head_eq

/-- Internal predicate for an operator synthesized on a restricted domain. -/
def DomainSynthesis (ψ ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Prop :=
  LocalEquivalent ψ ϕ U ∧ dom ψ = U ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ

/-- Equality criterion for the internal domain-synthesis predicate. -/
theorem domain_synthesis_eq_iff (ψ ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (h_syn : DomainSynthesis ψ ϕ U) :
    ψ = ϕ ↔ U = dom ϕ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h_syn.2.1, h]
  · intro hU
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · exact h_syn.1 x hx
    · have hψ_not_dom : x ∉ dom ψ := by
        rw [h_syn.2.1]
        exact hx
      have hϕ_not_dom : x ∉ dom ϕ := by
        rw [← hU]
        exact hx
      have hψ_bot : ψ.func x = bot := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hψ_not_dom hne
      have hϕ_bot : ϕ.func x = bot := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hϕ_not_dom hne
      rw [hψ_bot, hϕ_bot]

end

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.matrix_composition
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.annihilation_matrix


namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

noncomputable section

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}
local instance instDecidableEqIDistanceRecurrence : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**§ #h-5a1b95150c3a4df2（算子链）**
The chain data is a finite ordered list, and this helper computes its composite.
The internal list is stored in composition order: the tail acts first.
-/
abbrev operator_chain {X : Type} {bot : X} (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) :
    Operator X bot :=
  formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.OperatorChain ϕs

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**定义（距离向量）**
对于两点 `x,y`，距离向量的第 `i` 个分量为 `d i x y`。
-/
def DistanceVector (x y : X) (i : I) : ENNReal := d i x y

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**§ #h-5a1b95150c3a4df2（距离向量递推）**
单步递推数据：同一算子同时携带合法 L/K 矩阵。
-/
structure DistanceVectorRecurrenceStep [Fintype I]
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) where
  L : I → I → ENNReal
  K : I → I → ENNReal
  lip : IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L
  colip : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K

/--
矩阵作用在距离向量上的第 `j` 个分量：
`∑ i, M i j * v i`。
-/
noncomputable def matrix_vector_bound [Fintype I]
    (M : I → I → ENNReal) (v : I → ENNReal) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  ∑ i : I, M i j * v i

/--
OET anchor: h-664ab4248e21a8a0
**命题 #h-664ab4248e21a8a0（零化矩阵的链级下界）**
For a nonempty chain domain and valid Lip matrices on every tail input domain,
the first factor's all-component annihilation radius is a lower bound for every
output component of the composite.
-/
theorem chain_annihilation_matrix_lower_bound [Fintype I]
    (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X) (i j : I)
    (h_len : 2 ≤ ϕs.length)
    (h_dom : U ⊆ dom (OperatorChain ϕs))
    (h_U_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (h_lip : HasTailLipMatrices d U ϕs) :
    min_annihilation_radius d (OperatorChain ϕs) i
        (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U ≥
      ⨅ l : I, min_annihilation_radius d (first_operator ϕs) i
        (singleton_nonempty_finset l) U :=
  composite_zero_radius_bound_1_exact d ϕs U i j h_len h_dom h_U_nonempty h_lip

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**§ #h-5a1b95150c3a4df2（距离向量递推，上界部分）**
合法 Lip 矩阵给出链前后距离向量的逐分量上界。
-/
theorem distance_recurrence_lip_upper [Fintype I]
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound L (DistanceVector d x y) j := by
  intro x hx y hy j
  simpa [matrix_vector_bound, DistanceVector] using hL.2 x hx y hy j

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**§ #h-5a1b95150c3a4df2（距离向量递推，下界部分）**
合法 co-Lip 矩阵给出链前后距离向量的逐分量下界。
-/
theorem distance_recurrence_colip_lower [Fintype I]
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d ϕ U K) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      matrix_vector_bound K (DistanceVector d x y) j ≤
        d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) := by
  intro x hx y hy j
  simpa [matrix_vector_bound, DistanceVector] using hK.2.2 x hx y hy j

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**§ #h-5a1b95150c3a4df2（距离向量递推）**
L/K 两侧界的合并形式。
-/
theorem distance_vector_recurrence_bounds [Fintype I]
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (step : DistanceVectorRecurrenceStep d ϕ U) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      matrix_vector_bound step.K (DistanceVector d x y) j ≤
        d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ∧
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound step.L (DistanceVector d x y) j := by
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact ⟨
    distance_recurrence_colip_lower d ϕ U step.K step.colip x hx y hy j,
    distance_recurrence_lip_upper d ϕ U step.L step.lip x hx y hy j⟩

/--
局部零化球给出单通路输出零距离。

这是正文中零化半径条件的直接 Lean 形式：一旦点对落入某个已证明会进入计算纤维的
开球，目标输出分量必为零。
-/
theorem distance_recurrence_zeroing_of_ball
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (center x : X) (r : ENNReal)
    (hx_ball : x ∈ OpenBall d i center r ∩ U)
    (h_ball :
      OpenBall d i center r ∩ U ⊆
        ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func center)) :
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func center) = 0 := by
  have hx_fiber := h_ball hx_ball
  have h_zero :=
    (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j) (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func center)).mp
      hx_fiber.2
  exact h_zero j (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)

/-- Local core of the chain-level fiber truncation step. -/
theorem chain_fiber_truncation_zero_step_core
    (dist_comm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) (x y : X)
    (hy_fiber :
      y ∈ ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func x)) :
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
  have h_zero_rev :
      d j (ϕ.func y) (ϕ.func x) = 0 :=
    (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d (singleton_nonempty_finset j)
      (ϕ.func y) (ϕ.func x)).mp hy_fiber.2 j
        (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)
  calc
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)
        = d j (ϕ.func y) (ϕ.func x) := dist_comm j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)
    _ = 0 := h_zero_rev

/--
OET anchor: h-9a65248d646a2b6f
**命题 #h-9a65248d646a2b6f（链级纤维截断与零距传播，截断步）**
At an actual chain input domain, membership in the next operator's computational
fiber forces zero output distance in the selected component.
-/
theorem chain_fiber_truncation_zero_step
    (dist_comm : ∀ i x y, d i x y = d i y x)
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) (x y : X)
    (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hy_fiber :
      y ∈ ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func x)) :
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
  have _ := hU hx
  have _ := hU hy
  exact chain_fiber_truncation_zero_step_core d dist_comm ϕ U j x y hy_fiber

/--
OET anchor: h-9a65248d646a2b6f
**命题 #h-9a65248d646a2b6f（链级纤维截断与零距传播，Lip 零距传播）**
合法 Lip 矩阵把全分量零测距点对送到全分量零测距点对。
-/
theorem all_components_zero_propagates_lip [Fintype I]
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d ϕ U L) (x y : X)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hzero : ∀ i : I, d i x y = 0) :
    ∀ j : I, d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
  intro j
  have hupper := distance_recurrence_lip_upper d ϕ U L hL x hx y hy j
  have hsum : matrix_vector_bound L (DistanceVector d x y) j = 0 := by
    simp [matrix_vector_bound, DistanceVector, hzero]
  exact le_antisymm (by simpa [hsum] using hupper) (zero_le _)

/--
OET anchor: h-9a65248d646a2b6f
**命题 #h-9a65248d646a2b6f（链级纤维截断与零距传播，复合链形式）**
若复合链已有合法 Lip 矩阵，则起点处全分量零测距传递到链输出端。
-/
theorem chain_zero_distance_propagation_of_lip_matrix [Fintype I]
    (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ϕs) U L) (x y : X)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hzero : ∀ i : I, d i x y = 0) :
    ∀ j : I,
      d j ((OperatorChain ϕs).func x) ((OperatorChain ϕs).func y) = 0 := by
  exact all_components_zero_propagates_lip d (OperatorChain ϕs) U L hL x y hx hy hzero

/--
OET anchor: h-9a65248d646a2b6f
**命题 #h-9a65248d646a2b6f（链级纤维截断与零距传播，逐步 Lip 形式）**
Zero distance in every component at level `s` propagates to level `q` when each
intermediate step has a valid Lip matrix on its actual input domain.
-/
theorem chain_zero_distance_propagation_along_lip_steps [Fintype I]
    (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot) (U : ℕ → Set X)
    (x x' : ℕ → X) (s q : ℕ) (hsq : s ≤ q)
    (hmem : ∀ p, s ≤ p → p < q → x p ∈ U p ∧ x' p ∈ U p)
    (hnext : ∀ p, s ≤ p → p < q →
      x (p + 1) = (ϕ p).func (x p) ∧ x' (p + 1) = (ϕ p).func (x' p))
    (hL : ∀ p, s ≤ p → p < q →
      ∃ L : I → I → ENNReal, IsLipMatrix d (ϕ p) (U p) L)
    (hzero : ∀ l : I, d l (x s) (x' s) = 0) :
    ∀ l : I, d l (x q) (x' q) = 0 := by
  apply all_component_zero_preserved_along_lip_steps d x x' s q hsq
  · intro p hsp hpq
    rcases hmem p hsp hpq with ⟨hxp, hx'p⟩
    rcases hnext p hsp hpq with ⟨hxnext, hx'next⟩
    rcases hL p hsp hpq with ⟨L, hLp⟩
    exact ⟨ϕ p, U p, L, hLp, hxp, hx'p, hxnext, hx'next⟩
  · exact hzero

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**§ #h-5a1b95150c3a4df2（距离向量递推，零化截断分支）**
零化截断分支的显式形式。
-/
theorem distance_vector_recurrence_zero_branch
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (center x : X) (r : ENNReal)
    (hx_ball : x ∈ OpenBall d i center r ∩ U)
    (h_ball :
      OpenBall d i center r ∩ U ⊆
        ComputationalFiber d ϕ (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U (ϕ.func center)) :
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func center) = 0 := by
  exact distance_recurrence_zeroing_of_ball d ϕ U i j center x r hx_ball h_ball

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**§ #h-5a1b95150c3a4df2（距离向量递推，极小零化半径分支）**
点对距离严格小于极小零化半径时，正文中的零化截断条件由半径定义直接推出。
-/
theorem distance_vector_recurrence_zero_branch_of_min_radius
    (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (i j : I) (x y : X)
    (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hxy : d i x y <
      min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U) :
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0 := by
  have h_min_le_ann :
      min_annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U ≤
        annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y :=
    iInf₂_le y hy
  have hxy_ann :
      d i x y < annihilation_radius d ϕ i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) U y :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hxy h_min_le_ann
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.mp hxy_ann with ⟨r, hr⟩
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.mp hr with ⟨_hr_fin_pos, hr'⟩
  rcases lt_iSup_iff.mp hr' with ⟨h_ball, hxy_r⟩
  have hx_ball : x ∈ OpenBall d i y r ∩ U := ⟨hxy_r, hx⟩
  exact distance_recurrence_zeroing_of_ball d ϕ U i j y x r hx_ball h_ball

/--
OET anchor: h-5a1b95150c3a4df2
**§ #h-5a1b95150c3a4df2（链级行为传递）**
若全链没有触发截断，《算子界》 的链式 L/K 乘积给出链级双侧界。
-/
theorem distance_vector_chain_bounds [Fintype I]
    (ϕs : List (Operator X bot)) (U : Set X)
    (L K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hL : RightChainLipBounded d ϕs U L)
    (hK : RightChainCoLipBounded d ϕs U K) :
    IsLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ϕs) U L ∧
      IsCoLipMatrix d (OperatorChain ϕs) U K := by
  exact ⟨right_chain_lip_matrix d ϕs U L hL,
    right_chain_colip_matrix d ϕs U K hK⟩

end

end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.mapping_entropy
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

open scoped BigOperators
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

noncomputable section

/-- The one-based finite chain `ϕₖ ∘ ⋯ ∘ ϕ₁`. -/
def finite_one_based_chain {X : Type} {bot : X}
    (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot) (k : ℕ) : Operator X bot :=
  OperatorChain ((List.range k).reverse.map fun m => ϕ (m + 1))

/--
单步熵差。
《算子链代数》的熵递推只使用有限实值熵的代数望远镜等式。
-/
def entropy_drop (E : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ := E m - E (m + 1)

theorem ereal_coe_finset_sum {A : Type} (s : Finset A) (f : A → ℝ) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, ((f a : ℝ) : EReal)) = (((∑ a ∈ s, f a) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih => simp [ha, ih]

/--
零起点版本的熵望远镜等式。
-/
theorem entropy_telescoping_zero_index (E : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    E k + (Finset.range k).sum (fun m => entropy_drop E m) = E 0 := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      simp [entropy_drop]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      dsimp [entropy_drop] at *
      linarith

/--
OET anchor: h-2cb9c1e3d59895b0
**推论 #h-2cb9c1e3d59895b0（算子链的熵递推等式）的有限实值熵递推核心**
按正文的一起点编号：
`E_{k+1} + ∑_{m=1}^{k} ΔE_m = E_1`。
-/
theorem entropy_telescoping_one_index (E : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    E (k + 1) + (Finset.range k).sum (fun m => entropy_drop E (m + 1)) = E 1 := by
  simpa [entropy_drop, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]
    using entropy_telescoping_zero_index (fun n => E (n + 1)) k

/-- The proof-independent value of a well-defined single-component entropy drop. -/
noncomputable def mapping_entropy_drop_value {X I : Type} {bot : X}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) : EReal :=
  metric_entropy (d i) ε U - metric_entropy (d i) ε (ϕ.func '' U)

theorem mapping_entropy_drop_value_eq_mapping_entropy_diff
    {X I : Type} {bot : X}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (i : I) (ε : ENNReal) (hwd : EntropyDiffWellDefined d ϕ U i i ε) :
    mapping_entropy_drop_value d ϕ U i ε =
      mapping_entropy_diff d ϕ U i i ε hwd := by
  rfl

set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false in
/--
OET anchor: h-2cb9c1e3d59895b0
**推论 #h-2cb9c1e3d59895b0（算子链的熵递推等式）**

正文命题的算子链版本。每个熵由有限实数 `E m` 表示，熵差在实际像域上读取。
-/
theorem chain_entropy_recurrence_textbook
    {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (U : ℕ → Set X) (E : ℕ → ℝ) (i : I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε_top : ε ≠ ⊤) (k : ℕ)
    (hU1 : U 1 = dom (finite_one_based_chain ϕ k))
    (hU1_nonempty : (U 1).Nonempty)
    (himage : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k → U (m + 1) = (ϕ m).func '' U m)
    (hentropy : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k + 1 →
      metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) = (E m : EReal)) :
    ∃ hwd : ∀ m : Fin k,
        EntropyDiffWellDefined d (ϕ (m.val + 1)) (U (m.val + 1)) i i ε,
      metric_entropy (d i) ε (U (k + 1)) =
        metric_entropy (d i) ε (U 1) -
          ∑ m : Fin k,
            mapping_entropy_diff d (ϕ (m.val + 1)) (U (m.val + 1)) i i ε (hwd m) := by
  have _ := hε
  have _ := hε_top
  have _ := hU1
  have hU_nonempty : ∀ r : ℕ, r < k → (U (r + 1)).Nonempty := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
        intro _hr
        simpa using hU1_nonempty
    | succ r ih =>
        intro hr
        have hprev : (U (r + 1)).Nonempty := ih (by omega)
        rw [himage (r + 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
        exact hprev.image (ϕ (r + 1)).func
  let hwd : ∀ m : Fin k,
      EntropyDiffWellDefined d (ϕ (m.val + 1)) (U (m.val + 1)) i i ε :=
    fun m =>
      ⟨hU_nonempty m.val m.isLt,
        Or.inl (cov_num_lt_top_of_metric_entropy_eq_real d i ε
          (U (m.val + 1)) (E (m.val + 1))
          (hentropy (m.val + 1) (by omega) (by omega)))⟩
  have hstep : ∀ m : Fin k,
      mapping_entropy_diff d (ϕ (m.val + 1)) (U (m.val + 1)) i i ε (hwd m) =
        ((entropy_drop E (m.val + 1) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    intro m
    change metric_entropy (d i) ε (U (m.val + 1)) -
        metric_entropy (d i) ε ((ϕ (m.val + 1)).func '' U (m.val + 1)) = _
    rw [← himage (m.val + 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
    rw [hentropy (m.val + 1) (by omega) (by omega),
      hentropy (m.val + 2) (by omega) (by omega)]
    simp [entropy_drop]
  have hsum :
      (∑ m : Fin k,
        mapping_entropy_diff d (ϕ (m.val + 1)) (U (m.val + 1)) i i ε (hwd m)) =
      (((∑ m : Fin k, entropy_drop E (m.val + 1)) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ m : Fin k, ((entropy_drop E (m.val + 1) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro m _hm
        exact hstep m
      _ = (((∑ m : Fin k, entropy_drop E (m.val + 1)) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
        exact ereal_coe_finset_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k))
          (fun m => entropy_drop E (m.val + 1))
  have hreal : E (k + 1) = E 1 -
      (∑ m : Fin k, entropy_drop E (m.val + 1)) := by
    have hrec := entropy_telescoping_one_index E k
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun r => entropy_drop E (r + 1)) k]
    linarith
  refine ⟨hwd, ?_⟩
  rw [hentropy (k + 1) (by omega) (le_refl _),
    hentropy 1 (by omega) (by omega), hsum]
  simpa using congrArg (fun z : ℝ => (z : EReal)) hreal

/-- The real finite-sequence core used by the textbook uniform-drop corollary. -/
theorem entropy_uniform_drop_reaches_zero (E : ℕ → ℝ) (k_star : ℕ)
    (δ : ℝ)
    (h_nonnegative : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star + 1 → 0 ≤ E m)
    (h_initial : E 1 ≤ (k_star : ℝ) * δ)
    (h_drop : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star → 0 < E m → δ ≤ entropy_drop E m) :
    ∃ m, 1 ≤ m ∧ m ≤ k_star + 1 ∧ E m = 0 := by
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  have hpos : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star + 1 → 0 < E m := by
    intro m hm1 hm
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (h_nonnegative m hm1 hm) (Ne.symm (hnone m hm1 hm))
  have h_each : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range k_star, δ ≤ entropy_drop E (m + 1) := by
    intro m hm
    have hle_k : m + 1 ≤ k_star := Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hm)
    exact h_drop (m + 1) (by omega) hle_k
      (hpos (m + 1) (by omega) (hle_k.trans (Nat.le_succ k_star)))
  have hsum_lower :
      (k_star : ℝ) * δ ≤
        (Finset.range k_star).sum (fun m => entropy_drop E (m + 1)) := by
    simpa using Finset.sum_le_sum h_each
  have htel := entropy_telescoping_one_index E k_star
  have hle_zero : E (k_star + 1) ≤ 0 := by
    linarith
  have hzero : E (k_star + 1) = 0 :=
    le_antisymm hle_zero (h_nonnegative (k_star + 1) (by omega) (le_refl _))
  exact hnone (k_star + 1) (by omega) (le_refl _) hzero

/--
OET anchor: h-b7e77b504317782a
**习题（一致正熵差下界给出的有限步熵归零）**

习题的上取整步数版本。这里只预设初始熵有限；若前缀尚未归零，正熵差下界会逐步
排除后继熵等于 `⊤`，从而在证明内部导出所需的有限实值前缀。
-/
theorem entropy_uniform_drop_reaches_zero_textbook
    {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : ℕ → Operator X bot)
    (U : ℕ → Set X) (i : I) (ε : ENNReal)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε_top : ε ≠ ⊤)
    (e₁ δ : ℝ) (he₁ : 0 ≤ e₁) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : Nat.ceil (e₁ / δ) ≤ k)
    (hU1 : U 1 = dom (finite_one_based_chain ϕ k))
    (hU_nonempty : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k + 1 → (U m).Nonempty)
    (himage : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k → U (m + 1) = (ϕ m).func '' U m)
    (hE₁ : metric_entropy (d i) ε (U 1) = (e₁ : EReal))
    (hwd : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k →
      EntropyDiffWellDefined d (ϕ m) (U m) i i ε)
    (hdrop : ∀ m (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmk : m ≤ Nat.ceil (e₁ / δ)),
      0 < metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) →
      (δ : EReal) ≤ mapping_entropy_diff d (ϕ m) (U m) i i ε
        (hwd m hm1 (hmk.trans hk)))
    (hmetric : ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i)) :
    ∃ m, 1 ≤ m ∧ m ≤ Nat.ceil (e₁ / δ) + 1 ∧
      metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) = 0 := by
  let k_star := Nat.ceil (e₁ / δ)
  have hk_star : k_star ≤ k := hk
  have hnonnegative : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star + 1 →
      (0 : EReal) ≤ metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) := by
    intro m hm1 hm
    have hmk1 : m ≤ k + 1 := hm.trans (Nat.succ_le_succ hk_star)
    have hcov : (1 : ENNReal) ≤ covering_number (d i) ε (U m) :=
      one_le_cov_num_of_nonempty d i ε (U m) (hU_nonempty m hm1 hmk1)
    calc
      (0 : EReal) = log2_ereal (1 : ENNReal) := by simp
      _ ≤ log2_ereal (covering_number (d i) ε (U m)) := log2_ereal_mono hcov
      _ = metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) := rfl
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  have hpositive : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star + 1 →
      (0 : EReal) < metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) := by
    intro m hm1 hm
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hnonnegative m hm1 hm) (Ne.symm (hnone m hm1 hm))
  have hfinite_aux : ∀ r, r ≤ k_star →
      metric_entropy (d i) ε (U (r + 1)) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro r hr
    induction r with
    | zero =>
        rw [hE₁]
        exact EReal.coe_ne_top e₁
    | succ r ih =>
        have hr_lt : r < k_star := by omega
        have hcur_top : metric_entropy (d i) ε (U (r + 1)) ≠ ⊤ :=
          ih (Nat.le_of_lt hr_lt)
        have hcur_nonnegative :
            (0 : EReal) ≤ metric_entropy (d i) ε (U (r + 1)) :=
          hnonnegative (r + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        have hcur_bot : metric_entropy (d i) ε (U (r + 1)) ≠ ⊥ := by
          intro hbot
          rw [hbot] at hcur_nonnegative
          simp at hcur_nonnegative
        let ecur := (metric_entropy (d i) ε (U (r + 1))).toReal
        have hcur_eq : metric_entropy (d i) ε (U (r + 1)) = (ecur : EReal) := by
          exact (EReal.coe_toReal hcur_top hcur_bot).symm
        intro hnext_top
        have hδmap := hdrop (r + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          (hpositive (r + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
        rw [← mapping_entropy_drop_value_eq_mapping_entropy_diff d
          (ϕ (r + 1)) (U (r + 1)) i ε
          (hwd (r + 1) (by omega) (by omega))] at hδmap
        dsimp [mapping_entropy_drop_value] at hδmap
        rw [← himage (r + 1) (by omega) (by omega), hcur_eq, hnext_top] at hδmap
        simp at hδmap
  have hfinite : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star + 1 →
      metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro m hm1 hm
    have heq : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
    rw [← heq]
    exact hfinite_aux (m - 1) (by omega)
  have hnot_bot : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star + 1 →
      metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro m hm1 hm hbot
    have hnonneg := hnonnegative m hm1 hm
    rw [hbot] at hnonneg
    simp at hnonneg
  let E : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m)).toReal
  have hentropy : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star + 1 →
      metric_entropy (d i) ε (U m) = (E m : EReal) := by
    intro m hm1 hm
    exact (EReal.coe_toReal (hfinite m hm1 hm) (hnot_bot m hm1 hm)).symm
  have hE₁_real : E 1 = e₁ := by
    apply EReal.coe_eq_coe_iff.mp
    exact (hentropy 1 (by omega) (by omega)).symm.trans hE₁
  have hnonnegative_real : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star + 1 → 0 ≤ E m := by
    intro m hm1 hm
    exact EReal.coe_nonneg.mp ((hentropy m hm1 hm).symm ▸ hnonnegative m hm1 hm)
  have hinitial : E 1 ≤ (k_star : ℝ) * δ := by
    rw [hE₁_real]
    have hceil : e₁ / δ ≤ (k_star : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil (e₁ / δ)
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hδ).mp hceil
  have hdrop_real : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ k_star → 0 < E m →
      δ ≤ entropy_drop E m := by
    intro m hm1 hmk_star hmpos
    have hmle : m ≤ k := hmk_star.trans hk_star
    have hmap : mapping_entropy_diff d (ϕ m) (U m) i i ε
          (hwd m hm1 hmle) =
        ((entropy_drop E m : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [← mapping_entropy_drop_value_eq_mapping_entropy_diff d
        (ϕ m) (U m) i ε (hwd m hm1 hmle)]
      dsimp [mapping_entropy_drop_value]
      rw [← himage m hm1 hmle]
      rw [hentropy m hm1 (by omega), hentropy (m + 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
      simp [entropy_drop]
    have hδ_map := hdrop m hm1 hmk_star
      ((hentropy m hm1 (by omega)).symm ▸ EReal.coe_pos.mpr hmpos)
    rw [hmap] at hδ_map
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mp hδ_map
  rcases entropy_uniform_drop_reaches_zero E k_star δ hnonnegative_real hinitial
      hdrop_real with ⟨m, hm1, hm, hEm⟩
  exact hnone m hm1 hm (by rw [hentropy m hm1 hm, hEm]; simp)

end
