files.content:
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.operator_network

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

variable {X V W : Type} {bot : X}

/-- Transport a successor label along one fixed bijection. -/
def relabel_output_choice (e : V ≃ W) : OutputChoice V → OutputChoice W
  | .stop => .stop
  | .next v => .next (e v)

@[simp] theorem relabel_output_choice_next_iff (e : V ≃ W)
    (c : OutputChoice V) (w : W) :
    relabel_output_choice e c = .next w ↔ c = .next (e.symm w) := by
  cases c with
  | stop => simp [relabel_output_choice]
  | next v =>
    simp only [relabel_output_choice, OutputChoice.next.injEq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [← h]
      simp
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      simp

/--
OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Relabeling leaves every intermediate point unchanged.
-/
theorem terminal_path_relabel {node_op : V → Operator X bot}
    {choice : V → X → OutputChoice V} (e : V ≃ W)
    {v : V} {x : X} {p : List V}
    (h : TerminalPathFrom node_op choice v x p) :
    TerminalPathFrom (fun w => node_op (e.symm w))
      (fun w y => relabel_output_choice e (choice (e.symm w) y))
      (e v) x (p.map e) := by
  induction h with
  | stop hs =>
    apply TerminalPathFrom.stop
    simpa [relabel_output_choice] using congrArg (relabel_output_choice e) hs
  | @next β γ y rest hs ht ih =>
    refine TerminalPathFrom.next (γ := e γ) ?_ ?_
    · simpa [relabel_output_choice] using congrArg (relabel_output_choice e) hs
    · simpa using ih

/--
OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
A single global bijection transports the whole finite network.
-/
noncomputable def FiniteOperatorNetwork.relabel
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (e : V ≃ W) :
    FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot W := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype V := N.node_fintype
  exact
    { U := N.U
      bot_not_mem := N.bot_not_mem
      node_fintype := Fintype.ofEquiv V e
      node_op := fun w => N.node_op (e.symm w)
      node_dom_nonempty := fun w => N.node_dom_nonempty (e.symm w)
      entry := fun x => e (N.entry x)
      entry_mem := by intro x; simpa using N.entry_mem x
      choice := fun w y => relabel_output_choice e (N.choice (e.symm w) y)
      choice_next_mem := by
        intro β γ y hy hchoice
        exact N.choice_next_mem hy ((relabel_output_choice_next_iff e _ γ).mp hchoice)
      depth_bound := N.depth_bound
      path_of := fun x => (N.path_of x).map e
      path_terminal := fun x => terminal_path_relabel e (N.path_terminal x)
      path_length_le_depth := by intro x; simpa using N.path_length_le_depth x
      node_reachable := by
        intro w
        rcases N.node_reachable (e.symm w) with ⟨x, hx⟩
        exact ⟨x, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e.symm w, hx, e.apply_symm_apply w⟩⟩ }

namespace FiniteOperatorNetwork

variable (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (e : V ≃ W)

@[simp] theorem relabel_source : (N.relabel e).U = N.U := rfl

@[simp] theorem relabel_path (x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) :
    (N.relabel e).path_of x = (N.path_of x).map e := rfl

@[simp] theorem relabel_path_length (x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) :
    ((N.relabel e).path_of x).length = (N.path_of x).length := by
  simp

/--
OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
One global bijection preserves which occurrences share a node.
-/
theorem relabel_label_equality (v w : V) : e v = e w ↔ v = w := e.injective.eq_iff

/-- OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
The local operator at the renamed node is the original operator. -/
@[simp] theorem relabel_node_op (v : V) :
    (N.relabel e).node_op (e v) = N.node_op v := by
  simp [relabel]

/-- OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Relabeling transports the actual initial-entry partition. -/
theorem relabel_entry_domain (v : V) :
    (N.relabel e).entry_domain (e v) = N.entry_domain v := by
  ext x
  simp [entry_domain, relabel, e.injective.eq_iff]

/-- OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
The full transition domain is preserved, including outputs not reached from U. -/
theorem relabel_edge_domain (v w : V) :
    (N.relabel e).edge_domain (e v) (e w) = N.edge_domain v w := by
  ext z
  simp [edge_domain, to_transition_graph, relabel, relabel_output_choice_next_iff]

/-- OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Nonempty edge domains define exactly the renamed graph edges. -/
theorem relabel_edge_nonempty (v w : V) :
    ((N.relabel e).edge_domain (e v) (e w)).Nonempty ↔
      (N.edge_domain v w).Nonempty := by
  rw [N.relabel_edge_domain e]

/-- OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Terminal output domains are preserved under the same global relabeling. -/
theorem relabel_terminal_domain (v : V) :
    (N.relabel e).terminal_domain (e v) = N.terminal_domain v := by
  ext z
  simp only [terminal_domain, OperatorTransitionGraph.terminal_domain,
    Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
  have himage : (N.relabel e).to_transition_graph.node_image (e v) =
      N.to_transition_graph.node_image v := by
    simp [OperatorTransitionGraph.node_image, OperatorTransitionGraph.node_dom,
      to_transition_graph, relabel]
  rw [himage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, h⟩
    refine ⟨hz, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    apply h (e w)
    change z ∈ (N.relabel e).edge_domain (e v) (e w)
    simpa only [N.relabel_edge_domain e] using hw
  · rintro ⟨hz, h⟩
    refine ⟨hz, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    apply h (e.symm w)
    change z ∈ N.edge_domain v (e.symm w)
    rw [← N.relabel_edge_domain e]
    simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hw

/-- The chain identity also covers lists that are not reachable paths. -/
theorem chain_eval_nodes_relabel (p : List V) (x : X) :
    (N.relabel e).chain_eval_nodes (p.map e) x = N.chain_eval_nodes p x := by
  induction p generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons v p ih =>
    simpa [FiniteOperatorNetwork.chain_eval_nodes, chain_eval_nodes_core,
      FiniteOperatorNetwork.relabel] using ih ((N.node_op v).func x)

/-- OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Every intermediate point, at every prefix length, is unchanged. -/
theorem relabel_intermediate_point (p : List V) (k : Nat) (x : X) :
    (N.relabel e).chain_eval_nodes ((p.map e).take k) x =
      N.chain_eval_nodes (p.take k) x := by
  rw [← List.map_take]
  exact N.chain_eval_nodes_relabel e (p.take k) x

/-- Actual evaluation is unchanged. -/
theorem relabel_eval (x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) :
    (N.relabel e).eval x = N.eval x :=
  N.chain_eval_nodes_relabel e (N.path_of x) x.val

/--
OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Relabeling preserves the full absorbing-point extension.
-/
theorem relabel_extensional_operator :
    (N.relabel e).extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator := by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ N.U
  · simpa [extensional_operator, hx] using N.relabel_eval e ⟨x, hx⟩
  · simp [extensional_operator, hx]

/--
OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Source points follow the corresponding relabeled list.
-/
theorem relabel_path_domain (p : List V) :
    (N.relabel e).path_domain (p.map e) = N.path_domain p := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hp⟩
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    apply List.map_injective_iff.mpr e.injective
    exact hp
  · rintro ⟨hx, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hx, congrArg (List.map e) hp⟩

theorem evaluation_depth_le_of_input_lengths (k : Nat)
    (h : ∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}, (N.path_of x).length ≤ k) :
    N.evaluation_depth ≤ k := by
  classical
  unfold evaluation_depth
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro p _
  rcases p.nonempty_domain with ⟨x, hx, hp⟩
  simpa only [hp] using h ⟨x, hx⟩

theorem input_path_length_le_evaluation_depth (x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) :
    (N.path_of x).length ≤ N.evaluation_depth :=
  N.reachable_path_nodes_length_le_evaluation_depth
    ⟨N.path_of x, ⟨x.val, x.property, rfl⟩⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Equality of the actual maximum path length, not only the stored fuel bound.
-/
theorem relabel_evaluation_depth :
    (N.relabel e).evaluation_depth = N.evaluation_depth := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (N.relabel e).evaluation_depth_le_of_input_lengths
    intro x
    simpa using N.input_path_length_le_evaluation_depth x
  · apply N.evaluation_depth_le_of_input_lengths
    intro x
    simpa using (N.relabel e).input_path_length_le_evaluation_depth x

/-- An encoding choice, not an isomorphism quotient. -/
noncomputable def standard_node_equiv : V ≃ Fin N.node_count := by
  letI : Fintype V := N.node_fintype
  exact Fintype.equivFin V

noncomputable def standard_relabel :
    FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot (Fin N.node_count) :=
  N.relabel N.standard_node_equiv

/--
OET anchor: h-b2fb8267687c8372
Every finite-label network has a finite numbered encoding preserving its source,
terminal operator and all actual path domains.
-/
theorem standard_relabel_preserves :
    N.standard_relabel.U = N.U ∧
    N.standard_relabel.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator ∧
    (∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U},
      N.standard_relabel.path_of x = (N.path_of x).map N.standard_node_equiv) ∧
    (∀ p : List V,
      N.standard_relabel.path_domain (p.map N.standard_node_equiv) = N.path_domain p) :=
  ⟨rfl, N.relabel_extensional_operator N.standard_node_equiv,
    fun _ => rfl, fun p => N.relabel_path_domain N.standard_node_equiv p⟩

end FiniteOperatorNetwork
end formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

files.name: formal_oet/vol_01/ch_05_operator_networks/operator_network.lean
files.content:
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus.decomposition_core
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Vector
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

variable {X V : Type} {bot : X}

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（输出选择）**
节点输出点或者终止，或者进入一个后继节点。
-/
inductive OutputChoice (V : Type) where
  | stop : OutputChoice V
  | next : V → OutputChoice V
deriving DecidableEq

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（算子转移图）**
The transition-graph layer contains the finite node set, the local operator at
each node, and arbitrary transition domains. It is not assumed deterministic;
deterministic successor choice is added only at the finite-network layer.
-/
structure OperatorTransitionGraph (X : Type) (bot : X) (V : Type) where
  node_fintype : Fintype V
  node_op : V → Operator X bot
  node_dom_nonempty : ∀ β : V, (dom (node_op β)).Nonempty
  edge_domain : V → V → Set X
  edge_domain_subset_node_image :
    ∀ β γ : V, edge_domain β γ ⊆ (node_op β).func '' dom (node_op β)
  edge_domain_subset_node_dom :
    ∀ β γ : V, edge_domain β γ ⊆ dom (node_op γ)

namespace OperatorTransitionGraph

variable (T : OperatorTransitionGraph X bot V)

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（节点定义域）**
At the transition-graph level, a node occurrence domain is exactly the domain
of its local operator.
-/
def node_dom (β : V) : Set X :=
  dom (T.node_op β)

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（节点输出像）**
The output image of a node is the image of its local operator on the node
occurrence domain.
-/
def node_image (β : V) : Set X :=
  (T.node_op β).func '' T.node_dom β

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（算子转移图的边）**
Lean treats an edge as a nonempty transition domain, matching the text's
nonempty-edge convention.
-/
def Edge (β γ : V) : Prop :=
  (T.edge_domain β γ).Nonempty

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（终止域）**
The terminal domain is the part of the node output image that enters no
successor transition domain.
-/
def terminal_domain (β : V) : Set X :=
  T.node_image β \ ⋃ γ : V, T.edge_domain β γ

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（带节点标签的一步转移）**
The transition relation records both the source node and the target node; point
value alone does not determine the computation state.
-/
def Step (β γ : V) (x y : X) : Prop :=
  x ∈ T.node_dom β ∧ y = (T.node_op β).func x ∧ y ∈ T.edge_domain β γ

theorem node_image_mem_terminal_or_edge {β : V} {z : X}
    (hz : z ∈ T.node_image β) :
    z ∈ T.terminal_domain β ∨ ∃ γ : V, z ∈ T.edge_domain β γ := by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ γ : V, z ∈ T.edge_domain β γ
  · exact Or.inr h
  · left
    refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
    intro hmem
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hmem with ⟨γ, hγ⟩
    exact h ⟨γ, hγ⟩

theorem terminal_domain_subset_node_image (β : V) :
    T.terminal_domain β ⊆ T.node_image β := by
  intro z hz
  exact hz.1

theorem step_output_eq {β γ : V} {x y : X} (h : T.Step β γ x y) :
    y = (T.node_op β).func x :=
  h.2.1

end OperatorTransitionGraph

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**§ #h-86752cb60c8e01e3（有限求值的递归核）**
该核只依赖节点算子与输出选择，因而可在 `OperatorNetwork` 结构字段中
表达无冗余节点条件。
-/
def eval_with_fuel_core (node_op : V → Operator X bot)
    (choice : V → X → OutputChoice V) : Nat → V → X → X
  | 0, β, y => (node_op β).func y
  | n + 1, β, y =>
      match choice β ((node_op β).func y) with
      | OutputChoice.stop => (node_op β).func y
      | OutputChoice.next γ =>
          eval_with_fuel_core node_op choice n γ ((node_op β).func y)

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**§ #h-86752cb60c8e01e3（路径节点序列的递归核）**
与 `eval_with_fuel_core` 同步记录实际经过的节点序列。
-/
def path_with_fuel_core (node_op : V → Operator X bot)
    (choice : V → X → OutputChoice V) : Nat → V → X → List V
  | 0, β, _ => [β]
  | n + 1, β, y =>
      β ::
        match choice β ((node_op β).func y) with
        | OutputChoice.stop => []
        | OutputChoice.next γ =>
            path_with_fuel_core node_op choice n γ ((node_op β).func y)

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（终止求值轨迹）**
The node list is exactly the trajectory generated by the deterministic choice
map and it stops at the last node.
-/
inductive TerminalPathFrom (node_op : V → Operator X bot)
    (choice : V → X → OutputChoice V) : V → X → List V → Prop where
  | stop {β : V} {y : X} :
      choice β ((node_op β).func y) = OutputChoice.stop →
        TerminalPathFrom node_op choice β y [β]
  | next {β γ : V} {y : X} {rest : List V} :
      choice β ((node_op β).func y) = OutputChoice.next γ →
        TerminalPathFrom node_op choice γ ((node_op β).func y) rest →
          TerminalPathFrom node_op choice β y (β :: rest)

/--
OET anchor: h-374f884cd4d69e88
**§ #h-374f884cd4d69e88（路径链求值）**
按节点序列从左到右执行局域算子。
-/
def chain_eval_nodes_core (node_op : V → Operator X bot) : List V → X → X
  | [], x => x
  | β :: rest, x => chain_eval_nodes_core node_op rest ((node_op β).func x)

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（有限算子网络）**
This is the finite-network layer used by the object space.  It records a
finite node family, an entry rule, a single-valued transition choice, and a
uniformly bounded terminal path for each source input.
-/
structure FiniteOperatorNetwork (X : Type) (bot : X) (V : Type) where
  U : Set X
  bot_not_mem : bot ∉ U
  node_fintype : Fintype V
  node_op : V → Operator X bot
  node_dom_nonempty : ∀ β : V, (dom (node_op β)).Nonempty
  entry : {x : X // x ∈ U} → V
  entry_mem : ∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ U}, x.val ∈ dom (node_op (entry x))
  choice : V → X → OutputChoice V
  choice_next_mem :
    ∀ {β γ : V} {y : X},
      y ∈ dom (node_op β) →
        choice β ((node_op β).func y) = OutputChoice.next γ →
          (node_op β).func y ∈ dom (node_op γ)
  depth_bound : Nat
  path_of : {x : X // x ∈ U} → List V
  path_terminal :
    ∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ U},
      TerminalPathFrom node_op choice (entry x) x.val (path_of x)
  path_length_le_depth :
    ∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ U}, (path_of x).length ≤ depth_bound
  node_reachable :
    ∀ β : V, ∃ x : {x : X // x ∈ U}, β ∈ path_of x

namespace FiniteOperatorNetwork

variable (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V)

/--
OET anchor: h-66fcc5860d4ca690
**定义（结构规模读出）**
The node-count coordinate of a finite network.
-/
def node_count : Nat :=
  @Fintype.card V N.node_fintype

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（有限算子网络的底层算子转移图）**
Forgetting the source-domain, entry, path and nonredundancy data leaves the
underlying operator transition graph.
-/
def to_transition_graph : OperatorTransitionGraph X bot V where
  node_fintype := N.node_fintype
  node_op := N.node_op
  node_dom_nonempty := N.node_dom_nonempty
  edge_domain := fun β γ =>
    {z | z ∈ (N.node_op β).func '' dom (N.node_op β) ∧
      N.choice β z = OutputChoice.next γ}

  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨p, hxp⟩
    exact N.path_domain_subset_source hxp
  · intro hx
    let nodes := N.path_of ⟨x, hx⟩

  rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
  intro x hx
  rcases hx.1 with ⟨hUp, hp⟩
  rcases hx.2 with ⟨hUq, hq⟩
  have hsub : (⟨x, hUp⟩ : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) = ⟨x, hUq⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hpath_eq :
      N.path_of ⟨x, hUp⟩ = N.path_of ⟨x, hUq⟩ := by
    rw [hsub]
  exact hne (hp.symm.trans (hpath_eq.trans hq))

  classical
  letI : Fintype V := N.node_fintype
  let S : Finset (List V) := Finset.univ.biUnion
    (fun p : N.ReachablePath => p.nodes.inits.toFinset)
  let code : N.PrefixOccurrence → {q // q ∈ S} := fun q => ⟨q.nodes, by
    rcases q.reachable with ⟨p, rest, hp⟩
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨p, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    apply List.mem_toFinset.mpr
    exact (List.mem_inits _ _).mpr ⟨rest, hp.symm⟩⟩
  exact Fintype.ofInjective code (by
    intro q r h
    have hnodes : q.nodes = r.nodes := congrArg Subtype.val h
    cases q
    cases r
    cases hnodes
    rfl)

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（无环算子网络）**
Lean keeps the transition-graph fields in the network structure and exposes
them as `to_transition_graph`.  The extra network data are the source domain,
the initial-entry partition, the acyclicity rank, and the nonredundancy
condition.  The choice map represents transition domains; actual edges are
nonempty derived transition domains.
`node_fintype` records the finiteness of the node set.
`rank` 是有向无环性的拓扑秩证书：每次进入后继节点都严格降低秩。
`node_reachable` 表示正文中纳入定义的无冗余节点约束。
-/
structure OperatorNetwork (X : Type) (bot : X) (V : Type) where
  U : Set X
  bot_not_mem : bot ∉ U
  node_fintype : Fintype V
  node_op : V → Operator X bot
  node_dom_nonempty : ∀ β : V, (dom (node_op β)).Nonempty
  entry : {x : X // x ∈ U} → V
  entry_mem : ∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ U}, x.val ∈ dom (node_op (entry x))
  choice : V → X → OutputChoice V
  choice_next_mem :
    ∀ {β γ : V} {y : X},
      y ∈ dom (node_op β) →
        choice β ((node_op β).func y) = OutputChoice.next γ →
          (node_op β).func y ∈ dom (node_op γ)
  rank : V → Nat
  choice_next_rank :
    ∀ {β γ : V} {y : X},
      y ∈ dom (node_op β) →
        choice β ((node_op β).func y) = OutputChoice.next γ →
          rank γ < rank β
  node_reachable :
    ∀ β : V, ∃ x : {x : X // x ∈ U},
      β ∈ path_with_fuel_core node_op choice (rank (entry x)) (entry x) x.val

namespace OperatorNetwork

variable (N : OperatorNetwork X bot V)

/--
OET anchor: h-86752cb60c8e01e3
**定义（算子网络的底层算子转移图）**
Forgetting the source-domain, entry, acyclicity and nonredundancy data leaves
the underlying operator transition graph.
-/
def to_transition_graph : OperatorTransitionGraph X bot V where
  node_fintype := N.node_fintype
  node_op := N.node_op
  node_dom_nonempty := N.node_dom_nonempty
  edge_domain := fun β γ =>
    {z | z ∈ (N.node_op β).func '' dom (N.node_op β) ∧
      N.choice β z = OutputChoice.next γ}
  edge_domain_subset_node_image := by
    intro β γ z hz
    exact hz.1
  edge_domain_subset_node_dom := by
    intro β γ z hz
    rcases hz.1 with ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
    have hchoice :
        N.choice β ((N.node_op β).func y) = OutputChoice.next γ := by
      simpa [hyz] using hz.2
    have hmem : (N.node_op β).func y ∈ dom (N.node_op γ) :=
      N.choice_next_mem hy hchoice
    simpa [hyz] using hmem

@[simp]
theorem to_transition_graph_node_op :
    N.to_transition_graph.node_op = N.node_op :=
  rfl

/--

theorem operator_chain_append_apply (ops₁ ops₂ : List (Operator X bot)) (x : X) :
    (OperatorChain (ops₁ ++ ops₂)).func x =
      (OperatorChain ops₁).func ((OperatorChain ops₂).func x) := by
  induction ops₁ with
  | nil =>
      simp [OperatorChain]
  | cons op tail ih =>
      simp [OperatorChain, ih]

theorem path_chain_apply_eq_chain_eval_nodes (nodes : List V) (x : X) :
    (N.path_chain nodes).func x = N.chain_eval_nodes nodes x := by
  induction nodes generalizing x with
  | nil =>
      simp [path_chain, chain_eval_nodes, chain_eval_nodes_core, OperatorChain]
  | cons β rest ih =>
      rw [path_chain, List.map_cons, List.reverse_cons]
      rw [operator_chain_append_apply]
      change
        (N.path_chain rest).func ((N.node_op β).func x) =
          N.chain_eval_nodes rest ((N.node_op β).func x)
      exact ih ((N.node_op β).func x)

    ∀ (n : Nat) (β : V) (y : X),
      y ∈ N.node_dom β → N.eval_with_fuel n β y ≠ bot := by

  induction n with
  | zero =>

      exact hy

      cases hchoice : N.choice β ((N.node_op β).func y) with

  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hxdom
    by_cases hx : x ∈ N.U
    · exact hx
    · dsimp [dom, extensional_operator] at hxdom
      simp [hx] at hxdom
  · intro hx
    dsimp [dom, extensional_operator]
    simp [hx, N.eval_ne_bot ⟨x, hx⟩]

  · intro hx

  intro x hx
  rcases hx.1 with ⟨hUβ, hβ⟩
  rcases hx.2 with ⟨hUγ, hγ⟩
  have hsub : (⟨x, hUβ⟩ : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) = ⟨x, hUγ⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hentry_eq :
      N.entry ⟨x, hUβ⟩ = N.entry ⟨x, hUγ⟩ := by
    rw [hsub]
  exact hne (hβ.symm.trans (hentry_eq.trans hγ))

    (h : (N.edge_domain β γ).Nonempty) :
    N.rank γ < N.rank β := by
  rcases h with ⟨z, hz⟩
  rcases hz.1 with ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
  have hyN : y ∈ N.node_dom β := by
    simpa [node_dom] using hy
  have hchoice :
      N.choice β ((N.node_op β).func y) = OutputChoice.next γ := by
    simpa [hyz] using hz.2
  exact N.choice_next_rank hyN hchoice

  | succ n ih =>

      | next γ =>

            N.choice_next_mem hy hchoice
          have hrest :

          have hzero : N.rank β = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hrank
          rw [hzero] at hlt

      unfold path_with_fuel path_with_fuel_core
      cases hchoice : N.choice β ((N.node_op β).func y) with
      | stop =>

noncomputable def reachable_path_code (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    Fin (N.node_count + 1) × (Fin N.node_count → Option V) :=
  (⟨p.nodes.length,
      Nat.lt_succ_of_le (N.reachable_path_nodes_length_le_node_count p)⟩,
    fun i =>
      if hi : i.val < p.nodes.length then
        some (p.nodes.get ⟨i.val, hi⟩)

OET anchor: h-56edb9917107efcd **命题 #h-56edb9917107efcd（路径分解与可达路径有限性，有限性）** 可达路径编码是单射。 -/
theorem reachable_path_code_injective :
    Function.Injective N.reachable_path_code := by
  intro p q hpq
  cases p with
  | mk pnodes pnonempty =>
      cases q with
      | mk qnodes qnonempty =>
          have hp_len :
              pnodes.length ≤ N.node_count :=
            N.reachable_path_nodes_length_le_node_count
              ⟨pnodes, pnonempty⟩
          have hq_len :
              qnodes.length ≤ N.node_count :=
            N.reachable_path_nodes_length_le_node_count
              ⟨qnodes, qnonempty⟩
          have hlen : pnodes.length = qnodes.length := by
            exact Fin.ext_iff.mp (congrArg Prod.fst hpq)
          have hget :
              ∀ (n : Nat) (hp : n < pnodes.length) (hq : n < qnodes.length),
                pnodes.get ⟨n, hp⟩ = qnodes.get ⟨n, hq⟩ := by
            intro n hp hq
            have hn : n < N.node_count := lt_of_lt_of_le hp hp_len
            have hfun :=
              congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd hpq) ⟨n, hn⟩
            dsimp [reachable_path_code] at hfun
            simp only [hp, hq, ↓reduceDIte] at hfun
            exact Option.some.inj hfun
          have hnodes : pnodes = qnodes := by
            exact List.ext_get hlen hget
          cases hnodes
          rfl

  letI : Fintype V := N.node_fintype
  exact Fintype.ofInjective N.reachable_path_code
    N.reachable_path_code_injective

OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，路径相等）**

theorem reachable_path_ext {p q : N.ReachablePath}
    (h : p.nodes = q.nodes) : p = q := by
  cases p with
  | mk pnodes pnonempty =>
      cases q with
      | mk qnodes qnonempty =>
          dsimp at h
          cases h
          rfl

theorem path_domain_subset_path_chain_dom (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    N.path_domain p.nodes ⊆ dom (N.path_chain p.nodes) := by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨hxU, hpath⟩
  dsimp [dom]
  rw [N.path_chain_apply_eq_chain_eval_nodes]
  rw [← hpath]
  exact N.eval_ne_bot ⟨x, hxU⟩

OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，前缀一步求值）**
路径前缀多执行一位，等于先执行较短前缀，再执行该位节点算子。

theorem chain_eval_nodes_take_succ {nodes : List V} {n : Nat}
    (hn : n < nodes.length) (x : X) :
    N.chain_eval_nodes (nodes.take (n + 1)) x =
      (N.node_op (nodes.get ⟨n, hn⟩)).func
        (N.chain_eval_nodes (nodes.take n) x) := by
  induction nodes generalizing n x with
  | nil =>
      cases hn
  | cons β rest ih =>
      cases n with
      | zero =>
          simp [chain_eval_nodes, chain_eval_nodes_core]
      | succ n =>
          have hnrest : n < rest.length := by
            simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hn
          simpa [chain_eval_nodes, chain_eval_nodes_core] using
            ih hnrest ((N.node_op β).func x)

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，路径位置）**
无环展开的节点由一条可达终止路径和该路径中的一个位置组成。

abbrev PathPosition : Type :=

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，位置投影）**
路径位置投影到原有限网络中的节点标签。
-/
def path_position_label (w : N.PathPosition) : V :=
  w.1.nodes.get w.2

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，标签序列投影）**

原路径的节点标签序列。

theorem path_position_label_sequence (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin p.nodes.length =>
      N.path_position_label (⟨p, i⟩ : N.PathPosition)) = p.nodes := by
  simp [path_position_label]

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，位置输入域）**
路径位置 `(p,s)` 的输入域是在路径域 `U_p` 上执行前 `s` 个节点之前

-/
def path_position_input_domain (w : N.PathPosition) : Set X :=
  N.chain_eval_nodes (w.1.nodes.take w.2.val) '' N.path_domain w.1.nodes

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，位置输入域非空）**
每个路径位置的输入域非空。
-/
theorem path_position_input_domain_nonempty (w : N.PathPosition) :
    (N.path_position_input_domain w).Nonempty := by
  rcases w.1.nonempty_domain with ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨N.chain_eval_nodes (w.1.nodes.take w.2.val) x,
    Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，位置输入合法性）**
路径位置输入域包含于对应原节点的定义域。
-/
theorem path_position_input_domain_subset_node_dom (w : N.PathPosition) :
    N.path_position_input_domain w ⊆ dom (N.node_op (N.path_position_label w)) := by
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rcases hx with ⟨hxU, hpath⟩
  let xp : {x : X // x ∈ N.U} := ⟨x, hxU⟩
  let n : Fin (N.path_of xp).length :=
    ⟨w.2.val, by simp [xp, hpath, w.2.isLt]⟩
  have hmem :=
    terminal_path_prefix_input_mem N.choice_next_mem
      (N.entry_mem xp) (N.path_terminal xp) n
  simpa [PathPosition, path_position_label, path_position_input_domain,
    chain_eval_nodes, xp, hpath, n] using hmem

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，下一位置）**
路径位置的后继位置；末位置没有后继。
-/
noncomputable def path_position_next (w : N.PathPosition) : Option N.PathPosition :=
  if hnext : w.2.val + 1 < w.1.nodes.length then
    some ⟨w.1, ⟨w.2.val + 1, hnext⟩⟩
  else
    none

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，位置秩）**
路径位置到末端的剩余节点数给出无环秩。
-/
def path_position_rank (w : N.PathPosition) : Nat :=
  w.1.nodes.length - (w.2.val + 1)

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，位置局域算子）**
路径位置展开中的局域算子是原节点局域算子在该位置实际输入域上的限制。
-/
noncomputable def path_position_node_op (w : N.PathPosition) : Operator X bot :=
  restrict_operator (N.node_op (N.path_position_label w))
    (N.path_position_input_domain w)

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，位置算子定义域）**
路径位置局域算子的定义域正好是该位置输入域。
-/
theorem dom_path_position_node_op_eq (w : N.PathPosition) :
    dom (N.path_position_node_op w) = N.path_position_input_domain w := by
  exact
    dom_restrict_operator_eq
      (N.node_op (N.path_position_label w))
      (N.path_position_input_domain w)
      (N.path_position_input_domain_subset_node_dom w)

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，位置后继选择）**

    OutputChoice N.PathPosition :=
  match N.path_position_next w with
  | some w' => OutputChoice.next w'
  | none => OutputChoice.stop

/--

**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，后继输入域）**

theorem path_position_node_output_mem_successor
    (w : N.PathPosition) (hnext : w.2.val + 1 < w.1.nodes.length)
    {y : X} (hy : y ∈ N.path_position_input_domain w) :
    (N.node_op (N.path_position_label w)).func y ∈
      N.path_position_input_domain
        ⟨w.1, ⟨w.2.val + 1, hnext⟩⟩ := by
  rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  exact N.chain_eval_nodes_take_succ w.2.isLt x

/--

theorem path_position_successor_rank_lt
    (w : N.PathPosition) (hnext : w.2.val + 1 < w.1.nodes.length) :
    N.path_position_rank ⟨w.1, ⟨w.2.val + 1, hnext⟩⟩ <
      N.path_position_rank w := by
  dsimp [path_position_rank]
  omega

**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，展开路径核）**

noncomputable def path_position_walk_with_fuel :
    Nat → N.PathPosition → List N.PathPosition
  | 0, w => [w]
  | n + 1, w =>
      w ::
        match N.path_position_next w with
        | some w' => path_position_walk_with_fuel n w'
        | none => []

theorem path_position_path_with_fuel_core_eq_walk :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (w : N.PathPosition) (y : X),
      path_with_fuel_core N.path_position_node_op
        N.path_position_choice n w y =
          N.path_position_walk_with_fuel n w := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro w y
      simp [path_with_fuel_core, path_position_walk_with_fuel]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro w y
      unfold path_with_fuel_core path_position_walk_with_fuel
      cases hnext : N.path_position_next w with
      | none =>

      | some w' =>

                (N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take i) x)) =
                OutputChoice.next
                  (⟨p, ⟨i + 1, hnext⟩⟩ : N.PathPosition) := by
          have hnext_eq :
              N.path_position_next (⟨p, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩ : N.PathPosition) =
                some (⟨p, ⟨i + 1, hnext⟩⟩ : N.PathPosition) := by
            simp [path_position_next, hnext]
          rw [path_position_choice, hnext_eq]
        rw [hchoice, happly]
        have hstep_label :
            (N.node_op (N.path_position_label ⟨p, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩)).func
                (N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take i) x) =
              N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take (i + 1)) x := by
          simpa [path_position_label] using hstep.symm
        rw [hstep_label]
        exact hrec
      · have hlast : i + 1 = p.nodes.length := by omega
        have hfuel_zero : p.nodes.length - (i + 1) = 0 := by omega
        rw [← hfuel, hfuel_zero]
        unfold eval_with_fuel_core
        have hy_input :
            N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take i) x ∈
              N.path_position_input_domain ⟨p, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩ := by
          exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        rw [path_position_node_op]
        rw [restrict_operator_apply_of_mem
          (N.node_op (N.path_position_label ⟨p, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩))
          (N.path_position_input_domain ⟨p, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩)
          hy_input]
        have hstep := N.chain_eval_nodes_take_succ hi x
        calc
          (N.node_op (N.path_position_label ⟨p, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩)).func
              (N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take i) x)
              = N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take (i + 1)) x := by
                simpa [path_position_label] using hstep.symm
          _ = N.chain_eval_nodes p.nodes x := by
                simp [hlast]

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，路径标签后缀）**
从第 `i` 位开始的逐位置展开路径，其标签序列等于原路径标签序列的
第 `i` 位后缀。
-/
theorem path_position_walk_label_sequence_from_index (p : N.ReachablePath) :
    ∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < p.nodes.length),
      (N.path_position_walk_with_fuel
        (p.nodes.length - (i + 1)) ⟨p, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩).map
          N.path_position_label =
        p.nodes.drop i := by
  intro i hi
  induction hfuel : p.nodes.length - (i + 1) using
      Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i with
  | h d ih =>
      by_cases hnext : i + 1 < p.nodes.length
      · have hfuel_succ :
            p.nodes.length - (i + 1) =
              (p.nodes.length - ((i + 1) + 1)) + 1 := by
          omega
        have hrec :=
          ih (p.nodes.length - ((i + 1) + 1)) (by omega)
            (i + 1) hnext rfl
        rw [← hfuel, hfuel_succ]
        simp [path_position_walk_with_fuel, path_position_next, hnext,
          path_position_label, hrec]
      · have hlast : i + 1 = p.nodes.length := by omega
        have hfuel_zero : p.nodes.length - (i + 1) = 0 := by omega
        rw [← hfuel, hfuel_zero]
        simp [path_position_walk_with_fuel, path_position_label]
        simpa [hlast] using
          (List.cons_get_drop_succ (l := p.nodes) (n := ⟨i, hi⟩))

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，起点标签序列）**
从逐位置展开链入口开始的标签序列正好是原终止路径标签序列。
-/
theorem path_position_walk_label_sequence_from_start (p : N.ReachablePath)
    (h0 : 0 < p.nodes.length) :
    (N.path_position_walk_with_fuel
      (p.nodes.length - 1) ⟨p, ⟨0, h0⟩⟩).map N.path_position_label =
      p.nodes := by
  have hseq := N.path_position_walk_label_sequence_from_index p 0 h0
  simpa using hseq

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，逐位置同域）**
逐位置无环展开与原有限网络具有相同输入域。
-/
theorem path_position_acyclic_expansion_same_domain :
    N.path_position_acyclic_expansion.U = N.U :=
  rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，逐位置外延相等）**
逐位置无环展开与原有限网络具有相同外延算子。
-/
theorem path_position_acyclic_expansion_extensional_eq :
    N.path_position_acyclic_expansion.extensional_operator =
      N.extensional_operator := by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ N.U
  · let xp : {x : X // x ∈ N.U} := ⟨x, hx⟩
    let p : N.ReachablePath := ⟨N.path_of xp, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
    have h0 : 0 < p.nodes.length := by
      simpa [p] using Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (N.path_nonempty xp)
    have hx_path : x ∈ N.path_domain p.nodes := by
      exact ⟨hx, rfl⟩
    have heval :=
      N.path_position_eval_from_index_eq p 0 h0 x hx_path
    simpa [OperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, OperatorNetwork.eval,
      OperatorNetwork.eval_from, OperatorNetwork.eval_with_fuel,
      path_position_acyclic_expansion,
      FiniteOperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, hx, xp, p,
      path_position_rank, chain_eval_nodes, chain_eval_nodes_core] using heval
  · simp [OperatorNetwork.extensional_operator,
      path_position_acyclic_expansion,
      FiniteOperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, hx]

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，实际路径投影）**
逐位置无环展开在每个输入点上的实际终止路径，经位置标签投影后，
等于原有限网络的实际终止路径标签序列。
-/
theorem path_position_acyclic_expansion_path_projection
    (x : {x : X // x ∈ N.U}) :
    (N.path_position_acyclic_expansion.path_of x).map
      N.path_position_label = N.path_of x := by
  let p : N.ReachablePath := ⟨N.path_of x, ⟨x.val, x.property, rfl⟩⟩
  have h0 : 0 < p.nodes.length := by
    simpa [p] using Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (N.path_nonempty x)
  have hcore :=
    N.path_position_path_with_fuel_core_eq_walk
      (N.path_position_rank ⟨p, ⟨0, h0⟩⟩)
      (⟨p, ⟨0, h0⟩⟩ : N.PathPosition)
      x.val
  have hlabels := N.path_position_walk_label_sequence_from_start p h0
  have hcore' :
      N.path_position_acyclic_expansion.path_of x =
        N.path_position_walk_with_fuel
          (N.path_position_rank ⟨p, ⟨0, h0⟩⟩)
          (⟨p, ⟨0, h0⟩⟩ : N.PathPosition) := by
    simpa [OperatorNetwork.path_of, OperatorNetwork.path_from,
      OperatorNetwork.path_with_fuel, path_position_acyclic_expansion,
      path_position_rank, p] using hcore
  rw [hcore']
  simpa [p] using hlabels

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，路径投影）**
逐位置无环展开中的每条可达路径，经位置标签投影后给出原有限网络
中的一条可达路径。
-/
noncomputable def path_position_projected_path
    (q : N.path_position_acyclic_expansion.ReachablePath) :
    N.ReachablePath := by
  classical
  refine ⟨q.nodes.map N.path_position_label, ?_⟩
  rcases q.nonempty_domain with ⟨x, hxUdag, hq⟩
  have hxU : x ∈ N.U := by
    simpa [path_position_acyclic_expansion] using hxUdag
  refine ⟨x, hxU, ?_⟩
  have hsub :
      (⟨x, hxUdag⟩ :
        {x : X // x ∈ N.path_position_acyclic_expansion.U}) =
        ⟨x, hxU⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  rw [← hq]
  rw [hsub]
  exact (N.path_position_acyclic_expansion_path_projection ⟨x, hxU⟩).symm

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，路径折叠构造）**
把每条可达路径折叠为一个无环节点；该节点的局域算子是路径链在
该路径域上的限制。
-/
noncomputable def path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion :
    OperatorNetwork X bot N.ReachablePath where
  U := N.U
  bot_not_mem := N.bot_not_mem
  node_fintype := N.reachable_path_fintype
  node_op := fun p => restrict_operator (N.path_chain p.nodes) (N.path_domain p.nodes)
  node_dom_nonempty := by
    intro p
    have hdom :
        dom (restrict_operator (N.path_chain p.nodes) (N.path_domain p.nodes)) =
          N.path_domain p.nodes :=
      dom_restrict_operator_eq (N.path_chain p.nodes) (N.path_domain p.nodes)
        (N.path_domain_subset_path_chain_dom p)
    rw [hdom]
    exact p.nonempty_domain
  entry := fun x => ⟨N.path_of x, ⟨x.val, x.property, rfl⟩⟩
  entry_mem := by
    intro x
    have hdom :
        dom
          (restrict_operator
            (N.path_chain (N.path_of x))
            (N.path_domain (N.path_of x))) =
          N.path_domain (N.path_of x) :=
      dom_restrict_operator_eq
        (N.path_chain (N.path_of x))
        (N.path_domain (N.path_of x))
        (N.path_domain_subset_path_chain_dom
          (⟨N.path_of x, ⟨x.val, x.property, rfl⟩⟩ : N.ReachablePath))
    simpa [hdom] using (show x.val ∈ N.path_domain (N.path_of x) from
      ⟨x.property, rfl⟩)
  choice := fun _ _ => OutputChoice.stop
  choice_next_mem := by
    intro β γ y hy hchoice
    cases hchoice
  rank := fun _ => 0
  choice_next_rank := by
    intro β γ y hy hchoice
    cases hchoice
  node_reachable := by
    intro p
    rcases p.nonempty_domain with ⟨x, hxU, hpath⟩
    let xp : {x : X // x ∈ N.U} := ⟨x, hxU⟩
    refine ⟨xp, ?_⟩
    have hentry :
        (⟨N.path_of xp, ⟨xp.val, xp.property, rfl⟩⟩ : N.ReachablePath) = p :=
      N.reachable_path_ext hpath
    simp [path_with_fuel_core, hentry]

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，同域）**
路径折叠无环展开与原有限网络具有相同输入域。
-/
theorem path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion_same_domain :
    N.path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion.U = N.U :=
  rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，外延相等）**
路径折叠无环展开与原有限网络具有相同外延算子。
-/
theorem path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion_extensional_eq :
    N.path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion.extensional_operator =
      N.extensional_operator := by
  classical
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ N.U
  · let xp : {x : X // x ∈ N.U} := ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hpath_dom : x ∈ N.path_domain (N.path_of xp) := ⟨hx, rfl⟩
    have hrestrict :
        (restrict_operator
          (N.path_chain (N.path_of xp))
          (N.path_domain (N.path_of xp))).func x =
            (N.path_chain (N.path_of xp)).func x :=
      restrict_operator_apply_of_mem
        (N.path_chain (N.path_of xp))
        (N.path_domain (N.path_of xp))
        hpath_dom
    have hchain :
        (N.path_chain (N.path_of xp)).func x = N.eval xp := by
      rw [N.path_chain_apply_eq_chain_eval_nodes]
      rfl
    simp [OperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, OperatorNetwork.eval,
      OperatorNetwork.eval_from, OperatorNetwork.eval_with_fuel,
      eval_with_fuel_core, path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion,
      FiniteOperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, hx, xp, hrestrict, hchain]
  · simp [OperatorNetwork.extensional_operator,
      path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion,
      FiniteOperatorNetwork.extensional_operator, hx]

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，外延存在形式）**
每个有限算子网络都存在同域且外延算子相同的无环算子网络展开。
-/
theorem acyclic_extensional_expansion_exists :
  ∃ W : Type, ∃ dag : OperatorNetwork X bot W,
    dag.U = N.U ∧ dag.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator := by
  exact
    ⟨N.ReachablePath, N.path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion,
      N.path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion_same_domain,
      N.path_collapsed_acyclic_expansion_extensional_eq⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，见证结构）**
有限网络的无环展开由一个无环网络、同一输入域、外延算子相等和
路径投影一致性组成。正文中的构造给出该见证。
-/
structure AcyclicExpansionWitness where
  W : Type
  dag : OperatorNetwork X bot W
  node_projection : W → V
  path_projection : dag.ReachablePath → N.ReachablePath
  same_domain : dag.U = N.U
  extensional_eq : dag.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator
  path_projection_nodes :
    ∀ q : dag.ReachablePath,
      q.nodes.map node_projection = (path_projection q).nodes
  path_projection_surjective : Function.Surjective path_projection

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，完整见证）**
逐位置复制构造给出有限网络无环展开的完整见证。
-/
noncomputable def acyclic_expansion_witness : AcyclicExpansionWitness N where
  W := N.PathPosition
  dag := N.path_position_acyclic_expansion
  node_projection := N.path_position_label
  path_projection := N.path_position_projected_path
  same_domain := N.path_position_acyclic_expansion_same_domain
  extensional_eq := N.path_position_acyclic_expansion_extensional_eq
  path_projection_nodes := by
    intro q
    rfl
  path_projection_surjective := by
    intro p
    rcases p.nonempty_domain with ⟨x, hxU, hpath⟩
    let xp : {x : X // x ∈ N.U} := ⟨x, hxU⟩
    let q : N.path_position_acyclic_expansion.ReachablePath :=
      ⟨N.path_position_acyclic_expansion.path_of xp, ⟨x, hxU, rfl⟩⟩
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    apply N.reachable_path_ext
    dsimp [path_position_projected_path, q, xp]
    simpa [xp, hpath] using
      N.path_position_acyclic_expansion_path_projection xp

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，见证形式）**
一旦给出无环展开见证，就得到与原有限网络同域且外延相同的无环
网络，并保留路径投影一致性陈述。
-/
theorem acyclic_expansion_exists_of_witness
    (w : AcyclicExpansionWitness N) :
  ∃ W : Type, ∃ dag : OperatorNetwork X bot W,
    ∃ node_projection : W → V,
      ∃ path_projection : dag.ReachablePath → N.ReachablePath,
        dag.U = N.U ∧
          dag.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator ∧
            (∀ q : dag.ReachablePath,
              q.nodes.map node_projection = (path_projection q).nodes) ∧
              Function.Surjective path_projection := by
  exact
    ⟨w.W, w.dag, w.node_projection, w.path_projection, w.same_domain,
      w.extensional_eq, w.path_projection_nodes, w.path_projection_surjective⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-3d5365e74a8359df
**命题 #h-3d5365e74a8359df（有限网络的无环展开，构造形式）**
每个有限算子网络都存在同域、同外延且逐路径标签投影保持的无环
算子网络展开。
-/
theorem acyclic_expansion_exists :
  ∃ W : Type, ∃ dag : OperatorNetwork X bot W,
    ∃ node_projection : W → V,
      ∃ path_projection : dag.ReachablePath → N.ReachablePath,
        dag.U = N.U ∧
          dag.extensional_operator = N.extensional_operator ∧
            (∀ q : dag.ReachablePath,
              q.nodes.map node_projection = (path_projection q).nodes) ∧
              Function.Surjective path_projection := by
  exact N.acyclic_expansion_exists_of_witness N.acyclic_expansion_witness

end FiniteOperatorNetwork

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.operator_network
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.path_algebra


namespace formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks

noncomputable section

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X V I : Type} {bot : X}
variable [Fintype I]
local instance instDecidableEqIPathMatrix : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

namespace FiniteOperatorNetwork

variable (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V)

/-- The ordered matrix product attached to a path node sequence. -/
noncomputable def path_matrix_product
    (M : V → I → I → ENNReal) (nodes : List V) : I → I → ENNReal :=
  matrix_list_mul ((nodes.map M).reverse)

@[simp]
theorem path_matrix_product_nil (M : V → I → I → ENNReal) :
    path_matrix_product M [] = matrix_id := rfl

@[simp]
theorem path_matrix_product_append_singleton
    (M : V → I → I → ENNReal) (nodes : List V) (β : V) :
    path_matrix_product M (nodes ++ [β]) =
      matrix_mul (M β) (path_matrix_product M nodes) := by
  simp [path_matrix_product, matrix_list_mul]

/-- Restricting the set of inputs preserves a Lip matrix. -/
theorem is_lip_matrix_mono {A B : Set X} {φ : Operator X bot}
    {L : I → I → ENNReal} (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hL : IsLipMatrix d φ B L) :
    IsLipMatrix d φ A L := by
  exact ⟨fun x hx => hL.1 (hAB hx), fun x hx y hy j =>
    hL.2 x (hAB hx) y (hAB hy) j⟩

/-- Restricting to a nonempty subset preserves a co-Lip matrix. -/
theorem is_colip_matrix_mono {A B : Set X} {φ : Operator X bot}
    {K : I → I → ENNReal} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hAB : A ⊆ B)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d φ B K) : IsCoLipMatrix d φ A K := by
  exact ⟨hA, fun x hx => hK.2.1 (hAB hx), fun x hx y hy j =>
    hK.2.2 x (hAB hx) y (hAB hy) j⟩

/-- Every path-prefix image lies in the domain of its next stored node. -/
theorem path_prefix_image_subset_node_dom (p : N.ReachablePath)
    (n : Fin p.nodes.length) :
    (N.path_chain (p.nodes.take n.val)).func '' N.path_domain p.nodes ⊆
      N.node_dom (p.nodes.get n) := by
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hpos := N.path_position_input_domain_subset_node_dom
    (⟨p, n⟩ : N.PathPosition)
  have hmem :
      N.chain_eval_nodes (p.nodes.take n.val) x ∈
        N.path_position_input_domain (⟨p, n⟩ : N.PathPosition) :=
    ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have := hpos hmem
  simpa [FiniteOperatorNetwork.path_position_label,
    FiniteOperatorNetwork.node_dom,
    N.path_chain_apply_eq_chain_eval_nodes] using this

/-- Full-node Lip certificates generate the exact ordered path product. -/
theorem path_right_chain_lip_bounded
    (nodes : List V) (U : Set X) (L : V → I → I → ENNReal)
    (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ bot)
    (hinput : ∀ (n : Nat) (hn : n < nodes.length),
      (N.path_chain (nodes.take n)).func '' U ⊆
        N.node_dom (nodes.get ⟨n, hn⟩))
    (hL : ∀ β ∈ nodes,
      IsLipMatrix d (N.node_op β) (N.node_dom β) (L β)) :
    RightChainLipBounded d ((nodes.map N.node_op).reverse) U
      (path_matrix_product L nodes) := by
  induction nodes using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
      exact RightChainLipBounded.nil U hU
  | append_singleton nodes β ih =>
      have hinput_prefix : ∀ (n : Nat) (hn : n < nodes.length),
          (N.path_chain (nodes.take n)).func '' U ⊆
            N.node_dom (nodes.get ⟨n, hn⟩) := by
        intro n hn
        have hn' : n < (nodes ++ [β]).length :=
          lt_trans hn (by simp)
        have h := hinput n hn'
        have htake : (nodes ++ [β]).take n = nodes.take n :=
          List.take_append_of_le_length (Nat.le_of_lt hn)
        rw [htake] at h
        simpa [List.get_eq_getElem, hn] using h
      have htail := ih hinput_prefix (by
        intro γ hγ
        exact hL γ (by simp [hγ]))
      have hlast :
          (N.path_chain nodes).func '' U ⊆ N.node_dom β := by
        have h := hinput nodes.length (by simp)
        simpa using h
      have hnode :
          IsLipMatrix d (N.node_op β) ((N.path_chain nodes).func '' U) (L β) :=
        is_lip_matrix_mono d hlast (hL β (by simp))
      simpa [FiniteOperatorNetwork.path_chain] using
        (RightChainLipBounded.cons (d := d) (N.node_op β)
          ((nodes.map N.node_op).reverse) U (L β)
          (path_matrix_product L nodes) htail hnode)

/-- Full-node co-Lip certificates generate the exact ordered path product. -/
theorem path_right_chain_colip_bounded
    (nodes : List V) (U : Set X) (K : V → I → I → ENNReal)
    (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, x ≠ bot) (hU_ne : U.Nonempty)
    (hinput : ∀ (n : Nat) (hn : n < nodes.length),
      (N.path_chain (nodes.take n)).func '' U ⊆
        N.node_dom (nodes.get ⟨n, hn⟩))
    (hK : ∀ β ∈ nodes,
      IsCoLipMatrix d (N.node_op β) (N.node_dom β) (K β)) :
    RightChainCoLipBounded d ((nodes.map N.node_op).reverse) U
      (path_matrix_product K nodes) := by
  induction nodes using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
      exact RightChainCoLipBounded.nil U hU hU_ne
  | append_singleton nodes β ih =>
      have hinput_prefix : ∀ (n : Nat) (hn : n < nodes.length),
          (N.path_chain (nodes.take n)).func '' U ⊆
            N.node_dom (nodes.get ⟨n, hn⟩) := by
        intro n hn
        have hn' : n < (nodes ++ [β]).length :=
          lt_trans hn (by simp)
        have h := hinput n hn'
        have htake : (nodes ++ [β]).take n = nodes.take n :=
          List.take_append_of_le_length (Nat.le_of_lt hn)
        rw [htake] at h
        simpa [List.get_eq_getElem, hn] using h
      have htail := ih hinput_prefix (by
        intro γ hγ
        exact hK γ (by simp [hγ]))
      have hlast :
          (N.path_chain nodes).func '' U ⊆ N.node_dom β := by
        have h := hinput nodes.length (by simp)
        simpa using h
      have himage : ((N.path_chain nodes).func '' U).Nonempty :=
        hU_ne.image (N.path_chain nodes).func
      have hnode :
          IsCoLipMatrix d (N.node_op β) ((N.path_chain nodes).func '' U) (K β) :=
        is_colip_matrix_mono d himage hlast (hK β (by simp))
      simpa [FiniteOperatorNetwork.path_chain] using
        (RightChainCoLipBounded.cons (d := d) (N.node_op β)
          ((nodes.map N.node_op).reverse) U (K β)
          (path_matrix_product K nodes) htail hnode)

/--
OET anchor: h-d64105c6ec192365
**命题 #h-d64105c6ec192365（路径级矩阵证书继承，Lip）**
Node-level Lip matrices on the node domains of one reachable path compose to
the ordered path product on that path domain.
-/
theorem path_chain_lip_matrix (p : N.ReachablePath)
    (L : V → I → I → ENNReal)
    (hL : ∀ β ∈ p.nodes,
      IsLipMatrix d (N.node_op β) (N.node_dom β) (L β)) :
    IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain p.nodes) (N.path_domain p.nodes)
      (path_matrix_product L p.nodes) := by
  have hU : ∀ x ∈ N.path_domain p.nodes, x ≠ bot := by
    intro x hx hxb
    subst x
    exact N.bot_not_mem (N.path_domain_subset_source hx)
  have hinput : ∀ (n : Nat) (hn : n < p.nodes.length),
      (N.path_chain (p.nodes.take n)).func '' N.path_domain p.nodes ⊆
        N.node_dom (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hn⟩) := by
    intro n hn
    exact N.path_prefix_image_subset_node_dom p ⟨n, hn⟩
  simpa [FiniteOperatorNetwork.path_chain] using
    right_chain_lip_matrix d ((p.nodes.map N.node_op).reverse)
      (N.path_domain p.nodes) (path_matrix_product L p.nodes)
      (N.path_right_chain_lip_bounded d p.nodes (N.path_domain p.nodes)
        L hU hinput hL)

/--
OET anchor: h-d64105c6ec192365
**命题 #h-d64105c6ec192365（路径级矩阵证书继承，co-Lip）**
Node-level co-Lip matrices on the node domains of one reachable path compose
to the ordered path product on that nonempty path domain.
-/
theorem path_chain_colip_matrix (p : N.ReachablePath)
    (K : V → I → I → ENNReal)
    (hK : ∀ β ∈ p.nodes,
      IsCoLipMatrix d (N.node_op β) (N.node_dom β) (K β)) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d (N.path_chain p.nodes) (N.path_domain p.nodes)
      (path_matrix_product K p.nodes) := by
  have hU : ∀ x ∈ N.path_domain p.nodes, x ≠ bot := by
    intro x hx hxb
    subst x
    exact N.bot_not_mem (N.path_domain_subset_source hx)
  have hinput : ∀ (n : Nat) (hn : n < p.nodes.length),
      (N.path_chain (p.nodes.take n)).func '' N.path_domain p.nodes ⊆
        N.node_dom (p.nodes.get ⟨n, hn⟩) := by
    intro n hn
    exact N.path_prefix_image_subset_node_dom p ⟨n, hn⟩
  simpa [FiniteOperatorNetwork.path_chain] using
    right_chain_colip_matrix d ((p.nodes.map N.node_op).reverse)
      (N.path_domain p.nodes) (path_matrix_product K p.nodes)
      (N.path_right_chain_colip_bounded d p.nodes (N.path_domain p.nodes)
        K hU p.nonempty_domain hinput hK)

/--
OET anchor: h-d64105c6ec192365
**命题 #h-d64105c6ec192365（路径级矩阵证书继承，Lip）**
若 《算子界》 的右链 Lip 递推条件在路径域上成立，则路径链具有对应矩阵上界。
-/
theorem path_chain_lip_matrix_of_right_chain (nodes : List V) (U : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hL :
      RightChainLipBounded d ((nodes.map N.node_op).reverse) U L) :
    IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain nodes) U L := by
  simpa [path_chain] using
    right_chain_lip_matrix d ((nodes.map N.node_op).reverse) U L hL

/--
OET anchor: h-d64105c6ec192365
**命题 #h-d64105c6ec192365（路径级矩阵证书继承，co-Lip）**
若 《算子界》 的右链 co-Lip 递推条件在路径域上成立，则路径链具有对应矩阵下界。
-/
theorem path_chain_colip_matrix_of_right_chain (nodes : List V) (U : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hK :
      RightChainCoLipBounded d ((nodes.map N.node_op).reverse) U K) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d (N.path_chain nodes) U K := by
  simpa [path_chain] using
    right_chain_colip_matrix d ((nodes.map N.node_op).reverse) U K hK

/--
OET anchor: h-d64105c6ec192365
**命题 #h-d64105c6ec192365（路径级矩阵证书继承，Lip 逐点形式）**
合法路径 Lip 矩阵给出路径终点距离的逐分量上界。
-/
theorem path_chain_lip_pointwise (nodes : List V) (U : Set X)
    (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain nodes) U L) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j ((N.path_chain nodes).func x) ((N.path_chain nodes).func y) ≤
        ∑ i : I, L i j * d i x y := by
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact hL.2 x hx y hy j

/--
OET anchor: h-d64105c6ec192365
**命题 #h-d64105c6ec192365（路径级矩阵证书继承，co-Lip 逐点形式）**
合法路径 co-Lip 矩阵给出路径终点距离的逐分量下界。
-/
theorem path_chain_colip_pointwise (nodes : List V) (U : Set X)
    (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d (N.path_chain nodes) U K) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      ∑ i : I, K i j * d i x y ≤
        d j ((N.path_chain nodes).func x) ((N.path_chain nodes).func y) := by
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact hK.2.2 x hx y hy j

/--
**命题 #h-8893f19c84720522（前缀扩展的复合等式，算子链形式）**
Auxiliary chain unfolding. The actual network extension, path domains and
matrix inheritance are proved in `prefix_extension.lean`.
-/
theorem prefix_extension_path_chain_apply (φ : Operator X bot)
    (nodes : List V) (x : X) :
    (OperatorChain [N.path_chain nodes, φ]).func x =
      (N.path_chain nodes).func (φ.func x) := by
  simp [OperatorChain]

end FiniteOperatorNetwork

end

import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.single_step_bounds
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus.distance_recurrence
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Operations
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-f3c6356537b5c083
**命题 #h-f3c6356537b5c083（矩阵向量上界的单调性）**
The finite matrix-vector action is monotone in the vector argument.
-/
theorem matrix_vector_bound_mono
    (M : I → I → ENNReal) {v w : I → ENNReal}
    (hvw : ∀ i : I, v i ≤ w i) :
    ∀ j : I, matrix_vector_bound M v j ≤ matrix_vector_bound M w j := by
  intro j
  unfold matrix_vector_bound
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
    simpa [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_right (hvw i) (M i j)

/--
OET anchor: h-f3c6356537b5c083
**命题 #h-f3c6356537b5c083（矩阵向量上界的加法性）**
The matrix-vector action distributes over finite componentwise addition.
-/
theorem matrix_vector_bound_add
    (M : I → I → ENNReal) (v w : I → ENNReal) :
    ∀ j : I,
      matrix_vector_bound M (fun i => v i + w i) j =
        matrix_vector_bound M v j + matrix_vector_bound M w j := by
  intro j
  unfold matrix_vector_bound
  simp_rw [mul_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/--
OET anchor: h-f3c6356537b5c083
**命题 #h-f3c6356537b5c083（仿射递推包络）**
Recursive finite-step envelope for inequalities of the form
`δ_{m+1} ≤ A_m δ_m + ε_m`.
-/
noncomputable def affine_upper_bound
    (A : Nat → I → I → ENNReal) (eps : Nat → I → ENNReal) :
    Nat → I → ENNReal
  | 0 => fun _ => 0
  | n + 1 => fun j => matrix_vector_bound (A n) (affine_upper_bound A eps n) j + eps n j

/-- The ordered product of matrices strictly after a selected error step. -/
noncomputable def ordered_suffix_matrix_product
    (A : Nat → I → I → ENNReal) (s : Nat) : Nat → I → I → ENNReal
  | 0 =>
      letI := Classical.decEq I
      matrix_id
  | k + 1 =>
      letI := Classical.decEq I
      if s < k + 1 then
        matrix_mul (A k) (ordered_suffix_matrix_product A s k)
      else
        matrix_id

/-- The explicit ordered suffix-product expansion of a finite affine recurrence. -/
noncomputable def ordered_suffix_error_sum
    (A : Nat → I → I → ENNReal) (eps : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (k : Nat) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  (Finset.range k).sum fun q =>
    matrix_vector_bound (ordered_suffix_matrix_product A (q + 1) k) (eps q) j

private theorem matrix_vector_bound_matrix_id
    (v : I → ENNReal) (j : I) :
    matrix_vector_bound matrix_id v j = v j := by
  classical
  simp [matrix_vector_bound, matrix_id]

private theorem matrix_vector_bound_matrix_mul
    (L₂ L₁ : I → I → ENNReal) (v : I → ENNReal) (j : I) :
    matrix_vector_bound (matrix_mul L₂ L₁) v j =
      matrix_vector_bound L₂ (matrix_vector_bound L₁ v) j := by
  classical
  unfold matrix_vector_bound matrix_mul
  calc
    (∑ i : I, (∑ q : I, L₂ q j * L₁ i q) * v i) =
        ∑ i : I, ∑ q : I, (L₂ q j * L₁ i q) * v i := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ q : I, ∑ i : I, (L₂ q j * L₁ i q) * v i := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ q : I, L₂ q j * ∑ i : I, L₁ i q * v i := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro q _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [mul_assoc]

private theorem sum_matrix_vector_bound
    {alpha : Type}
    (M : I → I → ENNReal) (S : Finset alpha) (v : alpha → I → ENNReal) (j : I) :
    S.sum (fun a => matrix_vector_bound M (v a) j) =
      matrix_vector_bound M (fun i => S.sum fun a => v a i) j := by
  unfold matrix_vector_bound
  calc
    S.sum (fun a => ∑ i : I, M i j * v a i) =
        ∑ i : I, S.sum (fun a => M i j * v a i) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ i : I, M i j * S.sum (fun a => v a i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]

private theorem ordered_suffix_error_sum_succ
    (A : Nat → I → I → ENNReal) (eps : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (k : Nat) (j : I) :
    ordered_suffix_error_sum A eps (k + 1) j =
      matrix_vector_bound (A k) (ordered_suffix_error_sum A eps k) j + eps k j := by
  classical
  have hold :
      (Finset.range k).sum (fun q =>
          matrix_vector_bound (ordered_suffix_matrix_product A (q + 1) (k + 1))
            (eps q) j) =
        (Finset.range k).sum (fun q =>
          matrix_vector_bound (A k)
            (matrix_vector_bound (ordered_suffix_matrix_product A (q + 1) k)
              (eps q)) j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro q hq
    have hqk : q < k := Finset.mem_range.mp hq
    rw [ordered_suffix_matrix_product]
    simp only [if_pos (Nat.succ_lt_succ hqk)]
    exact matrix_vector_bound_matrix_mul (A k)
      (ordered_suffix_matrix_product A (q + 1) k) (eps q) j
  have hlast :
      matrix_vector_bound (ordered_suffix_matrix_product A (k + 1) (k + 1))
          (eps k) j = eps k j := by
    rw [ordered_suffix_matrix_product]
    simp only [lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte]
    exact matrix_vector_bound_matrix_id (eps k) j
  unfold ordered_suffix_error_sum
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hold, hlast]
  rw [sum_matrix_vector_bound]

/--
OET support: h-db404f24d5fa0541 and h-eff0f168218a98d0
The explicit ordered suffix-product sum equals the recursive affine envelope.
-/
theorem affine_upper_bound_eq_ordered_suffix_error_sum
    (A : Nat → I → I → ENNReal) (eps : Nat → I → ENNReal) :
    ∀ k : Nat, ∀ j : I,
      affine_upper_bound A eps k j = ordered_suffix_error_sum A eps k j := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro j
      simp [affine_upper_bound, ordered_suffix_error_sum]
  | succ k ih =>
      intro j
      rw [affine_upper_bound, ordered_suffix_error_sum_succ]
      rw [show affine_upper_bound A eps k = ordered_suffix_error_sum A eps k from
        funext ih]

/--
OET anchor: h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3
**引理 #h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3（候选扩张域族的闭球容纳判据，多维闭球）**
The closed gauge ball determined by a component radius vector.
-/
def closed_gauge_ball (center : X) (radius : I → ENNReal) : Set X :=
  { y | ∀ i : I, d i center y ≤ radius i }

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3
**引理 #h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3（候选扩张域族的闭球容纳判据，单步域包含）**
If the actual state is inside the candidate closed ball and the ball is
contained in the selected candidate extension domain, then the actual state is
in that domain.
-/
theorem state_mem_candidate_extension_domain_of_closed_ball
    (center state : X) (radius : I → ENNReal) (W : Set X)
    (hstate : state ∈ closed_gauge_ball d center radius)
    (hcover : closed_gauge_ball d center radius ⊆ W) :
    state ∈ W :=
  hcover hstate

/--
OET anchor: h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3
**引理 #h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3（候选扩张域族的闭球容纳判据，候选上界控制真实偏差）**
If the true deviation recurrence is dominated by the recurrence defining a
candidate envelope, then the candidate envelope bounds every step.
-/
theorem candidate_bound_controls_deviation
    (A : Nat → I → I → ENNReal) (eps delta delta_hat : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (hinit : ∀ j : I, delta 0 j ≤ delta_hat 0 j)
    (hrec :
      ∀ m : Nat, ∀ j : I,
        delta (m + 1) j ≤ matrix_vector_bound (A m) (delta m) j + eps m j)
    (hhat :
      ∀ m : Nat, ∀ j : I,
        matrix_vector_bound (A m) (delta_hat m) j + eps m j ≤ delta_hat (m + 1) j) :
    ∀ n : Nat, ∀ j : I, delta n j ≤ delta_hat n j := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro j
      exact hinit j
  | succ n ih =>
      intro j
      calc
        delta (n + 1) j
            ≤ matrix_vector_bound (A n) (delta n) j + eps n j := hrec n j
        _ ≤ matrix_vector_bound (A n) (delta_hat n) j + eps n j :=
            add_le_add (matrix_vector_bound_mono (A n) ih j) le_rfl
        _ ≤ delta_hat (n + 1) j := hhat n j

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3
**引理 #h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3（候选扩张域族的闭球容纳判据）**
The candidate deviation bounds and closed-ball containment imply that each
proxy state lies in the selected candidate extension domain.
-/
theorem candidate_extension_containment_states
    (target_state proxy_state : Nat → X) (W : Nat → Set X)
    (delta_hat : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (hdev :
      ∀ n : Nat, ∀ i : I,
        d i (target_state n) (proxy_state n) ≤ delta_hat n i)
    (hcover :
      ∀ n : Nat, closed_gauge_ball d (target_state n) (delta_hat n) ⊆ W n) :
    ∀ n : Nat, proxy_state n ∈ W n := by
  intro n
  exact hcover n (hdev n)

/--
OET anchor: h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3
**引理 #h-7e8245f5a4ac1eb3（候选扩张域族的闭球容纳判据，候选包络与扩张域）**
Combining the affine candidate-envelope recurrence with closed-ball
containment gives both the deviation bound and membership in the selected
candidate extension domain.
-/
theorem candidate_envelope_controls_deviation_and_extension_domains
    (target_state proxy_state : Nat → X) (W : Nat → Set X)
    (A : Nat → I → I → ENNReal) (eps delta delta_hat : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (hdelta_dist :
      ∀ n : Nat, ∀ i : I,
        d i (target_state n) (proxy_state n) ≤ delta n i)
    (hinit : ∀ j : I, delta 0 j ≤ delta_hat 0 j)
    (hrec :
      ∀ m : Nat, ∀ j : I,
        delta (m + 1) j ≤ matrix_vector_bound (A m) (delta m) j + eps m j)
    (hhat :
      ∀ m : Nat, ∀ j : I,
        matrix_vector_bound (A m) (delta_hat m) j + eps m j ≤ delta_hat (m + 1) j)
    (hcover :
      ∀ n : Nat, closed_gauge_ball d (target_state n) (delta_hat n) ⊆ W n) :
    (∀ n : Nat, ∀ i : I, delta n i ≤ delta_hat n i) ∧
      (∀ n : Nat, proxy_state n ∈ W n) := by
  constructor
  · exact candidate_bound_controls_deviation A eps delta delta_hat hinit hrec hhat
  · intro n
    apply hcover n
    intro i
    exact le_trans (hdelta_dist n i)
      (candidate_bound_controls_deviation A eps delta delta_hat hinit hrec hhat n i)

/--
OET anchor: h-f3c6356537b5c083
**命题（偏差累积律，代理 Lip 单步上界）**
Bridging through the proxy at the target input uses only the proxy Lip
certificate on the common safety domain. The proxy input need not lie in `U`.
-/
theorem deviation_step_upper
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U W : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (L_proxy : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUW : U ⊆ W)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hLproxy : IsLipMatrix d proxy W L_proxy)
    {x_nat_prev x_prev : X}
    (hx_nat_U : x_nat_prev ∈ U)
    (hx_prev_W : x_prev ∈ W) :
    ∀ j : I,
      d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound L_proxy
          (fun i => d i x_nat_prev x_prev) j + eps j := by
  intro j
  calc
    d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev)
        ≤ d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_nat_prev) +
          d j (proxy.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) := (hd j).triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ eps j + matrix_vector_bound L_proxy
          (fun i => d i x_nat_prev x_prev) j :=
      add_le_add (hfit.error x_nat_prev hx_nat_U j (Set.mem_univ j))
        (hLproxy.2 x_nat_prev (hUW hx_nat_U) x_prev hx_prev_W j)
    _ = _ := add_comm _ _

/--
OET anchor: h-f3c6356537b5c083
**命题 #h-f3c6356537b5c083（偏差累积律，全链累积递推形式）**
Iterating the one-step affine recurrence gives the finite chain envelope.  This
is the recursive Lean form of the displayed product-sum expansion in the text.
-/
theorem deviation_recurrence_bound
    (A : Nat → I → I → ENNReal) (eps delta : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (hdelta0 : ∀ j : I, delta 0 j = 0)
    (hrec :

theorem proxy_colip_additive_step
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U W : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (K_proxy : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hKproxy : IsCoLipMatrix d proxy W K_proxy)
    {x_nat_prev x_prev : X}
    (hx_nat_U : x_nat_prev ∈ U)
    (hx_nat_W : x_nat_prev ∈ W)
    (hx_prev_W : x_prev ∈ W) :
    ∀ j : I,
      matrix_vector_bound K_proxy (fun i => d i x_nat_prev x_prev) j ≤
        d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) + eps j := by
  intro j
  have hcolip :
      matrix_vector_bound K_proxy (fun i => d i x_nat_prev x_prev) j ≤
        d j (proxy.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) := by
    simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using
      hKproxy.2.2 x_nat_prev hx_nat_W x_prev hx_prev_W j
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle (proxy.func x_nat_prev)
      (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev)
  have hfit' : d j (proxy.func x_nat_prev) (target.func x_nat_prev) ≤ eps j := by
    rw [(hd j).symm (proxy.func x_nat_prev) (target.func x_nat_prev)]
    exact hfit.error x_nat_prev hx_nat_U j (Set.mem_univ j)
  have hupper :
      d j (proxy.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) ≤
        eps j + d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) :=
    le_trans htri (add_le_add_left hfit' _)
  calc
    matrix_vector_bound K_proxy (fun i => d i x_nat_prev x_prev) j
        ≤ d j (proxy.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) := hcolip
    _ ≤ eps j + d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) := hupper
    _ = d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) + eps j := by
        rw [add_comm]

/--
OET anchor: h-e6b35b7b528f8ebe
**命题 #h-e6b35b7b528f8ebe（co-Lip 偏差保留的加法侧证书，目标侧）**
When the proxy state remains in the fitting domain, the target co-Lip lower
bound also gives the additive-side recurrence.
-/
theorem target_colip_additive_step
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U W : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (K_target : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hKtarget : IsCoLipMatrix d target W K_target)
    {x_nat_prev x_prev : X}
    (hx_nat_W : x_nat_prev ∈ W)
    (hx_prev_W : x_prev ∈ W)
    (hx_prev_U : x_prev ∈ U) :
    ∀ j : I,
      matrix_vector_bound K_target (fun i => d i x_nat_prev x_prev) j ≤
        d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) + eps j := by
  intro j
  have hcolip :
      matrix_vector_bound K_target (fun i => d i x_nat_prev x_prev) j ≤
        d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (target.func x_prev) := by
    simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using
      hKtarget.2.2 x_nat_prev hx_nat_W x_prev hx_prev_W j
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle (target.func x_nat_prev)
      (proxy.func x_prev) (target.func x_prev)
  have hfit' : d j (proxy.func x_prev) (target.func x_prev) ≤ eps j := by
    rw [(hd j).symm (proxy.func x_prev) (target.func x_prev)]
    exact hfit.error x_prev hx_prev_U j (Set.mem_univ j)
  have hupper :
      d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (target.func x_prev) ≤
        d j (target.func x_nat_prev) (proxy.func x_prev) + eps j :=
    le_trans htri (add_le_add le_rfl hfit')
  exact le_trans hcolip hupper

/--
OET anchor: h-e6b35b7b528f8ebe
**命题 #h-e6b35b7b528f8ebe（co-Lip 偏差保留的加法侧证书，有限项实数余量）**
An additive co-Lip certificate may be converted to a positive real difference
only after the propagated term and the tolerance are both known to be finite.
-/
theorem colip_additive_step_finite_positive_margin
    (propagated deviation tolerance : ENNReal)
    (hcert : propagated ≤ deviation + tolerance)
    (hpropagated_finite : propagated ≠ ⊤)
    (htolerance_finite : tolerance ≠ ⊤)
    (hstrict : tolerance < propagated) :
    (propagated - tolerance).toReal =
        propagated.toReal - tolerance.toReal ∧
      0 < propagated - tolerance ∧
      propagated - tolerance ≠ ⊤ ∧
      propagated - tolerance ≤ deviation := by
  have _ := htolerance_finite
  have htolerance_le : tolerance ≤ propagated := le_of_lt hstrict
  refine ⟨ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le htolerance_le hpropagated_finite, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact tsub_pos_iff_lt.mpr hstrict
  · exact ENNReal.sub_ne_top hpropagated_finite
  · exact tsub_le_iff_right.mpr hcert

/--
OET anchor: h-e6b35b7b528f8ebe
**命题 #h-e6b35b7b528f8ebe（co-Lip 偏差保留的加法侧证书，全步量词）**
Zero-based Lean form of the text's quantification over every
`m = 1, ..., k` and every component `j` on the proxy side.
-/
theorem proxy_colip_additive_steps
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Nat → Operator X bot)
    (U W : Nat → Set X) (eps : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (K_proxy : Nat → I → I → ENNReal)
    (x_natural x_proxy : Nat → X) (k : Nat)
    (hfit :
      ∀ m : Nat, m < k →
        InFullFittingBall d (target m) (proxy m) (U m) (eps m))
    (hKproxy :
      ∀ m : Nat, m < k → IsCoLipMatrix d (proxy m) (W m) (K_proxy m))
    (hx_natural_U : ∀ m : Nat, m < k → x_natural m ∈ U m)
    (hx_natural_W : ∀ m : Nat, m < k → x_natural m ∈ W m)
    (hx_proxy_W : ∀ m : Nat, m < k → x_proxy m ∈ W m) :
    ∀ m : Nat, m < k → ∀ j : I,
      matrix_vector_bound (K_proxy m)
          (fun i => d i (x_natural m) (x_proxy m)) j ≤
        d j ((target m).func (x_natural m)) ((proxy m).func (x_proxy m)) +
          eps m j := by
  intro m hm
  exact proxy_colip_additive_step d hd (target m) (proxy m) (U m) (W m)
    (eps m) (K_proxy m) (hfit m hm) (hKproxy m hm)
    (hx_natural_U m hm) (hx_natural_W m hm) (hx_proxy_W m hm)

/--
OET anchor: h-e6b35b7b528f8ebe
**命题 #h-e6b35b7b528f8ebe（co-Lip 偏差保留的加法侧证书，全步量词，目标侧）**
Zero-based all-step and all-component form of the target-side recurrence.
-/
theorem target_colip_additive_steps
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Nat → Operator X bot)
    (U W : Nat → Set X) (eps : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (K_target : Nat → I → I → ENNReal)
    (x_natural x_proxy : Nat → X) (k : Nat)
    (hfit :
      ∀ m : Nat, m < k →
        InFullFittingBall d (target m) (proxy m) (U m) (eps m))
    (hKtarget :
      ∀ m : Nat, m < k → IsCoLipMatrix d (target m) (W m) (K_target m))
    (hx_natural_W : ∀ m : Nat, m < k → x_natural m ∈ W m)
    (hx_proxy_W : ∀ m : Nat, m < k → x_proxy m ∈ W m)
    (hx_proxy_U : ∀ m : Nat, m < k → x_proxy m ∈ U m) :
    ∀ m : Nat, m < k → ∀ j : I,
      matrix_vector_bound (K_target m)
          (fun i => d i (x_natural m) (x_proxy m)) j ≤
        d j ((target m).func (x_natural m)) ((proxy m).func (x_proxy m)) +
          eps m j := by
  intro m hm
  exact target_colip_additive_step d hd (target m) (proxy m) (U m) (W m)
    (eps m) (K_target m) (hfit m hm) (hKtarget m hm)
    (hx_natural_W m hm) (hx_proxy_W m hm) (hx_proxy_U m hm)

end formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations
