import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.gauge_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations.operator_space
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.lip_matrix
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.annihilation_matrix
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X}
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**§ #h-70b110ccae52fc0b（分量误差向量）**
`component_error_vector d target proxy U j` is the `j`-component
supremum of the pointwise output error on `U`.
-/
noncomputable def component_error_vector
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x : {x // x ∈ U}, d j (target.func x.1) (proxy.func x.1)

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**定义（代理闭球）**
Pointwise form of membership in the proxy closed ball on a component set `J`.
-/
structure InFittingBall
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I) (eps : I → ENNReal) :
    Prop where
  tolerance_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → eps j ≠ ⊤
  target_dom : U ⊆ dom target
  proxy_dom : U ⊆ dom proxy
  error : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → d j (target.func x) (proxy.func x) ≤ eps j

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**§ #h-70b110ccae52fc0b（全分量代理闭球）**
The all-component specialization of `InFittingBall`.
-/
abbrev InFullFittingBall
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) : Prop :=
  InFittingBall d target proxy U Set.univ eps

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**定义（残差下界证书）**
A residual lower-bound certificate includes the same common-domain conditions
as the corresponding pointwise comparison.
-/
structure ResidualLowerCertificate
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps_res : I → ENNReal) : Prop where
  target_dom : U ⊆ dom target
  proxy_dom : U ⊆ dom proxy
  component_nonempty : J.Nonempty
  lower : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → eps_res j ≤ d j (target.func x) (proxy.func x)

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**定义（残差下界证书，零证书）**
The zero vector is a residual lower-bound certificate on every common domain.
-/
theorem zero_residual_lower_certificate
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I)
    (htarget : U ⊆ dom target) (hproxy : U ⊆ dom proxy)
    (hJ : J.Nonempty) :
    ResidualLowerCertificate d target proxy U J (fun _ => 0) := by
  refine ⟨htarget, hproxy, hJ, ?_⟩
  intro x hx j hj
  exact zero_le _

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**定义（残差下界证书，空域语义）**
On the empty domain every nonnegative extended vector satisfies the pointwise
lower inequality vacuously.
-/
theorem residual_lower_certificate_empty
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (J : Set I) (eps_res : I → ENNReal)
    (hJ : J.Nonempty) :
    ResidualLowerCertificate d target proxy ∅ J eps_res := by
  refine ⟨Set.empty_subset _, Set.empty_subset _, hJ, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  exact False.elim hx

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**定义（残差下界证书，正残差的非空域语义）**
A positive certificate component yields an attained positive residual only
when the measuring domain is nonempty.
-/
theorem positive_residual_witness_of_nonempty
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps_res : I → ENNReal)
    (hcert : ResidualLowerCertificate d target proxy U J eps_res)
    (hU : U.Nonempty) (j : I) (hj : j ∈ J) (hpos : 0 < eps_res j) :
    ∃ x ∈ U, 0 < d j (target.func x) (proxy.func x) := by
  rcases hU with ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (hcert.lower x hx j hj)⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**§ #h-70b110ccae52fc0b（分量误差向量与代理闭球）**
Proxy-ball membership bounds each component error vector entry.
-/
theorem component_error_vector_le_of_fitting
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (hfit : InFittingBall d target proxy U J eps) :
    ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
      component_error_vector d target proxy U j ≤ eps j := by
  intro j hj
  unfold component_error_vector
  apply iSup_le
  intro x
  exact hfit.error x.1 x.2 j hj

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**§ #h-70b110ccae52fc0b（分量误差向量与代理闭球）**
Conversely, componentwise supremum bounds give the pointwise proxy-ball
condition, once the common-domain requirements are supplied.
-/
theorem fitting_of_component_error_vector_le
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (heps_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → eps j ≠ ⊤)
    (htarget : U ⊆ dom target) (hproxy : U ⊆ dom proxy)
    (hD : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
      component_error_vector d target proxy U j ≤ eps j) :
    InFittingBall d target proxy U J eps := by
  refine ⟨heps_finite, htarget, hproxy, ?_⟩
  intro x hx j hj
  have hx_le :
      d j (target.func x) (proxy.func x) ≤
        component_error_vector d target proxy U j := by
    unfold component_error_vector
    exact le_iSup (fun y : {x // x ∈ U} => d j (target.func y.1) (proxy.func y.1)) ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact le_trans hx_le (hD j hj)

/--
OET anchor: h-70b110ccae52fc0b
**§ #h-70b110ccae52fc0b（域单调性）**
Restricting the measuring domain preserves proxy-ball membership.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_mono_domain
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U₁ U₂ : Set X) (J : Set I) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (hsub : U₁ ⊆ U₂)
    (hfit : InFittingBall d target proxy U₂ J eps) :
    InFittingBall d target proxy U₁ J eps := by
  refine ⟨hfit.tolerance_finite, fun x hx => hfit.target_dom (hsub hx),
    fun x hx => hfit.proxy_dom (hsub hx), ?_⟩
  intro x hx j hj
  exact hfit.error x (hsub hx) j hj

/--
OET anchor: h-a48c70147269828e
**命题 #h-a48c70147269828e（代理闭球传递律，二步形式）**
Two consecutive full-component proxy-ball certificates compose with additive
tolerance.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_transitive_two
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (phi₀ phi₁ phi₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (eps₁ eps₂ : I → ENNReal)
    (hfit₁ : InFullFittingBall d phi₀ phi₁ U eps₁)
    (hfit₂ : InFullFittingBall d phi₁ phi₂ U eps₂) :
    InFullFittingBall d phi₀ phi₂ U (fun j => eps₁ j + eps₂ j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, hfit₁.target_dom, hfit₂.proxy_dom, ?_⟩
  · intro j _
    exact ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr
      ⟨hfit₁.tolerance_finite j (Set.mem_univ j),
        hfit₂.tolerance_finite j (Set.mem_univ j)⟩
  intro x hx j _
  have htri := (hd j).triangle (phi₀.func x) (phi₁.func x) (phi₂.func x)
  exact le_trans htri
    (add_le_add
      (hfit₁.error x hx j (Set.mem_univ j))
      (hfit₂.error x hx j (Set.mem_univ j)))

/--
OET anchor: h-a48c70147269828e
**命题 #h-a48c70147269828e（代理闭球传递律）**
This declaration formalizes the target-center-shift special case.
A full-component error-vector bound from a perturbed target to the original
target, followed by a fitting certificate from the original target to the
proxy, gives the sum-tolerance certificate from the perturbed target.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_target_center_shift
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (perturbed_target target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (delta eps : I → ENNReal)
    (hdelta_finite : ∀ j : I, delta j ≠ ⊤)
    (hperturbed_dom : U ⊆ dom perturbed_target)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hdelta :
      ∀ j : I,
        component_error_vector d perturbed_target target U j ≤ delta j) :
    InFullFittingBall d perturbed_target proxy U (fun j => delta j + eps j) := by
  have hshift :
      InFullFittingBall d perturbed_target target U delta :=
    fitting_of_component_error_vector_le d perturbed_target target U Set.univ delta
      (fun j _ => hdelta_finite j) hperturbed_dom hfit.target_dom
      (fun j _ => hdelta j)
  exact fitting_ball_transitive_two d hd perturbed_target target proxy U delta eps
    hshift hfit

/--
OET anchor: h-a48c70147269828e
**命题 #h-a48c70147269828e（代理闭球传递律）**
Along a finite proxy chain indexed by `0, ..., m`, pointwise fitting errors
accumulate by the finite sum of the step tolerances.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_transitive_chain
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (phi : Nat → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (m : Nat)
    (hdom : ∀ r : Nat, r ≤ m → U ⊆ dom (phi r))
    (heps_finite : ∀ r : Nat, r < m → ∀ j : I, eps r j ≠ ⊤)
    (hfit :
      ∀ r : Nat, r < m →
        ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
          d j ((phi r).func x) ((phi (r + 1)).func x) ≤ eps r j) :
    InFullFittingBall d (phi 0) (phi m) U
      (fun j => (Finset.range m).sum (fun r => eps r j)) := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨?_, hdom 0 le_rfl, hdom 0 le_rfl, ?_⟩
      · intro j _
        simp
      intro x _ j _
      simpa using (hd j).dist_self ((phi 0).func x)
  | succ m ih =>
      have ihfit :
          InFullFittingBall d (phi 0) (phi m) U
            (fun j => (Finset.range m).sum (fun r => eps r j)) := by
        apply ih
        · intro r hr
          exact hdom r (Nat.le_trans hr (Nat.le_succ m))
        · intro r hr j
          exact heps_finite r (Nat.lt_trans hr (Nat.lt_succ_self m)) j
        · intro r hr
          exact hfit r (Nat.lt_trans hr (Nat.lt_succ_self m))
      refine ⟨?_, hdom 0 (Nat.zero_le _), hdom (m + 1) le_rfl, ?_⟩
      · intro j _
        exact ENNReal.sum_ne_top.mpr fun r hr =>
          heps_finite r (Finset.mem_range.mp hr) j
      intro x hx j _
      have htri :=
        (hd j).triangle ((phi 0).func x) ((phi m).func x) ((phi (m + 1)).func x)
      have hstep := hfit m (Nat.lt_succ_self m) x hx j
      calc
        d j ((phi 0).func x) ((phi (m + 1)).func x)
            ≤ d j ((phi 0).func x) ((phi m).func x) +
              d j ((phi m).func x) ((phi (m + 1)).func x) := htri
        _ ≤ (Finset.range m).sum (fun r => eps r j) + eps m j :=
            add_le_add (ihfit.error x hx j (Set.mem_univ j)) hstep
        _ = (Finset.range (m + 1)).sum (fun r => eps r j) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]

/--
OET anchor: h-a48c70147269828e
**命题 #h-a48c70147269828e（代理闭球传递律，任意子链）**
Text-faithful interval form.  Here `eps r` records the text's tolerance
`ε⁽ʳ⁺¹⁾` for the step from `phi r` to `phi (r + 1)`.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_transitive_subchain_text
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (phi : Nat → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (m : Nat) (hm_pos : 1 ≤ m) (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (hdom : ∀ r : Nat, r ≤ m → U ⊆ dom (phi r))
    (heps_finite : ∀ r : Nat, r < m → ∀ j : I, eps r j ≠ ⊤)
    (hfit :
      ∀ r : Nat, r < m →
        ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
          d j ((phi r).func x) ((phi (r + 1)).func x) ≤ eps r j)
    (a b : Nat) (ha : a < b) (hb : b ≤ m) :
    InFullFittingBall d (phi a) (phi b) U
      (fun j => (Finset.range (b - a)).sum (fun r => eps (a + r) j)) := by
  have _ := hm_pos
  have _ := hU_nonempty
  let shifted_phi : Nat → Operator X bot := fun r => phi (a + r)
  let shifted_eps : Nat → I → ENNReal := fun r => eps (a + r)
  have hchain := fitting_ball_transitive_chain d hd shifted_phi U shifted_eps (b - a)
    (by
      intro r hr
      apply hdom (a + r)
      omega)
    (by
      intro r hr j
      apply heps_finite (a + r)
      omega)
    (by
      intro r hr x hx j
      simpa [shifted_phi, shifted_eps, Nat.add_assoc] using
        hfit (a + r) (by omega) x hx j)
  simpa [shifted_phi, shifted_eps, Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt ha)] using hchain

/--
A fitting certificate with a componentwise smaller tolerance is also a fitting
certificate for any larger tolerance vector on the same domain and target.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_mono_tolerance
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps eta : I → ENNReal)
    (heta_finite : ∀ j : I, eta j ≠ ⊤)
    (hle : ∀ j : I, eps j ≤ eta j)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps) :
    InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eta := by
  refine ⟨fun j _ => heta_finite j, hfit.target_dom, hfit.proxy_dom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx j hj
  exact le_trans (hfit.error x hx j hj) (hle j)

/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由）**
Two proxies fitting the same target on `U` differ by at most the sum of their
component tolerances on `U`.
-/
theorem proxy_pair_cross_consistency
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy_a proxy_b : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (eps_a eps_b : I → ENNReal)
    (hfit_a : InFullFittingBall d target proxy_a U eps_a)
    (hfit_b : InFullFittingBall d target proxy_b U eps_b) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (proxy_a.func x) (proxy_b.func x) ≤ eps_a j + eps_b j := by
  intro x hx j
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle (proxy_a.func x) (target.func x) (proxy_b.func x)
  have ha : d j (proxy_a.func x) (target.func x) ≤ eps_a j := by
    rw [(hd j).symm (proxy_a.func x) (target.func x)]
    exact hfit_a.error x hx j (Set.mem_univ j)
  have hb : d j (target.func x) (proxy_b.func x) ≤ eps_b j :=
    hfit_b.error x hx j (Set.mem_univ j)
  exact le_trans htri (add_le_add ha hb)

/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由，正文前提版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining the nonempty fitting domain and finite
nonnegative tolerance assumptions from the text.  Nonnegativity is built into
`ENNReal`; finiteness is kept as an explicit text-level hypothesis.
-/
theorem proxy_pair_cross_consistency_text
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy_a proxy_b : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (eps_a eps_b : I → ENNReal)
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (heps_a_finite : ∀ j : I, eps_a j ≠ ⊤)
    (heps_b_finite : ∀ j : I, eps_b j ≠ ⊤)
    (hfit_a : InFullFittingBall d target proxy_a U eps_a)
    (hfit_b : InFullFittingBall d target proxy_b U eps_b) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (proxy_a.func x) (proxy_b.func x) ≤ eps_a j + eps_b j := by
  have _ := hU_nonempty
  have _ := heps_a_finite
  have _ := heps_b_finite
  exact proxy_pair_cross_consistency d hd target proxy_a proxy_b U eps_a eps_b hfit_a hfit_b

/--
OET anchor: h-09f81de53176a55d
**命题 #h-09f81de53176a55d（零容限拟合的受限规范数据一致）**
Zero-tolerance fitting on `U` makes the target and proxy pairwise output
distances identical on `U`, without requiring pointwise equality.
-/
theorem zero_error_fitting_pairwise_distance_eq
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0)) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (target.func x) (target.func y) =
        d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y) := by
  intro x hx y hy j
  have hx_zero : d j (target.func x) (proxy.func x) = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (hfit.error x hx j (Set.mem_univ j)) (zero_le _)
  have hy_zero : d j (target.func y) (proxy.func y) = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (hfit.error y hy j (Set.mem_univ j)) (zero_le _)
  have hx_zero_symm : d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) = 0 := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm (proxy.func x) (target.func x)] using hx_zero
  have hy_zero_symm : d j (proxy.func y) (target.func y) = 0 := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm (proxy.func y) (target.func y)] using hy_zero
  apply le_antisymm
  · have htri₁ :=
      (hd j).triangle (target.func x) (proxy.func x) (target.func y)
    have htri₂ :=
      (hd j).triangle (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y) (target.func y)
    have hmid :
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func y) ≤
          d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y) := by
      have hle :
          d j (proxy.func x) (target.func y) ≤
            d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y) + 0 :=
        le_trans htri₂ (add_le_add le_rfl (le_of_eq hy_zero_symm))
      simpa using hle
    have hle :
        d j (target.func x) (target.func y) ≤
          0 + d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y) :=
      le_trans htri₁ (add_le_add (le_of_eq hx_zero) hmid)
    simpa using hle
  · have htri₁ :=
      (hd j).triangle (proxy.func x) (target.func x) (proxy.func y)
    have htri₂ :=
      (hd j).triangle (target.func x) (target.func y) (proxy.func y)
    have hmid :
        d j (target.func x) (proxy.func y) ≤
          d j (target.func x) (target.func y) := by
      have hle :
          d j (target.func x) (proxy.func y) ≤
            d j (target.func x) (target.func y) + 0 :=
        le_trans htri₂ (add_le_add le_rfl (le_of_eq hy_zero))
      simpa using hle
    have hle :
        d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y) ≤
          0 + d j (target.func x) (target.func y) :=
      le_trans htri₁ (add_le_add (le_of_eq hx_zero_symm) hmid)
    simpa using hle

/--
OET anchor: h-09f81de53176a55d
**命题 #h-09f81de53176a55d（零容限拟合的受限规范数据一致）**
Zero pointwise fitting error preserves all restricted Lip matrix predicates.
-/
theorem zero_error_lip_matrix_iff [Fintype I]
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (htarget_dom : U ⊆ dom target) (hproxy_dom : U ⊆ dom proxy)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0)) :
    IsLipMatrix d target U L ↔ IsLipMatrix d proxy U L := by
  constructor
  · intro hL
    refine ⟨hproxy_dom, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy j
    have hdist := zero_error_fitting_pairwise_distance_eq d hd target proxy U hfit x hx y hy j
    rw [← hdist]
    exact hL.2 x hx y hy j
  · intro hL
    refine ⟨htarget_dom, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy j
    have hdist := zero_error_fitting_pairwise_distance_eq d hd target proxy U hfit x hx y hy j
    rw [hdist]
    exact hL.2 x hx y hy j

/-- Internal helper: zero pointwise fitting error preserves restricted co-Lip
matrix predicates, including the vacuous equivalence on an empty domain. -/
theorem zero_error_colip_matrix_iff [Fintype I]
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (htarget_dom : U ⊆ dom target) (hproxy_dom : U ⊆ dom proxy)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0)) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d target U K ↔ IsCoLipMatrix d proxy U K := by
  constructor
  · intro hK
    refine ⟨hK.1, hproxy_dom, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy j
    have hdist := zero_error_fitting_pairwise_distance_eq d hd target proxy U hfit x hx y hy j
    rw [← hdist]
    exact hK.2.2 x hx y hy j
  · intro hK
    refine ⟨hK.1, htarget_dom, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy j
    have hdist := zero_error_fitting_pairwise_distance_eq d hd target proxy U hfit x hx y hy j
    rw [hdist]
    exact hK.2.2 x hx y hy j

/--
OET anchor: h-09f81de53176a55d
**命题 #h-09f81de53176a55d（零容限拟合的受限规范数据一致，非空域 co-Lip）**
Text-faithful co-Lip equality on a nonempty restricted domain.
-/
theorem zero_error_colip_matrix_iff_on_nonempty [Fintype I]
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0))
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty) :
    IsCoLipMatrix d target U K ↔ IsCoLipMatrix d proxy U K := by
  have _ := hU_nonempty
  exact zero_error_colip_matrix_iff d hd target proxy U K
    hfit.target_dom hfit.proxy_dom hfit

/--
OET anchor: h-09f81de53176a55d
**命题 #h-09f81de53176a55d（零容限拟合的受限规范数据一致）**
Zero pointwise fitting error gives identical computational fibers on `U`.
-/
theorem zero_error_computational_fiber_iff
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0))
    (J : NonemptyFinset I) {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    x ∈ ComputationalFiber d target J U (target.func y) ↔
      x ∈ ComputationalFiber d proxy J U (proxy.func y) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hfib
    constructor
    · exact hfib.1
    · have hzero_target :
        ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (target.func x) (target.func y) = 0 :=
        (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (target.func x) (target.func y)).mp hfib.2
      apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y)).mpr
      intro j hj
      have hdist := zero_error_fitting_pairwise_distance_eq d hd target proxy U hfit x hx y hy j
      rw [← hdist]
      exact hzero_target j hj
  · intro hfib
    constructor
    · exact hfib.1
    · have hzero_proxy :
        ∀ j ∈ J.val, d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y) = 0 :=
        (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y)).mp hfib.2
      apply (comp_pseudo_metric_eq_zero_iff d J (target.func x) (target.func y)).mpr
      intro j hj
      have hdist := zero_error_fitting_pairwise_distance_eq d hd target proxy U hfit x hx y hy j
      rw [hdist]
      exact hzero_proxy j hj

/-- Internal helper: zero pointwise fitting error preserves pointwise
restricted annihilation radii, including the vacuous empty-domain case. -/
theorem zero_error_annihilation_radius_eq
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0))
    (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    annihilation_radius d target i J U y =
      annihilation_radius d proxy i J U y := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · dsimp [annihilation_radius]
    apply iSup_le
    intro r
    apply iSup_le
    intro hr
    apply iSup_le
    intro hsub
    apply le_iSup_of_le r
    apply le_iSup_of_le hr
    have hsub_proxy :
        OpenBall d i y r ∩ U ⊆
          ComputationalFiber d proxy J U (proxy.func y) := by
      intro x hx
      exact (zero_error_computational_fiber_iff d hd target proxy U hfit J
        hx.2 hy).mp (hsub hx)
    exact le_iSup_of_le hsub_proxy le_rfl
  · dsimp [annihilation_radius]
    apply iSup_le
    intro r
    apply iSup_le
    intro hr
    apply iSup_le
    intro hsub
    apply le_iSup_of_le r
    apply le_iSup_of_le hr
    have hsub_target :
        OpenBall d i y r ∩ U ⊆
          ComputationalFiber d target J U (target.func y) := by
      intro x hx
      exact (zero_error_computational_fiber_iff d hd target proxy U hfit J
        hx.2 hy).mpr (hsub hx)
    exact le_iSup_of_le hsub_target le_rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-09f81de53176a55d
**命题 #h-09f81de53176a55d（零容限拟合的受限规范数据一致，非空域零化半径）**
Text-faithful pointwise annihilation-radius equality on a nonempty domain.
-/
theorem zero_error_annihilation_radius_eq_on_nonempty
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0))
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    annihilation_radius d target i J U y =
      annihilation_radius d proxy i J U y := by
  have _ := hU_nonempty
  exact zero_error_annihilation_radius_eq d hd target proxy U hfit i J hy

/-- Internal helper: zero error preserves restricted minimal annihilation
radii, including the empty-domain lattice value. -/
theorem zero_error_min_annihilation_radius_eq
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0))
    (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) :
    min_annihilation_radius d target i J U =
      min_annihilation_radius d proxy i J U := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · dsimp [min_annihilation_radius]
    apply le_iInf
    intro y
    apply le_iInf
    intro hy
    exact le_trans (iInf₂_le y hy)
      (le_of_eq (zero_error_annihilation_radius_eq d hd target proxy U hfit i J hy))
  · dsimp [min_annihilation_radius]
    apply le_iInf
    intro y
    apply le_iInf
    intro hy
    exact le_trans (iInf₂_le y hy)
      (ge_of_eq (zero_error_annihilation_radius_eq d hd target proxy U hfit i J hy))

/--
OET anchor: h-09f81de53176a55d

Text-faithful minimal annihilation-radius equality on a nonempty domain.

theorem zero_error_min_annihilation_radius_eq_on_nonempty
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0))
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (i : I) (J : NonemptyFinset I) :
    min_annihilation_radius d target i J U =

/-- Internal helper: zero error preserves restricted annihilation matrices,

theorem zero_error_annihilation_matrix_eq

theorem zero_error_restricted_data
    [Fintype I]
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U (fun _ => 0))
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty) :
    (∀ L : I → I → ENNReal,
      IsLipMatrix d target U L ↔ IsLipMatrix d proxy U L) ∧
    (∀ K : I → I → ENNReal,
      IsCoLipMatrix d target U K ↔ IsCoLipMatrix d proxy U K) ∧
    (∀ i j : I,
      AnnihilationMatrix d target U i j =
        AnnihilationMatrix d proxy U i j) := by
  have _ := hU_nonempty
  exact ⟨
    fun L =>
      zero_error_lip_matrix_iff d hd target proxy U L
        hfit.target_dom hfit.proxy_dom hfit,
    fun K =>
      zero_error_colip_matrix_iff_on_nonempty d hd target proxy U K
        hfit hU_nonempty,
    zero_error_annihilation_matrix_eq_on_nonempty d hd target proxy U
      hfit hU_nonempty⟩

import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.fitting_ball
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.lip_matrix
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus.distance_recurrence
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy.component_partition
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-10333868e2fa38b6
**命题 #h-10333868e2fa38b6（点态下游双侧界与共同前后接局部传递，点态下游双侧界）**
For a downstream operator with valid restricted L/K matrices, the terminal
distance is trapped between the matrix-vector lower and upper bounds.
-/
theorem terminal_composition_bounds
    (downstream : Operator X bot) (V : Set X)
    (K L : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d downstream V K)
    (hL : IsLipMatrix d downstream V L) :
    ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ y' ∈ V, ∀ j : I,
      matrix_vector_bound K (fun i => d i y y') j ≤
        d j (downstream.func y) (downstream.func y') ∧
      d j (downstream.func y) (downstream.func y') ≤
        matrix_vector_bound L (fun i => d i y y') j := by
  intro y hy y' hy' j
  exact ⟨by simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using hK.2.2 y hy y' hy' j,
    by simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using hL.2 y hy y' hy' j⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-10333868e2fa38b6
**命题 #h-10333868e2fa38b6（点态下游双侧界与共同前后接局部传递，共同前后接局部上界）**
If the target/proxy pointwise distance is bounded by a local error certificate
on `S`, and a common pre-composition sends `A` into `S`, then a common
post-composition with a Lip matrix on the relevant local image set propagates
the upper bound.
-/
theorem common_pre_post_composition_local_upper_bound
    (c_up c_down target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (A S V : Set X) (eps' : I → ENNReal) (L_down' : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hc_up_dom : A ⊆ dom c_up)
    (hc_upS : ∀ x ∈ A, c_up.func x ∈ S)
    (hfit : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ i : I, d i (target.func u) (proxy.func u) ≤ eps' i)
    (hV : ∀ x ∈ A, target.func (c_up.func x) ∈ V ∧ proxy.func (c_up.func x) ∈ V)
    (hL_down : IsLipMatrix d c_down V L_down') :
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ j : I,
      d j (c_down.func (target.func (c_up.func x)))
          (c_down.func (proxy.func (c_up.func x))) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound L_down' eps' j := by
  intro x hx j
  have _ := hc_up_dom hx
  have hxS : c_up.func x ∈ S := hc_upS x hx
  have hraw :
      d j (c_down.func (target.func (c_up.func x)))
          (c_down.func (proxy.func (c_up.func x))) ≤
        ∑ i : I, L_down' i j *
          d i (target.func (c_up.func x)) (proxy.func (c_up.func x)) := by
    exact hL_down.2 (target.func (c_up.func x)) (hV x hx).1
      (proxy.func (c_up.func x)) (hV x hx).2 j
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : I, L_down' i j *
          d i (target.func (c_up.func x)) (proxy.func (c_up.func x))) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound L_down' eps' j := by
    unfold matrix_vector_bound
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact mul_le_mul_right
      (hfit (c_up.func x) hxS i)
      (L_down' i j)
  exact le_trans hraw hsum

/--
OET anchor: h-10333868e2fa38b6
**命题 #h-10333868e2fa38b6（共同前后接的拟合上界与残差下界传递，有限传播闭球）**
The extended-valued pointwise bound above becomes proxy-ball membership only
when every propagated tolerance component is finite.
-/
theorem common_pre_post_composition_fitting_ball_of_finite
    (c_up c_down target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (A S_A V : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (L_down : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hc_up_dom : A ⊆ dom c_up)
    (hc_upS : ∀ x ∈ A, c_up.func x ∈ S_A)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy S_A eps)
    (hV : ∀ x ∈ A, target.func (c_up.func x) ∈ V ∧ proxy.func (c_up.func x) ∈ V)
    (hL_down : IsLipMatrix d c_down V L_down)
    (hpropagated_finite : ∀ j : I, matrix_vector_bound L_down eps j ≠ ⊤) :
    InFullFittingBall d
      (OperatorChain [c_down, target, c_up])
      (OperatorChain [c_down, proxy, c_up]) A
      (matrix_vector_bound L_down eps) := by
  refine ⟨fun j _ => hpropagated_finite j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [dom, OperatorChain]
    exact hL_down.1 (hV x hx).1
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [dom, OperatorChain]
    exact hL_down.1 (hV x hx).2
  · intro x hx j _
    simpa [OperatorChain] using
      common_pre_post_composition_local_upper_bound d

theorem terminal_upper_bound_subset_split
    [DecidableEq I]
    (L : I → I → ENNReal) (raw eps : I → ENNReal) (J : Finset I) (j : I)
    (hfit : ∀ i : I, i ∈ J → raw i ≤ eps i) :
    matrix_vector_bound L raw j ≤
      ∑ i : I, if i ∈ J then L i j * eps i else L i j * raw i := by
  classical
  unfold matrix_vector_bound
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
  · simp [hiJ]
    simpa [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_right (hfit i hiJ) (L i j)
  · simp [hiJ]

    [DecidableEq I]
    (L : I → I → ENNReal) (raw eps : I → ENNReal) (J : Finset I) (j : I)
    (hfit : ∀ i : I, i ∈ J → raw i ≤ eps i)
    (hzero : ∀ i : I, i ∉ J → L i j = 0) :
    matrix_vector_bound L raw j ≤
      ∑ i : I, if i ∈ J then L i j * eps i else 0 := by
  classical

    terminal_upper_bound_subset_split L raw eps J j hfit

      (∑ i : I, if i ∈ J then L i j * eps i else L i j * raw i) =
        ∑ i : I, if i ∈ J then L i j * eps i else 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
    · simp [hiJ]
    · simp [hiJ, hzero i hiJ]
  rwa [hsum_eq] at hsplit

      x hx x' hx' j

/--
OET anchor: h-3b97f42dbabb301d
**命题 #h-3b97f42dbabb301d（纤维非归零的 co-Lip 阈值证书）**
If the target co-Lip lower bound exceeds the additive tolerance, the proxy
cannot collapse the pair to zero in that component.
-/
theorem fiber_nonzero_of_colip_threshold
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d target U K)
    {x x' : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hx' : x' ∈ U) (j : I)
    (hstrict :
      (eps j + eps j) <
        matrix_vector_bound K (fun i => d i x x') j) :
    0 < d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func x') := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hle_zero : d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func x') ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp hnot
  have hzero : d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func x') = 0 :=
    le_antisymm hle_zero (zero_le _)
  have hbound :=
    fitting_ball_colip_matrix_constraint d hd target proxy U eps K hfit hK x hx x' hx' j
  have hle_eps :
      matrix_vector_bound K (fun i => d i x x') j ≤ eps j + eps j := by
    simpa [hzero, zero_add] using hbound
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hle_eps) hstrict

/--
OET anchor: h-7b1310be48fd8407
**推论 #h-7b1310be48fd8407（常值与活跃分量的 ε-稳定性，分量像直径）**
The `j`-component diameter of the image of `U` under an operator.
-/
noncomputable def component_image_diameter
    (phi : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x : {x // x ∈ U}, ⨆ y : {y // y ∈ U},
    d j (phi.func x.1) (phi.func y.1)

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-7b1310be48fd8407
**推论 #h-7b1310be48fd8407（近似常值继承）**
A target component that is constant on `U` yields proxy image diameter at most
`2 ε_j`.
-/
theorem const_component_proxy_diameter_le_two_eps
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hconst : j ∈ ConstComponent d target U) :
    component_image_diameter d proxy U j ≤ eps j + eps j := by
  unfold component_image_diameter
  apply iSup_le
  intro x
  apply iSup_le
  intro y
  have htri₁ :=
    (hd j).triangle (proxy.func x.1) (target.func x.1) (proxy.func y.1)
  have htri₂ :=
    (hd j).triangle (target.func x.1) (target.func y.1) (proxy.func y.1)
  have hxerr : d j (proxy.func x.1) (target.func x.1) ≤ eps j := by
    rw [(hd j).symm (proxy.func x.1) (target.func x.1)]
    exact hfit.error x.1 x.2 j (Set.mem_univ j)
  have hyerr : d j (target.func y.1) (proxy.func y.1) ≤ eps j :=
    hfit.error y.1 y.2 j (Set.mem_univ j)
  have hconst_zero : d j (target.func x.1) (target.func y.1) = 0 :=
    hconst x.1 x.2 y.1 y.2
  calc
    d j (proxy.func x.1) (proxy.func y.1)
        ≤ d j (proxy.func x.1) (target.func x.1) +
          d j (target.func x.1) (proxy.func y.1) := htri₁
    _ ≤ eps j + (d j (target.func x.1) (target.func y.1) +
          d j (target.func y.1) (proxy.func y.1)) :=
        add_le_add hxerr htri₂
    _ = eps j + d j (target.func y.1) (proxy.func y.1) := by
        simp [hconst_zero]
    _ ≤ eps j + eps j := by
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hyerr (eps j)
    _ = eps j + eps j := by simp

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-7b1310be48fd8407
**推论 #h-7b1310be48fd8407（正像距排除常值退化）**
A positive proxy image distance on a pair in `U` rules out membership in the
constant-component class.
-/
theorem not_const_component_of_positive_image_pair
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I)
    {x x' : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hx' : x' ∈ U)
    (hpos : 0 < d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func x')) :
    j ∉ ConstComponent d proxy U := by
  intro hconst
  have hzero := hconst x hx x' hx'
  rw [hzero] at hpos
  exact (lt_irrefl (0 : ENNReal)) hpos

/--
OET anchor: h-7b1310be48fd8407
**推论 #h-7b1310be48fd8407（近似非常值继承）**
The co-Lip threshold certificate of h-3b97f42dbabb301d makes the proxy
non-constant in component `j`; with non-identity assumed, it is active.
-/
theorem act_component_of_colip_threshold
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (K : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d target U K)
    {x x' : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hx' : x' ∈ U) (j : I)
    (hnot_id : j ∉ IdComponent d proxy U)
    (hstrict :
      (eps j + eps j) <
        matrix_vector_bound K (fun i => d i x x') j) :
    j ∈ ActComponent d proxy U := by
  refine ⟨hnot_id, ?_⟩
  exact not_const_component_of_positive_image_pair d proxy U j hx hx'
    (fiber_nonzero_of_colip_threshold d hd target proxy U eps K hfit hK hx hx' j hstrict)

/--
OET anchor: h-8a441271c942d299
**命题 #h-8a441271c942d299（域外偏差延拓界，点态版本）**
For any fitting-domain point `x ∈ U`, the off-domain error is bounded by the
weighted distance from `x'` to `x` plus the fitting tolerance.
-/
theorem domain_extension_error_point_bound
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U W : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (Lt Lp : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUW : U ⊆ W)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hLt : IsLipMatrix d target W Lt)
    (hLp : IsLipMatrix d proxy W Lp) :
    ∀ x' ∈ W, ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (target.func x') (proxy.func x') ≤
        matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lt i j + Lp i j) (fun i => d i x' x) j +
          eps j := by
  intro x' hxW x hxU j
  have hxW' : x ∈ W := hUW hxU
  have htri₁ :=
    (hd j).triangle (target.func x') (target.func x) (proxy.func x')
  have htri₂ :=
    (hd j).triangle (target.func x) (proxy.func x) (proxy.func x')
  have ht :
      d j (target.func x') (target.func x) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound Lt (fun i => d i x' x) j := by
    simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using hLt.2 x' hxW x hxW' j
  have hp :
      d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func x') ≤
        matrix_vector_bound Lp (fun i => d i x' x) j := by
    have hraw := hLp.2 x hxW' x' hxW j
    calc
      d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func x') ≤ ∑ i : I, Lp i j * d i x x' := hraw
      _ = matrix_vector_bound Lp (fun i => d i x' x) j := by
          unfold matrix_vector_bound
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [(hd i).symm x x']
  have heps : d j (target.func x) (proxy.func x) ≤ eps j :=
    hfit.error x hxU j (Set.mem_univ j)
  have hsum :
      matrix_vector_bound Lt (fun i => d i x' x) j +
        (eps j + matrix_vector_bound Lp (fun i => d i x' x) j) ≤
      matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lt i j + Lp i j) (fun i => d i x' x) j +
        eps j := by
    unfold matrix_vector_bound
    simp_rw [add_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp [add_comm, add_left_comm]
  calc
    d j (target.func x') (proxy.func x')
        ≤ d j (target.func x') (target.func x) +
          d j (target.func x) (proxy.func x') := htri₁
    _ ≤ d j (target.func x') (target.func x) +
          (d j (target.func x) (proxy.func x) +
            d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func x')) :=
        by
          simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
            add_le_add_left htri₂ (d j (target.func x') (target.func x))
    _ ≤ matrix_vector_bound Lt (fun i => d i x' x) j +
          (eps j + matrix_vector_bound Lp (fun i => d i x' x) j) :=
        add_le_add ht (add_le_add heps hp)
    _ ≤ matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lt i j + Lp i j) (fun i => d i x' x) j +
          eps j := hsum

/--
OET anchor: h-8a441271c942d299
**命题 #h-8a441271c942d299（域外偏差延拓界，正文前提版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining the nonempty fitting domain and finite-matrix
assumptions from the text.
-/
theorem domain_extension_error_point_bound_text
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U W : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (Lt Lp : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hU_nonempty : U.Nonempty)
    (hLt_finite : ∀ i j : I, Lt i j ≠ ⊤)
    (hLp_finite : ∀ i j : I, Lp i j ≠ ⊤)
    (hUW : U ⊆ W)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hLt : IsLipMatrix d target W Lt)
    (hLp : IsLipMatrix d proxy W Lp) :
    ∀ x' ∈ W, ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (target.func x') (proxy.func x') ≤
        matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lt i j + Lp i j) (fun i => d i x' x) j +
          eps j := by
  have _ := hU_nonempty
  have _ := hLt_finite
  have _ := hLp_finite
  exact domain_extension_error_point_bound d hd target proxy U W eps Lt Lp hUW hfit hLt hLp

/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由，域外距离上界点态版本）**
The proxy-pair off-domain distance is controlled by the sum of the two proxy
Lip matrices and the two fitting tolerances.
-/
theorem proxy_pair_domain_extension_point
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy_a proxy_b : Operator X bot) (U W : Set X)
    (eps_a eps_b : I → ENNReal) (La Lb : I → I → ENNReal)
    (hUW : U ⊆ W)
    (hfit_a : InFullFittingBall d target proxy_a U eps_a)
    (hfit_b : InFullFittingBall d target proxy_b U eps_b)
    (hLa : IsLipMatrix d proxy_a W La)
    (hLb : IsLipMatrix d proxy_b W Lb) :
    ∀ x' ∈ W, ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (proxy_a.func x') (proxy_b.func x') ≤
        matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => La i j + Lb i j) (fun i => d i x' x) j +
          (eps_a j + eps_b j) := by
  intro x' hxW x hxU j
  have hxW' : x ∈ W := hUW hxU
  have htri₁ :=
    (hd j).triangle (proxy_a.func x') (proxy_a.func x) (proxy_b.func x')
  have htri₂ :=
    (hd j).triangle (proxy_a.func x) (proxy_b.func x) (proxy_b.func x')
  have ha :
      d j (proxy_a.func x') (proxy_a.func x) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound La (fun i => d i x' x) j := by
    simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using hLa.2 x' hxW x hxW' j
  have hb :
      d j (proxy_b.func x) (proxy_b.func x') ≤
        matrix_vector_bound Lb (fun i => d i x' x) j := by
    have hraw := hLb.2 x hxW' x' hxW j
    calc
      d j (proxy_b.func x) (proxy_b.func x') ≤ ∑ i : I, Lb i j * d i x x' := hraw
      _ = matrix_vector_bound Lb (fun i => d i x' x) j := by
          unfold matrix_vector_bound
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [(hd i).symm x x']
  have hmid :
      d j (proxy_a.func x) (proxy_b.func x) ≤ eps_a j + eps_b j :=
    proxy_pair_cross_consistency d hd target proxy_a proxy_b U eps_a eps_b hfit_a hfit_b x hxU j
  have hsum :
      matrix_vector_bound La (fun i => d i x' x) j +
        ((eps_a j + eps_b j) + matrix_vector_bound Lb (fun i => d i x' x) j) ≤
      matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => La i j + Lb i j) (fun i => d i x' x) j +
        (eps_a j + eps_b j) := by
    unfold matrix_vector_bound
    simp_rw [add_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm]
  calc
    d j (proxy_a.func x') (proxy_b.func x')
        ≤ d j (proxy_a.func x') (proxy_a.func x) +
          d j (proxy_a.func x) (proxy_b.func x') := htri₁
    _ ≤ d j (proxy_a.func x') (proxy_a.func x) +
          (d j (proxy_a.func x) (proxy_b.func x) +
            d j (proxy_b.func x) (proxy_b.func x')) :=
        by
          simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
            add_le_add_left htri₂ (d j (proxy_a.func x') (proxy_a.func x))
    _ ≤ matrix_vector_bound La (fun i => d i x' x) j +
          ((eps_a j + eps_b j) + matrix_vector_bound Lb (fun i => d i x' x) j) :=
        add_le_add ha (add_le_add hmid hb)
    _ ≤ matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => La i j + Lb i j) (fun i => d i x' x) j +
          (eps_a j + eps_b j) := hsum

/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由，域外自由度）**
Overriding a proxy at a point outside `U` preserves its fitting-ball membership
on `U`.
-/
noncomputable def override_proxy_at
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (x' y : X) : Operator X bot := by
  classical
  exact
    { func := fun x => if x = bot then bot else if x = x' then y else proxy.func x
      preserves_bot := by simp }

/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由，域外指定点值）**
If the overridden point is not the absorbing element, the constructed proxy
takes the prescribed value there.
-/
theorem override_proxy_at_value
    (proxy : Operator X bot) {x' y : X} (hx'_ne_bot : x' ≠ bot) :
    (override_proxy_at proxy x' y).func x' = y := by
  classical
  unfold override_proxy_at
  simp [hx'_ne_bot]

/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由，域内限制不变）**
The override agrees with the original proxy throughout `U` when the modified
point is outside `U`.
-/
theorem override_proxy_at_eq_on_set
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) {x' y : X}
    (hx'_notU : x' ∉ U) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, (override_proxy_at proxy x' y).func x = proxy.func x := by
  classical
  intro x hx
  unfold override_proxy_at
  by_cases hbot : x = bot
  · simp [hbot, proxy.preserves_bot]
  · have hx_ne : x ≠ x' := by
      intro h
      exact hx'_notU (by simpa [h] using hx)
    simp [hbot, hx_ne]

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由，域外自由度）**
Changing the proxy at a point outside `U` does not affect fitting-ball
membership measured on `U`.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_outside_free_extension
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) {x' y : X}
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hx'_notU : x' ∉ U) :
    InFullFittingBall d target (override_proxy_at proxy x' y) U eps := by
  refine ⟨hfit.tolerance_finite, hfit.target_dom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    dsimp [dom]
    rw [override_proxy_at_eq_on_set proxy U hx'_notU x hx]
    exact hfit.proxy_dom hx
  · intro x hx j hj
    rw [override_proxy_at_eq_on_set proxy U hx'_notU x hx]
    exact hfit.error x hx j hj

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由，保定义域指定值）**
At a nonabsorbing point outside `U`, prescribing a nonabsorbing value preserves
fitting on `U` and keeps that point in the modified proxy domain.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_outside_free_value
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    {x' y : X}
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hx'_dom : x' ∈ dom proxy) (hx'_notU : x' ∉ U) (hy_ne_bot : y ≠ bot) :
    ∃ modified : Operator X bot,
      InFullFittingBall d target modified U eps ∧
      (∀ x ∈ U, modified.func x = proxy.func x) ∧
      x' ∈ dom modified ∧ modified.func x' = y := by
  classical
  have hx'_ne_bot : x' ≠ bot := by
    intro hx'_bot
    apply hx'_dom
    simpa [hx'_bot] using proxy.preserves_bot
  let modified := override_proxy_at proxy x' y
  have hvalue : modified.func x' = y := by
    exact override_proxy_at_value proxy hx'_ne_bot
  refine ⟨modified, ?_, ?_, ?_, hvalue⟩
  · exact fitting_ball_outside_free_extension d target proxy U eps hfit hx'_notU
  · exact override_proxy_at_eq_on_set proxy U hx'_notU
  · dsimp [dom]
    rw [hvalue]
    exact hy_ne_bot

omit [Fintype I] in
/--
OET anchor: h-96c357f03b81261a
**命题 #h-96c357f03b81261a（同目标代理对的域内外距离与补域自由，有限阈值无界）**
If every finite threshold is exceeded by a nonabsorbing prescribed value, then
every finite threshold is exceeded by a modified fitting proxy that remains
defined at `x'`.
-/
theorem fitting_ball_outside_distances_unbounded
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    {x' : X} (j : I)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d target proxy U eps)
    (hx'_dom : x' ∈ dom proxy) (hx'_notU : x' ∉ U)
    (hunbounded :
      ∀ M : ENNReal, M ≠ ⊤ →
        ∃ y : X, y ≠ bot ∧ M < d j (proxy.func x') y) :
    ∀ M : ENNReal, M ≠ ⊤ →
      ∃ modified : Operator X bot,
        InFullFittingBall d target modified U eps ∧
        (∀ x ∈ U, modified.func x = proxy.func x) ∧
        x' ∈ dom modified ∧ M < d j (proxy.func x') (modified.func x') := by
  intro M hM_finite
  rcases hunbounded M hM_finite with ⟨y, hy_ne_bot, hy_large⟩
  rcases fitting_ball_outside_free_value d target proxy U eps hfit
      hx'_dom hx'_notU hy_ne_bot with
    ⟨modified, hmodified_fit, hmodified_on_U, hx'_modified_dom, hvalue⟩
  exact ⟨modified, hmodified_fit, hmodified_on_U, hx'_modified_dom,
    by simpa [hvalue] using hy_large⟩

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks.network_profiles
import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.fitting_ball

namespace formal_oet.vol_02.ch_08_network_fitting

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations

variable {X I Net ProfileValue : Type} {bot : X}

/--
OET path: vol-02-deterministic-fitting/08-network-fitting.md
**定义（读出受控代理）**
The readout preorder comparison induced by one ordered network profile.
-/
def profile_le (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue)
    (proxy target : Net) : Prop :=
  Γ.le (Γ.read proxy) (Γ.read target)

/--
OET path: vol-02-deterministic-fitting/08-network-fitting.md
**定义（读出受控代理）**
The canonical strict part of the readout preorder.
-/
def profile_lt (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue)
    (proxy target : Net) : Prop :=
  profile_le Γ proxy target ∧ ¬ profile_le Γ target proxy

/--
OET anchor: h-b48eeff85d89e7fb
**命题（外延拟合的读出不敏感性）**
If two proxy exterior operators are pointwise indistinguishable on the
evaluation domain in every gauge component, then they have the same
full-gauge error-band membership with respect to the same target.
-/
theorem full_fitting_ball_iff_of_pointwise_zero
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ i : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d i))
    (target proxy₁ proxy₂ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (htarget_dom : U ⊆ dom target)
    (hproxy₁_dom : U ⊆ dom proxy₁)
    (hproxy₂_dom : U ⊆ dom proxy₂)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i : I, d i (proxy₁.func x) (proxy₂.func x) = 0) :
    InFullFittingBall d target proxy₁ U eps ↔
      InFullFittingBall d target proxy₂ U eps := by
  constructor
  · intro hfit
    refine ⟨hfit.tolerance_finite, htarget_dom, hproxy₂_dom, ?_⟩
    intro x hx i _
    have htri := (hd i).triangle
      (target.func x) (proxy₁.func x) (proxy₂.func x)
    calc
      d i (target.func x) (proxy₂.func x)
          ≤ d i (target.func x) (proxy₁.func x) +
            d i (proxy₁.func x) (proxy₂.func x) := htri
      _ = d i (target.func x) (proxy₁.func x) := by
        rw [hzero x hx i, add_zero]
      _ ≤ eps i := hfit.error x hx i (Set.mem_univ i)
  · intro hfit
    refine ⟨hfit.tolerance_finite, htarget_dom, hproxy₁_dom, ?_⟩
    intro x hx i _
    have htri :=
      (hd i).triangle (target.func x) (proxy₂.func x) (proxy₁.func x)
    have hz : d i (proxy₂.func x) (proxy₁.func x) = 0 := by
      rw [(hd i).symm (proxy₂.func x) (proxy₁.func x)]
      exact hzero x hx i
    calc
      d i (target.func x) (proxy₁.func x)
          ≤ d i (target.func x) (proxy₂.func x) +
            d i (proxy₂.func x) (proxy₁.func x) := htri
      _ = d i (target.func x) (proxy₂.func x) := by
        rw [hz, add_zero]
      _ ≤ eps i := hfit.error x hx i (Set.mem_univ i)

/--
OET path: vol-02-deterministic-fitting/08-network-fitting.md
**定义（读出受控代理）**
A profile-controlled proxy combines a full-gauge exterior error bound with
one ordered readout comparison on the same two network representations.
-/
structure ProfileControlledProxy
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (extensional : Net → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue) (target_net proxy_net : Net) :
    Prop where
  eps_ne_top : ∀ i : I, eps i ≠ ⊤
  target_dom : U ⊆ dom (extensional target_net)
  proxy_dom : U ⊆ dom (extensional proxy_net)
  error : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i : I,
    d i ((extensional proxy_net).func x) ((extensional target_net).func x) ≤ eps i
  profile_le : profile_le Γ proxy_net target_net

/--
OET path: vol-02-deterministic-fitting/08-network-fitting.md
**定义（读出受控代理）**
Strict profile control uses the canonical strict part of the selected readout
preorder.
-/
def StrictProfileControlledProxy
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (extensional : Net → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue) (target_net proxy_net : Net) :
    Prop :=
  ProfileControlledProxy d extensional U eps Γ target_net proxy_net ∧
    profile_lt Γ proxy_net target_net

/--
OET support: definition consequence of a readout-controlled proxy
A profile-controlled proxy belongs to the full-component fitting ball of the
target exterior operator.
-/
theorem profile_controlled_proxy_in_full_fitting_ball
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd_symm : ∀ i : I, ∀ x y : X, d i x y = d i y x)
    (extensional : Net → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue) (target_net proxy_net : Net)
    (hproxy : ProfileControlledProxy d extensional U eps Γ target_net proxy_net) :
    InFullFittingBall d (extensional target_net) (extensional proxy_net) U eps := by
  refine ⟨fun i _ => hproxy.eps_ne_top i, hproxy.target_dom, hproxy.proxy_dom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx i _
  simpa [hd_symm i ((extensional target_net).func x) ((extensional proxy_net).func x)]
    using hproxy.error x hx i

/--
OET support: definition consequence of a readout-controlled proxy
The representation-level conclusion is exactly the selected readout
comparison.
-/
theorem profile_controlled_proxy_profile_le
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (extensional : Net → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue) (target_net proxy_net : Net)
    (hproxy : ProfileControlledProxy d extensional U eps Γ target_net proxy_net) :
    profile_le Γ proxy_net target_net :=
  hproxy.profile_le

end formal_oet.vol_02.ch_08_network_fitting

import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.fitting_ball
import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds.lip_matrix
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.ENNReal.Real
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_02.ch_09_family_fitting

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

variable {X I β : Type} {bot : X}
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
variable [Fintype I] [Nonempty I] [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]

/--
OET anchor: h-16c45c5e0e60f572
**定义（活跃集）**
The active target indices at `x` relative to the ambient fitting domain `U`.
-/
def active_indices (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (x : X) : Set β :=
  { b | x ∈ U ∧ x ∈ dom (target b) }

/--
OET anchor: h-16c45c5e0e60f572
**定义（目标重数）**
The cardinality of the active target set at a point.
-/
noncomputable def target_multiplicity [Fintype β]
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (x : X) : Nat :=
  by
    classical
    exact (Finset.univ.filter fun b => b ∈ active_indices target U x).card

/--
OET anchor: h-16c45c5e0e60f572
**定义（有效族域）**
The points of `U` covered by at least one target operator.
-/
def effective_family_domain (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Set X :=
  { x | x ∈ U ∧ ∃ b : β, x ∈ dom (target b) }

/--
OET anchor: h-16c45c5e0e60f572
**定义（成对重叠域）**
The pairwise overlap domain of two target indices.
-/
def overlap_domain (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (a b : β) : Set X :=
  effective_family_domain target U ∩ dom (target a) ∩ dom (target b)

/--
OET anchor: h-16c45c5e0e60f572
**定义（成对分歧向量）**
The `j` component of the pairwise divergence vector.
-/
def pairwise_divergence
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (a b : β) (x : X) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  d j ((target a).func x) ((target b).func x)

/--
OET anchor: h-16c45c5e0e60f572
**定义（域级分歧上确界）**
The componentwise supremum of pairwise divergence on the overlap domain.
-/
noncomputable def domain_divergence
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (a b : β) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x : {x // x ∈ overlap_domain target U a b},
    pairwise_divergence d target a b x.1 j

/--
OET anchor: h-a9984fd2a088982a
**辅助定义（全族成对分歧上确界）**
The family-wide supremum of pairwise divergence used as a
selection-independent bound.
When there are no distinct pairs, the supremum over the empty subtype is `0`.
-/
noncomputable def family_pairwise_divergence_supremum
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ p : {p : β × β // p.1 ≠ p.2},
    domain_divergence d target U p.1.1 p.1.2 j

/--
OET anchor: h-68e510dbbcca4760
**定义（族成对分歧下界）**
One half of the supremal pairwise domain divergence.
-/
noncomputable def pairwise_tolerance_lower_bound
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  family_pairwise_divergence_supremum d target U j / 2

/--
OET anchor: h-16c45c5e0e60f572
**定义（联合拟合）**
Pointwise all-component form of joint fitting for a target family.
-/
structure JointFitting
    [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) : Prop where
  tolerance_finite : ∀ j : I, eps j ≠ ⊤
  proxy_dom : effective_family_domain target U ⊆ dom proxy
  error :
    ∀ x ∈ effective_family_domain target U, ∀ b : β,
      b ∈ active_indices target U x → ∀ j : I,
        d j ((target b).func x) (proxy.func x) ≤ eps j

/-- Joint fitting restricts monotonically when the evaluation domain shrinks. -/
theorem joint_fitting_mono_domain
    {target : β → Operator X bot} {proxy : Operator X bot}
    {U V : Set X} {eps : I → ENNReal}
    (hsub : V ⊆ U) (hfit : JointFitting d target proxy U eps) :
    JointFitting d target proxy V eps := by
  refine ⟨hfit.tolerance_finite, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact hfit.proxy_dom ⟨hsub hx.1, hx.2⟩
  · intro x hx b hb j
    exact hfit.error x ⟨hsub hx.1, hx.2⟩ b ⟨hsub hb.1, hb.2⟩ j

/-- Joint fitting is monotone when every component tolerance is enlarged. -/
theorem joint_fitting_mono_tolerance
    {target : β → Operator X bot} {proxy : Operator X bot}
    {U : Set X} {eps eta : I → ENNReal}
    (heta_finite : ∀ j : I, eta j ≠ ⊤)
    (hle : ∀ j : I, eps j ≤ eta j)
    (hfit : JointFitting d target proxy U eps) :
    JointFitting d target proxy U eta := by
  refine ⟨heta_finite, hfit.proxy_dom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx b hb j
  exact le_trans (hfit.error x hx b hb j) (hle j)

/--
OET anchor: h-5519d2d2e212fbd6
**定义（活跃目标指标集）**
The indices whose restricted target domain on `U` is nonempty.
-/
def active_target_indices (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) : Set β :=
  {b | (U ∩ dom (target b)).Nonempty}

/--
OET anchor: h-5519d2d2e212fbd6
**定义（目标拟合集）**
The active target indices fitted by a proxy on their restricted domains.
-/
def target_fit_set
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) : Set β :=
  {b | b ∈ active_target_indices target U ∧
    U ∩ dom (target b) ⊆ dom proxy ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U ∩ dom (target b), ∀ j : I,
      d j ((target b).func x) (proxy.func x) ≤ eps j}

/--
OET anchor: h-5519d2d2e212fbd6
**定义（目标遗漏集）**
The active target indices not fitted by the proxy.
-/
def target_miss_set
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) : Set β :=
  active_target_indices target U \ target_fit_set d target proxy U eps

/--
OET anchor: h-5519d2d2e212fbd6
**定义（可达目标拟合集族）**
The family of target-fit sets achieved by candidates in `A`.
-/
def reachable_target_fit_sets
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (A : Set (Operator X bot))
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) : Set (Set β) :=
  {S | ∃ proxy ∈ A, target_fit_set d target proxy U eps = S}

/--
OET anchor: h-5519d2d2e212fbd6
**定义（目标拟合前沿）**
The inclusion-maximal target-fit sets among the candidates.
-/
def target_fit_frontier
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (A : Set (Operator X bot))
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) : Set (Set β) :=
  {S | S ∈ reachable_target_fit_sets d target A U eps ∧
    ¬ ∃ T ∈ reachable_target_fit_sets d target A U eps, S ⊂ T}

/--
OET anchor: h-5519d2d2e212fbd6
**网络候选族的外延算子像**
Network representations enter the operator-candidate layer through the image
of their extensional-operator map. Equal extensional operators are therefore
the same member of this candidate set.
-/
def extensional_operator_candidates {Net : Type}
    (extensional_operator : Net → Operator X bot)
    (network_candidates : Set Net) : Set (Operator X bot) :=
  extensional_operator '' network_candidates

theorem active_target_indices_iff_effective_member
    {target : β → Operator X bot} {U : Set X} {b : β} :
    b ∈ active_target_indices target U ↔
      ∃ x, x ∈ effective_family_domain target U ∧
        b ∈ active_indices target U x := by
  constructor
  · intro hb
    rcases hb with ⟨x, hxU, hxdom⟩
    exact ⟨x, ⟨hxU, b, hxdom⟩, ⟨hxU, hxdom⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, _, hxactive⟩
    exact ⟨x, hxactive.1, hxactive.2⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34
**命题 #h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34（目标拟合集的基本性质）**
A proxy jointly fits the family exactly when its target-fit set is the full
active target-index set.
-/
theorem joint_fitting_iff_target_fit_set_eq_active
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (heps : ∀ j : I, eps j ≠ ⊤) :
    JointFitting d target proxy U eps ↔
      target_fit_set d target proxy U eps = active_target_indices target U := by
  constructor
  · intro hfit
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro b hb
      exact hb.1
    · intro b hb
      refine ⟨hb, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        exact hfit.proxy_dom ⟨hx.1, b, hx.2⟩
      · intro x hx j
        exact hfit.error x ⟨hx.1, b, hx.2⟩ b ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩ j
  · intro heq
    refine ⟨heps, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨hxU, b, hxdom⟩
      have hbfit : b ∈ target_fit_set d target proxy U eps := by
        rw [heq]
        exact ⟨x, hxU, hxdom⟩
      exact hbfit.2.1 ⟨hxU, hxdom⟩
    · intro x hx b hb j
      have hbfit : b ∈ target_fit_set d target proxy U eps := by
        rw [heq]
        exact ⟨x, hb.1, hb.2⟩
      exact hbfit.2.2 x ⟨hb.1, hb.2⟩ j

/--
OET anchor: h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34
**命题 #h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34（候选族中的联合拟合判据）**
Some candidate jointly fits the target family iff the full active target-index
set is reachable as a target-fit set.
-/
theorem candidate_joint_fitting_iff_active_fit_set_reachable
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (A : Set (Operator X bot))
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (heps : ∀ j : I, eps j ≠ ⊤) :
    (∃ proxy ∈ A, JointFitting d target proxy U eps) ↔
      active_target_indices target U ∈
        reachable_target_fit_sets d target A U eps := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨proxy, hproxyA, hfit⟩
    exact ⟨proxy, hproxyA,
      (joint_fitting_iff_target_fit_set_eq_active d target proxy U eps heps).mp hfit⟩
  · rintro ⟨proxy, hproxyA, hfitset⟩
    exact ⟨proxy, hproxyA,
      (joint_fitting_iff_target_fit_set_eq_active d target proxy U eps heps).mpr hfitset⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34
**命题 #h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34（无联合拟合时遗漏非空）**
If the full active target-index set is not reachable and the active set is
nonempty, every candidate misses at least one active target.
-/
theorem target_miss_set_nonempty_of_active_unreachable
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (A : Set (Operator X bot))
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (hunreachable :
      active_target_indices target U ∉
        reachable_target_fit_sets d target A U eps)
    (hactive : (active_target_indices target U).Nonempty) :
    ∀ proxy ∈ A, (target_miss_set d target proxy U eps).Nonempty := by
  have _ := hactive
  intro proxy hproxyA
  by_contra hnone
  have hsubset :
      active_target_indices target U ⊆ target_fit_set d target proxy U eps := by
    intro b hb
    by_contra hbfit
    exact hnone ⟨b, hb, hbfit⟩
  have heq : target_fit_set d target proxy U eps = active_target_indices target U := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro b hb
      exact hb.1
    · exact hsubset
  exact hunreachable ⟨proxy, hproxyA, heq⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34
**命题（目标拟合集的基本性质，前沿扩张）**
Every reachable target-fit set is contained in a reachable inclusion-maximal
target-fit set.
-/
theorem reachable_fit_set_subset_frontier
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (A : Set (Operator X bot))
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    {S : Set β}
    (hS : S ∈ reachable_target_fit_sets d target A U eps) :
    ∃ T ∈ target_fit_frontier d target A U eps, S ⊆ T := by
  classical
  let candidates : Set (Set β) :=
    {T | T ∈ reachable_target_fit_sets d target A U eps ∧ S ⊆ T}
  have hcandidates_nonempty : candidates.Nonempty := by
    exact ⟨S, hS, Set.Subset.rfl⟩
  have hcandidates_finite : candidates.Finite := Set.toFinite candidates
  rcases hcandidates_finite.exists_maximal hcandidates_nonempty with
    ⟨T, hT, hmax⟩
  refine ⟨T, ?_, hT.2⟩
  refine ⟨hT.1, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨T', hT'reach, hstrict⟩
  have hT'_candidate : T' ∈ candidates :=
    ⟨hT'reach, Set.Subset.trans hT.2 hstrict.1⟩
  have hreverse : T' ⊆ T := hmax hT'_candidate hstrict.1
  exact hstrict.2 hreverse

/--
OET anchor: h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34
**命题（目标拟合集的基本性质，前沿非空）**
A nonempty candidate family has a nonempty target-fit frontier.
-/
theorem target_fit_frontier_nonempty
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (A : Set (Operator X bot))
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    (target_fit_frontier d target A U eps).Nonempty := by
  rcases hA with ⟨proxy, hproxy⟩
  have hreachable :
      target_fit_set d target proxy U eps ∈
        reachable_target_fit_sets d target A U eps :=
    ⟨proxy, hproxy, rfl⟩
  rcases reachable_fit_set_subset_frontier d target A U eps hreachable with
    ⟨T, hT, _⟩
  exact ⟨T, hT⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-e7c195c2a7ca7d34
**命题（目标拟合集的基本性质，前沿反链）**
Two frontier members related by inclusion are equal.
-/
theorem target_fit_frontier_eq_of_subset
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (A : Set (Operator X bot))
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    {S T : Set β}
    (hS : S ∈ target_fit_frontier d target A U eps)
    (hT : T ∈ target_fit_frontier d target A U eps)
    (hsub : S ⊆ T) :
    S = T := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm hsub
  by_contra hnot
  have hstrict : S ⊂ T := ⟨hsub, hnot⟩
  exact hS.2 ⟨T, hT.1, hstrict⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-904b1a51d72852bd
**命题 #h-904b1a51d72852bd（联合拟合的逐点交会判据）**
The local feasible cell at `x` is the intersection of all active target balls.
-/
def local_joint_feasible_cell
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (x : X) :
    Set X :=
  { y | ∀ b : β, b ∈ active_indices target U x → ∀ j : I,
      d j ((target b).func x) y ≤ eps j }

/--
OET anchor: h-904b1a51d72852bd
**命题 #h-904b1a51d72852bd（联合拟合的逐点交会判据）**
A joint proxy exists exactly when every effective point admits a non-bottom
choice in its local feasible cell.
-/
theorem joint_fitting_pointwise_intersection_criterion
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (heps : ∀ j : I, eps j ≠ ⊤) :
    (∃ proxy : Operator X bot, JointFitting d target proxy U eps) ↔
      ∃ s : {x // x ∈ effective_family_domain target U} → X,
        ∀ x : {x // x ∈ effective_family_domain target U},
          s x ∈ local_joint_feasible_cell d target U eps x.1 := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨proxy, hfit⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => proxy.func x.1, ?_⟩
    intro x b hb j
    exact hfit.error x.1 x.2 b hb j
  · rintro ⟨s, hs_cell⟩
    have hs_dom : ∀ x : {x // x ∈ effective_family_domain target U}, s x ≠ bot := by
      intro x hsbot
      rcases x.2 with ⟨hxU, b, hbdom⟩
      let j : I := Classical.choice inferInstance
      have hcell := hs_cell x b ⟨hxU, hbdom⟩ j
      have htop : d j ((target b).func x.1) bot = ⊤ :=
        (hd j).isolate_bot ((target b).func x.1) hbdom
      rw [hsbot, htop] at hcell
      exact heps j (top_unique hcell)
    let proxy : Operator X bot :=
      { func := fun x =>
          if hx : x ∈ effective_family_domain target U then s ⟨x, hx⟩ else bot
        preserves_bot := by
          have hbot_not : bot ∉ effective_family_domain target U := by
            intro hbot
            rcases hbot with ⟨_, b, hbdom⟩
            exact hbdom (target b).preserves_bot
          simp [hbot_not] }
    refine ⟨proxy, ?_⟩
    refine ⟨heps, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      dsimp [proxy, dom]
      simpa only [dif_pos hx] using hs_dom ⟨x, hx⟩
    · intro x hx b hb j
      dsimp [proxy]
      simpa only [dif_pos hx] using hs_cell ⟨x, hx⟩ b hb j

/-- Internal local-cell monotonicity helper. -/
theorem local_joint_feasible_cell_extension_mono
    (target_old target_new : β → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (x y : X)
    (hactive :
      ∀ b : β, b ∈ active_indices target_old U x →
        b ∈ active_indices target_new U x)
    (hagrees :
      ∀ b : β, b ∈ active_indices target_old U x →
        (target_new b).func x = (target_old b).func x)
    (hy : y ∈ local_joint_feasible_cell d target_new U eps x) :
    y ∈ local_joint_feasible_cell d target_old U eps x := by
  intro b hb j
  have hnew := hy b (hactive b hb) j
  simpa [hagrees b hb] using hnew

/-- Internal same-index family-extension helper. -/
theorem family_extension_constraint_monotonicity
    (target_old target_new : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (heff :
      effective_family_domain target_old U ⊆ effective_family_domain target_new U)
    (hactive :
      ∀ x ∈ effective_family_domain target_old U, ∀ b : β,
        b ∈ active_indices target_old U x →
          b ∈ active_indices target_new U x)
