      (d j ((target a).func x) ((target a).func y)).toReal ≤
        (d j ((target b).func x) ((target b).func y)).toReal +
          2 * delta.toReal := by
    have hsum_finite :
        d j ((target b).func x) ((target b).func y) + (delta + delta) ≠ ⊤ :=
      ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨hb_finite, htwo_finite⟩
    have := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal ha_finite hsum_finite).2 hab_bound
    simpa [ENNReal.toReal_add, hb_finite, hdelta_finite, two_mul] using this
  have hba_real :
      (d j ((target b).func x) ((target b).func y)).toReal ≤
        (d j ((target a).func x) ((target a).func y)).toReal +
          2 * delta.toReal := by
    have hsum_finite :
        d j ((target a).func x) ((target a).func y) + (delta + delta) ≠ ⊤ :=
      ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨ha_finite, htwo_finite⟩
    have := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hb_finite hsum_finite).2 hba_bound
    simpa [ENNReal.toReal_add, ha_finite, hdelta_finite, two_mul] using this
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

/--
OET anchor: h-e158434843cf7652
**定义（选择归约算子）**
The target operator selected pointwise by an admissible choice map.
-/
noncomputable def selection_reduced_operator
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (sigma : X → β) :
    Operator X bot :=
  by
    classical
    exact
      { func := fun x =>
          if hx : x ∈ effective_family_domain target U then
            (target (sigma x)).func x
          else
            bot
        preserves_bot := by
          by_cases hbot : bot ∈ effective_family_domain target U
          · simp [hbot, (target (sigma bot)).preserves_bot]
          · simp [hbot] }

lemma selection_reduced_operator_eq_of_mem
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (sigma : X → β)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ effective_family_domain target U) :
    (selection_reduced_operator target U sigma).func x = (target (sigma x)).func x := by
  classical
  simp [selection_reduced_operator, hx]

lemma selection_reduced_operator_dom
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (sigma : X → β)
    (hsigma :
      ∀ x ∈ effective_family_domain target U,
        sigma x ∈ active_indices target U x) :
    effective_family_domain target U ⊆ dom (selection_reduced_operator target U sigma) := by
  intro x hx
  have hs := hsigma x hx
  have hdom : x ∈ dom (target (sigma x)) := hs.2
  simpa [dom, selection_reduced_operator_eq_of_mem target U sigma hx] using hdom

/--
OET anchor: h-a9984fd2a088982a
**命题（选择归约拟合的反向偏差界，选择偏差）**
The worst distance from the selected target value to any active target value
at the same effective input.
-/
noncomputable def selection_divergence
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (sigma : X → β) (j : I) :
    ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x : {x // x ∈ effective_family_domain target U},
    ⨆ b : {b // b ∈ active_indices target U x.1},
      d j ((target b.1).func x.1) ((target (sigma x.1)).func x.1)

lemma active_pair_divergence_le_selection_divergence
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (sigma : X → β)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ effective_family_domain target U)
    {b : β} (hb : b ∈ active_indices target U x) (j : I) :
    d j ((target b).func x) ((target (sigma x)).func x) ≤
      selection_divergence d target U sigma j := by
  unfold selection_divergence
  exact le_trans
    (le_iSup (fun c : {c // c ∈ active_indices target U x} =>
      d j ((target c.1).func x) ((target (sigma x)).func x)) ⟨b, hb⟩)
    (le_iSup (fun z : {z // z ∈ effective_family_domain target U} =>
      ⨆ c : {c // c ∈ active_indices target U z.1},
        d j ((target c.1).func z.1) ((target (sigma z.1)).func z.1)) ⟨x, hx⟩)

/-- The selection-dependent divergence is bounded by the family-wide supremum. -/
theorem selection_divergence_le_family_pairwise_divergence_supremum
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (sigma : X → β)
    (hsigma :
      ∀ x ∈ effective_family_domain target U,
        sigma x ∈ active_indices target U x) (j : I) :
    selection_divergence d target U sigma j ≤
      family_pairwise_divergence_supremum d target U j := by
  unfold selection_divergence
  apply iSup_le
  intro x
  apply iSup_le
  intro b
  by_cases hsame : b.1 = sigma x.1
  · rw [hsame, (hd j).dist_self]
    exact zero_le _
  · have hoverlap : x.1 ∈ overlap_domain target U b.1 (sigma x.1) :=
      ⟨⟨x.2, b.2.2⟩, (hsigma x.1 x.2).2⟩
    have hdomain :
        d j ((target b.1).func x.1) ((target (sigma x.1)).func x.1) ≤
          domain_divergence d target U b.1 (sigma x.1) j := by
      simpa [domain_divergence, pairwise_divergence] using
        (le_iSup
          (fun y : {z // z ∈ overlap_domain target U b.1 (sigma x.1)} =>
            pairwise_divergence d target b.1 (sigma x.1) y.1 j)
          ⟨x.1, hoverlap⟩)
    exact le_trans hdomain
      (le_iSup
        (fun p : {p : β × β // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
          domain_divergence d target U p.1.1 p.1.2 j)
        ⟨(b.1, sigma x.1), hsame⟩)

/--
OET anchor: h-b70a7ff2afc725d2
**引理（联合拟合蕴含选择归约拟合）**
Any joint fitting proxy fits every selection reduction with the same tolerance.
-/
theorem joint_fitting_to_selection_reduced_fitting
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (sigma : X → β)
    (hsigma :
      ∀ x ∈ effective_family_domain target U,
        sigma x ∈ active_indices target U x)
    (hfit : JointFitting d target proxy U eps) :
    InFullFittingBall d (selection_reduced_operator target U sigma) proxy
      (effective_family_domain target U) eps := by
  refine ⟨fun j _ => hfit.tolerance_finite j,
    selection_reduced_operator_dom target U sigma hsigma, hfit.proxy_dom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx j _
  rw [selection_reduced_operator_eq_of_mem target U sigma hx]
  exact hfit.error x hx (sigma x) (hsigma x hx) j

/--
OET anchor: h-a9984fd2a088982a
**命题（选择归约拟合的反向偏差界，点态界）**
Selection-reduced fitting gives the joint pointwise bound after adding the
selection-dependent divergence.
-/
theorem selection_reduced_fitting_to_joint_pointwise_bound
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (sigma : X → β)
    (hfit :
      InFullFittingBall d (selection_reduced_operator target U sigma) proxy
        (effective_family_domain target U) eps) :
    ∀ x ∈ effective_family_domain target U, ∀ b : β,
      b ∈ active_indices target U x → ∀ j : I,
        d j ((target b).func x) (proxy.func x) ≤
          eps j + selection_divergence d target U sigma j := by
  intro x hx b hb j
  have hmerge :
      (selection_reduced_operator target U sigma).func x = (target (sigma x)).func x :=
    selection_reduced_operator_eq_of_mem target U sigma hx
  have hfit_x :
      d j ((target (sigma x)).func x) (proxy.func x) ≤ eps j := by
    simpa [hmerge] using hfit.error x hx j (Set.mem_univ j)
  have hpair :=
    active_pair_divergence_le_selection_divergence
      d target U sigma hx hb j
  calc
    d j ((target b).func x) (proxy.func x)
        ≤ d j ((target b).func x) ((target (sigma x)).func x) +
          d j ((target (sigma x)).func x) (proxy.func x) :=
      (hd j).triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ selection_divergence d target U sigma j + eps j :=
      add_le_add hpair hfit_x
    _ = eps j + selection_divergence d target U sigma j := by rw [add_comm]

/--
OET anchor: h-a9984fd2a088982a
**命题（选择归约拟合的反向偏差界）**
A finite selection-dependent divergence gives a genuine joint fitting
tolerance vector.
-/
theorem selection_reduced_fitting_to_joint_fitting
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (sigma : X → β)
    (hsigma :
      ∀ x ∈ effective_family_domain target U,
        sigma x ∈ active_indices target U x)
    (heps : ∀ j : I, eps j ≠ ⊤)
    (hdivergence : ∀ j : I, selection_divergence d target U sigma j ≠ ⊤)
    (hfit :
      InFullFittingBall d (selection_reduced_operator target U sigma) proxy
        (effective_family_domain target U) eps) :
    JointFitting d target proxy U
      (fun j => eps j + selection_divergence d target U sigma j) := by
  let hfit' :
      InFullFittingBall d (selection_reduced_operator target U sigma) proxy
        (effective_family_domain target U) eps :=
    { hfit with
      target_dom := selection_reduced_operator_dom target U sigma hsigma }
  refine ⟨?_, hfit.proxy_dom, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    exact ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨heps j, hdivergence j⟩
  · exact selection_reduced_fitting_to_joint_pointwise_bound
      d hd target proxy U eps sigma hfit'

/--
OET anchor: h-a9984fd2a088982a
**命题（选择归约拟合的反向偏差界，delta-近族）**
For a delta-near family with `delta ≠ ⊤`, selection-reduced fitting within
`eps` gives joint fitting within the finite tolerance `eps + delta`.
-/
theorem selection_reduced_fitting_to_joint_fitting_of_delta_near
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (delta : ENNReal)
    (sigma : X → β)
    (hsigma :
      ∀ x ∈ effective_family_domain target U,
        sigma x ∈ active_indices target U x)
    (heps : ∀ j : I, eps j ≠ ⊤)
    (hdelta : delta ≠ ⊤)
    (hnear : DeltaNearFamily d target U delta)
    (hfit :
      InFullFittingBall d (selection_reduced_operator target U sigma) proxy
        (effective_family_domain target U) eps) :
    JointFitting d target proxy U (fun j => eps j + delta) := by
  refine ⟨fun j => ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨heps j, hdelta⟩, hfit.proxy_dom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx b hb j
  have hpoint :=
    selection_reduced_fitting_to_joint_pointwise_bound
      d hd target proxy U eps sigma hfit x hx b hb j
  exact le_trans hpoint
    (add_le_add le_rfl
      (le_trans
        (selection_divergence_le_family_pairwise_divergence_supremum
          d hd target U sigma hsigma j)
        (family_pairwise_divergence_supremum_le_of_delta_near d target U delta hnear j)))

/-- Internal co-Lip separation helper for downstream composition results. -/
theorem colip_amplified_divergence_unfittable
    [Fintype I]
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (omega target_a target_b proxy : Operator X bot)
    (V : Set X) (K : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (hK : IsCoLipMatrix d omega V K)
    {x : X} {j : I}
    (haV : target_a.func x ∈ V)
    (hbV : target_b.func x ∈ V)
    (hpV : proxy.func x ∈ V)
    (hfit_a :
      d j (omega.func (target_a.func x)) (omega.func (proxy.func x)) ≤ eps j)
    (hfit_b :
      d j (omega.func (target_b.func x)) (omega.func (proxy.func x)) ≤ eps j)
    (hamp :
      (∑ i : I, K i j * d i (target_a.func x) (target_b.func x)) >
        eps j + eps j) :
    False := by
  have _ := hpV
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle (omega.func (target_a.func x)) (omega.func (proxy.func x))
      (omega.func (target_b.func x))
  have hfit_b_symm :
      d j (omega.func (proxy.func x)) (omega.func (target_b.func x)) ≤ eps j := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm (omega.func (proxy.func x)) (omega.func (target_b.func x))]
      using hfit_b
  have hupper :
      d j (omega.func (target_a.func x)) (omega.func (target_b.func x)) ≤
        eps j + eps j :=
    le_trans htri (add_le_add hfit_a hfit_b_symm)
  have hlower :
      (∑ i : I, K i j * d i (target_a.func x) (target_b.func x)) ≤
        d j (omega.func (target_a.func x)) (omega.func (target_b.func x)) :=
    hK.2.2 (target_a.func x) haV (target_b.func x) hbV j
  exact not_lt_of_ge (le_trans hlower hupper) hamp

/-- Internal zero-fiber helper for downstream composition results. -/
theorem zeroized_pair_same_fiber_dichotomy
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (omega : Operator X bot) {ya yb y : X} {j : I}
    (hzero : d j (omega.func ya) (omega.func yb) = 0) :
    (d j (omega.func ya) (omega.func y) = 0 ∧
      d j (omega.func yb) (omega.func y) = 0) ∨
    (0 < d j (omega.func ya) (omega.func y) ∨
      0 < d j (omega.func yb) (omega.func y)) := by
  by_cases ha : d j (omega.func ya) (omega.func y) = 0
  · left
    refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
    have htri :=
      (hd j).triangle (omega.func yb) (omega.func ya) (omega.func y)
    have hsymm_zero : d j (omega.func yb) (omega.func ya) = 0 := by
      simpa [(hd j).symm (omega.func yb) (omega.func ya)] using hzero
    have hle : d j (omega.func yb) (omega.func y) ≤ 0 := by
      simpa [hsymm_zero, ha] using htri
    exact le_antisymm hle (zero_le _)
  · right
    left
    exact pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha

end

import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.single_step_bounds

import formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus.spectral_regimes
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_02.ch_10_composition_fitting

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_03_operator_local_degeneracy
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_09_family_fitting

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I β : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]
variable (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

/--
Internal single-target common pre/post data used to formalize the target-family
common external context. The corresponding single-target fitting certificate is
handled in §7, not as a separate §10 item.
-/
structure CommonPrePostData
    (psi phi eta chi : Operator X bot) (A U V : Set X) : Prop where
  eta_dom : A ⊆ dom eta
  eta_mem : ∀ x ∈ A, eta.func x ∈ U
  psi_dom : U ⊆ dom psi
  phi_dom : U ⊆ dom phi
  psi_image_mem : ∀ x ∈ A, psi.func (eta.func x) ∈ V
  phi_image_mem : ∀ x ∈ A, phi.func (eta.func x) ∈ V
  chi_dom : V ⊆ dom chi

/--
Internal helper: a single-target fitting bound propagates through a common
pre-composition and a common post-composition with a valid Lip matrix.
-/
theorem common_external_composition_upper_certificate
    (psi phi eta chi : Operator X bot) (A U V : Set X)
    (eps : I → ENNReal) (Lχ : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx : CommonPrePostData psi phi eta chi A U V)
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d psi phi U eps)
    (hLχ : IsLipMatrix d chi V Lχ) :
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ j : I,
      d j (chi.func (psi.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x))) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound Lχ eps j := by
  intro x hx j
  exact common_pre_post_composition_local_upper_bound d eta chi psi phi A U V
    eps Lχ ctx.eta_dom ctx.eta_mem
    (fun u hu i => hfit.error u hu i (Set.mem_univ i))
    (fun y hy => ⟨ctx.psi_image_mem y hy, ctx.phi_image_mem y hy⟩)
    hLχ x hx j

/--
Internal helper: a post-composition co-Lip lower bound exceeding twice the
requested tolerance prevents one proxy from fitting two post-composed targets
at the same point.
-/
private theorem common_external_composition_separation_incompatible
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (psi₁ psi₂ phi eta chi : Operator X bot) (A U V : Set X)
    (Kχ : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx₁ : CommonPrePostData psi₁ phi eta chi A U V)
    (ctx₂ : CommonPrePostData psi₂ phi eta chi A U V)
    (hKχ : IsCoLipMatrix d chi V Kχ)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ A) (j : I) (tau : ENNReal)
    (hstrict :
      tau + tau <
        matrix_vector_bound Kχ
          (fun i => d i (psi₁.func (eta.func x)) (psi₂.func (eta.func x))) j) :
    ¬ (d j (chi.func (psi₁.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x))) ≤ tau ∧
        d j (chi.func (psi₂.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x))) ≤ tau) := by
  intro hboth
  have hright :
      d j (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (psi₂.func (eta.func x))) ≤ tau := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm
      (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x)))
      (chi.func (psi₂.func (eta.func x)))] using hboth.2
  have htri :
      d j (chi.func (psi₁.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (psi₂.func (eta.func x))) ≤ tau + tau := by
    exact le_trans
      ((hd j).triangle
        (chi.func (psi₁.func (eta.func x)))
        (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x)))
        (chi.func (psi₂.func (eta.func x))))
      (add_le_add hboth.1 hright)
  have hlower :
      matrix_vector_bound Kχ
          (fun i => d i (psi₁.func (eta.func x)) (psi₂.func (eta.func x))) j ≤
        d j (chi.func (psi₁.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (psi₂.func (eta.func x))) := by
    simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using
      hKχ.2.2
        (psi₁.func (eta.func x)) (ctx₁.psi_image_mem x hx)
        (psi₂.func (eta.func x)) (ctx₂.psi_image_mem x hx) j
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (le_trans hlower htri)) hstrict

/--
OET anchor: h-f0b77b4693ca1b12
**定义（目标族的共同外部复合语境）**
Common pre/post data for every target in a target family.
-/
structure FamilyCommonExternalContext
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (phi eta chi : Operator X bot)
    (A U V : Set X) : Prop where
  data : ∀ b : β, CommonPrePostData (target b) phi eta chi A U V

/--
OET anchor: h-006158670576669f
**推论 #h-006158670576669f（目标族共同外部复合的上界证书）**
Joint fitting of a target family propagates through a common external
composition by the post-composition Lip matrix.
-/
theorem family_common_external_upper_certificate
    [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (phi eta chi : Operator X bot)
    (A U V : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (Lχ : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx : FamilyCommonExternalContext target phi eta chi A U V)
    (hfit : JointFitting d target phi U eps)
    (hLχ : IsLipMatrix d chi V Lχ) :
    ∀ b : β, ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ j : I,
      d j (chi.func ((target b).func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x))) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound Lχ eps j := by
  intro b x hx j
  have hsingle : InFullFittingBall d (target b) phi U eps := by
    refine ⟨fun i _ => hfit.tolerance_finite i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      exact (ctx.data b).psi_dom hy
    · intro y hy
      exact (ctx.data b).phi_dom hy
    · intro y hy i _
      exact hfit.error y ⟨hy, b, (ctx.data b).psi_dom hy⟩ b
        ⟨hy, (ctx.data b).psi_dom hy⟩ i
  exact common_external_composition_upper_certificate d
    (target b) phi eta chi A U V eps Lχ (ctx.data b) hsingle hLχ x hx j

/--
OET anchor: h-fbfa3512b4c1ffb9
**推论 #h-fbfa3512b4c1ffb9（目标族共同外部复合的分离不相容）**
The two-target incompatibility certificate applies to any two selected
targets in the family context.
-/
theorem family_common_external_separation_incompatible
    [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (phi eta chi : Operator X bot)
    (A U V : Set X) (Kχ : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx : FamilyCommonExternalContext target phi eta chi A U V)
    (hKχ : IsCoLipMatrix d chi V Kχ)
    {a b : β} (hne : a ≠ b) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ A)
    (j : I) (tau : ENNReal)
    (hstrict :
      tau + tau <
        matrix_vector_bound Kχ
          (fun i => d i ((target a).func (eta.func x))
            ((target b).func (eta.func x))) j) :
    ¬ (d j (chi.func ((target a).func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x))) ≤ tau ∧
        d j (chi.func ((target b).func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (phi.func (eta.func x))) ≤ tau) := by
  have _ := hne
  exact common_external_composition_separation_incompatible d hd
    (target a) (target b) phi eta chi A U V Kχ
    (ctx.data a) (ctx.data b) hKχ hx j tau hstrict

/--

**推论 #h-006158670576669f（目标族共同外部复合的代理闭球形式）**
The pointwise upper certificate assembles into the exact jointly fitted
post-composed target family when its propagated tolerance is finite.
-/
theorem family_common_external_joint_fitting
    [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (phi eta chi : Operator X bot)
    (A U V : Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) (Lchi : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx : FamilyCommonExternalContext target phi eta chi A U V)
    (hfit : JointFitting d target phi U eps)
    (hLchi : IsLipMatrix d chi V Lchi)
    (hfinite : ∀ j : I, matrix_vector_bound Lchi eps j ≠ ⊤) :
    JointFitting d
      (fun b => OperatorChain [chi, target b, eta])
      (OperatorChain [chi, phi, eta]) A
      (matrix_vector_bound Lchi eps) := by
  refine ⟨hfinite, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    rcases hx.2 with ⟨b, _⟩
    have hnonbot := (ctx.data b).chi_dom ((ctx.data b).phi_image_mem x hx.1)
    simpa [dom, OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using hnonbot
  · intro x hx b hb j
    have hbound := family_common_external_upper_certificate d
      target phi eta chi A U V eps Lchi ctx hfit hLchi b x hx.1 j
    simpa [OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using hbound

/--
OET anchor: h-fbfa3512b4c1ffb9
**推论 #h-fbfa3512b4c1ffb9（共同外部复合后的联合拟合不相容）**
The strict post-composed pair separation excludes the corresponding joint
fitting certificate on `A`.
-/
theorem family_common_external_not_joint_fitting
    [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (phi eta chi : Operator X bot)
    (A U V : Set X) (Kchi : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx : FamilyCommonExternalContext target phi eta chi A U V)
    (hKchi : IsCoLipMatrix d chi V Kchi)
    {a b : β} (hne : a ≠ b) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ A)
    (j : I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hstrict : tau j + tau j <
      matrix_vector_bound Kchi
        (fun i => d i ((target a).func (eta.func x))
          ((target b).func (eta.func x))) j) :
    ¬ JointFitting d
      (fun c => OperatorChain [chi, target c, eta])
      (OperatorChain [chi, phi, eta]) A tau := by
  intro hall
  have hpair := family_common_external_separation_incompatible d hd
    target phi eta chi A U V Kchi ctx hKchi hne hx j (tau j) hstrict
  apply hpair
  constructor
  · have hdom_a : x ∈ dom (OperatorChain [chi, target a, eta]) := by
      have hnonbot := (ctx.data a).chi_dom ((ctx.data a).psi_image_mem x hx)
      simpa [dom, OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using hnonbot
    have heff : x ∈ effective_family_domain
        (fun c => OperatorChain [chi, target c, eta]) A := ⟨hx, a, hdom_a⟩
    have hactive : a ∈ active_indices
        (fun c => OperatorChain [chi, target c, eta]) A x := by
      exact ⟨hx, hdom_a⟩
    simpa [OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using hall.error x heff a hactive j
  · have hdom_b : x ∈ dom (OperatorChain [chi, target b, eta]) := by
      have hnonbot := (ctx.data b).chi_dom ((ctx.data b).psi_image_mem x hx)
      simpa [dom, OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using hnonbot
    have heff : x ∈ effective_family_domain
        (fun c => OperatorChain [chi, target c, eta]) A := ⟨hx, b, hdom_b⟩
    have hactive : b ∈ active_indices
        (fun c => OperatorChain [chi, target c, eta]) A x := by
      exact ⟨hx, hdom_b⟩
    simpa [OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using hall.error x heff b hactive j

/--
OET anchor: h-f09503fad2aac2e8
**推论 #h-f09503fad2aac2e8（后接零化半径对成对分歧的截断）**
A pair below the uniform annihilation radius is identified in the requested
output component after post-composition.
-/
theorem postcomposition_annihilation_radius_pair_zero
    [DecidableEq I]
    (chi : Operator X bot) (V : Set X) (y₁ y₂ : X) (i j : I)
    (hy₁ : y₁ ∈ V) (hy₂ : y₂ ∈ V)
    (hbelow : d i y₁ y₂ <
      min_annihilation_radius d chi i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) V) :
    d j (chi.func y₁) (chi.func y₂) = 0 := by
  exact zeroing_step_of_min_annihilation_radius d chi V i j
    (min_annihilation_radius d chi i (singleton_nonempty_finset j) V)
    le_rfl hy₁ hy₂ hbelow

/--
OET source: vol-02-deterministic-fitting/10-composition-fitting.md
**定义（共同前后接链数据）**
The terminal chain values after the common pre-composition lie in the common
post-composition domain.
-/
structure CommonPrePostChainData
    (target_chain proxy_chain eta chi : Operator X bot) (A V : Set X) :
    Prop where
  eta_dom : A ⊆ dom eta
  target_chain_dom : ∀ x ∈ A, eta.func x ∈ dom target_chain
  proxy_chain_dom : ∀ x ∈ A, eta.func x ∈ dom proxy_chain
  target_terminal_mem : ∀ x ∈ A, target_chain.func (eta.func x) ∈ V
  proxy_terminal_mem : ∀ x ∈ A, proxy_chain.func (eta.func x) ∈ V
  chi_dom : V ⊆ dom chi

/--
OET anchor: h-f17dd88fcbe2e116
**命题 #h-f17dd88fcbe2e116（共同前后接链的上界证书）**
The composed operators represent the nonempty target and proxy chains fixed in
the text.  The propagated conclusion is explicit for every `x ∈ A` and every
output component `j`.
-/
theorem common_pre_post_chain_upper_certificate
    (target_chain proxy_chain eta chi : Operator X bot) (A V : Set X)
    (Theta : I → ENNReal) (Lχ : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx : CommonPrePostChainData target_chain proxy_chain eta chi A V)
    (hTheta :
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ i : I,
        d i (target_chain.func (eta.func x))
          (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x)) ≤ Theta i)
    (hLχ : IsLipMatrix d chi V Lχ) :
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ j : I,
      d j (chi.func (target_chain.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x))) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound Lχ Theta j := by
  intro x hx j
  have hraw :
      d j (chi.func (target_chain.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x))) ≤
        ∑ i : I, Lχ i j *
          d i (target_chain.func (eta.func x))
            (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x)) := by
    exact hLχ.2 (target_chain.func (eta.func x))
      (ctx.target_terminal_mem x hx)
      (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x)) (ctx.proxy_terminal_mem x hx) j
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : I, Lχ i j *
          d i (target_chain.func (eta.func x))
            (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x))) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound Lχ Theta j := by
    unfold matrix_vector_bound
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact mul_le_mul_right (hTheta x hx i) (Lχ i j)
  exact le_trans hraw hsum

/--
OET anchor: h-f17dd88fcbe2e116
**命题 #h-f17dd88fcbe2e116（共同前后接链的代理闭球形式）**
The propagated finite terminal vector gives the exact full-component fitting
certificate for the two commonly pre/post-composed chains.
-/
theorem common_pre_post_chain_fitting_certificate
    (target_chain proxy_chain eta chi : Operator X bot) (A V : Set X)
    (Theta : I → ENNReal) (Lchi : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx : CommonPrePostChainData target_chain proxy_chain eta chi A V)
    (hTheta : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ i : I,
      d i (target_chain.func (eta.func x))
        (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x)) ≤ Theta i)
    (hLchi : IsLipMatrix d chi V Lchi)
    (hfinite : ∀ j : I, matrix_vector_bound Lchi Theta j ≠ ⊤) :
    InFullFittingBall d
      (OperatorChain [chi, target_chain, eta])
      (OperatorChain [chi, proxy_chain, eta]) A
      (matrix_vector_bound Lchi Theta) := by
  refine ⟨fun j _ => hfinite j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hnonbot := ctx.chi_dom (ctx.target_terminal_mem x hx)
    simpa [dom, OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using hnonbot
  · intro x hx
    have hnonbot := ctx.chi_dom (ctx.proxy_terminal_mem x hx)
    simpa [dom, OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using hnonbot
  · intro x hx j _
    have _ := hfinite j
    simpa [OperatorChain, Function.comp_apply] using
      common_pre_post_chain_upper_certificate d target_chain proxy_chain eta chi
        A V Theta Lchi ctx hTheta hLchi x hx j

/--
OET anchor: h-75e01a5ca682be45
**定义（局部误差预算集）**
The local error budgets whose propagated componentwise sum is bounded by the
terminal tolerance vector.
-/
def LocalErrorBudget
    {k : Nat} (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (A : Fin k → I → I → ENNReal)
    (eps : Fin k → I → ENNReal) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : I, (∑ m : Fin k, matrix_vector_bound (A m) (eps m) j) ≤ tau j

/--
OET anchor: h-28ceee0bc7dbdab0
**命题 #h-28ceee0bc7dbdab0（局部误差预算集的基本性质，向下封闭）**
Lowering every local error vector preserves membership in the budget set.
-/
theorem local_error_budget_antitone_error
    {k : Nat} (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (A : Fin k → I → I → ENNReal)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {eps eps' : Fin k → I → ENNReal}
    (hbudget : LocalErrorBudget tau A eps)
    (heps : ∀ m : Fin k, ∀ i : I, eps' m i ≤ eps m i) :
    LocalErrorBudget tau A eps' := by
  have _ := hk
  intro j
  exact le_trans
    (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ =>
      by
        unfold matrix_vector_bound
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact mul_le_mul_right (heps m i) (A m i j)))
    (hbudget j)

/--
OET anchor: h-28ceee0bc7dbdab0
**命题 #h-28ceee0bc7dbdab0（局部误差预算集的基本性质，传播矩阵单调性）**
If every propagation matrix is decreased componentwise, every budget valid for
the larger matrices remains valid for the smaller matrices.
-/
theorem local_error_budget_antitone_matrix
    {k : Nat} (tau : I → ENNReal)
    {A B : Fin k → I → I → ENNReal}
    (eps : Fin k → I → ENNReal)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hbudget : LocalErrorBudget tau B eps)
    (hAB : ∀ m : Fin k, ∀ i j : I, A m i j ≤ B m i j) :
    LocalErrorBudget tau A eps := by
  have _ := hk
  intro j
  have hterm :
      ∀ m : Fin k,
        matrix_vector_bound (A m) (eps m) j ≤
          matrix_vector_bound (B m) (eps m) j := by
    intro m
    unfold matrix_vector_bound
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    simpa [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_right (hAB m i j) (eps m i)
  exact le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => hterm m)) (hbudget j)

/--
OET anchor: h-28ceee0bc7dbdab0
**命题 #h-28ceee0bc7dbdab0（无穷传播系数强制对应局部误差归零）**
If one local channel has coefficient `⊤` into a finite terminal budget, its
source local tolerance must vanish.
-/
theorem local_error_budget_top_coefficient_forces_zero
    {k : Nat} (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (A : Fin k → I → I → ENNReal)
    (eps : Fin k → I → ENNReal)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hbudget : LocalErrorBudget tau A eps)
    (m : Fin k) (i j : I)
    (htau : tau j ≠ ⊤)
    (hA : A m i j = ⊤) :
    eps m i = 0 := by
  have _ := hk
  by_contra heps
  have hentry_top : A m i j * eps m i = ⊤ := by
    simp [hA, heps]
  have hentry_le_matrix :
      A m i j * eps m i ≤ matrix_vector_bound (A m) (eps m) j := by
    unfold matrix_vector_bound
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (s := Finset.univ) (a := i)
      (f := fun q : I => A m q j * eps m q)
      (fun _ _ => zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hmatrix_le_total :
      matrix_vector_bound (A m) (eps m) j ≤
        ∑ q : Fin k, matrix_vector_bound (A q) (eps q) j := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (s := Finset.univ) (a := m)
      (f := fun q : Fin k => matrix_vector_bound (A q) (eps q) j)
      (fun _ _ => zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ m)
  have htop_le : ⊤ ≤ tau j := by
    rw [← hentry_top]
    exact le_trans hentry_le_matrix (le_trans hmatrix_le_total (hbudget j))
  exact htau (top_unique htop_le)

end formal_oet.vol_02.ch_10_composition_fitting

import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.fitting_ball
import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.chain_recurrence
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（有限阈值）**
A tolerance or threshold is finite exactly when it is not the top element of
`\bar{\mathbb R}_+`.
-/
def finite_ennreal (a : ENNReal) : Prop :=
  a ≠ ⊤

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（采样结构与可评估分量）**
The component indices whose empirical residual can be evaluated because their
component sample set is nonempty.
-/
def evaluable_components (sample : I → Set X) : Set I :=
  {j | (sample j).Nonempty}

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（采样结构与可评估分量，采样结构）**
A finite ambient sample together with component sample subsets on which both
the proxy and target values are defined.
-/
structure SamplingStructure
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (ambient : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) : Prop where
  finite_ambient : ambient.Finite
  component_subset :
    ∀ j : I, sample j ⊆
      {x | x ∈ ambient ∧ x ∈ dom proxy ∧ x ∈ dom target}

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（采样结构与可评估分量，环境包含）**
Every component sample point belongs to the finite ambient sample.
-/
theorem sampling_component_subset_ambient
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (ambient : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X)
    (str : SamplingStructure target proxy ambient sample) :
    ∀ j : I, sample j ⊆ ambient := by
  intro j x hx
  exact (str.component_subset j hx).1

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（采样结构与可评估分量，代理定义域）**
Every component sample point lies in the proxy domain.
-/
theorem sampling_component_subset_proxy_dom
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (ambient : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X)
    (str : SamplingStructure target proxy ambient sample) :
    ∀ j : I, sample j ⊆ dom proxy := by
  intro j x hx
  exact (str.component_subset j hx).2.1

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（采样结构与可评估分量，目标定义域）**
Every component sample point lies in the target domain.
-/
theorem sampling_component_subset_target_dom
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (ambient : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X)
    (str : SamplingStructure target proxy ambient sample) :
    ∀ j : I, sample j ⊆ dom target := by
  intro j x hx
  exact (str.component_subset j hx).2.2

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（采样结构与可评估分量，非可评估分量）**
Unfold the complement of the evaluable component set.
-/
theorem not_mem_evaluable_components_iff
    (sample : I → Set X) (j : I) :
    j ∉ evaluable_components sample ↔ ¬ (sample j).Nonempty := Iff.rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（经验残差上界，采样上确界）**
The raw sampled residual supremum on one component.
-/
noncomputable def empirical_residual_raw_sup
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (sample : Set X) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x : {x // x ∈ sample}, d j (proxy.func x.1) (target.func x.1)

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（经验残差上界，展开公式）**
The empirical residual upper bound is the sampled residual supremum plus the
observation-resolution correction.
-/
noncomputable def empirical_residual_upper
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (j : I) : ENNReal :=
  empirical_residual_raw_sup d target proxy (sample j) j + delta_o j

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（经验残差上界，采样上确界支配）**
Every sampled residual is bounded by the raw sampled supremum.
-/
theorem empirical_residual_raw_sup_bounds_sample
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (sample : Set X) (j : I) :
    ∀ x ∈ sample,
      d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
        empirical_residual_raw_sup d target proxy sample j := by
  intro x hx
  exact le_iSup
    (fun y : {y // y ∈ sample} => d j (proxy.func y.1) (target.func y.1))
    ⟨x, hx⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（经验残差上界，样本残差界）**
The empirical residual upper bound dominates every sampled residual.
-/
theorem empirical_residual_upper_bounds_sample
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (j : I) :
    ∀ x ∈ sample j,
      d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
        empirical_residual_upper d target proxy sample delta_o j := by
  intro x hx
  unfold empirical_residual_upper
  exact le_trans
    (empirical_residual_raw_sup_bounds_sample d target proxy (sample j) j x hx)
    le_self_add

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（经验残差上界）**
A componentwise empirical residual certificate records exactly the pointwise
sample residual bounds used later by the chapter.
-/
structure EmpiricalResidualBound
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (sample : I → Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal) : Prop where
  sample_error :
    ∀ j : I, j ∈ evaluable_components sample →
      ∀ x ∈ sample j, d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ eps j

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（经验残差上界，展开形式）**
Unpack the empirical residual certificate on an evaluable component.
-/
theorem empirical_residual_bound_on_sample
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (sample : I → Set X) (eps : I → ENNReal)
    (cert : EmpiricalResidualBound d target proxy sample eps) :
    ∀ j : I, j ∈ evaluable_components sample →
      ∀ x ∈ sample j, d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ eps j :=
  cert.sample_error

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（经验残差上界，公式诱导证书）**
The `sup + δ_o` formula produces the residual certificate used by the later
chapter results on all evaluable components.
-/
theorem empirical_residual_upper_certificate
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (sample : I → Set X) (delta_o : I → ENNReal) :
    EmpiricalResidualBound d target proxy sample
      (empirical_residual_upper d target proxy sample delta_o) := by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro j _hj x hx
  exact empirical_residual_upper_bounds_sample d target proxy sample delta_o j x hx

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（共同锚点加权距离）**
The column-`j` weighted common-anchor distance from a point to a component
sample set.  The same anchor `y` is used for every source component.
-/
noncomputable def weighted_anchor_distance
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (x : X) (E : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨅ y : {y // y ∈ E}, matrix_vector_bound A (fun i => d i x y.1) j

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（共同锚点最大间隙）**
The supremal weighted common-anchor gap over a working domain.
-/
noncomputable def max_anchor_gap
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (U E : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ x : {x // x ∈ U}, weighted_anchor_distance d A j x.1 E

/--
OET anchor: h-6f9e054ce01ccfef
**定义（经验保证子水平集）**
The sublevel set used in the sampling-augmentation monotonicity result.
-/
def anchor_gap_sublevel
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (U E : Set X) (eta tau : ENNReal) : Set X :=
  {x | x ∈ U ∧ weighted_anchor_distance d A j x E + eta ≤ tau}

/--
OET anchor: h-48bb46f7ef1c3c2e
**命题（采样限制的单调性）**
Restricting the anchor set can only increase the common-anchor distance.
-/
theorem weighted_anchor_distance_mono_of_subset
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (x : X)
    {S T : Set X} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    weighted_anchor_distance d A j x T ≤ weighted_anchor_distance d A j x S := by
  unfold weighted_anchor_distance
  apply le_iInf
  intro y
  exact iInf_le
    (fun z : {z // z ∈ T} => matrix_vector_bound A (fun i => d i x z.1) j)
    ⟨y.1, hST y.2⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-48bb46f7ef1c3c2e
**引理（采样限制的单调性）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining the nonempty restricted sample condition.
-/
theorem weighted_anchor_distance_mono_of_subset_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (x : X)
    {Ssmall Slarge : Set X}
    (hsmall_nonempty : Ssmall.Nonempty)
    (hST : Ssmall ⊆ Slarge) :
    weighted_anchor_distance d A j x Slarge ≤
      weighted_anchor_distance d A j x Ssmall := by
  have _ := hsmall_nonempty
  exact weighted_anchor_distance_mono_of_subset d A j x hST

/--
OET anchor: h-48bb46f7ef1c3c2e
**命题（采样限制的单调性，最大间隙形式）**
The same monotonicity holds after taking the supremum over the working domain.
-/
theorem max_anchor_gap_mono_of_subset
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (U : Set X)
    {S T : Set X} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    max_anchor_gap d A j U T ≤ max_anchor_gap d A j U S := by
  unfold max_anchor_gap
  exact iSup_mono fun x =>
    weighted_anchor_distance_mono_of_subset d A j x.1 hST

/--
OET anchor: h-48bb46f7ef1c3c2e
**命题（采样限制的单调性，最大间隙正文前提版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining the nonempty restricted sample condition.
-/
theorem max_anchor_gap_mono_of_subset_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (U : Set X)
    {Ssmall Slarge : Set X}
    (hsmall_nonempty : Ssmall.Nonempty)
    (hST : Ssmall ⊆ Slarge) :
    max_anchor_gap d A j U Slarge ≤ max_anchor_gap d A j U Ssmall := by
  have _ := hsmall_nonempty
  exact max_anchor_gap_mono_of_subset d A j U hST

/--
OET anchor: h-59d7df4e412804c3
**推论（采样增广的条件单调性）**
Adding anchors can only decrease the common-anchor distance.
-/
theorem weighted_anchor_distance_mono_of_superset
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (x : X)
    {S T : Set X} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    weighted_anchor_distance d A j x T ≤ weighted_anchor_distance d A j x S :=
  weighted_anchor_distance_mono_of_subset d A j x hST

/--
OET anchor: h-59d7df4e412804c3
**推论（采样增广的条件单调性，最大间隙形式）**
The maximal gap also decreases when the anchor set is enlarged.
-/
theorem max_anchor_gap_mono_of_superset
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (U : Set X)
    {S T : Set X} (hST : S ⊆ T) :
    max_anchor_gap d A j U T ≤ max_anchor_gap d A j U S :=
  max_anchor_gap_mono_of_subset d A j U hST

/--
OET anchor: h-59d7df4e412804c3
**推论（采样增广的条件单调性，保证域形式）**
If the anchor set is enlarged and the residual tolerance does not increase,
then the corresponding empirical guarantee sublevel set expands.
-/
theorem anchor_gap_sublevel_mono_of_sample_augmentation
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (U : Set X)
    {S T : Set X} {etaS etaT tau : ENNReal}
    (hST : S ⊆ T) (heta : etaT ≤ etaS) :
    anchor_gap_sublevel d A j U S etaS tau ⊆
      anchor_gap_sublevel d A j U T etaT tau := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨hx.1,
    le_trans
      (add_le_add (weighted_anchor_distance_mono_of_superset d A j x hST) heta)
      hx.2⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-59d7df4e412804c3
**推论（采样增广的条件单调性，有限阈值版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining the nonempty original sample and finite
threshold assumptions from the chapter text.
-/
theorem anchor_gap_sublevel_mono_of_sample_augmentation_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (U : Set X)
    {S T : Set X} {etaS etaT tau : ENNReal}
    (hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : finite_ennreal tau)
    (hST : S ⊆ T) (heta : etaT ≤ etaS) :
    anchor_gap_sublevel d A j U S etaS tau ⊆
      anchor_gap_sublevel d A j U T etaT tau := by
  have _ := hS_nonempty
  have _ := htau_finite
  exact anchor_gap_sublevel_mono_of_sample_augmentation d A j U hST heta

import formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution.structural_priors
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]

/--
OET anchor: h-67ea98399b9a982d
**定义（分量经验保证域）**
The component empirical guarantee domain at threshold `tau`.
-/
def empirical_component_guarantee_domain
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U sample : Set X)
    (j : I) (eps tau : ENNReal) : Set X :=
  anchor_gap_sublevel d A j U sample eps tau

/--
OET anchor: h-67ea98399b9a982d
**定义（联合经验保证域）**
The joint empirical guarantee domain over a component set `J`.
-/
def empirical_joint_guarantee_domain
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps tau : I → ENNReal) : Set X :=
  {x | x ∈ U ∧
    ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
      weighted_anchor_distance d A j x (sample j) + eps j ≤ tau j}

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质）**
A sampled anchor has zero common-anchor distance to its own component sample
set.
-/
theorem weighted_anchor_distance_self_eq_zero
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) {sample : Set X} {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ sample) :
    weighted_anchor_distance d A j x sample = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold weighted_anchor_distance
    have hzero :
        matrix_vector_bound A (fun i => d i x x) j = 0 := by
      unfold matrix_vector_bound
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      simp [(hd i).dist_self x]
    exact le_trans
      (iInf_le
        (fun y : {y // y ∈ sample} =>
          matrix_vector_bound A (fun i => d i x y.1) j)
        ⟨x, hx⟩)
      (le_of_eq hzero)
  · exact zero_le _

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，采样点）**
A sampled point lies in the component guarantee domain whenever the threshold
dominates the empirical residual bound.
-/
theorem sample_point_mem_empirical_component_guarantee_domain
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U sample : Set X)
    (j : I) (eps tau : ENNReal) {x : X}
    (hsampleU : sample ⊆ U)
    (hx : x ∈ sample)
    (htau : eps ≤ tau) :
    x ∈ empirical_component_guarantee_domain d A U sample j eps tau := by
  refine ⟨hsampleU hx, ?_⟩
  rw [weighted_anchor_distance_self_eq_zero d hd A j hx, zero_add]
  exact htau

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，采样点有限阈值版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining the finite threshold condition.
-/
theorem sample_point_mem_empirical_component_guarantee_domain_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U sample : Set X)
    (j : I) (eps tau : ENNReal) {x : X}
    (htau_finite : finite_ennreal tau)
    (hsampleU : sample ⊆ U)
    (hx : x ∈ sample)
    (htau : eps ≤ tau) :
    x ∈ empirical_component_guarantee_domain d A U sample j eps tau := by
  have _ := htau_finite
  exact sample_point_mem_empirical_component_guarantee_domain d hd A U sample
    j eps tau hsampleU hx htau

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，联合采样点）**
A point sampled in every resolved component belongs to the joint empirical
guarantee domain when every threshold dominates its residual bound.
-/
theorem sample_point_mem_empirical_joint_guarantee_domain
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps tau : I → ENNReal) {x : X}
    (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (hxsample : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → x ∈ sample j)
    (htau : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → eps j ≤ tau j) :
    x ∈ empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau := by
  refine ⟨hxU, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  rw [weighted_anchor_distance_self_eq_zero d hd A j (hxsample j hj), zero_add]
  exact htau j hj

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，联合采样点分量形式）**
If the resolved component set is nonempty and every component sample lies in
`U`, then a point sampled in every resolved component lies in the joint
empirical guarantee domain whenever the thresholds dominate the residual
bounds.
-/
theorem sample_point_mem_empirical_joint_guarantee_domain_of_component_samples
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps tau : I → ENNReal) {x : X}
    (hJne : J.Nonempty)
    (hsampleU : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → sample j ⊆ U)
    (hxsample : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → x ∈ sample j)
    (htau : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → eps j ≤ tau j) :
    x ∈ empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau := by
  rcases hJne with ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩
  exact sample_point_mem_empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d hd A U sample J eps tau
    (hsampleU j₀ hj₀ (hxsample j₀ hj₀)) hxsample htau

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，联合采样点有限阈值版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining finite thresholds for every resolved
component.
-/
theorem sample_point_mem_empirical_joint_guarantee_domain_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps tau : I → ENNReal) {x : X}
    (hJne : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (hsampleU : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → sample j ⊆ U)
    (hxsample : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → x ∈ sample j)
    (htau : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → eps j ≤ tau j) :
    x ∈ empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau := by
  have _ := htau_finite
  exact sample_point_mem_empirical_joint_guarantee_domain_of_component_samples
    d hd A U sample J eps tau hJne hsampleU hxsample htau

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，分量误差）**
Membership in the component guarantee domain converts the empirical upper
certificate into the requested component tolerance.
-/
theorem empirical_component_guarantee_error_bound
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U sample : Set X)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (j : I) (eps tau : ENNReal)
    (hupper :
      ∀ x ∈ U,
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
          weighted_anchor_distance d A j x sample + eps)
    {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ empirical_component_guarantee_domain d A U sample j eps tau) :
    d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau :=
  le_trans (hupper x hx.1) hx.2

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，联合误差）**
Membership in the joint empirical guarantee domain gives all component
tolerance bounds on `J`.
-/
theorem empirical_joint_guarantee_error_bound
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (eps tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hupper :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
          weighted_anchor_distance d A j x (sample j) + eps j)
    {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau) :
    ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau j := by
  intro j hj
  exact le_trans (hupper x hx.1 j hj) (hx.2 j hj)

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，阈值单调性）**
Increasing the tolerance vector enlarges the joint empirical guarantee domain.
-/
theorem empirical_joint_guarantee_domain_mono_tau
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps tau tau' : I → ENNReal)
    (htau : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → tau j ≤ tau' j) :
    empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau ⊆
      empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau' := by
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨hx.1, fun j hj => le_trans (hx.2 j hj) (htau j hj)⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，阈值单调性有限版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining finite threshold-vector assumptions.
-/
theorem empirical_joint_guarantee_domain_mono_tau_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps tau tau' : I → ENNReal)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (htau'_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau' j))
    (htau : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → tau j ≤ tau' j) :
    empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau ⊆
      empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau' := by
  have _ := htau_finite
  have _ := htau'_finite
  exact empirical_joint_guarantee_domain_mono_tau d A U sample J eps tau tau' htau

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，采样缩小）**
If the sample set is restricted while the same residual bound is kept, the
component guarantee domain can only shrink.
-/
theorem empirical_component_guarantee_domain_mono_sample_restriction
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (j : I) (eps tau : ENNReal)
    {Ssmall Slarge : Set X} (hsub : Ssmall ⊆ Slarge) :
    empirical_component_guarantee_domain d A U Ssmall j eps tau ⊆
      empirical_component_guarantee_domain d A U Slarge j eps tau := by
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
  exact le_trans
    (add_le_add (weighted_anchor_distance_mono_of_subset d A j x hsub) le_rfl)
    hx.2

/--
OET anchor: h-51e4f3855df2b936
**命题（经验保证域的基本性质，采样缩小正文前提版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining nonempty restricted sample and finite threshold
assumptions.
-/
theorem empirical_component_guarantee_domain_mono_sample_restriction_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (j : I) (eps tau : ENNReal)
    {Ssmall Slarge : Set X}
    (hsmall_nonempty : Ssmall.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : finite_ennreal tau)
    (hsub : Ssmall ⊆ Slarge) :
    empirical_component_guarantee_domain d A U Ssmall j eps tau ⊆
      empirical_component_guarantee_domain d A U Slarge j eps tau := by
  have _ := hsmall_nonempty
  have _ := htau_finite
  exact empirical_component_guarantee_domain_mono_sample_restriction
    d A U j eps tau hsub

/--
OET anchor: h-67ea98399b9a982d
**定义（共同锚点内插域）**
The points in `U` that have one common anchor within the componentwise radius
vector `r`.
-/
def common_anchor_interpolation_domain
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (U sample : Set X) (r : I → ENNReal) : Set X :=
  {x | x ∈ U ∧ ∃ xs ∈ sample, ∀ i : I, d i x xs ≤ r i}

/--
OET anchor: h-67ea98399b9a982d
**定义（共同锚点外插域）**
The complement in `U` of the common-anchor interpolation domain.
-/
def common_anchor_extrapolation_domain
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (U sample : Set X) (r : I → ENNReal) : Set X :=
  U \ common_anchor_interpolation_domain d U sample r

/--
OET anchor: h-a0d7c8d3d3aaaa3d
**命题（共同锚点内插界，锚点距离形式）**
Inside the common-anchor interpolation domain, the anchor distance is bounded
by the matrix-vector action on the radius vector.
-/
theorem common_anchor_interpolation_distance_bound
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U sample : Set X)
    (r : I → ENNReal) (j : I) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ common_anchor_interpolation_domain d U sample r) :
    weighted_anchor_distance d A j x sample ≤ matrix_vector_bound A r j := by
  rcases hx.2 with ⟨xs, hxs, hdist⟩
  exact le_trans
    (iInf_le
      (fun y : {y // y ∈ sample} =>
        matrix_vector_bound A (fun i => d i x y.1) j)
      ⟨xs, hxs⟩)
    (matrix_vector_bound_mono A hdist j)

/--
OET anchor: h-a0d7c8d3d3aaaa3d
**命题（共同锚点内插界）**
The empirical upper certificate specializes on the interpolation domain to the
radius-vector bound.
-/
theorem common_anchor_interpolation_error_bound
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U sample : Set X)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (r : I → ENNReal) (eps : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hupper :
      ∀ x ∈ U,
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
          weighted_anchor_distance d A j x sample + eps)
    {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ common_anchor_interpolation_domain d U sample r) :
    d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
      matrix_vector_bound A r j + eps := by
  exact le_trans (hupper x hx.1)
    (add_le_add
      (common_anchor_interpolation_distance_bound d A U sample r j hx)
      le_rfl)

/--
OET anchor: h-a0d7c8d3d3aaaa3d
**命题（共同锚点内插界，可评估分量版本）**
The interpolation bound specialized to an evaluable component sample and a
componentwise upper certificate.
-/
theorem common_anchor_interpolation_error_bound_evaluable_component
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (r : I → ENNReal) (eps : I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hj : j ∈ J)
    (hupper :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
          weighted_anchor_distance d A j x (sample j) + eps j)
    {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ common_anchor_interpolation_domain d U (sample j) r) :
    d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
      matrix_vector_bound A r j + eps j := by
  exact common_anchor_interpolation_error_bound d A U (sample j) target proxy
    r (eps j) j (fun x hxU => hupper x hxU j hj) hx

/--
OET anchor: h-a0d7c8d3d3aaaa3d
**命题（共同锚点内插界，外插边界）**
Membership in the extrapolation domain records only that the interpolation
certificate is not available.
-/
theorem common_anchor_extrapolation_records_nonmembership
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (U sample : Set X) (r : I → ENNReal) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ common_anchor_extrapolation_domain d U sample r) :
    x ∈ U ∧ x ∉ common_anchor_interpolation_domain d U sample r :=
  hx

/--
OET anchor: h-a0d7c8d3d3aaaa3d
**命题（共同锚点内插界，外插不蕴含正偏差）**
Extrapolation-domain membership alone cannot force a positive true-deviation
lower bound: taking the target and proxy to be the same operator leaves the
true deviation equal to zero.
-/
theorem common_anchor_extrapolation_does_not_force_positive_error
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (phi : Operator X bot)
    (U sample : Set X) (r : I → ENNReal)
    (j : I) (tau : ENNReal) {x : X}
    (hUdom : U ⊆ dom phi)
    (hx : x ∈ common_anchor_extrapolation_domain d U sample r) :
    x ∈ dom phi ∧ ¬ tau < d j (phi.func x) (phi.func x) := by
  refine ⟨hUdom hx.1, ?_⟩
  rw [(hd j).dist_self]
  exact not_lt_of_ge (zero_le tau)

end formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_09_family_fitting
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_10_composition_fitting

variable {X I β : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I] [Nonempty I]

/--
OET anchor: h-336b0edda7ebdcc6
**定义（采样点的分量受限联合可行胞）**
The pointwise feasible cell at a sample point for all targets active on the
ambient domain and for a selected component subfamily.
-/
def sample_joint_feasible_cell
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (target : β → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (xₛ : X) (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal) : Set X :=
  {z | ∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U xₛ →
      ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → d j ((target beta).func xₛ) z ≤ tau j}

/--
OET anchor: h-336b0edda7ebdcc6
**定义（采样点的分量受限联合可行胞，全分量特例）**
On the full component family, the sample cell is exactly the local joint
feasible cell from target-family fitting.
-/
theorem sample_joint_feasible_cell_eq_local
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (target : β → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (xₛ : X) (tau : I → ENNReal) :
    sample_joint_feasible_cell d target U xₛ Set.univ tau =
      local_joint_feasible_cell d target U tau xₛ := by
  ext z
  simp [sample_joint_feasible_cell, local_joint_feasible_cell]

/--
OET anchor: h-336b0edda7ebdcc6
**命题（采样点联合可行胞判据）**
Pointwise simultaneous fitting at the sample point is exactly membership of
the proxy output in the component-restricted joint feasible cell.
-/
theorem sample_joint_feasible_cell_iff
    [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (target : β → Operator X bot)
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (xₛ : X) (J : Set I)
    (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hxₛ : xₛ ∈ effective_family_domain target U)
    (hJ : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (hproxy_dom : xₛ ∈ dom proxy) :
    (∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U xₛ →
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
          d j ((target beta).func xₛ) (proxy.func xₛ) ≤ tau j) ↔
      proxy.func xₛ ∈ sample_joint_feasible_cell d target U xₛ J tau := by
  have _ := hxₛ
  have _ := hJ
  have _ := htau_finite
  have _ := hproxy_dom
  rfl

/--
OET anchor: h-336b0edda7ebdcc6
**命题（采样点联合可行胞判据，空胞）**
If the sample joint feasible cell is empty, no pointwise proxy output can
satisfy all active target inequalities at that sample point.
-/
theorem no_sample_joint_fitting_of_cell_empty
    [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (target : β → Operator X bot)
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (xₛ : X) (J : Set I)
    (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hxₛ : xₛ ∈ effective_family_domain target U)
    (hJ : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (hproxy_dom : xₛ ∈ dom proxy)
    (hempty : sample_joint_feasible_cell d target U xₛ J tau = ∅) :
    ¬ (∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U xₛ →
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
          d j ((target beta).func xₛ) (proxy.func xₛ) ≤ tau j) := by
  intro hfit
  have hmem :
      proxy.func xₛ ∈ sample_joint_feasible_cell d target U xₛ J tau :=
    (sample_joint_feasible_cell_iff d target proxy U xₛ J tau
      hxₛ hJ htau_finite hproxy_dom).mp hfit
  simp [hempty] at hmem

/--
OET anchor: h-336b0edda7ebdcc6
**命题（采样点联合可行胞判据，不存在可行点值）**
An empty component-restricted joint feasible cell contains no point value
satisfying all active target constraints.
-/
theorem no_sample_joint_output_of_cell_empty
    [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (target : β → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (xₛ : X) (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hxₛ : xₛ ∈ effective_family_domain target U)
    (hJ : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (hempty : sample_joint_feasible_cell d target U xₛ J tau = ∅) :
    ¬ ∃ z : X, ∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U xₛ →
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
          d j ((target beta).func xₛ) z ≤ tau j := by
  have _ := hxₛ
  have _ := hJ
  have _ := htau_finite
  intro h
  rcases h with ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hzmem : z ∈ sample_joint_feasible_cell d target U xₛ J tau := hz
  simp [hempty] at hzmem

/--
OET anchor: h-236b99a83c3780af
**推论（共享中间目标的经验复合证书）**
If the target is close to an intermediate target chain and the proxy chain is
close to that intermediate target chain on the same domain, then the proxy
chain fits the target with the summed tolerance.
-/
theorem shared_intermediate_target_empirical_composition_certificate
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target_task target_chain proxy_chain : Operator X bot) (A : Set X)
    (Theta alpha : I → ENNReal)
    (hTheta_finite : ∀ j : I, finite_ennreal (Theta j))
    (halpha_finite : ∀ j : I, finite_ennreal (alpha j))
    (htask_dom : A ⊆ dom target_task)
    (htarget_chain_dom : A ⊆ dom target_chain)
    (hproxy_dom : A ⊆ dom proxy_chain)
    (htask_chain :
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ j : I,
        d j (target_task.func x) (target_chain.func x) ≤ alpha j)
    (hchain_proxy :
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ j : I,
        d j (target_chain.func x) (proxy_chain.func x) ≤ Theta j) :
    InFullFittingBall d target_task proxy_chain A
      (fun j => alpha j + Theta j) := by
  have _ := htarget_chain_dom
  refine ⟨?_, htask_dom, hproxy_dom, ?_⟩
  · intro j _
    exact ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨halpha_finite j, hTheta_finite j⟩
  intro x hx j _
  exact le_trans
    ((hd j).triangle (target_task.func x) (target_chain.func x)
      (proxy_chain.func x))
    (add_le_add (htask_chain x hx j) (hchain_proxy x hx j))

/--
OET anchor: h-236b99a83c3780af
**推论（共享中间目标的经验复合证书，目标等同特例）**
When the intermediate target chain equals the task target on the analysis
domain, the intermediate-alignment tolerance is zero.
-/
theorem shared_intermediate_target_exact_specialization
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target_task target_chain proxy_chain : Operator X bot) (A : Set X)
    (Theta : I → ENNReal)
    (hTheta_finite : ∀ j : I, finite_ennreal (Theta j))
    (htask_dom : A ⊆ dom target_task)
    (htarget_chain_dom : A ⊆ dom target_chain)
    (hproxy_dom : A ⊆ dom proxy_chain)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ A, target_chain.func x = target_task.func x)
    (hchain_proxy :
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ j : I,
        d j (target_chain.func x) (proxy_chain.func x) ≤ Theta j) :
    InFullFittingBall d target_task proxy_chain A Theta := by
  have _ := hd
  have _ := htarget_chain_dom
  refine ⟨fun j _ => hTheta_finite j, htask_dom, hproxy_dom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx j _
  simpa [heq x hx] using hchain_proxy x hx j

/--
OET anchor: h-7db372adecc0221f
**推论（经验链上界的共同前后接传递）**
An empirical terminal chain-error vector is exactly the vector consumed by the
common pre/post chain upper certificate.
-/
theorem empirical_common_pre_post_chain_inheritance
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target_chain proxy_chain eta chi : Operator X bot) (A V : Set X)
    (Theta : I → ENNReal) (Lχ : I → I → ENNReal)
    (ctx : CommonPrePostChainData target_chain proxy_chain eta chi A V)
    (hTheta :
      ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ i : I,
        d i (target_chain.func (eta.func x))
          (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x)) ≤ Theta i)
    (hLχ : IsLipMatrix d chi V Lχ) :
    ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ j : I,
      d j (chi.func (target_chain.func (eta.func x)))
          (chi.func (proxy_chain.func (eta.func x))) ≤
        matrix_vector_bound Lχ Theta j :=
  common_pre_post_chain_upper_certificate d
    target_chain proxy_chain eta chi A V Theta Lχ ctx hTheta hLχ

end formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.fitting_ball
import formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution.empirical_residuals
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]

/--
OET anchor: h-9655cbb9401e5c90
**定义（目标 Lip 包络证书）**
An external target-side Lip envelope certificate on a specified domain.
-/
structure TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target : Operator X bot) (V : Set X) (L : I → I → ENNReal) : Prop where
  lip_matrix : IsLipMatrix d target V L

/--
OET anchor: h-9655cbb9401e5c90
**定义（目标 co-Lip 下界证书）**
An external target-side co-Lip lower certificate on a specified domain.
-/
structure TargetCoLipLowerCertificate
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target : Operator X bot) (V : Set X) (K : I → I → ENNReal) : Prop where
  colip_matrix : IsCoLipMatrix d target V K

/--
OET anchor: h-f16da76e4331b725
**命题（经验目标扰动上界，矩阵加法）**
Pointwise matrix addition distributes across the finite matrix-vector action.
-/
theorem matrix_vector_bound_matrix_add
    (L₁ L₂ : I → I → ENNReal) (v : I → ENNReal) (j : I) :
    matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => L₁ i j + L₂ i j) v j =
      matrix_vector_bound L₁ v j + matrix_vector_bound L₂ v j := by
  unfold matrix_vector_bound
  simp_rw [add_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

/--
OET anchor: h-f16da76e4331b725
**命题（经验目标扰动上界，逐点形式）**
With proxy and target Lip certificates, one empirical anchor bounds the
target-proxy error.  Taking the infimum over the same anchor gives the
common-anchor estimate.
-/
theorem empirical_target_perturbation_upper_point
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U V sample : Set X)
    (Lp Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hU : U ⊆ V)
    (hsample : sample ⊆ U)
    (hLp : IsLipMatrix d proxy U Lp)
    (hLstar : IsLipMatrix d target V Lstar)
    (hres : ∀ y ∈ sample, d j (proxy.func y) (target.func y) ≤ eps) :
    ∀ x ∈ U,
      d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
        weighted_anchor_distance d (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j) j x sample + eps := by
  intro x hx
  have hxV : x ∈ V := hU hx
  have h_each :
      ∀ y : {y // y ∈ sample},
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
          matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j)
            (fun i => d i x y.1) j + eps := by
    intro y
    have hyU : y.1 ∈ U := hsample y.2
    have hyV : y.1 ∈ V := hU hyU
    have htri₁ :=
      (hd j).triangle (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y.1) (target.func x)
    have htri₂ :=
      (hd j).triangle (proxy.func y.1) (target.func y.1) (target.func x)
    have hproxy :
        d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y.1) ≤
          matrix_vector_bound Lp (fun i => d i x y.1) j := by
      simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using hLp.2 x hx y.1 hyU j
    have htarget :
        d j (target.func y.1) (target.func x) ≤
          matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j := by
      have hraw :
          d j (target.func x) (target.func y.1) ≤
            matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j := by
        simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using hLstar.2 x hxV y.1 hyV j
      simpa [(hd j).symm (target.func y.1) (target.func x)] using hraw
    have hmiddle :
        d j (proxy.func y.1) (target.func x) ≤
          eps + matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j := by
      exact le_trans htri₂ (add_le_add (hres y.1 y.2) htarget)
    calc
      d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x)
          ≤ d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y.1) +
              d j (proxy.func y.1) (target.func x) := htri₁
      _ ≤ matrix_vector_bound Lp (fun i => d i x y.1) j +
            (eps + matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j) :=
          add_le_add hproxy hmiddle
      _ = matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j)
            (fun i => d i x y.1) j + eps := by
          rw [matrix_vector_bound_matrix_add]
          simp [add_comm, add_left_comm]
  have hiinf :
      d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
        ⨅ y : {y // y ∈ sample},
          matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j)
            (fun i => d i x y.1) j + eps :=
    le_iInf h_each
  simpa [weighted_anchor_distance, ENNReal.iInf_add] using hiinf

/--
OET anchor: h-f16da76e4331b725
**命题（经验目标扰动上界，域上确界形式）**
The pointwise common-anchor estimate bounds the component distance vector on
the working domain.
-/
theorem empirical_target_perturbation_upper_sup
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U V sample : Set X)
    (Lp Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hU : U ⊆ V)
    (hsample : sample ⊆ U)
    (hLp : IsLipMatrix d proxy U Lp)
    (hLstar : IsLipMatrix d target V Lstar)
    (hres : ∀ y ∈ sample, d j (proxy.func y) (target.func y) ≤ eps) :
    component_error_vector d target proxy U j ≤
      max_anchor_gap d (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j) j U sample + eps := by
  unfold component_error_vector max_anchor_gap
  apply iSup_le
  intro x
  have hpoint :=
    empirical_target_perturbation_upper_point d hd target proxy U V sample
      Lp Lstar eps j hU hsample hLp hLstar hres x.1 x.2
  have hsymm :
      d j (target.func x.1) (proxy.func x.1) ≤
        weighted_anchor_distance d (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j) j x.1 sample + eps := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm (target.func x.1) (proxy.func x.1)] using hpoint
  exact le_trans hsymm
    (add_le_add (le_iSup
      (fun x : {x // x ∈ U} =>
        weighted_anchor_distance d (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j) j x.1 sample) x) le_rfl)

/--
OET anchor: h-f16da76e4331b725
**命题（经验目标扰动上界）**
The pointwise upper bound specialized to an evaluable component and a
componentwise empirical residual certificate.
-/
theorem empirical_target_perturbation_upper_point_from_residual_certificate
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X)
    (Lp Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hU : U ⊆ V)
    (hsample : sample j ⊆ U)
    (hLp : IsLipMatrix d proxy U Lp)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target V Lstar)
    (hres : EmpiricalResidualBound d target proxy sample eps)
    (hj : j ∈ evaluable_components sample) :
    ∀ x ∈ U,
      d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
        weighted_anchor_distance d (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j) j x (sample j) +
          eps j := by
  exact empirical_target_perturbation_upper_point d hd target proxy U V (sample j)
    Lp Lstar (eps j) j hU hsample hLp hLstar.lip_matrix
    (hres.sample_error j hj)

/--
OET anchor: h-f16da76e4331b725
**命题（经验目标扰动上界，可评估分量上确界形式）**
The domain supremum version specialized to an evaluable component and a
componentwise empirical residual certificate.
-/
theorem empirical_target_perturbation_upper_sup_from_residual_certificate
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X)
    (Lp Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hU : U ⊆ V)
    (hsample : sample j ⊆ U)
    (hLp : IsLipMatrix d proxy U Lp)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target V Lstar)
    (hres : EmpiricalResidualBound d target proxy sample eps)
    (hj : j ∈ evaluable_components sample) :
    component_error_vector d target proxy U j ≤
      max_anchor_gap d (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j) j U (sample j) + eps j := by
  exact empirical_target_perturbation_upper_sup d hd target proxy U V (sample j)
    Lp Lstar (eps j) j hU hsample hLp hLstar.lip_matrix
    (hres.sample_error j hj)

/--
OET anchor: h-5f713424d00a09e9
**定义（读取误差证书与读取修正锚点距离）**
The readout-corrected anchor distance replaces the target sample residual by
the proxy-to-label residual plus a pointwise readout error certificate.
-/
noncomputable def readout_corrected_anchor_distance
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (label : X → X) (readout_error : X → ENNReal)
    (x : X) (sample : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨅ y : {y // y ∈ sample},
    matrix_vector_bound A (fun i => d i x y.1) j +
      d j (proxy.func y.1) (label y.1) +
      readout_error y.1

/--
OET anchor: h-5f713424d00a09e9
**命题（逐点读取误差下的经验上界）**
With proxy and target Lip certificates, labels equipped with pointwise readout
error certificates give a refined common-anchor upper bound.
-/
theorem readout_error_empirical_upper_point
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U V sample : Set X)
    (Lp Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (label : X → X)
    (readout_error : X → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hU : U ⊆ V)
    (hsample : sample ⊆ U)
    (hLp : IsLipMatrix d proxy U Lp)
    (hLstar : IsLipMatrix d target V Lstar)
    (hread : ∀ y ∈ sample, d j (label y) (target.func y) ≤ readout_error y) :
    ∀ x ∈ U,
      d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
        readout_corrected_anchor_distance d proxy
          (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j) j label readout_error x sample := by
  intro x hx
  have hxV : x ∈ V := hU hx
  have h_each :
      ∀ y : {y // y ∈ sample},
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
          matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j)
            (fun i => d i x y.1) j +
            d j (proxy.func y.1) (label y.1) +
            readout_error y.1 := by
    intro y
    have hyU : y.1 ∈ U := hsample y.2
    have hyV : y.1 ∈ V := hU hyU
    have hproxy :
        d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y.1) ≤
          matrix_vector_bound Lp (fun i => d i x y.1) j := by
      simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using hLp.2 x hx y.1 hyU j
    have htarget :
        d j (target.func y.1) (target.func x) ≤
          matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j := by
      have hraw :
          d j (target.func x) (target.func y.1) ≤
            matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j := by
        simpa [matrix_vector_bound] using hLstar.2 x hxV y.1 hyV j
      simpa [(hd j).symm (target.func y.1) (target.func x)] using hraw
    have hlabel_target :
        d j (label y.1) (target.func x) ≤
          readout_error y.1 + matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j := by
      exact le_trans ((hd j).triangle (label y.1) (target.func y.1) (target.func x))
        (add_le_add (hread y.1 y.2) htarget)
    have hproxy_label_target :
        d j (proxy.func y.1) (target.func x) ≤
          d j (proxy.func y.1) (label y.1) +
            (readout_error y.1 + matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j) := by
      exact le_trans ((hd j).triangle (proxy.func y.1) (label y.1) (target.func x))
        (add_le_add le_rfl hlabel_target)
    calc
      d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x)
          ≤ d j (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y.1) +
              d j (proxy.func y.1) (target.func x) :=
            (hd j).triangle (proxy.func x) (proxy.func y.1) (target.func x)
      _ ≤ matrix_vector_bound Lp (fun i => d i x y.1) j +
            (d j (proxy.func y.1) (label y.1) +
              (readout_error y.1 + matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x y.1) j)) :=
            add_le_add hproxy hproxy_label_target
      _ = matrix_vector_bound (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j)
            (fun i => d i x y.1) j +
            d j (proxy.func y.1) (label y.1) +
            readout_error y.1 := by
          rw [matrix_vector_bound_matrix_add]
          simp [add_comm, add_left_comm]
