The proxy-separation test specialized to an evaluable component and an
empirical residual certificate.
-/
theorem target_lip_sample_necessary_from_proxy_gap_residual_certificate
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (V : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : I → ENNReal) (a : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hsub : sample j ⊆ V)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target V Lstar)
    (hres : EmpiricalResidualBound d target proxy sample eps)
    (hj : j ∈ evaluable_components sample)
    {xs xt : X} (hxs : xs ∈ sample j) (hxt : xt ∈ sample j)
    (hgap : a + (eps j + eps j) < d j (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt)) :
    a < matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i xs xt) j := by
  exact target_lip_sample_necessary_from_proxy_gap d hd target proxy V (sample j)
    Lstar (eps j) a j hsub hLstar.lip_matrix hxs hxt
    (hres.sample_error j hj xs hxs) (hres.sample_error j hj xt hxt) hgap

/--
OET anchor: h-885c9167af3ee3ef
**命题（Lip 包络的采样必要条件，代理分离正文前提形式）**
Text-faithful form retaining that the tested lower radius is finite.
-/
theorem target_lip_sample_necessary_from_proxy_gap_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (V : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : I → ENNReal) (a : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (ha_finite : finite_ennreal a)
    (hsub : sample j ⊆ V)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target V Lstar)
    (hres : EmpiricalResidualBound d target proxy sample eps)
    (hj : j ∈ evaluable_components sample)
    {xs xt : X} (hxs : xs ∈ sample j) (hxt : xt ∈ sample j)
    (hgap : a + (eps j + eps j) < d j (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt)) :
    a < matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i xs xt) j := by
  have _ := ha_finite
  exact target_lip_sample_necessary_from_proxy_gap_residual_certificate
    d hd target proxy V sample Lstar eps a j hsub hLstar hres hj
    hxs hxt hgap

/--
OET anchor: h-9b0a38625719c139
**命题（co-Lip 下界的采样必要条件）**
A target co-Lip lower certificate must be no larger than the sampled target
output distance, hence no larger than the sampled proxy distance plus two
residual tolerances.
-/
theorem target_colip_sample_necessary
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (V sample : Set X)
    (Kstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hsub : sample ⊆ V)
    (hKstar : IsCoLipMatrix d target V Kstar)
    {xs xt : X} (hxs : xs ∈ sample) (hxt : xt ∈ sample)
    (hres_s : d j (proxy.func xs) (target.func xs) ≤ eps)
    (hres_t : d j (proxy.func xt) (target.func xt) ≤ eps) :
    matrix_vector_bound Kstar (fun i => d i xs xt) j ≤
      d j (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt) + (eps + eps) := by
  have hco :
      matrix_vector_bound Kstar (fun i => d i xs xt) j ≤
        d j (target.func xs) (target.func xt) :=
    hKstar.2.2 xs (hsub hxs) xt (hsub hxt) j
  have hres_s_symm : d j (target.func xs) (proxy.func xs) ≤ eps := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm (target.func xs) (proxy.func xs)] using hres_s
  have htri₁ :=
    (hd j).triangle (target.func xs) (proxy.func xs) (target.func xt)
  have htri₂ :=
    (hd j).triangle (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt) (target.func xt)
  have hproxy_to_target :
      d j (proxy.func xs) (target.func xt) ≤
        d j (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt) + eps :=
    le_trans htri₂ (add_le_add le_rfl hres_t)
  have htarget_upper :
      d j (target.func xs) (target.func xt) ≤
        d j (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt) + (eps + eps) := by
    calc
      d j (target.func xs) (target.func xt)
          ≤ d j (target.func xs) (proxy.func xs) +
              d j (proxy.func xs) (target.func xt) := htri₁
      _ ≤ eps + (d j (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt) + eps) :=
          add_le_add hres_s_symm hproxy_to_target
      _ = d j (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt) + (eps + eps) := by
          simp [add_comm, add_assoc]
  exact le_trans hco htarget_upper

/--
OET anchor: h-9b0a38625719c139
**命题（co-Lip 下界的采样必要条件，可评估分量形式）**
The sampled co-Lip necessary condition specialized to an evaluable component,
a target co-Lip certificate, and an empirical residual certificate.
-/
theorem target_colip_sample_necessary_from_residual_certificate
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (V : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X)
    (Kstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps : I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hsub : sample j ⊆ V)
    (hKstar : TargetCoLipLowerCertificate d target V Kstar)
    (hres : EmpiricalResidualBound d target proxy sample eps)
    (hj : j ∈ evaluable_components sample)
    {xs xt : X} (hxs : xs ∈ sample j) (hxt : xt ∈ sample j) :
    matrix_vector_bound Kstar (fun i => d i xs xt) j ≤
      d j (proxy.func xs) (proxy.func xt) + (eps j + eps j) := by
  exact target_colip_sample_necessary d hd target proxy V (sample j)
    Kstar (eps j) j hsub hKstar.colip_matrix hxs hxt
    (hres.sample_error j hj xs hxs) (hres.sample_error j hj xt hxt)

end formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

import formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution.guarantee_domains
import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.chain_recurrence
import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_09_family_fitting.joint_fitting
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_09_family_fitting

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]

/--
OET anchor: h-811f6faa2a21c74d
**引理（经验拟合球继承）**
On any subdomain of the empirical guarantee domain, the empirical upper
certificate gives the corresponding component fitting ball.
-/
theorem empirical_fitting_ball_inheritance
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U U₀ : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (eps tau : I → ENNReal)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (htarget_dom : U₀ ⊆ dom target)
    (hproxy_dom : U₀ ⊆ dom proxy)
    (hU₀ :
      U₀ ⊆ empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau)
    (hupper :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
          weighted_anchor_distance d A j x (sample j) + eps j) :
    InFittingBall d target proxy U₀ J tau := by
  refine ⟨htau_finite, htarget_dom, hproxy_dom, ?_⟩
  intro x hx j hj
  have hbound :=
    empirical_joint_guarantee_error_bound d A U sample J target proxy eps tau
      hupper (hU₀ hx) j hj
  simpa [(hd j).symm (target.func x) (proxy.func x)] using hbound

/--
OET anchor: h-f0c32a1e279a067f
**推论（经验代理传递）**
Fitting a proxy to an empirically certified proxy adds the two component
tolerance vectors on the same component set.
-/
theorem empirical_proxy_transfer
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy psi : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I)
    (tau sigma : I → ENNReal)
    (hproxy :
      InFittingBall d target proxy U J tau)
    (hpsi :
      InFittingBall d proxy psi U J sigma) :
    InFittingBall d target psi U J (fun j => tau j + sigma j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, hproxy.target_dom, hpsi.proxy_dom, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    exact ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr
      ⟨hproxy.tolerance_finite j hj, hpsi.tolerance_finite j hj⟩
  intro x hx j hj
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle (target.func x) (proxy.func x) (psi.func x)
  exact le_trans htri
    (add_le_add (hproxy.error x hx j hj) (hpsi.error x hx j hj))

/--
OET anchor: h-f0c32a1e279a067f
**推论（经验代理传递，保证域正文形式）**
On a nonempty evaluable component family, a subdomain of the empirical
guarantee domain first yields the target-to-proxy fitting certificate; fitting
a second proxy to that proxy then gives the summed tolerance certificate.
-/
theorem empirical_proxy_transfer_from_guarantee_domain_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (U U₀ : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (target proxy psi : Operator X bot)
    (eps tau sigma : I → ENNReal)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (hJ_evaluable : J ⊆ evaluable_components sample)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (htarget_dom : U₀ ⊆ dom target)
    (hproxy_dom : U₀ ⊆ dom proxy)
    (hU₀ :
      U₀ ⊆ empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d A U sample J eps tau)
    (hupper :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤
          weighted_anchor_distance d A j x (sample j) + eps j)
    (hpsi : InFittingBall d proxy psi U₀ J sigma) :
    InFittingBall d target psi U₀ J (fun j => tau j + sigma j) := by
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  have _ := hJ_evaluable
  have hproxy :
      InFittingBall d target proxy U₀ J tau :=
    empirical_fitting_ball_inheritance d hd A U U₀ sample J target proxy
      eps tau htau_finite htarget_dom hproxy_dom hU₀ hupper
  exact empirical_proxy_transfer d hd target proxy psi U₀ J tau sigma
    hproxy hpsi

/--
OET anchor: h-55e5b701cc5268a8
**推论（活跃目标散度证书下的经验继承）**
A divergence certificate from one reference target to every active target
transfers the empirical bound pointwise on the same component family.
-/
theorem active_target_divergence_empirical_inheritance
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (beta₀ : β)
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I)
    (tau Delta : I → ENNReal)
    (hDelta_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (Delta j))
    (hfit :
      InFittingBall d (target beta₀) proxy U J tau)
    (hdiv :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U x →
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
          d j ((target beta₀).func x) ((target beta).func x) ≤ Delta j) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U x →
      ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        d j ((target beta).func x) (proxy.func x) ≤ tau j + Delta j := by
  intro x hx beta hbeta j hj
  have _ := hDelta_finite j hj
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle ((target beta).func x) ((target beta₀).func x) (proxy.func x)
  have hdiv_symm :
      d j ((target beta).func x) ((target beta₀).func x) ≤ Delta j := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm ((target beta).func x) ((target beta₀).func x)]
      using hdiv x hx beta hbeta j hj
  calc
    d j ((target beta).func x) (proxy.func x)
        ≤ d j ((target beta).func x) ((target beta₀).func x) +
            d j ((target beta₀).func x) (proxy.func x) := htri
    _ ≤ Delta j + tau j :=
        add_le_add hdiv_symm (hfit.error x hx j hj)
    _ = tau j + Delta j := by
        rw [add_comm]

/--
OET anchor: h-55e5b701cc5268a8
**推论（活跃目标散度证书下的经验继承，正文前提形式）**
Text-faithful form retaining that the selected component family is nonempty.
-/
theorem active_target_divergence_empirical_inheritance_text
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (beta₀ : β)
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I)
    (tau Delta : I → ENNReal)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (hDelta_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (Delta j))
    (hfit :
      InFittingBall d (target beta₀) proxy U J tau)
    (hdiv :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U x →
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
          d j ((target beta₀).func x) ((target beta).func x) ≤ Delta j) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U x →
      ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        d j ((target beta).func x) (proxy.func x) ≤ tau j + Delta j := by
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  exact active_target_divergence_empirical_inheritance
    d hd target beta₀ proxy U J tau Delta hDelta_finite hfit hdiv

/--
OET anchor: h-55e5b701cc5268a8
**推论（活跃目标散度证书下的经验继承，全分量形式）**
When every component is controlled, the active-target pointwise bounds are
exactly a joint fitting certificate for the target family.
-/
theorem active_target_divergence_empirical_joint_fitting
    {β : Type} [Fintype β] [Nonempty β] [Nonempty I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : β → Operator X bot) (beta₀ : β)
    (proxy : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (tau Delta : I → ENNReal)
    (hDelta_finite : ∀ j : I, finite_ennreal (Delta j))
    (hfit : InFullFittingBall d (target beta₀) proxy U tau)
    (hdiv :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ beta : β, beta ∈ active_indices target U x →
        ∀ j : I,
          d j ((target beta₀).func x) ((target beta).func x) ≤ Delta j) :
    JointFitting d target proxy U (fun j => tau j + Delta j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    exact ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr
      ⟨hfit.tolerance_finite j (Set.mem_univ j), hDelta_finite j⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact hfit.proxy_dom hx.1
  · intro x hx beta hbeta j
    exact active_target_divergence_empirical_inheritance
      d hd target beta₀ proxy U Set.univ tau Delta
      (fun q _ => hDelta_finite q) hfit
      (fun x hx beta hbeta j _ => hdiv x hx beta hbeta j)
      x hx.1 beta hbeta j (Set.mem_univ j)

/--
OET anchor: h-d58fb36d7b840be1
**命题（有限采样的补域分歧见证，采样并集）**
The union of all resolved component sample sets.
-/
def sample_union (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I) : Set X :=
  {x | ∃ j : I, j ∈ J ∧ x ∈ sample j}

/--
OET anchor: h-d58fb36d7b840be1
**命题（有限采样的补域分歧见证，零容限相容目标类）**
Target candidates compatible with the current samples at zero tolerance on
the resolved component set.
-/
def zero_tolerance_sample_compatible
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target psi : Operator X bot) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → ∀ x ∈ sample j,
    d j (psi.func x) (target.func x) = 0

/--
OET anchor: h-d58fb36d7b840be1
**命题（有限采样的补域分歧见证，补域改写算子）**
An operator that agrees with the target on the sample union, assigns a chosen
value at one unsampled point, and sends all other points to `bot`.
-/
noncomputable def sample_complement_override
    (target : Operator X bot) (Sbullet : Set X)
    (x₀ value : X) (hx₀_ne_bot : x₀ ≠ bot) : Operator X bot := by
  classical
  refine
    { func := fun x =>
        if x ∈ Sbullet then target.func x else if x = x₀ then value else bot
      preserves_bot := ?_ }
  by_cases hbotS : bot ∈ Sbullet
  · simp [hbotS, target.preserves_bot]
  · have hbot_ne_x₀ : bot ≠ x₀ := by
      intro h
      exact hx₀_ne_bot h.symm
    simp [hbotS, hbot_ne_x₀]

/--
OET anchor: h-d58fb36d7b840be1
**命题（有限采样的补域分歧见证，采样上一致）**
The complement override agrees with the target on the sample union.
-/
theorem sample_complement_override_eq_on_sample
    (target : Operator X bot) (Sbullet : Set X)
    (x₀ value : X) (hx₀_ne_bot : x₀ ≠ bot)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ Sbullet) :
    (sample_complement_override target Sbullet x₀ value hx₀_ne_bot).func x =
      target.func x := by
  classical
  simp [sample_complement_override, hx]

/--
OET anchor: h-d58fb36d7b840be1
**命题（有限采样的补域分歧见证，补域点取值）**
At the selected unsampled point, the complement override takes the chosen
value.
-/
theorem sample_complement_override_value_at
    (target : Operator X bot) (Sbullet : Set X)
    (x₀ value : X) (hx₀_ne_bot : x₀ ≠ bot)
    (hx₀_not_sample : x₀ ∉ Sbullet) :
    (sample_complement_override target Sbullet x₀ value hx₀_ne_bot).func x₀ =
      value := by
  classical
  simp [sample_complement_override, hx₀_not_sample]

/--
OET anchor: h-d58fb36d7b840be1
**命题（有限采样的补域分歧见证）**
If there is an unsampled non-bottom point and a distinguishable output pair,
then two sample-compatible targets can still differ at that point.
-/
theorem finite_sample_complement_underdetermined
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (U : Set X)
    {x₀ a b : X} {ell : I}
    (hx₀U : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hx₀_not_sample : x₀ ∉ sample_union sample J)
    (hx₀_ne_bot : x₀ ≠ bot)
    (hsep : 0 < d ell a b) :
    ∃ psi_a psi_b : Operator X bot,
      zero_tolerance_sample_compatible d target psi_a sample J ∧
      zero_tolerance_sample_compatible d target psi_b sample J ∧
      0 < d ell (psi_a.func x₀) (psi_b.func x₀) := by
  have _ := hx₀U
  let psi_a := sample_complement_override target (sample_union sample J) x₀ a hx₀_ne_bot
  let psi_b := sample_complement_override target (sample_union sample J) x₀ b hx₀_ne_bot
  refine ⟨psi_a, psi_b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj x hx
    have hx_union : x ∈ sample_union sample J := ⟨j, hj, hx⟩
    rw [show psi_a.func x = target.func x from
      sample_complement_override_eq_on_sample target (sample_union sample J)
        x₀ a hx₀_ne_bot hx_union]
    exact (hd j).dist_self (target.func x)
  · intro j hj x hx
    have hx_union : x ∈ sample_union sample J := ⟨j, hj, hx⟩
    rw [show psi_b.func x = target.func x from
      sample_complement_override_eq_on_sample target (sample_union sample J)
        x₀ b hx₀_ne_bot hx_union]
    exact (hd j).dist_self (target.func x)
  · rw [show psi_a.func x₀ = a from
        sample_complement_override_value_at target (sample_union sample J)
          x₀ a hx₀_ne_bot hx₀_not_sample,
      show psi_b.func x₀ = b from
        sample_complement_override_value_at target (sample_union sample J)
          x₀ b hx₀_ne_bot hx₀_not_sample]
    exact hsep

/--
OET anchor: h-c9dea98a2f95fb0c
**推论（经验链的域内累积上界）**
Layerwise empirical fitting balls satisfy the same terminal accumulation bound
as the deterministic in-domain chain recurrence.
-/
theorem empirical_chain_in_domain_accumulation
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Nat → Operator X bot)
    (U : Nat → Set X) (tau : Nat → I → ENNReal)
    (L : Nat → I → I → ENNReal)
    (target_state proxy_state : Nat → X) (k : Nat)
    (hinitial : target_state 0 = proxy_state 0)
    (htarget_step : ∀ n : Nat, n < k →
      target_state (n + 1) = (target n).func (target_state n))
    (hproxy_step : ∀ n : Nat, n < k →
      proxy_state (n + 1) = (proxy n).func (proxy_state n))
    (hfit : ∀ n : Nat, n < k →
      InFullFittingBall d (target n) (proxy n) (U n) (tau n))
    (hL : ∀ n : Nat, n < k → IsLipMatrix d (target n) (U n) (L n))
    (htarget_mem : ∀ n : Nat, n < k → target_state n ∈ U n)
    (hproxy_mem : ∀ n : Nat, n < k → proxy_state n ∈ U n) :
    ∀ j : I,
      d j (target_state k) (proxy_state k) ≤
        ordered_suffix_error_sum L tau k j :=
  in_domain_chain_deviation_accumulation d hd target proxy U tau L
    target_state proxy_state k hinitial htarget_step hproxy_step hfit hL
    htarget_mem hproxy_mem

end formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

files.content:
import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_08_network_fitting.profile_controlled_proxy
import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_10_composition_fitting.external_composition
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_05_operator_networks
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_08_network_fitting
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_10_composition_fitting

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I Net ProfileValue α : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]

/--
OET anchor: h-3a69b1cd5dda780e
**定义（经验误差带内读出前沿，经验可接受候选索引集）**
An index is empirically acceptable when its certified domain contains the
common analysis domain and its network belongs to the profile's admissible set.
-/
def empirical_acceptable_indices
    (cert_domain : α → Set X) (net : α → Net)
    (U₀ : Set X) (admissible : Set Net) : Set α :=
  {a | U₀ ⊆ cert_domain a ∧ net a ∈ admissible}

/--
OET anchor: h-1ebd1372cd7d2bb2
**命题（局部残差次序不决定传播预算）**
The exact finite scalar example from the text.
-/
theorem local_error_order_not_budget_order_example :
    ∃ tau epsA epsB coeffA coeffB : ENNReal,
      epsA < epsB ∧
        ¬ coeffA * epsA ≤ tau ∧
        coeffB * epsB ≤ tau := by
  refine ⟨3, 1, 2, 4, 1, ?_⟩
  norm_num

/--
OET anchor: h-b6d94b9dead3cb6b
**定义（经验误差带内读出前沿）**
Profile comparison between two accepted empirical candidates.
-/
def empirical_profile_le
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue) (net : α → Net)
    (a b : α) : Prop :=
  profile_le Γ (net a) (net b)

/--
OET anchor: h-b6d94b9dead3cb6b
**定义（经验误差带内读出前沿）**
The canonical strict part of the empirical profile preorder between two
accepted candidates.
-/
def empirical_profile_lt
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue) (net : α → Net)
    (a b : α) : Prop :=
  empirical_profile_le Γ net a b ∧ ¬ empirical_profile_le Γ net b a

/--
OET anchor: h-b6d94b9dead3cb6b
**定义（经验误差带内读出前沿）**
The empirical profile front consists of accepted indices not strictly dominated
by another accepted index.
-/
def empirical_profile_front
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue)
    (cert_domain : α → Set X) (net : α → Net)
    (U₀ : Set X) (admissible : Set Net) : Set α :=
  {a | a ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible ∧
    ¬ ∃ b ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
      empirical_profile_lt Γ net b a}

/--
OET anchor: h-b6d94b9dead3cb6b
**命题（经验读出前沿的基本性质）**
The empirical profile preorder is reflexive on the accepted set and transitive
there.
-/
theorem empirical_profile_le_preorder
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue)
    (cert_domain : α → Set X) (net : α → Net)
    (U₀ : Set X) (admissible : Set Net) :
    (∀ a ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
        empirical_profile_le Γ net a a) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
        ∀ b ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
          ∀ c ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
            empirical_profile_le Γ net a b →
              empirical_profile_le Γ net b c →
                empirical_profile_le Γ net a c) := by
  constructor
  · intro a _ha
    exact Γ.le_refl (Γ.read (net a))
  · intro a _ha b _hb c _hc hab hbc
    exact Γ.le_trans hab hbc

/--
OET anchor: h-b6d94b9dead3cb6b
**命题（经验读出前沿的基本性质，严格支配排除）**
A strictly dominated accepted candidate is not in the empirical profile front.
-/
theorem empirical_profile_lt_not_front
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue)
    (cert_domain : α → Set X) (net : α → Net)
    (U₀ : Set X) (admissible : Set Net) {a b : α}
    (ha : a ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible)
    (hb : b ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible)
    (hlt : empirical_profile_lt Γ net b a) :
    a ∉ empirical_profile_front Γ cert_domain net U₀ admissible := by
  have _ := ha
  intro hfront
  exact hfront.2 ⟨b, hb, hlt⟩

/--
OET anchor: h-b6d94b9dead3cb6b
**命题（经验读出前沿的基本性质，有限非空性）**
A nonempty finite accepted set has an undominated candidate.
-/
theorem empirical_profile_front_nonempty
    [Finite α]
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue)
    (cert_domain : α → Set X) (net : α → Net)
    (U₀ : Set X) (admissible : Set Net)
    (hacc :
      (empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible).Nonempty) :
    (empirical_profile_front Γ cert_domain net U₀ admissible).Nonempty := by
  letI : Preorder ProfileValue :=
    { le := Γ.le
      le_refl := Γ.le_refl
      le_trans := fun _ _ _ hab hbc => Γ.le_trans hab hbc }
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
    (Set.toFinite
      (empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible)).exists_minimalFor
      (fun b => Γ.read (net b))
      (empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible)
      hacc
  refine ⟨a, ha.1, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨b, hb, hba⟩
  exact hba.2 (ha.2 hb hba.1)

/--
OET anchor: h-b6d94b9dead3cb6b
**命题（经验读出前沿的基本性质，正文前提版本）**
The text-level wrapper retains the finite nonempty candidate family, nonempty
component set, finite tolerance, and pointwise soundness of each certified set.
-/
theorem empirical_profile_front_basic_properties_text
    [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target : Operator X bot)
    (operator_readout : Net → Operator X bot)
    (Γ : OrderedNetworkProfile Net ProfileValue)
    (cert_domain : α → Set X) (net : α → Net)
    (U₀ : Set X) (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (admissible : Set Net)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → tau j ≠ ⊤)
    (hcert_dom : ∀ a : α, cert_domain a ⊆
      dom (operator_readout (net a)) ∩ dom target)
    (hcert :
      ∀ a : α, ∀ x ∈ cert_domain a, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        d j ((operator_readout (net a)).func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau j) :
    ((∀ a ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
        empirical_profile_le Γ net a a) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
        ∀ b ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
          ∀ c ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible,
            empirical_profile_le Γ net a b →
              empirical_profile_le Γ net b c →
                empirical_profile_le Γ net a c)) ∧
      (∀ a b : α,
        a ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible →
        b ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible →
        empirical_profile_lt Γ net b a →
        a ∉ empirical_profile_front Γ cert_domain net U₀ admissible) ∧
      ((empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible).Nonempty →
        (empirical_profile_front Γ cert_domain net U₀ admissible).Nonempty) := by
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  have _ := htau_finite
  have _ := hcert_dom
  have _ := hcert
  constructor
  · exact empirical_profile_le_preorder Γ cert_domain net U₀ admissible
  · constructor
    · intro a b ha hb hlt
      exact empirical_profile_lt_not_front Γ cert_domain net U₀ admissible
        ha hb hlt
    · exact empirical_profile_front_nonempty Γ cert_domain net U₀ admissible

/-- A candidate accepted by the empirical front has valid outputs and the
specified pointwise error bound on the common analysis domain. -/
theorem empirical_accepted_candidate_sound
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target : Operator X bot)
    (operator_readout : Net → Operator X bot)
    (cert_domain : α → Set X) (net : α → Net)
    (U₀ : Set X) (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (admissible : Set Net)
    (hcert_dom : ∀ a : α, cert_domain a ⊆
      dom (operator_readout (net a)) ∩ dom target)
    (hcert : ∀ a : α, ∀ x ∈ cert_domain a, ∀ j ∈ J,
      d j ((operator_readout (net a)).func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau j)
    {a : α}
    (ha : a ∈ empirical_acceptable_indices cert_domain net U₀ admissible) :
    U₀ ⊆ dom (operator_readout (net a)) ∩ dom target ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U₀, ∀ j ∈ J,
        d j ((operator_readout (net a)).func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau j := by
  exact ⟨fun _ hx => hcert_dom a (ha.1 hx),
    fun x hx j hj => hcert a x (ha.1 hx) j hj⟩

end formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification

files.name: formal_oet/vol_03/ch_13_comparison_and_falsification/candidate_family.lean
files.content:
import formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I Aidx : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]

/--
OET anchor: h-7fe1ddd2b091e405
**定义（候选代理族）**
A candidate proxy family is represented by a finite nonempty index type and a
proxy operator at each index.
-/
structure CandidateProxyFamily (X : Type) (bot : X) (Aidx : Type)
    [Fintype Aidx] [Nonempty Aidx] where
  proxy : Aidx → Operator X bot

/--
OET anchor: h-7fe1ddd2b091e405
**定义（一致性轮廓）**
The componentwise candidate-family consistency profile.
-/
noncomputable def consistency_profile
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (proxy : Aidx → Operator X bot) (j : I) (x : X) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ alpha : Aidx, ⨆ beta : Aidx,
    d j ((proxy alpha).func x) ((proxy beta).func x)

/--
OET anchor: h-7fe1ddd2b091e405
**定义（一致性轮廓，单点候选族）**
For a singleton candidate family, the consistency profile is identically zero.
-/
theorem consistency_profile_eq_zero_of_subsingleton
    [Subsingleton Aidx]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (proxy : Aidx → Operator X bot) (j : I) (x : X) :
    consistency_profile d proxy j x = 0 := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold consistency_profile
    apply iSup_le
    intro alpha
    apply iSup_le
    intro beta
    have hbeta : beta = alpha := Subsingleton.elim beta alpha
    subst beta
    exact le_of_eq ((hd j).dist_self ((proxy alpha).func x))
  · exact zero_le _

/--
OET anchor: h-0d1d36e9b079b4af
**命题（一致性轮廓的目标证书上界）**
If every candidate fits the same target on `U` over `J`, candidate disagreement
is bounded by the supremum of the pairwise tolerance sums.
-/
theorem consistency_profile_target_certificate_upper
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot) (proxy : Aidx → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (J : Set I) (tau : Aidx → I → ENNReal)
    (hfit : ∀ alpha : Aidx, InFittingBall d target (proxy alpha) U J (tau alpha)) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
      consistency_profile d proxy j x ≤
        ⨆ alpha : Aidx, ⨆ beta : Aidx, tau alpha j + tau beta j := by
  intro x hx j hj
  unfold consistency_profile
  apply iSup_le
  intro alpha
  apply iSup_le
  intro beta
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle ((proxy alpha).func x) (target.func x) ((proxy beta).func x)
  have halpha :
      d j ((proxy alpha).func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau alpha j := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm ((proxy alpha).func x) (target.func x)]
      using (hfit alpha).error x hx j hj
  have hbeta :
      d j (target.func x) ((proxy beta).func x) ≤ tau beta j :=
    (hfit beta).error x hx j hj
  have hpair :
      d j ((proxy alpha).func x) ((proxy beta).func x) ≤
        tau alpha j + tau beta j :=
    le_trans htri (add_le_add halpha hbeta)
  exact le_trans hpair
      (le_trans
        (le_iSup (fun beta : Aidx => tau alpha j + tau beta j) beta)
      (le_iSup (fun alpha : Aidx => ⨆ beta : Aidx, tau alpha j + tau beta j) alpha))

/--
OET anchor: h-0d1d36e9b079b4af
**命题（一致性轮廓的目标证书上界，正文前提版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining the finite nonempty candidate family, nonempty
component set, and finite tolerance assumptions.
-/
theorem consistency_profile_target_certificate_upper_text
    [Fintype Aidx] [Nonempty Aidx]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot) (family : CandidateProxyFamily X bot Aidx)
    (U : Set X) (J : Set I) (tau : Aidx → I → ENNReal)
    (hJne : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ alpha : Aidx, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau alpha j))
    (hfit : ∀ alpha : Aidx, InFittingBall d target (family.proxy alpha) U J (tau alpha)) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
      consistency_profile d family.proxy j x ≤
        ⨆ alpha : Aidx, ⨆ beta : Aidx, tau alpha j + tau beta j := by
  have _ := hJne
  have _ := htau_finite
  exact consistency_profile_target_certificate_upper d hd target family.proxy U J tau hfit

/--
OET anchor: h-0d1d36e9b079b4af
**命题（一致性轮廓的目标证书上界，统一阈值版本）**
If all candidate tolerances are bounded by one vector, the consistency profile
is bounded by twice that vector component.
-/
theorem consistency_profile_uniform_target_certificate_upper
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot) (proxy : Aidx → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (J : Set I) (tau : Aidx → I → ENNReal)
    (tau₀ : I → ENNReal)
    (hfit : ∀ alpha : Aidx, InFittingBall d target (proxy alpha) U J (tau alpha))
    (htau : ∀ alpha : Aidx, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → tau alpha j ≤ tau₀ j) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
      consistency_profile d proxy j x ≤ tau₀ j + tau₀ j := by
  intro x hx j hj
  unfold consistency_profile
  apply iSup_le
  intro alpha
  apply iSup_le
  intro beta
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle ((proxy alpha).func x) (target.func x) ((proxy beta).func x)
  have halpha :
      d j ((proxy alpha).func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau alpha j := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm ((proxy alpha).func x) (target.func x)]
      using (hfit alpha).error x hx j hj
  have hbeta :
      d j (target.func x) ((proxy beta).func x) ≤ tau beta j :=
    (hfit beta).error x hx j hj
  exact le_trans (le_trans htri (add_le_add halpha hbeta))
    (add_le_add (htau alpha j hj) (htau beta j hj))

/--
OET anchor: h-4c09ebab1364ae8a
**命题（证书上界子水平集的比较，矩阵向量单调性）**
The finite matrix-vector action is monotone in the matrix argument.
-/
theorem matrix_vector_bound_mono_matrix
    (A B : I → I → ENNReal) (v : I → ENNReal)
    (hAB : ∀ i j : I, A i j ≤ B i j) :
    ∀ j : I, matrix_vector_bound A v j ≤ matrix_vector_bound B v j := by
  intro j
  unfold matrix_vector_bound
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
    exact mul_le_mul_left (hAB i j) (v i)

/--
OET anchor: h-4c09ebab1364ae8a
**命题（证书上界子水平集的比较，共同锚点距离单调性）**
Pointwise matrix dominance implies dominance of the common-anchor distance.
-/
theorem weighted_anchor_distance_mono_matrix
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A B : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (x : X) (sample : Set X)
    (hAB : ∀ i j : I, A i j ≤ B i j) :
    weighted_anchor_distance d A j x sample ≤
      weighted_anchor_distance d B j x sample := by
  unfold weighted_anchor_distance
  apply le_iInf
  intro y
  exact le_trans
    (iInf_le
      (fun z : {z // z ∈ sample} =>
        matrix_vector_bound A (fun i => d i x z.1) j)
      y)
    (matrix_vector_bound_mono_matrix A B (fun i => d i x y.1) hAB j)

/--
OET anchor: h-4c09ebab1364ae8a
**命题（证书上界子水平集的比较，逐点证书上界）**
The scalar certificate upper bound obtained by adding a weighted common-anchor
term and a residual level.
-/
noncomputable def point_certificate_bound
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (sample : Set X)
    (eps : ENNReal) (j : I) (x : X) : ENNReal :=
  weighted_anchor_distance d A j x sample + eps

/--
OET anchor: h-4c09ebab1364ae8a
**命题（证书上界子水平集的比较，逐点证书界）**
If one proxy has no larger common-anchor term and no larger empirical residual,
then its pointwise certificate upper bound is no larger.
-/
theorem point_certificate_bound_le_of_matrix_and_residual_le
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A B : I → I → ENNReal) (sample : I → Set X)
    (epsA epsB : I → ENNReal)
    (hAB : ∀ i j : I, A i j ≤ B i j)
    (heps : ∀ j : I, epsA j ≤ epsB j) :
    ∀ x : X, ∀ j : I,
      weighted_anchor_distance d A j x (sample j) + epsA j ≤
        weighted_anchor_distance d B j x (sample j) + epsB j := by
  intro x j
  exact add_le_add (weighted_anchor_distance_mono_matrix d A B j x (sample j) hAB)
    (heps j)

/--
OET anchor: h-4c09ebab1364ae8a
**命题（证书上界子水平集的比较）**
Pointwise comparison of certificate upper bounds gives reverse inclusion of
the corresponding guarantee domains.
-/
theorem empirical_guarantee_domain_subset_of_certificate_bound_le
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (Abetter Aworse : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps_better eps_worse tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hbound :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        weighted_anchor_distance d Abetter j x (sample j) + eps_better j ≤
          weighted_anchor_distance d Aworse j x (sample j) + eps_worse j) :
    empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d Aworse U sample J eps_worse tau ⊆
      empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d Abetter U sample J eps_better tau := by
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  exact le_trans (hbound x hx.1 j hj) (hx.2 j hj)

/--
OET anchor: h-4c09ebab1364ae8a
**命题（证书上界子水平集的比较，正文前提版本）**
The text-level statement retains the nonempty evaluable component family and
finite threshold vector.
-/
theorem empirical_guarantee_domain_subset_of_certificate_bound_le_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (Abetter Aworse : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps_better eps_worse tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (hJ_evaluable : J ⊆ evaluable_components sample)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (hbound :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
        weighted_anchor_distance d Abetter j x (sample j) + eps_better j ≤
          weighted_anchor_distance d Aworse j x (sample j) + eps_worse j) :
    empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d Aworse U sample J eps_worse tau ⊆
      empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d Abetter U sample J eps_better tau := by
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  have _ := hJ_evaluable
  have _ := htau_finite
  exact empirical_guarantee_domain_subset_of_certificate_bound_le
    d Abetter Aworse U sample J eps_better eps_worse tau hbound

/--
OET anchor: h-4c09ebab1364ae8a
**命题（证书上界子水平集的比较，矩阵与残差特例）**
Pointwise matrix and residual dominance imply the text-level sublevel-set
inclusion.
-/
theorem empirical_guarantee_domain_subset_of_matrix_and_residual_le_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (Abetter Aworse : I → I → ENNReal) (U : Set X)
    (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eps_better eps_worse tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (hJ_evaluable : J ⊆ evaluable_components sample)
    (htau_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau j))
    (hA : ∀ i j : I, Abetter i j ≤ Aworse i j)
    (heps : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → eps_better j ≤ eps_worse j) :
    empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d Aworse U sample J eps_worse tau ⊆
      empirical_joint_guarantee_domain d Abetter U sample J eps_better tau := by
  refine empirical_guarantee_domain_subset_of_certificate_bound_le_text
    d Abetter Aworse U sample J eps_better eps_worse tau
    hJ_nonempty hJ_evaluable htau_finite ?_
  intro x _hx j hj
  exact add_le_add
    (weighted_anchor_distance_mono_matrix d Abetter Aworse j x (sample j) hA)
    (heps j hj)

/--
OET anchor: h-4c09ebab1364ae8a
**命题（证书上界子水平集的比较，单点阈值分离）**
A threshold between two pointwise certificate bounds puts a point in one
sublevel set and outside the other.
-/
theorem point_certificate_threshold_separates_domains
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (Abetter Aworse : I → I → ENNReal) (U sample : Set X)
    (eps_better eps_worse tau : ENNReal) (j : I) {x : X}
    (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (hbetter :
      point_certificate_bound d Abetter sample eps_better j x ≤ tau)
    (hworse :
      tau < point_certificate_bound d Aworse sample eps_worse j x) :
    x ∈ empirical_component_guarantee_domain d Abetter U sample j eps_better tau ∧
      x ∉ empirical_component_guarantee_domain d Aworse U sample j eps_worse tau := by
  constructor
  · exact ⟨hxU, hbetter⟩
  · intro hx
    exact not_lt_of_ge hx.2 hworse

/--
OET anchor: h-02d097fade9a1b7a
**定义（选择规则与选择稳定性证书）**
A selection-stability certificate records that the selected proxies at two data
states are both defined on `U` and are componentwise close there.
-/
structure SelectionStabilityCertificate
    {D : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (selector : D → Operator X bot)
    (U : Set X) (J : Set I) (sigma : I → ENNReal)
    (data₁ data₂ : D) : Prop where
  tolerance_finite : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → finite_ennreal (sigma j)
  left_dom : U ⊆ dom (selector data₁)
  right_dom : U ⊆ dom (selector data₂)
  bound :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J →
      d j ((selector data₁).func x) ((selector data₂).func x) ≤ sigma j

/--
OET anchor: h-02d097fade9a1b7a
**命题（选择稳定性的拟合传递）**
If the selected proxy at one data state fits the target, and the selection rule
is stable between two data states, then the selected proxy at the second data
state fits with the sum tolerance.
-/
theorem selection_stability_transfers_fitting
    {D : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (selector : D → Operator X bot)
    (target : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I)
    (tau sigma : I → ENNReal) (data₁ data₂ : D)
    (hfit : InFittingBall d target (selector data₁) U J tau)
    (hstable :
      SelectionStabilityCertificate d selector U J sigma data₁ data₂) :
    InFittingBall d target (selector data₂) U J (fun j => tau j + sigma j) := by
  refine ⟨?_, hfit.target_dom, hstable.right_dom, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    exact ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr
      ⟨hfit.tolerance_finite j hj, hstable.tolerance_finite j hj⟩
  intro x hx j hj
  have htri :=
    (hd j).triangle (target.func x) ((selector data₁).func x) ((selector data₂).func x)
  exact le_trans htri
    (add_le_add (hfit.error x hx j hj) (hstable.bound x hx j hj))

/--
OET anchor: h-02d097fade9a1b7a
**命题（选择稳定性的拟合传递，正文前提版本）**
The text-level statement retains the nonempty component family.
-/
theorem selection_stability_transfers_fitting_text
    {D : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (selector : D → Operator X bot)
    (target : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (J : Set I)
    (tau sigma : I → ENNReal) (data₁ data₂ : D)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (hfit : InFittingBall d target (selector data₁) U J tau)
    (hstable :
      SelectionStabilityCertificate d selector U J sigma data₁ data₂) :
    InFittingBall d target (selector data₂) U J (fun j => tau j + sigma j) := by
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  exact selection_stability_transfers_fitting d hd selector target U J
    tau sigma data₁ data₂ hfit hstable

end formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification

import formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification.sampling_falsification
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]

/--
OET anchor: h-16c8c408719ed50b
**定义（采样相容类）**
The tolerant sample-compatible class determined by component samples, labels,
component set, and tolerance vector.
-/
def sample_compatible_class
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (label : X → X) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eta : I → ENNReal) (psi : Operator X bot) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → ∀ x ∈ sample j,
    d j (psi.func x) (label x) ≤ eta j

/--
OET anchor: h-16c8c408719ed50b
**定义（相容类上的样本可识别性）**
A property is sample-identifiable on a compatible class exactly when it has
the same truth value for every two members of that class.
-/
def SampleIdentifiable
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (label : X → X) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eta : I → ENNReal) (P : Operator X bot → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v : Operator X bot,
    sample_compatible_class d label sample J eta u →
    sample_compatible_class d label sample J eta v →
    (P u ↔ P v)

/--
OET anchor: h-16c8c408719ed50b
**定义（采样相容类，零容限退化）**
Zero-tolerance compatibility with a target is the corresponding specialization
of the tolerant compatible class.
-/
theorem zero_tolerance_sample_compatible_is_compatible_class
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (target psi : Operator X bot) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (h : zero_tolerance_sample_compatible d target psi sample J) :
    sample_compatible_class d target.func sample J (fun _ => 0) psi := by
  intro j hj x hx
  exact le_of_eq (h j hj x hx)

/--
OET anchor: h-144749b31a4914e1
**命题（采样相容类的非识别性，零容限情形）**
The finite-sample complement construction at `h-d58fb36d7b840be1` supplies two
zero-tolerance-compatible targets that differ at an unsampled point.
-/
theorem zero_tolerance_sample_nonidentification_from_unsampled_point
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (U : Set X)
    {x₀ a b : X} {ell : I}
    (hx₀U : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hx₀_not_sample : x₀ ∉ sample_union sample J)
    (hx₀_ne_bot : x₀ ≠ bot)
    (hsep : 0 < d ell a b) :
    ∃ psi_a psi_b : Operator X bot,
      zero_tolerance_sample_compatible d target psi_a sample J ∧
      zero_tolerance_sample_compatible d target psi_b sample J ∧
      0 < d ell (psi_a.func x₀) (psi_b.func x₀) :=
  finite_sample_complement_underdetermined d hd target sample J U
    hx₀U hx₀_not_sample hx₀_ne_bot hsep

/--
OET anchor: h-144749b31a4914e1
**命题（采样相容类的非识别性，零容限正文版本）**
The text-level statement retains the nonempty component family.
-/
theorem zero_tolerance_sample_nonidentification_from_unsampled_point_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (U : Set X)
    {x₀ a b : X} {ell : I}
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (hx₀U : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hx₀_not_sample : x₀ ∉ sample_union sample J)
    (hx₀_ne_bot : x₀ ≠ bot)
    (hsep : 0 < d ell a b) :
    ∃ psi_a psi_b : Operator X bot,
      zero_tolerance_sample_compatible d target psi_a sample J ∧
      zero_tolerance_sample_compatible d target psi_b sample J ∧
      0 < d ell (psi_a.func x₀) (psi_b.func x₀) := by
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  exact zero_tolerance_sample_nonidentification_from_unsampled_point
    d hd target sample J U hx₀U hx₀_not_sample hx₀_ne_bot hsep

/--
OET anchor: h-144749b31a4914e1
**命题（采样相容类的非识别性）**
If a property is not constant on a compatible class, then it is not uniquely
determined by that class.
-/
theorem property_not_unique_on_compatible_of_witness
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (label : X → X) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eta : I → ENNReal) (P : Operator X bot → Prop)
    {psi chi : Operator X bot}
    (hpsi : sample_compatible_class d label sample J eta psi)
    (hchi : sample_compatible_class d label sample J eta chi)
    (hPpsi : P psi) (hPchi : ¬ P chi) :
    ¬ SampleIdentifiable d label sample J eta P := by
  intro hconstant
  exact hPchi ((hconstant psi chi hpsi hchi).1 hPpsi)

/--
OET anchor: h-144749b31a4914e1
**命题（采样相容类的非识别性，性质正文版本）**
The text-level property statement retains the nonempty component family.
-/
theorem property_not_unique_on_compatible_of_witness_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (label : X → X) (sample : I → Set X) (J : Set I)
    (eta : I → ENNReal) (P : Operator X bot → Prop)
    {psi chi : Operator X bot}
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (hpsi : sample_compatible_class d label sample J eta psi)
    (hchi : sample_compatible_class d label sample J eta chi)
    (hPpsi : P psi) (hPchi : ¬ P chi) :
    ¬ SampleIdentifiable d label sample J eta P := by
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  exact property_not_unique_on_compatible_of_witness
    d label sample J eta P hpsi hchi hPpsi hPchi

/--
OET anchor: h-16c8c408719ed50b
**定义（潜在采样坐标与潜在输出集，可见纤维）**
The hidden coordinates whose visible readout equals a fixed visible input.
-/
def visible_fiber {Z : Type} (pi : Z → X) (x : X) : Set Z :=
  {z | pi z = x}

/--
OET anchor: h-16c8c408719ed50b
**定义（潜在采样坐标与潜在输出集）**
The set of target outputs obtained from hidden coordinates over one visible
input.
-/
def latent_output_set {Z : Type} (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X) (x : X) : Set X :=
  theta '' visible_fiber pi x

/--
OET anchor: h-16c8c408719ed50b
**定义（潜在纤维冲突集）**
The visible inputs whose hidden fiber contains two outputs separated by more
than twice the tolerance.  Lean writes `2 ε` as `ε + ε`.
-/
def hidden_fiber_conflict {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X)
    (j : I) (eps : ENNReal) : Set X :=
  {x | ∃ z₁ ∈ visible_fiber pi x, ∃ z₂ ∈ visible_fiber pi x,
    eps + eps < d j (theta z₁) (theta z₂)}

/--
OET anchor: h-9c7dcb61b93679c7
**命题（表观多值冲突的单值拟合阻断，点对形式）**
Two hidden outputs separated by more than `2 ε` cannot both be fitted by one
visible output within `ε`.
-/
theorem no_single_value_fit_of_hidden_fiber_pair_gap {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X)
    {x y : X} {z₁ z₂ : Z} {j : I} {eps : ENNReal}
    (hz₁ : z₁ ∈ visible_fiber pi x)
    (hz₂ : z₂ ∈ visible_fiber pi x)
    (hgap : eps + eps < d j (theta z₁) (theta z₂))
    (hy₁ : d j y (theta z₁) ≤ eps)
    (hy₂ : d j y (theta z₂) ≤ eps) :
    False := by
  have _ := hz₁
  have _ := hz₂
  have hy₁_symm : d j (theta z₁) y ≤ eps := by
    simpa [(hd j).symm (theta z₁) y] using hy₁
  have hupper :
      d j (theta z₁) (theta z₂) ≤ eps + eps := by
    exact le_trans ((hd j).triangle (theta z₁) y (theta z₂))
      (add_le_add hy₁_symm hy₂)
  exact not_lt_of_ge hupper hgap

/--
OET anchor: h-9c7dcb61b93679c7
**命题（表观多值冲突的单值拟合阻断，正文点对版本）**
The text-level statement retains the finite tolerance and expresses
nonexistence as the negation of simultaneous fitting.
-/
theorem no_single_value_fit_of_hidden_fiber_pair_gap_text {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X)
    (J : Set I) {x y : X} {z₁ z₂ : Z} {j : I} {eps : ENNReal}
    (hj : j ∈ J)
    (heps_finite : finite_ennreal eps)
    (hz₁ : z₁ ∈ visible_fiber pi x)
    (hz₂ : z₂ ∈ visible_fiber pi x)
    (hgap : eps + eps < d j (theta z₁) (theta z₂)) :
    ¬ (d j y (theta z₁) ≤ eps ∧ d j y (theta z₂) ≤ eps) := by
  have _ := hj
  have _ := heps_finite
  intro hfit
  exact no_single_value_fit_of_hidden_fiber_pair_gap d hd pi theta
    hz₁ hz₂ hgap hfit.1 hfit.2

/--
OET anchor: h-9c7dcb61b93679c7
**命题（表观多值冲突的单值拟合阻断，纤维形式）**
A visible output fits a whole hidden fiber at tolerance `eps` when it fits every
hidden coordinate over that visible input.
-/
def single_value_fits_visible_fiber {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X)
    (j : I) (eps : ENNReal) (x y : X) : Prop :=
  ∀ z ∈ visible_fiber pi x, d j y (theta z) ≤ eps

/--
OET anchor: h-9c7dcb61b93679c7
**命题（表观多值冲突的单值拟合阻断）**
Membership in the hidden-fiber conflict set excludes every single visible
output from fitting the whole hidden fiber.
-/
theorem not_single_value_fits_visible_fiber_of_hidden_conflict {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X)
    {j : I} {eps : ENNReal} {x y : X}
    (hx : x ∈ hidden_fiber_conflict d pi theta j eps) :
    ¬ single_value_fits_visible_fiber d pi theta j eps x y := by
  intro hfit
  rcases hx with ⟨z₁, hz₁, z₂, hz₂, hgap⟩
  exact no_single_value_fit_of_hidden_fiber_pair_gap d hd pi theta
    hz₁ hz₂ hgap (hfit z₁ hz₁) (hfit z₂ hz₂)

/--
OET anchor: h-9c7dcb61b93679c7
**命题（表观多值冲突的单值拟合阻断，代理形式）**
If a visible input lies in the hidden conflict set, the value of any
single-valued proxy at that input cannot fit the whole hidden fiber.
-/
theorem not_proxy_fits_visible_fiber_of_hidden_conflict {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X) (proxy : Operator X bot)
    {j : I} {eps : ENNReal} {x : X}
    (hxdom : x ∈ dom proxy)
    (hx : x ∈ hidden_fiber_conflict d pi theta j eps) :
    ¬ single_value_fits_visible_fiber d pi theta j eps x (proxy.func x) := by
  have _ := hxdom
  exact not_single_value_fits_visible_fiber_of_hidden_conflict d hd pi theta hx

/--
OET anchor: h-9c7dcb61b93679c7
**命题（表观多值冲突的单值拟合阻断，正文代理版本）**
The proxy specialization retains the finite tolerance and domain condition.
-/
theorem not_proxy_fits_visible_fiber_of_hidden_conflict_text {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X) (proxy : Operator X bot) (J : Set I)
    {j : I} {eps : ENNReal} {x : X}
    (hj : j ∈ J)
    (heps_finite : finite_ennreal eps)
    (hxdom : x ∈ dom proxy)
    (hx : x ∈ hidden_fiber_conflict d pi theta j eps) :
    ¬ single_value_fits_visible_fiber d pi theta j eps x (proxy.func x) := by
  have _ := hj
  have _ := heps_finite
  exact not_proxy_fits_visible_fiber_of_hidden_conflict d hd pi theta proxy hxdom hx

/--
OET anchor: h-069c6fb0beae6a3e
**命题（潜在纤维截面的零测距等价性，截面目标）**
The visible target induced by a hidden-coordinate selector.
-/
def visible_target_of_section {Z : Type} (theta : Z → X) (sel : X → Z) : X → X :=
  fun x => theta (sel x)

/--
OET anchor: h-069c6fb0beae6a3e
**命题（潜在纤维截面的零测距等价性）**
If every hidden fiber is zero-distance on the chosen component set, then any
two visible sections induce zero-equivalent visible targets on that set.
-/
theorem latent_zero_fiber_sections_equivalent {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X) (U : Set X) (J₀ : Set I)
    (section₁ section₂ : X → Z)
    (hzero :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ z₁ ∈ visible_fiber pi x, ∀ z₂ ∈ visible_fiber pi x,
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J₀ → d j (theta z₁) (theta z₂) = 0)
    (hsection₁ : ∀ x ∈ U, section₁ x ∈ visible_fiber pi x)
    (hsection₂ : ∀ x ∈ U, section₂ x ∈ visible_fiber pi x) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J₀ →
      d j (visible_target_of_section theta section₁ x)
        (visible_target_of_section theta section₂ x) = 0 := by
  intro x hx j hj
  exact hzero x hx (section₁ x) (hsection₁ x hx)
    (section₂ x) (hsection₂ x hx) j hj

/--
OET anchor: h-069c6fb0beae6a3e
**命题（潜在纤维截面的零测距等价性，正文前提版本）**
Sections are defined only on `U`, and the nonempty component family is retained
exactly as in the text.
-/
theorem latent_zero_fiber_subtype_sections_equivalent_text {Z : Type}
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (pi : Z → X) (theta : Z → X) (U : Set X) (J J₀ : Set I)
    (section₁ section₂ : {x : X // x ∈ U} → Z)
    (hJ₀_subset : J₀ ⊆ J)
    (hJ₀_nonempty : J₀.Nonempty)
    (hzero :
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ z₁ ∈ visible_fiber pi x, ∀ z₂ ∈ visible_fiber pi x,
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J₀ → d j (theta z₁) (theta z₂) = 0)
    (hsection₁ : ∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ U}, pi (section₁ x) = x.1)
    (hsection₂ : ∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ U}, pi (section₂ x) = x.1) :
    ∀ x : {x : X // x ∈ U}, ∀ j : I, j ∈ J₀ →
      d j (theta (section₁ x)) (theta (section₂ x)) = 0 := by
  have _ := hJ₀_subset
  have _ := hJ₀_nonempty
  intro x j hj
  exact hzero x.1 x.2 (section₁ x) (hsection₁ x)
    (section₂ x) (hsection₂ x) j hj

end formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification

import formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations.fitting_ball
import formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification.compatibility_identifiability
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false
set_option linter.unusedFintypeInType false

namespace formal_oet.vol_03.ch_13_comparison_and_falsification

open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_01_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_02_operator_bounds
open formal_oet.vol_01.ch_04_operator_chain_calculus
open formal_oet.vol_02.ch_07_fitting_foundations
open formal_oet.vol_03.ch_12_residuals_and_substitution

open scoped BigOperators

variable {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]

/--
OET anchor: h-9b65ffd51c5a2abc
**定义（加权锚点覆盖数，覆盖集合）**
A finite nonempty subset of `U` whose common-anchor distance covers every point
of `U` at level `eps`.
-/
def weighted_covering_set
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (eps : ENNReal)
    (U E : Set X) : Prop :=
  E ⊆ U ∧ E.Nonempty ∧ E.Finite ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, weighted_anchor_distance d A j x E ≤ eps

/--
OET anchor: h-9b65ffd51c5a2abc
**定义（加权锚点覆盖数）**
The weighted covering number, with value `0` on the empty set and `⊤` when no
finite cover exists.
-/
noncomputable def weighted_cover_number
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (eps : ENNReal)
    (U : Set X) : ENNReal :=
  if U = ∅ then 0
  else
    ⨅ E : {E : Set X // weighted_covering_set d A j eps U E},
      (E.1.ncard : ENNReal)

/--
OET anchor: h-9b65ffd51c5a2abc
**定义（加权锚点覆盖数，空集）**
The weighted covering number of the empty set is zero.
-/
theorem weighted_cover_number_empty
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (eps : ENNReal) :
    weighted_cover_number d A j eps (∅ : Set X) = 0 := by

**定义（留出分解）**

structure HoldoutSplit
    (sample train validation : I → Set X) (J : Set I) : Prop where
  train_subset : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → train j ⊆ sample j
  validation_subset : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → validation j ⊆ sample j
  disjoint : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → Disjoint (train j) (validation j)
  union_eq : ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → sample j = train j ∪ validation j

point that lies in the working domain.

    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot) (U V : Set X)
    (train validation : I → Set X)
    (Lp Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (eps_tr : I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hU : U ⊆ V)
    (htrain : train j ⊆ U)
    (hLp : IsLipMatrix d proxy U Lp)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target V Lstar)
    (hres : EmpiricalResidualBound d target proxy train eps_tr)
    (hj : j ∈ evaluable_components train)
    {xv : X} (hxv : xv ∈ validation j ∩ U) :

      weighted_anchor_distance d (fun i j => Lp i j + Lstar i j) j xv (train j) +
        eps_tr j := by
  exact empirical_target_perturbation_upper_point_from_residual_certificate
    d hd target proxy U V train Lp Lstar eps_tr j hU htrain hLp hLstar hres hj
    xv hxv.2

    (train : I → Set X)

OET anchor: h-0056e459b9376864
**定义（路径分量经验保证域）**
The empirical guarantee domain for one component on one proxy path.
-/
def path_component_empirical_guarantee_domain
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (A : I → I → ENNReal)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (q : N.ReachablePath) (j : I) (eps tau : ENNReal) : Set X :=

theorem path_local_empirical_upper
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (q : N.ReachablePath)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hpathV : N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Lq)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar)
    (hj : j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q) :
    ∀ x ∈ N.path_domain q.nodes,
      d j ((N.path_chain q.nodes).func x) (target.func x) ≤
        weighted_anchor_distance d (fun i j => Lq i j + Lstar i j)
          j x (path_component_sample N sample q j) +
          path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j := by
  have hsample :
      path_sample_family N sample q j ⊆ N.path_domain q.nodes :=
    path_component_sample_subset_path_domain N sample q j
  have hres :
      EmpiricalResidualBound d target (N.path_chain q.nodes)
        (path_sample_family N sample q)
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) := by
    simpa [path_empirical_residual_upper] using
      (empirical_residual_upper_certificate d target (N.path_chain q.nodes)
        (path_sample_family N sample q) delta_o)
  exact empirical_target_perturbation_upper_point_from_residual_certificate
    d hd target (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Vstar
    (path_sample_family N sample q) Lq Lstar
    (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) j
    hpathV hsample hLq hLstar hres hj

/--

If the network represents the proxy, the path-local empirical upper bound is a
pointwise upper bound for the proxy-target deviation on the path.

theorem proxy_path_local_empirical_upper
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (q : N.ReachablePath)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Lq)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar)
    (hj : j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q) :

          path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j := by
  intro x hx
  have hchain :=
    path_chain_eq_represented_proxy_on_path N proxy q hrep hx
  simpa [hchain] using
    (path_local_empirical_upper d hd target N sample delta_o q Vstar Lq Lstar
      j hpathV hLq hLstar hj x hx)

/--

**命题（路径局部经验上界，保证域形式）**
Membership in a path component guarantee domain gives the requested component
tolerance for the path chain.
-/
theorem path_component_guarantee_error_bound
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (q : N.ReachablePath)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq Lstar : I → I → ENNReal)

    (hLq : IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Lq)

    {x : X}

    (fun i j => Lq i j + Lstar i j) (N.path_domain q.nodes)

    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)

    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq Lstar : I → I → ENNReal)
    (j : I) (tau : ENNReal)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)

    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)

    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (q : N.ReachablePath)

    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)

theorem path_positive_deviation_lower_proxy_colip
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (q : N.ReachablePath)

    (hpathV : N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hKq : IsCoLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Kq)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar)
    (hj : j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q)
    {x xs : X}
    (hx : x ∈ N.path_domain q.nodes)
    (hxs : xs ∈ path_component_sample N sample q j)
    (hgap :
      a + matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x xs) j +
          path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j <
        matrix_vector_bound Kq (fun i => d i x xs) j) :
    a < d j ((N.path_chain q.nodes).func x) (target.func x) := by
  have hsample :
      path_sample_family N sample q j ⊆ N.path_domain q.nodes :=
    path_component_sample_subset_path_domain N sample q j
  have hres :
      EmpiricalResidualBound d target (N.path_chain q.nodes)
        (path_sample_family N sample q)
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) := by
    simpa [path_empirical_residual_upper] using
      (empirical_residual_upper_certificate d target (N.path_chain q.nodes)
        (path_sample_family N sample q) delta_o)
  exact empirical_positive_deviation_lower_proxy_colip_from_residual_certificate
    d hd target (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Vstar
    (path_sample_family N sample q) Kq Lstar
    (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) a j
    hpathV hsample hKq hLstar hres hj hx hxs hgap

/--
OET anchor: h-4091a4a3834bf02c
**命题（路径局部正偏差下界证书，目标 co-Lip 形式）**
The symmetric path lower certificate using a target co-Lip lower bound and a
path-chain Lip upper bound.
-/
theorem path_positive_deviation_lower_target_colip
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (q : N.ReachablePath)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Kstar Lq : I → I → ENNReal)
    (a : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hpathV : N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hKstar : TargetCoLipLowerCertificate d target Vstar Kstar)
    (hLq : IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Lq)
    (hj : j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q)
    {x xs : X}
    (hx : x ∈ N.path_domain q.nodes)
    (hxs : xs ∈ path_component_sample N sample q j)
    (hgap :
      a + matrix_vector_bound Lq (fun i => d i x xs) j +
          path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j <
        matrix_vector_bound Kstar (fun i => d i x xs) j) :
    a < d j ((N.path_chain q.nodes).func x) (target.func x) := by
  have hsample :
      path_sample_family N sample q j ⊆ N.path_domain q.nodes :=
    path_component_sample_subset_path_domain N sample q j
  have hres :
      EmpiricalResidualBound d target (N.path_chain q.nodes)
        (path_sample_family N sample q)
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) := by
    simpa [path_empirical_residual_upper] using
      (empirical_residual_upper_certificate d target (N.path_chain q.nodes)
        (path_sample_family N sample q) delta_o)
  exact empirical_positive_deviation_lower_target_colip_from_residual_certificate
    d hd target (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Vstar
    (path_sample_family N sample q) Kstar Lq
    (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) a j
    hpathV hsample hKstar hLq hres hj hx hxs hgap

/--
OET anchor: h-4091a4a3834bf02c
**命题（路径局部正偏差下界证书，代理表示形式）**
When the network represents the proxy, the path-chain lower certificate is a

-/
theorem proxy_path_positive_deviation_lower_proxy_colip
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (q : N.ReachablePath)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Kq Lstar : I → I → ENNReal)
    (a : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hKq : IsCoLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Kq)
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar)
    (hj : j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q)
    {x xs : X}
    (hx : x ∈ N.path_domain q.nodes)
    (hxs : xs ∈ path_component_sample N sample q j)
    (hgap :
      a + matrix_vector_bound Lstar (fun i => d i x xs) j +
          path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j <
        matrix_vector_bound Kq (fun i => d i x xs) j) :
    a < d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) := by
  have hchain :=
    path_chain_eq_represented_proxy_on_path N proxy q hrep hx
  simpa [hchain] using
    (path_positive_deviation_lower_proxy_colip d hd target N sample delta_o q
      Vstar Kq Lstar a j hpathV hKq hLstar hj hx hxs hgap)

/--

**命题（路径局部正偏差下界证书，代理表示正文前提版本）**
Text-faithful wrapper retaining the finite radius condition.
-/
theorem proxy_path_positive_deviation_lower_proxy_colip_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal) (q : N.ReachablePath)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Kq Lstar : I → I → ENNReal)
    (a : ENNReal) (j : I)
    (ha_finite : finite_ennreal a)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hKq : IsCoLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) Kq)

        matrix_vector_bound Kq (fun i => d i x xs) j) :

/--

    (hKstar : TargetCoLipLowerCertificate d target Vstar Kstar)

The union of certified path component guarantee domains is contained in the
true proxy-target component tolerance region.

theorem path_component_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (tau : ENNReal)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q →
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    {x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
      j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
      x ∈ path_component_empirical_guarantee_domain d
        (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q j
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j) tau}
      ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧ d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau} := by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨q, hj, hxq⟩

    proxy_path_component_guarantee_error_bound d hd target proxy N sample

      hLstar hj hxq⟩

The union of path-local joint guarantee domains is contained in the true joint
proxy-target tolerance region.
-/
theorem path_joint_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q →
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    {x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
      J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
      x ∈ path_joint_empirical_guarantee_domain d
        (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q J
        (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) tau}
      ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
        ∀ j : I, j ∈ J → d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau j} := by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨q, hJ, hxq⟩
  refine ⟨N.path_domain_subset_source hxq.1, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hchain :=
    path_chain_eq_represented_proxy_on_path N proxy q hrep hxq.1
  simpa [hchain] using
    (path_joint_guarantee_error_bound d hd target N sample delta_o q
      Vstar (Lq q) Lstar J tau (hpathV q) (hLq q hJ) hLstar hJ hxq j hj)

/--
OET anchor: h-93b9c20ea18b4e59
**推论（路径保证域的全局拟合含义）**
The text-level component and joint conclusions retain finite thresholds and
the nonempty joint component family.
-/
theorem path_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error_text
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal)
    (hd : ∀ j : I, ExtendedPseudoMetric X bot (d j))
    (target proxy : Operator X bot)
    (N : FiniteOperatorNetwork X bot V) (sample : I → Set X)
    (delta_o : I → ENNReal)
    (Vstar : Set X) (Lq : N.ReachablePath → I → I → ENNReal)
    (Lstar : I → I → ENNReal) (j : I) (tau_j : ENNReal)
    (J : Set I) (tau : I → ENNReal)
    (hj_evaluable : j ∈ evaluable_components sample)
    (hJ_evaluable : J ⊆ evaluable_components sample)
    (htau_j_finite : finite_ennreal tau_j)
    (hJ_nonempty : J.Nonempty)
    (htau_finite : ∀ i : I, i ∈ J → finite_ennreal (tau i))
    (hrep : N.represents proxy)
    (hpathV : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath, N.path_domain q.nodes ⊆ Vstar)
    (hLq : ∀ q : N.ReachablePath,
      (j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∨
        J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q) →
      IsLipMatrix d (N.path_chain q.nodes) (N.path_domain q.nodes) (Lq q))
    (hLstar : TargetLipEnvelopeCertificate d target Vstar Lstar) :
    ({x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
        j ∈ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
        x ∈ path_component_empirical_guarantee_domain d
          (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q j
          (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q j) tau_j}
        ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
          d j (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau_j}) ∧
      ({x | ∃ q : N.ReachablePath,
        J ⊆ path_evaluable_components N sample q ∧
        x ∈ path_joint_empirical_guarantee_domain d
          (fun i j => Lq q i j + Lstar i j) N sample q J
          (path_empirical_residual_upper d target N sample delta_o q) tau}
        ⊆ {x | x ∈ N.U ∧
          ∀ i : I, i ∈ J →
            d i (proxy.func x) (target.func x) ≤ tau i}) := by
  have _ := hj_evaluable
  have _ := hJ_evaluable
  have _ := htau_j_finite
  have _ := hJ_nonempty
  have _ := htau_finite
  exact ⟨
    path_component_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error d hd target proxy N
      sample delta_o Vstar Lq Lstar j tau_j hrep hpathV
      (fun q hj => hLq q (Or.inl hj)) hLstar,
    path_joint_guarantee_union_subset_proxy_error d hd target proxy N

      (fun q hJ => hLq q (Or.inr hJ)) hLstar⟩
